    @staticmethod
    def _estimate_message_tokens(m: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        return TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(m)

    @staticmethod
    def extract_world_facts_from_history(history: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[str]:
        facts: List[str] = []
        for m in history:
            raw_c = m.get("content") if m.get("content") is not None else m.get("text", "")
            text = str(raw_c or "")
            if text.startswith("[Системный") or re.match(r'^\[IMAGE[\s_-]PROMPT:', text, re.IGNORECASE):
                continue
            sentences = re.split(r'[.!?\n]+', text)
            for s in sentences:
                s_clean = s.strip().strip('"\'*-–- ')
                if 15 <= len(s_clean) <= 180:
                    for pat in LORE_TRIGGER_PATTERNS:
                        if pat.search(s_clean):
                            s_lower = s_clean.lower()
                            if not any(s_lower in f.lower() or f.lower() in s_lower for f in facts):
                                facts.append(s_clean)
                            break
        return facts[-7:]

    @staticmethod
    def get_dynamic_art_models_protocol() -> str:
        """
        Формирует динамический список активных моделей из data/art_director_models.json.
        Включает только модели с active=True и непустым описанием,
        чтобы пользователь мог прозрачно управлять ими через интерфейс (Ctrl+Shift+M).
        """
        try:
            from services.model_router import ModelRouter
            router = ModelRouter()
            active = [
                m for m in router.profiles
                if m.get("active", True) and (m.get("routing_description") or m.get("description") or "").strip()
            ]
            if not active:
                return "   - cyberrealistic: фотореализм, студия, косплей\n   - realistic: повседневная жизнь"
            lines = []
            for m in active:
                m_id = str(m.get("id", "")).strip()
                desc = (m.get("routing_description") or m.get("description") or m.get("name") or "").strip()
                short_desc = (desc[:75].rsplit(' ', 1)[0] + "...") if len(desc) > 75 else desc
                lines.append(f"   - {m_id}: {short_desc}")
            return "\n".join(lines)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[ContextWindowBuilder] Ошибка чтения моделей для промпта: {e}")
            return "   - cyberrealistic: фотореализм, студия, косплей\n   - realistic: повседневная жизнь\n   - artistic: фэнтези, 3D\n   - anime: 2D аниме"

    @staticmethod
    def build_system_prompt(
        is_roleplay: bool = False,
        character_card: Optional[CharacterCard] = None,
        is_excel: bool = False,
        is_word: bool = False,
        user_name: str = "User",
        include_memory: bool = True,
        session_persona_id: Optional[str] = None,
        is_engineer: bool = False,
        relevant_facts: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        world_facts: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        scene_memory: Optional[str] = None,
        has_vision: bool = False,
        art_guidance: Optional[str] = None,
        active_cast_block: Optional[str] = None,
        recalled_lore_block: Optional[str] = None,
        meta_context_block: Optional[str] = None,
        session_id: Optional[str] = None,
        is_dm_mode: bool = False,
        enable_reasoning: bool = False,
        custom_system_prompt: Optional[str] = None,
        **kwargs
    ) -> str:
        # Single Type normalization
        if isinstance(character_card, dict):
            character_card = CharacterCard.from_dict(character_card)

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # ДОМЕН 1: РОЛЕВОЙ ЧАТ (Делегирование в RoleplayPromptBuilder)
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        if is_roleplay:
            active_persona = UserProfileManager.get_active_user_persona(
                is_roleplay=True,
                session_persona_id=session_persona_id
            )
            if user_name and user_name not in ("User", "Пользователь", "", None):
                effective_user_name = user_name
            else:
                effective_user_name = active_persona.get("name") or "Игрок"

            if not active_cast_block and session_id:
                cast_mgr = RPCastManager
                if hasattr(cast_mgr, "get_cast_prompt_block"):
                    active_cast_block = cast_mgr.get_cast_prompt_block(session_id)
                else:
                    try:
                        from services.session_manager import SessionManager
                        sess = SessionManager._sessions_cache.get(str(session_id)) or SessionManager.load_session(str(session_id))
                        if sess and "cast_data" in sess and hasattr(RPCastManager, "format_cast_data_block"):
                            active_cast_block = RPCastManager.format_cast_data_block(sess["cast_data"])
                    except Exception:
                        pass

            if not custom_system_prompt:
                custom_system_prompt = kwargs.get("custom_system_prompt")
            if not custom_system_prompt and session_id:
                try:
                    from services.session_manager import SessionManager
                    sess = SessionManager._sessions_cache.get(str(session_id)) or SessionManager.load_session(str(session_id))
                    if sess:
                        custom_system_prompt = sess.get("custom_system_prompt")
                except Exception:
                    pass

            return RoleplayPromptBuilder.build(
                character_card=character_card,
                user_name=effective_user_name,
                active_persona=active_persona,
                is_dm_mode=is_dm_mode,
                world_facts=world_facts,
                scene_memory=scene_memory,
                active_cast_block=active_cast_block or "",
                recalled_lore_block=recalled_lore_block or "",
                meta_context_block=meta_context_block or "",
                custom_system_prompt=custom_system_prompt
            )

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # ДОМЕН 2: ИНЖЕНЕР (Изолированная песочница)
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        if is_engineer:
            logger.info("[SysPrompt.Origin] Режим: engineer | Источник: Изолированная песочница Workspace Subagent")
            task_text = kwargs.get("task_prompt", "") or kwargs.get("task_text", "") or kwargs.get("user_message", "") or ""
            return get_engineer_system_prompt(task_text=task_text, is_analysis=kwargs.get("is_analysis", False))

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # ДОМЕН 3: АССИСТЕНТ (Элария + LanceDB)
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        logger.info("[SysPrompt.Origin] Режим: assistant | Источник: Базовая персона Эларии + LanceDB Memory")

        if not custom_system_prompt:
            custom_system_prompt = kwargs.get("custom_system_prompt")
        if not custom_system_prompt and session_id:
            try:
                from services.session_manager import SessionManager
                sess = SessionManager._sessions_cache.get(str(session_id)) or SessionManager.load_session(str(session_id))
                if sess:
                    custom_system_prompt = sess.get("custom_system_prompt")
            except Exception:
                pass

        active_persona = UserProfileManager.get_active_user_persona(
            is_roleplay=False,
            session_persona_id=session_persona_id
        )
        effective_user_name = active_persona.get("name") if user_name in ("User", "Пользователь", "", None) else user_name

        effective_query = (
            kwargs.get("user_query")
            or kwargs.get("task_text")
            or kwargs.get("user_message_text")
            or kwargs.get("task_prompt")
            or kwargs.get("user_message")
            or ""
        )

        return AssistantPromptBuilder.build(
            user_name=effective_user_name or "Пользователь",
            active_persona=active_persona,
            include_memory=include_memory,
            relevant_facts=relevant_facts,
            is_excel=is_excel,
            is_word=is_word,
            knowledge_block=kwargs.get("knowledge_block") or kwargs.get("knowledge_context"),
            matched_knowledge_docs=kwargs.get("matched_knowledge_docs"),
            enable_reasoning=enable_reasoning or kwargs.get("enable_reasoning", False),
            user_query=effective_query,
            session_id=session_id,
            session_metadata=kwargs.get("session_metadata"),
            active_assistant_skill=kwargs.get("active_assistant_skill"),
            custom_prompt=custom_system_prompt
        )

    @staticmethod
    def prepare_history_for_llm(
        history: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        vision_content: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        enable_reasoning: bool = False,
        keep_last_cot: bool = True
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Нормализует историю диалога для инференса LLM:
        - Преобразует сообщения в OpenAI-совместимый список [{"role": ..., "content": ...}]
        - Реализует скользящее сохранение CoT (Sliding CoT Preservation): при enable_reasoning=True и keep_last_cot=True
          сохраняет ровно одно последнее рассуждение <think> ассистента (с защитой от промежуточных ходов галереи [GALERY])
        - Все более ранние рассуждения ассистента санитизирует (<think>.*?</think>), экономя контекстное окно 14K
        - Исключает словарь 'thought' и метаданные размышлений, не подмешивая их в текст модели, кроме целевого CoT
        """
        if not history:
            return []

        # Поиск целевого индекса сообщения ассистента для сохранения CoT
        target_cot_idx = None
        if enable_reasoning and keep_last_cot:
            for idx in range(len(history) - 1, -1, -1):
                raw_m = history[idx]
                role = raw_m.get("role") or ("user" if raw_m.get("is_user") else "assistant")
                if role == "assistant":
                    th = raw_m.get("thought")
                    th_content = ""
                    if isinstance(th, dict):
                        th_content = th.get("content", "")
                    elif isinstance(th, str):
                        th_content = th

                    raw_content = raw_m.get("content") if raw_m.get("content") is not None else raw_m.get("text", "")
                    raw_text_str = ""
                    if isinstance(raw_content, str):
                        raw_text_str = raw_content
                    elif isinstance(raw_content, list):
                        raw_text_str = " ".join(str(p.get("text", "")) for p in raw_content if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("type") == "text")

                    has_thought = bool(th_content and str(th_content).strip())
                    has_think_tag = "<think>" in raw_text_str
                    if has_thought or has_think_tag:
                        target_cot_idx = idx
                        break

        normalized_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for idx, raw_m in enumerate(history):
            m = dict(raw_m)
            role = m.get("role") or ("user" if m.get("is_user") else "assistant")
            content = m.get("content") if m.get("content") is not None else m.get("text", "")
            text = content

            if isinstance(text, list):
                if idx != len(history) - 1 or vision_content is None:
                    txt_parts = [str(p.get("text", "")) for p in text if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("type") == "text"]
                    content_val = " ".join(tp for tp in txt_parts if tp).strip()
                else:
                    content_val = text
            else:
                content_val = str(text or "").strip()

            if role == "assistant":
                if idx == target_cot_idx:
                    # Целевой последний CoT ассистента
                    th = m.get("thought")
                    th_content = ""
                    if isinstance(th, dict):
                        th_content = th.get("content", "")
                    elif isinstance(th, str):
                        th_content = th
                    thought_content = str(th_content or "").strip()

                    if isinstance(content_val, str):
                        if "<think>" in content_val:
                            # Тег уже есть в тексте — сохраняем его
                            if "🔔" in content_val:
                                content_val = re.sub(r'(?:\n|\s)*🔔\s*Напоминаю:[^\n]*', '', content_val).strip()
                        else:
                            # Тег был вырезан или отсутствовал в text, но есть thought_content — восстанавливаем
                            clean_text = content_val
                            if "🔔" in clean_text:
                                clean_text = re.sub(r'(?:\n|\s)*🔔\s*Напоминаю:[^\n]*', '', clean_text).strip()
                            if thought_content:
                                if clean_text:
                                    content_val = f"<think>\n{thought_content}\n</think>\n\n{clean_text}"
                                else:
                                    content_val = f"<think>\n{thought_content}\n</think>"
                            else:
                                content_val = clean_text
                    elif isinstance(content_val, list):
                        has_think_in_list = any("<think>" in str(p.get("text", "")) for p in content_val if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("type") == "text")
                        if not has_think_in_list and thought_content:
                            content_val = [{"type": "text", "text": f"<think>\n{thought_content}\n</think>\n\n"}] + list(content_val)
                else:
                    # Все остальные сообщения ассистента: безусловно вырезаем <think>.*?</think> ради экономии контекста 14K
                    if isinstance(content_val, str):
                        content_val = re.sub(r'<think>.*?</think>', '', content_val, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
                        if "🔔" in content_val:
                            content_val = re.sub(r'(?:\n|\s)*🔔\s*Напоминаю:[^\n]*', '', content_val).strip()
                    elif isinstance(content_val, list):
                        clean_parts = []
                        for part in content_val:
                            if isinstance(part, dict) and part.get("type") == "text":
                                p_txt = str(part.get("text", ""))
                                p_clean = re.sub(r'<think>.*?</think>', '', p_txt, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
                                if p_clean:
                                    part_copy = dict(part)
                                    part_copy["text"] = p_clean
                                    clean_parts.append(part_copy)
                            else:
                                clean_parts.append(part)
                        content_val = clean_parts

            if isinstance(content_val, str) and not content_val and role == "assistant":
                continue

            normalized_history.append({"role": role, "content": content_val})

        return normalized_history

    @staticmethod
    def build_context_messages(
        history: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        *args,
        **kwargs
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Функция сборки сообщений для инференса с санитизацией мыслей.
        Если вызвана только с историей (без аргументов сборки контекста),
        возвращает результат prepare_history_for_llm.
        В остальных случаях собирает полное контекстное окно через get_lm_studio_messages.
        """
        if not args and not kwargs:
            return ContextWindowBuilder.prepare_history_for_llm(history)
        return ContextWindowBuilder.get_lm_studio_messages(history, *args, **kwargs)

    @staticmethod
    def get_lm_studio_messages(
        history: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        is_roleplay: bool = False,
        character_card: Optional[CharacterCard] = None,
        is_excel: bool = False,
        is_word: bool = False,
        vision_content: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        history_limit: int = 35,
        user_name: str = "User",
        include_memory: bool = True,
        session_persona_id: Optional[str] = None,
        is_engineer: bool = False,
        world_facts: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        art_guidance: Optional[str] = None,
        active_cast_block: Optional[str] = None,
        recalled_lore_block: Optional[str] = None,
        meta_context_block: Optional[str] = None,
        session_id: Optional[str] = None,
        is_dm_mode: bool = False,
        max_context_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
        enable_reasoning: bool = False,
        **kwargs
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        history = ContextWindowBuilder.prepare_history_for_llm(
            history=history,
            vision_content=vision_content,
            enable_reasoning=enable_reasoning,
            keep_last_cot=True
        )

        relevant_facts = []
        last_query = ""
        for m in reversed(history):
            if m.get("role") == "user":
                c = m.get("content")
                if isinstance(c, str):
                    clean_c = re.sub(r'\[IMAGE[\s_-]PROMPT:[^\]]+\]', '', c, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()
                    if clean_c.startswith("[Системный") or clean_c.startswith("[Tool"):
                        break
                    if clean_c.lower().startswith(("нарисуй", "покажи", "сгенерируй", "!art", "!арт")):
                        last_query = ""
                        break
                    last_query = clean_c
                    break
                elif isinstance(c, list):
                    text_parts = [str(p.get("text", "")) for p in c if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("type") == "text"]
                    c_text = " ".join(tp.strip() for tp in text_parts if tp.strip())
                    if c_text.startswith("[Системный") or c_text.startswith("[Tool"):
                        break
                    if c_text.lower().startswith(("нарисуй", "покажи", "сгенерируй", "!art", "!арт")):
                        last_query = ""
                        break
                    if c_text:
                        last_query = c_text
                        break

        # Для ассистента: запрашиваем top_k=5 (строго блокируем для roleplay и engineer)
        if not is_roleplay and not is_engineer and include_memory and last_query:
            try:
                relevant_facts = memory_db.search_relevant_facts(last_query, top_k=5)
            except Exception:
                pass

        deep_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        recent_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        scene_memory = ""
        effective_world_facts = world_facts

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # ДОМЕН 1: РОЛЕВОЙ РЕЖИМ (Динамический бюджет и first_mes Pin)
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        if is_roleplay:
            active_p = UserProfileManager.get_active_user_persona(is_roleplay=True, session_persona_id=session_persona_id)
            if user_name and user_name not in ("User", "Пользователь", "", None):
                effective_user_name = user_name
            else:
                effective_user_name = active_p.get("name") or "Игрок"
            companion_name = getattr(character_card, "name", "Спутница") if character_card else "Спутница"

            if character_card:
                # Гарантия сохранения Root Anchor (first_mes карточки) в начале истории
                has_assistant_first = bool(history and history[0].get("role") == "assistant")
                if not has_assistant_first:
                    pool = character_card.get_greetings_pool() if hasattr(character_card, "get_greetings_pool") else []
                    raw_greet = pool[0]["effective"] if pool else (character_card.first_mes_ru or character_card.first_mes or "")
                    if raw_greet and raw_greet.strip():
                        processed_greet = MacroEngine.process(raw_greet.strip(), user_name=effective_user_name, char_name=companion_name)
                        history = [{"role": "assistant", "content": processed_greet}] + list(history)

            # 1. Замена макросов {{user}} и {{char}} во всех репликах истории ДО расчета токенов
            processed_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
            for m in history:
                m_copy = dict(m)
                c = m_copy.get("content")
                if isinstance(c, str):
                    m_copy["content"] = MacroEngine.process(c, user_name=effective_user_name, char_name=companion_name)
                processed_history.append(m_copy)
            history = processed_history

            regex_world_facts = ContextWindowBuilder.extract_world_facts_from_history(history)
            if not effective_world_facts:
                effective_world_facts = regex_world_facts
            else:
                for rf in regex_world_facts:
                    if not any(rf.lower() in ef.lower() for ef in effective_world_facts):
                        effective_world_facts = list(effective_world_facts) + [rf]

            # Семантический поиск LanceDB централизован внутри RPCastManager.scan_and_tick (исключает дублирование)
            scene_memory = ""

            # 2. Предотвращение двойного тика: scan_and_tick строго если контроллер не передал готовые блоки
            if session_id and active_cast_block is None:
                is_env = getattr(character_card, "is_environment", False) if character_card else False

                last_raw = history[-1].get("content", "") if history else ""
                if isinstance(last_raw, list):
                    last_text = " ".join(p.get("text", "") for p in last_raw if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("type") == "text")
                else:
                    last_text = str(last_raw or "")

                scan_blocks = RPCastManager.scan_and_tick(
                    session_id,
                    last_text,
                    user_name=effective_user_name,
                    companion_name=companion_name,
                    is_environment=is_env
                )
                active_cast_block = scan_blocks.get("active_cast", "")
                recalled_lore_block = scan_blocks.get("recalled_lore", "")
                meta_context_block = scan_blocks.get("meta_context", "")

            # 3. Защитная нормализация блоков сцены
            active_cast_block = active_cast_block or ""
            recalled_lore_block = recalled_lore_block or ""
            meta_context_block = meta_context_block or ""

            # Получение актуального контекста спутников и инвентаря для ролевого системного промпта
            cast_context = ""
            cast_mgr = RPCastManager
            session = None
            if session_id:
                try:
                    from services.session_manager import SessionManager
                    session = SessionManager._sessions_cache.get(str(session_id)) or SessionManager.load_session(str(session_id))
                except Exception:
                    session = None

            if cast_mgr and hasattr(cast_mgr, "get_cast_prompt_block") and session_id:
                cast_context = cast_mgr.get_cast_prompt_block(session_id)
            elif session and "cast_data" in session:
                if hasattr(RPCastManager, "format_cast_data_block"):
                    cast_context = RPCastManager.format_cast_data_block(session["cast_data"])
                elif isinstance(session["cast_data"], dict):
                    cast_lines = []
                    if session["cast_data"].get("inventory"):
                        cast_lines.append("Инвентарь: " + ", ".join(session["cast_data"]["inventory"]))
                    cast_context = "\n".join(cast_lines)

            if cast_context:
                if active_cast_block and active_cast_block.strip() and active_cast_block.strip() not in cast_context:
                    active_cast_block = f"{cast_context.strip()}\n\n{active_cast_block.strip()}"
                else:
                    active_cast_block = cast_context.strip()

            # 4. Якорь 1 (Системный промпт): messages[0] (личность, сценарий, правила, mes_example) — никогда не удаляется
            custom_sys_prompt = kwargs.get("custom_system_prompt")
            if not custom_sys_prompt and session_id:
                try:
                    from services.session_manager import SessionManager
                    sess = SessionManager._sessions_cache.get(str(session_id)) or SessionManager.load_session(str(session_id))
                    if sess:
                        custom_sys_prompt = sess.get("custom_system_prompt")
                except Exception:
                    pass

            system_prompt = ContextWindowBuilder.build_system_prompt(
                is_roleplay=True,
                character_card=character_card,
                is_excel=False,
                is_word=False,
                user_name=effective_user_name,
                include_memory=include_memory,
                session_persona_id=session_persona_id,
                is_engineer=False,
                relevant_facts=[],
                world_facts=effective_world_facts,
                scene_memory=scene_memory,
                has_vision=bool(vision_content),
                art_guidance=art_guidance,
                active_cast_block=active_cast_block,
                recalled_lore_block=recalled_lore_block,
                meta_context_block=meta_context_block,
                session_id=session_id,
                is_dm_mode=is_dm_mode,
                task_text=last_query,
                user_query=kwargs.get("user_query") or last_query,
                knowledge_block=kwargs.get("knowledge_block") or kwargs.get("knowledge_context"),
                matched_knowledge_docs=kwargs.get("matched_knowledge_docs"),
                enable_reasoning=enable_reasoning or kwargs.get("enable_reasoning", False),
                custom_system_prompt=custom_sys_prompt
            )
            safe_user_name = str(effective_user_name).strip() if effective_user_name else "пользователь"
            system_content = system_prompt.replace("{user_name}", safe_user_name)
            system_message = {"role": "system", "content": system_content}

            # 5. Определение бюджета токенов max_context_tokens (24K Budget)
            rp_profile = get_mode_profile("roleplay")
            target_ctx_len = int(rp_profile.get("context_length", 24576))
            # Резерв на генерацию ответа модели (обычно 1024–2048 токенов, до 4096)
            configured_max_resp = int(rp_profile.get("sampling", {}).get("max_tokens", 4096))
            generation_reserve = max(1024, min(configured_max_resp, MASTER_MAX_RESPONSE_TOKENS))
            SCENE_INJECTION_RESERVE = 1200
            SAFETY_MARGIN = 128

            max_allowed_context = max(4000, target_ctx_len - generation_reserve - SCENE_INJECTION_RESERVE - SAFETY_MARGIN)

            effective_max_tokens = max_context_tokens if max_context_tokens is not None else kwargs.get("max_context_tokens")
            if effective_max_tokens is None:
                effective_max_tokens = max_allowed_context
            else:
                effective_max_tokens = int(effective_max_tokens)
                # Если передан сырой общий лимит контекста, гарантируем вычет резерва на генерацию
                if effective_max_tokens >= target_ctx_len - generation_reserve:
                    effective_max_tokens = max_allowed_context

            # 6. Архитектура «Трёх якорей» и логика вытеснения из середины (Eviction Zone)
            deep_history = []

            if not history:
                recent_history = []
            elif len(history) <= 14:
                # Если общее количество сообщений в истории <= 14: вытеснение не требуется, возвращаем всю историю целиком
                first_message = history[0]
                recent_tail = list(history[1:])

                total_tokens = (
                    TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(system_message)
                    + TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(first_message)
                    + sum(TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(m) for m in recent_tail)
                )

                if total_tokens > effective_max_tokens:
                    logger.warning(
                        f"[RoleplayEviction] Сообщения истории превышают лимит токенов ({total_tokens} > {effective_max_tokens}) "
                        f"при длине истории {len(history)} <= 14."
                    )

                recent_history = [first_message] + recent_tail
            else:
                # Якорь 2 (Завязка сюжета): Первое сообщение диалога first_message = history[0] (канонический first_mes) — никогда не удаляется
                first_message = history[0]
                # Зона вытеснения: средняя часть диалога
                middle_messages = list(history[1:-12])
                # Якорь 3 (Оперативный контекст): Хвост из последних 12 сообщений recent_tail = history[-12:] — всегда сохраняется для связности диалога
                recent_tail = list(history[-12:])

                total_tokens = (
                    TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(system_message)
                    + TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(first_message)
                    + sum(TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(m) for m in middle_messages)
                    + sum(TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(m) for m in recent_tail)
                )

                # В цикле while удаляем по одному самому старому сообщению из начала middle_messages,
                # пока суммарный объем токенов (system_prompt + first_message + middle_messages + recent_tail)
                # не уложится в заданный бюджет max_context_tokens
                while total_tokens > effective_max_tokens and middle_messages:
                    evicted = middle_messages.pop(0)
                    deep_history.append(evicted)
                    total_tokens -= TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(evicted)

                if total_tokens > effective_max_tokens:
                    logger.warning(
                        f"[RoleplayEviction] Суммарный объем токенов ({total_tokens}) превышает бюджет "
                        f"max_context_tokens ({effective_max_tokens}) даже после полной очистки зоны вытеснения (middle_messages)."
                    )

                # Итоговый список собирается строго в хронологическом порядке:
                # [system_prompt, first_message] + middle_messages + recent_tail
                recent_history = [first_message] + middle_messages + recent_tail

            # 7. Фолбэк-поиск в глубокой истории (если векторная память LanceDB была пуста)
            if not scene_memory and deep_history and last_query:
                lq_lower = last_query.lower()
                if any(t in lq_lower for t in RECALL_TRIGGERS):
                    query_tokens = [
                        w for w in re.findall(r'\b[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ]{3,}\b', lq_lower)
                        if w not in STOP_WORDS_RECALL
                    ]
                    if query_tokens:
                        best_match_text = ""
                        max_overlap = 0
                        for past_m in deep_history:
                            p_content = str(past_m.get("content", "")).strip()
                            if not p_content or p_content.startswith("["):
                                continue
                            p_lower = p_content.lower()
                            overlap = sum(1 for tok in query_tokens if tok in p_lower)
                            if overlap > max_overlap:
                                max_overlap = overlap
                                best_match_text = p_content

                        if max_overlap >= 1 and best_match_text:
                            scene_memory = (best_match_text[:250].strip() + "...") if len(best_match_text) > 250 else best_match_text
                            # Перекомпиляция системного промпта с найденным воспоминанием
                            system_prompt = ContextWindowBuilder.build_system_prompt(
                                is_roleplay=True,
                                character_card=character_card,
                                is_excel=False,
                                is_word=False,
                                user_name=effective_user_name,
                                include_memory=include_memory,
                                session_persona_id=session_persona_id,
                                is_engineer=False,
                                relevant_facts=[],
                                world_facts=effective_world_facts,
                                scene_memory=scene_memory,
                                has_vision=bool(vision_content),
                                art_guidance=art_guidance,
                                active_cast_block=active_cast_block,
                                recalled_lore_block=recalled_lore_block,
                                meta_context_block=meta_context_block,
                                session_id=session_id,
                                is_dm_mode=is_dm_mode,
                                task_text=last_query
                            )
                            system_content = system_prompt.replace("{user_name}", safe_user_name)
                            system_message = {"role": "system", "content": system_content}

            messages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [system_message]

        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        # ДОМЕН 2 И 3: ИНЖЕНЕР И АССИСТЕНТ (Изолированная логика без изменений)
        # -------------------------------------------------------------
        else:
            active_mode_key = "engineer" if is_engineer else "assistant"
            target_history_tokens = get_mode_profile(active_mode_key).get("history_tokens", 11000)
            if len(history) <= 4:
                recent_history = [dict(m) for m in history]
            elif is_engineer:
                # Якорь 1 (Root Anchor): Первые 2 сообщения сессии (старт диалога / исходная задача) строго для engineer
                root_anchor = [dict(history[0]), dict(history[1])]
                root_tok = sum(TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(m) for m in root_anchor)

                min_budget = 4000
                remaining_budget = max(min_budget, target_history_tokens - root_tok)
                tail_reversed = []
                tail_tok = 0

                for m in reversed(history[2:]):
                    m_tok = TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(m)
                    if tail_tok + m_tok <= remaining_budget:
                        tail_reversed.append(dict(m))
                        tail_tok += m_tok
                    else:
                        break

                tail_reversed.reverse()
                recent_history = root_anchor + tail_reversed
            else:
                # Для assistant: чистое скользящее окно по токенному бюджету tail_reversed без root_anchor
                remaining_budget = max(2400, target_history_tokens)
                tail_reversed = []
                tail_tok = 0

                for m in reversed(history):
                    m_tok = TokenBudgetManager.estimate_message_tokens(m)
                    if tail_tok + m_tok <= remaining_budget:
                        tail_reversed.append(dict(m))
                        tail_tok += m_tok
                    else:
                        break

                tail_reversed.reverse()
                recent_history = tail_reversed

            system_prompt = ContextWindowBuilder.build_system_prompt(
                is_roleplay=False,
                character_card=character_card,
                is_excel=is_excel,
                is_word=is_word,
                user_name=user_name,
                include_memory=include_memory,
                session_persona_id=session_persona_id,
                is_engineer=is_engineer,
                relevant_facts=relevant_facts,
                world_facts=effective_world_facts,
                scene_memory=scene_memory,
                has_vision=bool(vision_content),
                art_guidance=art_guidance,
                active_cast_block=active_cast_block,
                recalled_lore_block=recalled_lore_block,
                meta_context_block=meta_context_block,
                session_id=session_id,
                is_dm_mode=is_dm_mode,
                task_text=last_query,
                user_query=kwargs.get("user_query") or last_query,
                knowledge_block=kwargs.get("knowledge_block") or kwargs.get("knowledge_context"),
                matched_knowledge_docs=kwargs.get("matched_knowledge_docs"),
                enable_reasoning=enable_reasoning or kwargs.get("enable_reasoning", False),
                custom_system_prompt=kwargs.get("custom_system_prompt")
            )
            safe_user_name = str(user_name).strip() if user_name else "пользователь"
            system_content = system_prompt.replace("{user_name}", safe_user_name)

            messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_content}]

        if not is_roleplay and is_engineer:
            sanitized = []
            total = len(recent_history)
            for i, m in enumerate(recent_history):
                c = m.get('content')
                c_str = str(c) if isinstance(c, str) else ""
                role = m.get('role', '')
                is_last = (i == total - 1)
                if c_str.startswith('[Системный результат') or c_str.startswith('[Tool Observation'):
                    if is_last:
                        sanitized.append(m)
                    continue
                if role == 'assistant' and not is_last:
                    cleaned = re.sub(r'<<TOOL:\w+.*?>>.*?<<?/+TOOL(?::\w+)?>>?', '', c_str, flags=re.DOTALL)
                    cleaned = re.sub(r'<<TOOL:\w+.*?>>', '', cleaned).strip()
                    if cleaned:
                        sanitized.append({'role': 'assistant', 'content': cleaned})
                    continue
                sanitized.append(m)
            recent_history = sanitized

        if vision_content and recent_history:
            for i in range(len(recent_history) - 1, -1, -1):
                if recent_history[i].get("role") == "user":
                    payload_list = []
                    for part in vision_content:
                        p_copy = dict(part)
                        if p_copy.get("type") == "text" and is_roleplay:
                            t = str(p_copy.get("text", ""))
                            if "[Отвечай на русском языке]" not in t:
                                p_copy["text"] = t + "\n\n[Отвечай строго на русском языке. Подробно опиши изображение и его детали.]"
                        payload_list.append(p_copy)
                    recent_history[i] = {"role": "user", "content": payload_list}
                    break

        messages.extend(recent_history)

        return messages


__all__ = [
    "LORE_TRIGGER_PATTERNS",
    "RECALL_TRIGGERS",
    "STOP_WORDS_RECALL",
    "ContextWindowBuilder"
]

"""
NeonRoute - Direct Command Parser
Парсер параметров и флагов командной строки для ручного режима (!арт / !art).
"""

import re
from typing import Dict, Any, Tuple


def parse_direct_command_params(text: str) -> tuple[str, str, Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Парсит директ-команду (!арт / !art):
    Извлекает CLI-флаги (--steps, --cfg, --denoise, --scale, --hires, --ad, --seed, --model, --w, --h, --size).
    Надежно отделяет негативный промпт.
    """
    params: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    working_text = text

    m = re.search(r'--steps\s+(\d+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        params['steps'] = int(m.group(1))
        working_text = working_text[:m.start()] + " " + working_text[m.end():]

    m = re.search(r'--cfg\s+([\d\.]+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        params['cfg_scale'] = float(m.group(1))
        working_text = working_text[:m.start()] + " " + working_text[m.end():]

    m = re.search(r'--(?:denoise|dn)\s+([\d\.]+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        params['denoising_strength'] = float(m.group(1))
        working_text = working_text[:m.start()] + " " + working_text[m.end():]

    m = re.search(r'--(?:hires|hr)\s+(on|off|true|false|[\d\.]+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        val = m.group(1).lower()
        if val in ('off', 'false'):
            params['enable_hr'] = False
        elif val in ('on', 'true'):
            params['enable_hr'] = True
        else:
            params['enable_hr'] = True
            params['hr_scale'] = float(val)
        working_text = working_text[:m.start()] + " " + working_text[m.end():]

    m = re.search(r'--scale\s+([\d\.]+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        params['hr_scale'] = float(m.group(1))
        params['enable_hr'] = True
        working_text = working_text[:m.start()] + " " + working_text[m.end():]

    m = re.search(r'--(?:adetailer|ad)\s+(on|off|true|false)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        params['enable_adetailer'] = m.group(1).lower() in ('on', 'true')
        working_text = working_text[:m.start()] + " " + working_text[m.end():]

    m = re.search(r'--seed\s+(-?\d+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        params['seed'] = int(m.group(1))
        working_text = working_text[:m.start()] + " " + working_text[m.end():]

    m = re.search(r'--(?:model|style|ckpt)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        params['model_override'] = m.group(1).lower()
        working_text = working_text[:m.start()] + " " + working_text[m.end():]

    m_ar = re.search(r'--ar\s+([a-zA-Z0-9:]+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m_ar:
        ar_val = m_ar.group(1).lower()
        if ar_val in ("wide", "16:9", "3:2"):
            params['width'], params['height'] = 768, 512
        elif ar_val in ("tall", "9:16", "2:3"):
            params['width'], params['height'] = 512, 768
        elif ar_val in ("square", "1:1"):
            params['width'], params['height'] = 512, 512
        working_text = working_text[:m_ar.start()] + " " + working_text[m_ar.end():]

    m_size = re.search(r'--size\s+(\d+)x(\d+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m_size:
        params['width'] = int(m_size.group(1))
        params['height'] = int(m_size.group(2))
        working_text = working_text[:m_size.start()] + " " + working_text[m_size.end():]

    m_w = re.search(r'--w\s+(\d+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m_w:
        params['width'] = int(m_w.group(1))
        working_text = working_text[:m_w.start()] + " " + working_text[m_w.end():]

    m_h = re.search(r'--h\s+(\d+)', working_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m_h:
        params['height'] = int(m_h.group(1))
        working_text = working_text[:m_h.start()] + " " + working_text[m_h.end():]

    neg_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?:--negative|--neg|(?:negative|негативный\s+промп?т|негатив)\s*:)\s*',
        re.IGNORECASE
    )
    parts = neg_pattern.split(working_text, maxsplit=1)
    pos = parts[0].strip(' ,')
    neg = parts[1].strip(' ,') if len(parts) > 1 else ""

    return pos, neg, params


def parse_user_negative_trigger(text: str) -> tuple[bool, str, str]:
    """Вспомогательная функция для парсинга триггера negative: в запросе (обратная совместимость)."""
    pos, neg, _ = parse_direct_command_params(text)
    return bool(neg), pos, neg

"""
Universal Document & Chat Parser for NeonRoute.
Extracts structured text, code, logs, and document metadata on CPU (0 MB VRAM).
"""

import re
import json
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Union, List, Dict, Any, Tuple

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.DocumentParser")


@dataclass
class ParsedDocument:
    """Результат парсинга документа или текстового файла."""
    filename: str
    extension: str
    size_kb: float
    line_count: int
    page_count: Optional[int]
    content: str
    is_truncated: bool
    summary_header: str


class DocumentParser:
    """Легковесный парсер документов, кода и логов на CPU без VRAM."""

    CODE_EXTENSIONS = {
        ".py", ".js", ".ts", ".html", ".htm", ".css", ".cpp", ".c", ".h",
        ".cs", ".rs", ".go", ".java", ".sql", ".sh", ".bat", ".ps1"
    }

    CONFIG_EXTENSIONS = {
        ".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".ini", ".cfg", ".env", ".xml", ".fb2"
    }

    TABLE_EXTENSIONS = {
        ".csv", ".tsv", ".xlsx", ".xls"
    }

    DOCUMENT_EXTENSIONS = {
        ".txt", ".log", ".md", ".pdf", ".docx", ".doc", ".pptx"
    }

    SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS = (
        CODE_EXTENSIONS | CONFIG_EXTENSIONS | TABLE_EXTENSIONS | DOCUMENT_EXTENSIONS
    )

    TEXT_EXTENSIONS = CODE_EXTENSIONS | CONFIG_EXTENSIONS | {".txt", ".log", ".md", ".csv", ".tsv"}
    OFFICE_EXTENSIONS = {".docx", ".doc", ".xlsx", ".xls", ".pptx", ".pdf"}

    @classmethod
    def is_supported(cls, path: Union[str, Path]) -> bool:
        """Проверяет, поддерживается ли расширение файла."""
        if not path:
            return False
        p = Path(path)
        return p.suffix.lower() in cls.SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS

    @classmethod
    def parse_file(
        cls,
        file_path: Union[str, Path],
        max_chars: Optional[int] = 14000
    ) -> Optional[ParsedDocument]:
        """
        Разбирает файл любого поддерживаемого формата (текст, код, логи, PDF, офис)
        строго на CPU без использования VRAM.

        :param file_path: Путь к файлу (str или Path)
        :param max_chars: Максимальное количество символов (~3000-3500 токенов)
        :return: ParsedDocument или None (если файл не существует или недоступен)
        """
        if file_path is None:
            return None

        try:
            path = Path(file_path).resolve()
            if not path.exists() or not path.is_file():
                return None

            try:
                stat = path.stat()
                size_kb = round(stat.st_size / 1024.0, 2)
            except Exception:
                size_kb = 0.0

            filename = path.name
            ext = path.suffix.lower()

            raw_content = ""
            page_count: Optional[int] = None

            if ext == ".pdf":
                raw_content, page_count = cls._extract_pdf(path)
            elif ext == ".docx":
                raw_content = cls._parse_docx(path)
            elif ext == ".doc":
                raw_content = cls._parse_doc_binary(path)
            elif ext in (".xlsx", ".xls"):
                raw_content = cls._parse_excel(path)
            elif ext in (".csv", ".tsv"):
                raw_content = cls._parse_csv_or_tsv(path)
            elif ext in (".fb2", ".xml"):
                raw_content = cls._parse_fb2_or_xml(path)
            elif ext == ".pptx":
                raw_content = cls._parse_pptx(path)
            elif ext in (".html", ".htm"):
                raw_content = cls._parse_html(path)
            elif ext == ".json":
                text = cls._read_text_safely(path)
                raw_content = cls._parse_json_or_chat(text)
            else:
                # Текстовые файлы, код и конфиги (.txt, .md, .py, .yaml, .toml, .ini, .cpp, .rs, .env, .sql, .log и др.)
                raw_content = cls._read_text_safely(path)

            raw_content = raw_content.strip() if raw_content else ""
            line_count = len(raw_content.splitlines()) if raw_content else 0

            total = len(raw_content)
            if max_chars is not None and max_chars > 0 and total > max_chars:
                is_truncated = True
                content = raw_content[:max_chars] + (
                    f"\n\n[... Документ сокращен: показаны первые {max_chars} символов из {total}. "
                    f"Задай уточняющий вопрос по конкретной части документа ...]"
                )
            else:
                is_truncated = False
                content = raw_content

            summary_header = cls._format_summary_header(filename, page_count, line_count, size_kb)

            return ParsedDocument(
                filename=filename,
                extension=ext,
                size_kb=size_kb,
                line_count=line_count,
                page_count=page_count,
                content=content,
                is_truncated=is_truncated,
                summary_header=summary_header
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Ошибка при обработке файла {file_path}: {e}")
            return None

    @classmethod
    def extract_text(cls, path: Union[str, Path], max_chars: int = 30000) -> str:
        """Извлекает очищенный текст из поддерживаемого файла (обратная совместимость)."""
        parsed = cls.parse_file(path, max_chars=max_chars)
        if not parsed:
            return ""
        return parsed.content

    @classmethod
    def _format_summary_header(
        cls,
        filename: str,
        page_count: Optional[int],
        line_count: int,
        size_kb: float
    ) -> str:
        """Формирует однострочную HUD-сводку документа."""
        if size_kb >= 10:
            size_str = f"{size_kb:.0f}" if abs(size_kb - round(size_kb)) < 0.05 else f"{size_kb:.1f}"
        else:
            size_str = f"{size_kb:.1f}" if size_kb > 0 else "0"

        ext = Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        icon = "📊" if ext in (".csv", ".tsv", ".xlsx", ".xls") else "📄"

        if page_count is not None:
            return f"{icon} {filename} | {page_count} стр. | {size_str} КБ"
        else:
            return f"{icon} {filename} | {line_count} строк | {size_str} КБ"

    @classmethod
    def _read_text_safely(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """
        Безопасное чтение текстового файла с автоопределением кодировки.
        Последовательно пробует: utf-8, cp1251, utf-16, latin-1 с fallback на errors='replace'.
        """
        try:
            raw_bytes = path.read_bytes()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Не удалось прочитать байты файла {path}: {e}")
            return ""

        # Проверка маркеров BOM для UTF-16
        if raw_bytes.startswith((b"\xff\xfe", b"\xfe\xff")):
            try:
                return raw_bytes.decode("utf-16").replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
            except UnicodeError:
                pass

        # Последовательный перебор кодировок: utf-8, cp1251, utf-16, latin-1
        for enc in ("utf-8-sig", "utf-8", "cp1251", "utf-16", "latin-1"):
            try:
                text = raw_bytes.decode(enc)
                # Защита: ложное срабатывание cp1251 на utf-16 без BOM дает чередование \x00
                if enc == "cp1251" and text.count("\x00") > 3:
                    continue
                return text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
            except (UnicodeDecodeError, UnicodeError):
                continue
            except Exception:
                continue

        return raw_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")

    @classmethod
    def _parse_plain_text(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """Совместимый метод чтения plain-text."""
        return cls._read_text_safely(path)

    @classmethod
    def _clean_pdf_text(cls, text: str) -> str:
        """Очистка артефактов верстки PDF: склейка разорванных переносов и разрядки."""
        if not text:
            return ""
        # 1. Склейка переносов слов через дефис на новую строку: "эксп-\nлуатации" -> "эксплуатации"
        text = re.sub(r'([А-Яа-яA-Za-z]+)-\s*\n\s*([А-Яа-яA-Za-z]+)', r'\1\2', text)
        # 2. Склейка дефисных переносов внутри строки: "предназна- ченные" -> "предназначенные"
        text = re.sub(r'([А-Яа-яA-Za-z]{3,})-\s+([а-яa-z]{3,})', r'\1\2', text)
        # 3. Де-керинг разрядки заголовков (3+ одиночных заглавных букв через пробел): "Т Е Х Н И К А" -> "ТЕХНИКА"
        text = re.sub(
            r'\b([А-ЯЁA-Z])(?:\s+([А-ЯЁA-Z])){2,}\b',
            lambda m: re.sub(r'\s+', '', m.group(0)),
            text
        )
        return text

    @classmethod
    def _extract_pdf(cls, path: Path) -> Tuple[str, Optional[int]]:
        """
        Постраничное извлечение текста из PDF без нейросетей на CPU.
        Поддерживает pypdf, pymupdf (fitz), pdfplumber.
        Возвращает (content, page_count).
        """
        last_error = ""

        # 1. Попытка через pypdf
        try:
            import pypdf
            with open(path, "rb") as f_pdf:
                reader = pypdf.PdfReader(f_pdf)
                page_count = len(reader.pages)
                pages = []
                for idx, p in enumerate(reader.pages, 1):
                    try:
                        txt = p.extract_text() or ""
                        txt = txt.strip()
                        if txt:
                            pages.append(f"--- Страница {idx} ---\n{txt}")
                    except Exception as pe:
                        logger.debug(f"Ошибка извлечения страницы {idx} PDF через pypdf: {pe}")

                content = "\n\n".join(pages)
                content = cls._clean_pdf_text(content)
                if not content.strip():
                    content = "[PDF документ не содержит распознаваемого текстового слоя (возможно, сканированное изображение)]"
                return content, page_count
        except ImportError:
            pass
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Ошибка при парсинге PDF через pypdf ({path.name}): {e}")
            last_error = str(e)

        # 2. Попытка через pymupdf (fitz)
        try:
            import fitz
            doc = fitz.open(str(path))
            page_count = len(doc)
            pages = []
            for idx, page in enumerate(doc, 1):
                try:
                    txt = page.get_text() or ""
                    txt = txt.strip()
                    if txt:
                        pages.append(f"--- Страница {idx} ---\n{txt}")
                except Exception as pe:
                    logger.debug(f"Ошибка fitz на странице {idx}: {pe}")
            doc.close()

            content = "\n\n".join(pages)
            content = cls._clean_pdf_text(content)
            if not content.strip():
                content = "[PDF документ не содержит распознаваемого текстового слоя (возможно, сканированное изображение)]"
            return content, page_count
        except ImportError:
            pass
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Ошибка при парсинге PDF через fitz ({path.name}): {e}")
            last_error = str(e)

        # 3. Попытка через pdfplumber
        try:
            import pdfplumber
            with pdfplumber.open(str(path)) as pdf:
                page_count = len(pdf.pages)
                pages = []
                for idx, page in enumerate(pdf.pages, 1):
                    try:
                        txt = page.extract_text() or ""
                        txt = txt.strip()
                        if txt:
                            pages.append(f"--- Страница {idx} ---\n{txt}")
                    except Exception as pe:
                        logger.debug(f"Ошибка pdfplumber на странице {idx}: {pe}")
                content = "\n\n".join(pages)
                content = cls._clean_pdf_text(content)
                if not content.strip():
                    content = "[PDF документ не содержит распознаваемого текстового слоя (возможно, сканированное изображение)]"
                return content, page_count
        except ImportError:
            pass
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Ошибка при парсинге PDF через pdfplumber ({path.name}): {e}")
            last_error = str(e)

        if last_error:
            return f"[Ошибка чтения PDF: {last_error}]", None

        return (
            "[Ошибка: Библиотека для чтения PDF не установлена в окружении (требуется pypdf, pymupdf или pdfplumber)]",
            None
        )

    @classmethod
    def _parse_pdf(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """Совместимый метод парсинга PDF."""
        content, _ = cls._extract_pdf(path)
        return content

    @classmethod
    def _parse_docx(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """Извлечение текста и таблиц из .docx файлов."""
        try:
            import docx
            doc = docx.Document(path)
            lines = []
            for p in doc.paragraphs:
                if p.text.strip():
                    lines.append(p.text.strip())
            for t in doc.tables:
                for row in t.rows:
                    row_txt = [c.text.strip().replace("\n", " ") for c in row.cells if c.text.strip()]
                    if row_txt:
                        lines.append(" | ".join(row_txt))
            return "\n".join(lines)
        except ImportError:
            return "[Для чтения DOCX требуется python-docx. Установите: pip install python-docx]"
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"python-docx parsing failed: {e}")
            return cls._read_text_safely(path)

    @classmethod
    def _parse_doc_binary(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """Извлекает кириллицу и латиницу из старого OLE2 Word .doc файла."""
        try:
            raw_bytes = path.read_bytes()
            decoded_lines = []
            for enc in ("utf-16le", "cp1251", "utf-8"):
                try:
                    s = raw_bytes.decode(enc, errors="ignore")
                    words = re.findall(r"[а-яА-ЯёЁa-zA-Z0-9.,!?:;()\s-]{6,}", s)
                    clean_words = [w.strip() for w in words if len(w.strip()) > 5 and not w.strip().startswith("\x00")]
                    if len(" ".join(clean_words)) > len(" ".join(decoded_lines)):
                        decoded_lines = clean_words
                except Exception:
                    continue
            return "\n".join(decoded_lines[:350]) if decoded_lines else ""
        except Exception:
            return ""

    @classmethod
    def _parse_excel(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """Преобразует страницы Excel в Markdown-таблицы."""
        wb = None
        try:
            import openpyxl
            wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
            tables = []
            for sheet_name in wb.sheetnames[:3]:  # Первые 3 листа
                sheet = wb[sheet_name]
                rows_data = []
                for row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True):
                    row_vals = [str(c).strip() if c is not None else "" for c in row]
                    if any(row_vals):
                        rows_data.append(" | ".join(row_vals[:12]))
                    if len(rows_data) >= 80:  # Ограничение до 80 строк на лист
                        rows_data.append("... [строки листа усечены]")
                        break
                if rows_data:
                    tables.append(f"### Лист: {sheet_name}\n" + "\n".join(rows_data))
            return "\n\n".join(tables)
        except ImportError:
            return "[Для чтения Excel (.xlsx/.xls) требуется openpyxl. Установите: pip install openpyxl]"
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"openpyxl parsing failed: {e}")
            return ""
        finally:
            if wb is not None:
                try:
                    wb.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass

    @classmethod
    def _parse_csv_or_tsv(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """
        Чтение CSV и TSV файлов через встроенный модуль csv с конвертацией
        первых строк в компактную Markdown-таблицу.
        """
        import csv
        import io

        raw_text = cls._read_text_safely(path)
        if not raw_text.strip():
            return ""

        ext = path.suffix.lower()
        delimiter = "\t" if ext == ".tsv" else ","

        sample_lines = raw_text.splitlines()[:15]
        sample_str = "\n".join(sample_lines)

        if ext != ".tsv":
            try:
                sniffer = csv.Sniffer()
                dialect = sniffer.sniff(sample_str, delimiters=",;\t|")
                delimiter = dialect.delimiter
            except Exception:
                delimiter = "," if sample_str.count(",") >= sample_str.count(";") else ";"

        try:
            reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(raw_text), delimiter=delimiter)
            rows = []
            for row in reader:
                if any(c.strip() for c in row):
                    rows.append([c.strip().replace("\n", " ") for c in row])
                if len(rows) >= 100:
                    break

            if not rows:
                return raw_text[:3000]

            header = rows[0]
            col_count = len(header)
            md_lines = [" | ".join(header), " | ".join(["---"] * col_count)]

            for r in rows[1:]:
                if len(r) < col_count:
                    r = r + [""] * (col_count - len(r))
                elif len(r) > col_count:
                    r = r[:col_count]
                md_lines.append(" | ".join(r))

            total_lines = len(raw_text.splitlines())
            if total_lines > len(rows):
                md_lines.append(f"\n... [показано {len(rows)} строк из {total_lines}]")

            return "\n".join(md_lines)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"CSV parsing error: {e}")
            return "\n".join(sample_lines[:80])

    _parse_csv = _parse_csv_or_tsv

    @classmethod
    def _parse_fb2_or_xml(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """
        Парсинг FB2-книг и XML документов через xml.etree.ElementTree (без внешних зависимостей).
        Извлекает чистый текст, заголовки и метаданные без XML-тегов и бинарных данных.
        """
        import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

        try:
            raw_bytes = path.read_bytes()
            root = ET.fromstring(raw_bytes)

            lines: List[str] = []
            for elem in root.iter():
                tag = elem.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in elem.tag else elem.tag
                tag_lower = tag.lower()

                # Пропускаем бинарные данные картинок и скрипты
                if tag_lower in ("binary", "script", "style"):
                    continue

                text_val = (elem.text or "").strip()
                if text_val:
                    if tag_lower in ("book-title", "title"):
                        lines.append(f"### {text_val}")
                    elif tag_lower in ("p", "paragraph"):
                        lines.append(text_val)
                    elif tag_lower in ("subtitle",):
                        lines.append(f"**{text_val}**")
                    elif tag_lower in ("first-name", "last-name"):
                        lines.append(f"Автор: {text_val}")
                    elif tag_lower not in ("fictionbook", "body", "section", "description", "title-info", "author"):
                        lines.append(text_val)

            content = "\n\n".join(lines).strip()
            if content:
                return content

            all_text = [t.strip() for t in root.itertext() if t.strip()]
            return "\n".join(all_text)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"XML/FB2 ET parse failed ({path.name}): {e}")
            raw_text = cls._read_text_safely(path)
            no_binary = re.sub(r"<binary[\s\S]*?</binary>", "", raw_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            no_tags = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "\n", no_binary)
            cleaned_lines = [l.strip() for l in no_tags.splitlines() if l.strip()]
            return "\n".join(cleaned_lines)

    @classmethod
    def _parse_pptx(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """Извлекает заголовки и текст со слайдов презентации PowerPoint."""
        try:
            import zipfile
            import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
            slides_text = []
            with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "r") as z:
                slide_files = [f for f in z.namelist() if f.startswith("ppt/slides/slide") and f.endswith(".xml")]
                slide_files.sort(key=lambda x: int(re.search(r"\d+", x).group()) if re.search(r"\d+", x) else 0)

                for idx, s_file in enumerate(slide_files, 1):
                    xml_content = z.read(s_file)
                    tree = ET.fromstring(xml_content)
                    texts = [elem.text for elem in tree.iter() if elem.text and elem.text.strip()]
                    if texts:
                        slides_text.append(f"### Слайд {idx}:\n" + "\n".join(texts))
            return "\n\n".join(slides_text)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"pptx parsing failed: {e}")
            return ""

    @classmethod
    def _parse_html(cls, path: Path) -> str:
        """Очищает HTML-код от тегов и скриптов, оставляя чистый текст."""
        raw = cls._read_text_safely(path)
        no_scripts = re.sub(r"<(script|style).*?</\1>", "", raw, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
        no_tags = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "\n", no_scripts)
        lines = [line.strip() for line in no_tags.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        return "\n".join(lines)

    @classmethod
    def _parse_json_or_chat(cls, target: Union[str, Path]) -> str:
        """Распознает дампы экспортов ChatGPT, Claude или Tavern/Chub и вычищает служебные поля."""
        if isinstance(target, Path):
            raw = cls._read_text_safely(target)
        else:
            raw = target

        try:
            data = json.loads(raw)
            # 1. Дамп ChatGPT (структура с mapping)
            if isinstance(data, list) and data and isinstance(data[0], dict) and "mapping" in data[0]:
                dialogues = []
                for conv in data[:2]:
                    title = conv.get("title", "Диалог")
                    dialogues.append(f"=== Диалог: {title} ===")
                    mapping = conv.get("mapping", {})
                    for node in mapping.values():
                        msg = node.get("message")
                        if msg and isinstance(msg, dict):
                            author = msg.get("author", {}).get("role", "")
                            parts = msg.get("content", {}).get("parts", [])
                            txt = " ".join(str(p) for p in parts if isinstance(p, str)).strip()
                            if txt:
                                role_lbl = "Пользователь" if author == "user" else "ИИ"
                                dialogues.append(f"[{role_lbl}]: {txt}")
                return "\n".join(dialogues)

            # 2. Обычный список сообщений [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]
            if isinstance(data, list) and all(isinstance(x, dict) and "role" in x for x in data):
                res = []
                for item in data:
                    res.append(f"[{item.get('role')}]: {item.get('content', '')}")
                return "\n".join(res)

            # 3. Карточка персонажа Tavern / Chub
            if isinstance(data, dict) and ("spec" in data or "first_mes" in data or "data" in data):
                inner = data.get("data", data)
                name = inner.get("name", "Персонаж")
                desc = inner.get("description", "")
                first_mes = inner.get("first_mes", "")
                return f"Карточка персонажа: {name}\nОписание: {desc}\nПриветствие: {first_mes}"

            return raw
        except Exception:
            return raw
