"""
Geometry and aspect ratio management for SD 1.5 and SDXL.
"""
import re
from typing import Any, Dict

ASPECT_RATIO_BUCKETS_SD15: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
    "fullbody":  {"width": 448, "height": 768, "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": True},
    "solo":      {"width": 512, "height": 768, "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": True},
    "closeup":   {"width": 512, "height": 512, "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": True},
    "pair":      {"width": 768, "height": 512, "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": True},
    "scenery":   {"width": 768, "height": 512, "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": False},
    "cinematic": {"width": 768, "height": 448, "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": False},
}

ASPECT_RATIO_BUCKETS_SDXL: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
    "fullbody":  {"width": 832,  "height": 1216, "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": True},
    "solo":      {"width": 896,  "height": 1152, "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": True},
    "closeup":   {"width": 1024, "height": 1024, "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": True},
    "pair":      {"width": 1152, "height": 896,  "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": True},
    "scenery":   {"width": 1216, "height": 832,  "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": False},
    "cinematic": {"width": 1344, "height": 768,  "extra_neg": "", "force_ad": False},
}

ASPECT_RATIO_BUCKETS = ASPECT_RATIO_BUCKETS_SD15

XL_DELIMITED_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r'(?i)(?:^|[\W_])(?:sdxl|pony|flux|illustrious|sd3|stable[\s_-]?diffusion[\s_-]?3)(?:[\W_\d]|$)'
)
XL_TOKEN_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r'(?i:(?:^|[\W_])xl(?:[\W_\d]|$))|(?:[a-zA-Z0-9]XL(?:[\W_\d]|$))'
)

def is_xl_model(identifier: Any) -> bool:
    """Отказоустойчивое распознавание SDXL/Pony/Flux без ложных срабатываний на 'pixel', 'complex'."""
    if not identifier:
        return False

    if isinstance(identifier, dict):
        arch = str(identifier.get("architecture") or (identifier.get("pipeline") or {}).get("architecture") or "").lower()
        if arch in ("sd15", "sd1", "sd_15"):
            return False
        if arch in ("sdxl", "pony", "flux", "illustrious", "sd3"):
            return True
        text = f"{identifier.get('checkpoint', '')} {identifier.get('name', '')} {identifier.get('id', '')}"
    elif isinstance(identifier, (list, tuple, set)):
        text = " ".join(str(x) for x in identifier if x)
    else:
        text = str(identifier)

    clean_text = re.sub(r'(?i)\b(pixel|complex|duplex|reflex|flexible|relax)\b', '', text)
    is_distilled_xl = any(k in clean_text.lower() for k in ("dmd", "mop", "_fp8", "lightning", "hyper-sd", "hyper_sd", "hypersd"))
    return bool(XL_DELIMITED_PATTERN.search(clean_text) or XL_TOKEN_PATTERN.search(clean_text)) or is_distilled_xl

def get_archetype_config(model_key: Any, archetype: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    is_xl = is_xl_model(model_key)
    buckets = ASPECT_RATIO_BUCKETS_SDXL if is_xl else ASPECT_RATIO_BUCKETS_SD15
    bucket = buckets.get(archetype, buckets.get("solo", {"width": 512, "height": 768}))
    return {
        "width": bucket["width"],
        "height": bucket["height"],
        "extra_negative": bucket.get("extra_neg", ""),
        "force_adetailer": bucket.get("force_ad", True),
        "is_xl": is_xl,
        "architecture": "sdxl" if is_xl else "sd15"
    }

def detect_scene_archetype(prompt: str) -> str:
    p = prompt.lower()
    if any(m in p for m in ("close-up", "close up", "headshot", "face portrait", "macro face", "extreme close-up", "macro portrait")):
        return "closeup"
    if any(m in p for m in ("wide shot", "panorama", "panoramic", "horizon", "vista", "battlefield", "skyline", "aerial view", "landscape panorama")):
        return "cinematic"

    # Маркеры группы, парных сцен и оператора BREAK
    pair_markers = (
        "couple", "1man and 1woman", "1woman and 1man", "1boy and 1girl",
        "1girl and 1boy", "two people", "2people", "two girls", "2girls",
        "two women", "2women", "two men", "2men", "duo", "side by side",
        "standing together", "sitting together", "holding hands", "embracing",
        "sisters", "sisterly", "both girls", "together", " break "
    )
    if any(m in p for m in pair_markers):
        return "pair"

    scenery_markers = (
        "landscape", "scenery", "interior", "castle", "room", "tomb", "dungeon", "street",
        "cityscape", "environment", "fortress", "palace", "ruins", "forest", "mountains", "nature"
    )
    human_markers = ("1girl", "1woman", "1boy", "1man", "woman", "man", "person", "people", "girl", "boy", "knight", "soldier")
    if any(m in p for m in scenery_markers) and not any(h in p for h in human_markers):
        return "scenery"

    fullbody_markers = (
        "full body", "full-body", "standing", "full length", "head to toe", "long shot", "entire body", "boots", "dress"
    )
    if any(m in p for m in fullbody_markers):
        return "fullbody"

    return "solo"

def resolve_dimensions(prompt: str, model_key: Any = "realistic") -> tuple[int, int]:
    cfg = get_archetype_config(model_key, detect_scene_archetype(prompt))
    return cfg["width"], cfg["height"]

"""
Backward compatibility helpers for legacy test suites and external integrations.
"""

import re
from typing import Dict, Any, List


ANIMATION_CARTOON_PATTERNS = [
    r'\bцифров(?:ой|ый|ом|ому|ого)\s+арт\b',
    r'\bарт[\s\-]стил[а-яё]*\b',
    r'\bвекторн(?:ый|ом|ому|ого)\s+арт\b',
    r'\bконцепт[\s\-]арт[а-яё]*\b',
    r'\bаниме\b',
    r'\bманга\b',
    r'\bвайфу\b',
    r'\bхентай\b',
    r'\bмульт(?:фильм|яшн)[а-яё]*\b',
    r'\bкомикс[а-яё]*\b',
    r'\bиллюстраци[а-яё]*\b',
    r'\b2d\b',
    r'\bchibi\b',
    r'\bчиби\b',
]


def is_animation_or_cartoon_style(text: str) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return False
    # Strip headers like 🎨 Арт:
    cleaned = re.sub(r'🎨\s*[Аа]рт\s*:', '', text)
    cleaned_lower = cleaned.lower()
    for pat in ANIMATION_CARTOON_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pat, cleaned_lower, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
            return True
    return False


def is_model_realistic(model: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(model, dict):
        return False
    m_id = str(model.get("id", "")).lower()
    name = str(model.get("name", "")).lower()
    desc = str(model.get("description", "")).lower()
    ckpt = str(model.get("checkpoint", "")).lower()

    if "anime" in m_id or "meina" in ckpt or "meina" in name:
        return False
    if "fantasy" in m_id or "dreamshaper" in ckpt or "dreamshaper" in name:
        return False
    if "realistic" in m_id or "realistic" in name or "cyberrealistic" in ckpt or "photo" in desc:
        return True
    return False


def has_fantasy_artistic_priority(prompt: str) -> bool:
    lower = prompt.lower()
    fantasy_markers = [
        "эльф", "elf", "магия", "magic", "акварель", "watercolor",
        "фэнтези", "fantasy", "живопись", "digital painting", "enchanted",
        "волшебн", "дракон", "мистик", "масло", "oil painting"
    ]
    real_photo_explicit_markers = [
        "фото", "photo", "dslr", "35mm", "снимок", "сфотографируй", "косплей", "cosplay"
    ]
    return any(k in lower for k in fantasy_markers) and not any(k in lower for k in real_photo_explicit_markers)


def find_dreamshaper_model(models: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    for m in models:
        ckpt = str(m.get("checkpoint", "")).lower()
        m_id = str(m.get("id", "")).lower()
        m_name = str(m.get("name", "")).lower()
        if "dreamshaper" in ckpt or "dreamshaper" in m_name or "fantasy" in m_id:
            return m
    return models[0] if models else {}


def find_cyberrealistic_model(models: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    for m in models:
        ckpt = str(m.get("checkpoint", "")).lower()
        m_id = str(m.get("id", "")).lower()
        m_name = str(m.get("name", "")).lower()
        if "cyberrealistic" in ckpt or "cyberrealistic" in m_id or "cyber" in m_name:
            return m
    return models[0] if models else {}


def find_anime_model(models: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    for m in models:
        ckpt = str(m.get("checkpoint", "")).lower()
        m_id = str(m.get("id", "")).lower()
        m_name = str(m.get("name", "")).lower()
        if "anime" in m_id or "meina" in ckpt or "meina" in m_name:
            return m
    return models[0] if models else {}


def find_realistic_vision_model(models: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    for m in models:
        ckpt = str(m.get("checkpoint", "")).lower()
        m_id = str(m.get("id", "")).lower()
        m_name = str(m.get("name", "")).lower()
        if "realisticvision" in ckpt or m_id == "realistic" or "realistic vision" in m_name:
            return m
    return models[0] if models else {}


def sanitize_negative_for_model(style: str, negative_prompt: str) -> str:
    if not negative_prompt:
        return ""
    if style in ("realistic", "cyberrealistic"):
        pattern = r'\b(?:photorealistic|real\s+photo)\b'
        cleaned = re.sub(pattern, '', negative_prompt, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        parts = [p.strip() for p in cleaned.split(',') if p.strip()]
        return ", ".join(parts)
    return negative_prompt

from services.art_director.plan import is_sdxl_checkpoint
"""
LoraManager: Safe CPU Metadata & Trigger Phrase Extractor for LoRA Weights in NeonRoute.
Reads binary header of .safetensors (0 MB VRAM) to automatically harvest top-3 trigger words.
"""

import json
import struct
import re
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Tuple, List, Dict, Any

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.LoraManager")


def extract_lora_metadata(file_path: Path) -> List[str]:
    """Быстро считывает первые байты safetensors и извлекает до 3 ключевых триггеров (0 MB VRAM)."""
    try:
        with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
            header_size_bytes = f.read(8)
            if len(header_size_bytes) < 8:
                return []
            header_len = struct.unpack("<Q", header_size_bytes)[0]
            if header_len > 5 * 1024 * 1024 or header_len <= 0:
                return []
            header_json = f.read(header_len).decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
            metadata = json.loads(header_json).get("__metadata__", {})

        triggers: List[str] = []
        for key in ("modelspec.trigger_phrase", "trained_words", "ss_tag_frequency"):
            val = metadata.get(key)
            if not val:
                continue
            if key == "ss_tag_frequency":
                freq_data = json.loads(val) if isinstance(val, str) else val
                tag_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
                for dataset in freq_data.values():
                    if isinstance(dataset, dict):
                        for tag, cnt in dataset.items():
                            tag_counts[tag] = tag_counts.get(tag, 0) + cnt
                sorted_tags = sorted(tag_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
                ignore = {"1girl", "1boy", "solo", "looking at viewer", "masterpiece", "highres", "breasts"}
                triggers.extend([t for t, _ in sorted_tags if t.lower() not in ignore][:3])
            else:
                raw_words = val if isinstance(val, list) else str(val).split(",")
                for w in raw_words:
                    clean_w = re.sub(r'[\[\]"\'`]', '', str(w)).strip()
                    if clean_w:
                        triggers.append(clean_w)

        seen = set()
        unique_triggers = []
        for t in triggers:
            tl = t.lower()
            if tl not in seen:
                seen.add(tl)
                unique_triggers.append(t)
        return unique_triggers[:3]
    except Exception:
        return []


def _ensure_lora_registry_path() -> Path:
    return LORA_REGISTRY_PATH


class LoraManager:
    _trigger_cache: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}

    def __init__(self):
        self._trigger_cache = LoraManager._trigger_cache

    @classmethod
    def get_triggers(cls, lora_name: str) -> List[str]:
        return cls._trigger_cache.get(lora_name.lower().strip(), [])

    @classmethod
    def build_lora_tag(cls, name: str, weight: float, prompt: str = "") -> str:
        """
        Собирает <lora:name:weight> и дописывает недостающие триггеры,
        если их еще нет в промпте: <lora:name:weight>, trigger1, trigger2.
        """
        tag = f"<lora:{name}:{weight}>"
        triggers = cls.get_triggers(name)
        low_p = prompt.lower() if prompt else ""
        missing = [t for t in triggers if t.lower() not in low_p]
        if missing:
            return f"{tag}, {', '.join(missing)}"
        return tag

    @classmethod
    def get_available_lora_stems(cls, lora_dir: Optional[Path] = None) -> List[str]:
        search_dirs = []
        if lora_dir:
            search_dirs.append(Path(lora_dir))
        else:
            search_dirs.extend([
                DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR,
                FORGE_ROOT_DIR / "webui" / "models" / "Lora",
                FORGE_ROOT_DIR / "models" / "Lora",
                FORGE_ROOT_DIR / "webui_forge_cu121_torch231" / "models" / "Lora"
            ])

        valid_exts = {".safetensors", ".pt", ".pth"}
        stems = set()
        for d in search_dirs:
            if d.exists() and d.is_dir():
                try:
                    for f in d.rglob("*"):
                        if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in valid_exts:
                            lora_name = f.stem.lower()
                            stems.add(lora_name)
                            if f.suffix.lower() == ".safetensors" and lora_name not in cls._trigger_cache:
                                cls._trigger_cache[lora_name] = extract_lora_metadata(f)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return list(stems)

    def scan_directory(self, lora_dir: Optional[Path] = None) -> List[str]:
        search_dirs = [Path(lora_dir)] if lora_dir else [
            DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR,
            FORGE_ROOT_DIR / "webui" / "models" / "Lora",
            FORGE_ROOT_DIR / "models" / "Lora",
            FORGE_ROOT_DIR / "webui_forge_cu121_torch231" / "models" / "Lora"
        ]
        valid_exts = {".safetensors", ".pt", ".pth"}
        stems = set()
        for d in search_dirs:
            if d.exists() and d.is_dir():
                try:
                    for f in d.rglob("*"):
                        if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in valid_exts:
                            lora_name = f.stem.lower()
                            stems.add(lora_name)
                            if f.suffix.lower() == ".safetensors" and lora_name not in self._trigger_cache:
                                self._trigger_cache[lora_name] = extract_lora_metadata(f)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return list(stems)

    @staticmethod
    def load_registry() -> Dict[str, Any]:
        reg_path = _ensure_lora_registry_path()
        if not reg_path.exists():
            return {"characters": {}, "utility": {}}
        try:
            with open(reg_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Ошибка загрузки lora_registry.json: {e}")
            return {"characters": {}, "utility": {}}

    @classmethod
    def resolve_loras(
        cls,
        prompt: str,
        character_name: Optional[str] = None,
        style_id: str = "realistic",
        lora_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
        target_model_name: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> Tuple[List[str], List[str]]:
        """
        Возвращает:
        (lora_tags, activation_tags)
        Пример: (['<lora:ciri:0.8>, ciri, scar', '<lora:add_detail:0.35>'], ['ciri, white hair, scar'])
        """
        registry = cls.load_registry()
        available_stems = cls.get_available_lora_stems(lora_dir)

        selected_lora_tags: List[str] = []
        activation_tags: List[str] = []

        low_prompt = prompt.lower()

        # 1. Поиск явно указанных LoRA в промпте (пользовательские теги)
        explicit_loras = re.findall(r'<lora:([^:>]+)', prompt, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if explicit_loras:
            chars_registry = registry.get("characters", {})
            for explicit_stem in explicit_loras:
                clean_stem = explicit_stem.strip().lower()
                matched_conf = None
                for c_key, conf in chars_registry.items():
                    conf_fname = str(conf.get("file_name", c_key)).strip().lower()
                    if conf_fname == clean_stem or c_key.lower() == clean_stem:
                        matched_conf = conf
                        break

                if matched_conf:
                    act = matched_conf.get("activation_tags", "").strip()
                    if act and act.lower() not in low_prompt:
                        activation_tags.append(act)
                        logger.info(f"[LoraManager] Подтянуты теги активации для явной LoRA '{clean_stem}': {act}")

                # Подтягивание триггеров из заголовка .safetensors
                meta_triggers = cls.get_triggers(clean_stem)
                for trg in meta_triggers:
                    if trg.lower() not in low_prompt and trg not in activation_tags:
                        activation_tags.append(trg)
                        logger.info(f"[LoraManager] Подтянут мета-триггер safetensors для '{clean_stem}': {trg}")

        # 2. Персонажная LoRA (если передано имя персонажа)
        if character_name:
            c_key = character_name.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")
            chars_registry = registry.get("characters", {})
            char_conf = chars_registry.get(c_key)
            if not char_conf:
                for c_k, conf in chars_registry.items():
                    if conf.get("character", "").lower() == character_name.strip().lower():
                        char_conf = conf
                        break
            if char_conf:
                fname = char_conf.get("file_name", c_key)
                w = char_conf.get("weight", 0.8)
                if not any(fname.lower() in tag.lower() for tag in selected_lora_tags) and not any(fname.lower() in p.lower() for p in explicit_loras):
                    selected_lora_tags.append(cls.build_lora_tag(fname, w, prompt))
                    act = char_conf.get("activation_tags", "").strip()
                    if act and act.lower() not in low_prompt:
                        activation_tags.append(act)

        # 3. Сервисная LoRA микродетализации (add_detail)
        util_conf = registry.get("utility", {}).get("add_detail", {})
        allowed_styles = util_conf.get("allowed_styles", ["realistic", "cyberrealistic", "artistic"])

        if style_id in allowed_styles:
            if target_model_name and is_sdxl_checkpoint(target_model_name):
                logger.info(f"[LoraManager] Пропуск сервисной LoRA 'add_detail': несовместимость с архитектурой SDXL модели '{target_model_name}'.")
            else:
                fname = util_conf.get("file_name", "add_detail")
                w = util_conf.get("weight", 0.35)
                if available_stems and any(fname.lower() in s for s in available_stems):
                    if not any(fname.lower() in tag.lower() for tag in selected_lora_tags):
                        tag_with_triggers = cls.build_lora_tag(fname, w, prompt)
                        selected_lora_tags.append(tag_with_triggers)
                        logger.info(f"[LoraManager] Подключена сервисная LoRA: {tag_with_triggers}")

        return selected_lora_tags, activation_tags

    @classmethod
    def register_character_lora(
        cls,
        character_name: str,
        file_stem: str,
        activation_tags: List[str],
        weight: float = 0.8
    ) -> bool:
        """Регистрирует или обновляет запись о персонажной LoRA в lora_registry.json."""
        try:
            reg_path = _ensure_lora_registry_path()
            reg_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            registry = cls.load_registry()
            chars = registry.setdefault("characters", {})

            clean_name = character_name.strip()
            c_key = clean_name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

            triggers = list(dict.fromkeys([clean_name.lower(), file_stem.lower()] + [t.lower().strip() for t in activation_tags if t.strip()]))
            act_str = ", ".join(activation_tags).strip()

            chars[c_key] = {
                "character": clean_name,
                "file_name": file_stem,
                "triggers": triggers,
                "weight": weight,
                "activation_tags": act_str
            }

            from utils.file_utils import atomic_write_json
            if not atomic_write_json(reg_path, registry):
                return False

            logger.info(f"[LoraManager] LoRA '{file_stem}' успешно зарегистрирована для персонажа '{clean_name}'.")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[LoraManager] Ошибка регистрации LoRA: {e}")
            return False

SDXL_MARKERS = ("xl", "sdxl", "pony", "dmd", "insta", "mop")


def is_sdxl_checkpoint(model_name: str) -> bool:
    """
    Определяет, относится ли чекпоинт к архитектуре SDXL.
    Проверяет маркеры в имени файла: 'xl', 'sdxl', 'pony', 'dmd', 'insta', 'mop' (без учета регистра)
    либо сверяет размер/метаданные, если модель присутствует в реестре.
    """
    if not model_name:
        return False
    name_str = str(model_name).strip()
    if not name_str:
        return False
    name_lower = name_str.lower()

    if any(m in name_lower for m in SDXL_MARKERS):
        return True

    try:
        from services.art_director_config import load_art_director_models
        for m in load_art_director_models():
            ckpt = str(m.get("checkpoint", "")).lower()
            m_id = str(m.get("id", "")).lower()
            m_name = str(m.get("name", "")).lower()
            if name_lower in (ckpt, m_id, m_name) or (ckpt and ckpt in name_lower):
                arch = str(m.get("architecture", "")).lower()
                base_model = str(m.get("base_model", "")).lower()
                if "sdxl" in arch or "sdxl" in base_model or "pony" in arch:
                    return True
                if any(m_marker in ckpt for m_marker in SDXL_MARKERS):
                    return True
                size_gb = m.get("size_gb") or m.get("size")
                if size_gb and isinstance(size_gb, (int, float)) and size_gb > 5.0:
                    return True
    except Exception:
        pass

    return False

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List

@dataclass
class GenerationPlan:
    style: str = "realistic"
    target_model_key: str = "realistic"
    model_title: str = "Realistic"
    target_checkpoint: str = ""
    positive_prompt: str = ""
    negative_prompt: str = ""
    width: int = 512
    height: int = 768
    steps: int = 25
    cfg_scale: float = 7.0
    sampler_name: str = "DPM++ 2M"
    scheduler: str = "Karras"
    enable_hr: bool = False
    hr_scale: float = 1.5
    hr_upscaler: str = "R-ESRGAN 4x+"
    denoising_strength: float = 0.35
    hr_second_pass_steps: int = 15
    clip_skip: int = 1
    enable_adetailer: bool = True
    enable_hand_adetailer: bool = False
    prompt: Optional[str] = None
    ad_denoising_strength: Optional[float] = None
    ad_prompt: Optional[str] = None
    ad_negative_prompt: Optional[str] = None
    ad_mask_blur: int = 4
    seed: int = -1
    subseed: int = -1
    hires_upscaler: str = "R-ESRGAN 4x+"
    hires_denoise: float = 0.35
    reasoning: str = ""
    style_badge: str = ""
    is_ambiguous: bool = False
    clarification_message: str = ""
    unknown_words: Optional[List[str]] = None
    adetailer_face_denoise: Optional[float] = None
    adetailer_hands: Optional[bool] = None
    adetailer_face_model: str = "face_yolov8n.pt"
    adetailer_face_confidence: float = 0.35
    adetailer_hands_enabled: bool = False
    adetailer_hands_model: str = "hand_yolov8n.pt"
    adetailer_hands_confidence: float = 0.40
    adetailer_hands_denoise: float = 0.22

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.prompt and not self.positive_prompt:
            self.positive_prompt = self.prompt
        elif self.positive_prompt and not self.prompt:
            self.prompt = self.positive_prompt

    @classmethod
    def create_ambiguous(cls, message: str, unknown_words: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> 'GenerationPlan':
        return cls(
            style="ambiguous",
            target_model_key="none",
            model_title="Ambiguous",
            target_checkpoint="",
            positive_prompt="",
            negative_prompt="",
            width=512,
            height=512,
            steps=20,
            cfg_scale=6.0,
            sampler_name="DPM++ 2M",
            scheduler="Karras",
            enable_hr=False,
            hr_scale=1.0,
            hr_upscaler="None",
            denoising_strength=0.3,
            hr_second_pass_steps=10,
            clip_skip=1,
            enable_adetailer=False,
            enable_hand_adetailer=False,
            is_ambiguous=True,
            clarification_message=message,
            unknown_words=unknown_words or []
        )

    def to_forge_kwargs(self, output_dir: Optional[Any] = None, session_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        payload = {
            "prompt": self.positive_prompt,
            "negative_prompt": self.negative_prompt,
            "steps": self.steps,
            "width": self.width,
            "height": self.height,
            "cfg_scale": self.cfg_scale,
            "sampler_name": self.sampler_name,
            "scheduler": self.scheduler,
            "checkpoint": self.target_checkpoint,
            "seed": self.seed,
            "subseed": getattr(self, "subseed", -1),
            "clip_skip": self.clip_skip,
            "enable_hr": self.enable_hr,
            "hr_scale": self.hr_scale,
            "hr_upscaler": self.hr_upscaler or getattr(self, "hires_upscaler", "R-ESRGAN 4x+"),
            "denoising_strength": self.denoising_strength if self.denoising_strength is not None else getattr(self, "hires_denoise", 0.35),
            "hr_second_pass_steps": self.hr_second_pass_steps,
            "enable_adetailer": self.enable_adetailer,
            "enable_hand_adetailer": getattr(self, "adetailer_hands_enabled", False),
            "ad_denoising_strength": getattr(self, "adetailer_face_denoise", 0.30),
            "ad_prompt": self.ad_prompt,
            "ad_negative_prompt": self.ad_negative_prompt,
            "ad_mask_blur": self.ad_mask_blur,
            "output_dir": output_dir,
            "session_id": session_id
        }

        alwayson = {}
        if getattr(self, "enable_adetailer", True):
            face_slot = {
                "ad_model": getattr(self, "adetailer_face_model", "face_yolov8n.pt"),
                "ad_confidence": getattr(self, "adetailer_face_confidence", 0.35),
                "ad_denoising_strength": getattr(self, "adetailer_face_denoise", 0.30),
                "ad_inpaint_only_masked": True
            }
            if getattr(self, "ad_prompt", None):
                face_slot["ad_prompt"] = self.ad_prompt
            if getattr(self, "ad_negative_prompt", None):
                face_slot["ad_negative_prompt"] = self.ad_negative_prompt

            hands_active = bool(getattr(self, "adetailer_hands_enabled", False) or getattr(self, "adetailer_hands", False))
            hand_slot = {
                "ad_model": getattr(self, "adetailer_hands_model", "hand_yolov8n.pt"),
                "ad_confidence": getattr(self, "adetailer_hands_confidence", 0.40),
                "ad_denoising_strength": getattr(self, "adetailer_hands_denoise", 0.22),
                "ad_inpaint_only_masked": True
            }

            ad_args = [
                True,        # ad_enable (Master)
                False,       # ad_skip_img2img
                face_slot,   # Slot 1: Face
            ]
            if hands_active:
                ad_args.append(hand_slot)

            alwayson["ADetailer"] = {"args": ad_args}

        payload["alwayson_scripts"] = alwayson
        return payload

def extract_negations_from_prompt(prompt_text: str) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """
    Находит конструкции отрицания ('without coat', 'no glasses', 'not wearing shoes')
    в позитивном промпте, удаляет их из текста и возвращает:
    (очищенный_позитивный_промпт, список_токенов_для_негатива).
    """
    if not prompt_text:
        return "", []

    extracted_negs = []
    # Поиск шаблонов: without <item>, no <item>, not wearing <item>
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'\b(?:without|no|not\s+wearing)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+)?([a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+(?:\s+[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+)?)',
        re.IGNORECASE
    )

    def _replace_match(m):
        item = m.group(1).strip().lower()
        if item:
            # Расширение синонимов для частых категорий
            if item in ("coat", "jacket", "overcoat"):
                extracted_negs.extend(["coat", "jacket", "overcoat", "outerwear"])
            elif item in ("glasses", "sunglasses"):
                extracted_negs.extend(["glasses", "eyewear", "sunglasses"])
            elif item in ("shoes", "boots", "sneakers"):
                extracted_negs.extend(["shoes", "footwear", "boots"])
            elif item in ("hat", "cap", "beanie"):
                extracted_negs.extend(["hat", "headwear", "cap"])
            elif item in ("bra", "underwear", "panties"):
                extracted_negs.extend(["bra", "underwear", "panties"])
            else:
                extracted_negs.append(item)
        return ""

    cleaned = pattern.sub(_replace_match, prompt_text)
    # Удаление повисших запятых и двойных пробелов
    cleaned = re.sub(r',\s*,+', ',', cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'\s{2,}', ' ', cleaned).strip(' ,')

    return cleaned, list(dict.fromkeys(extracted_negs))


def build_negative_prompt(
    prompt: str,
    profile_id: str,
    canon_base_neg: str,
    user_neg: str = "",
    archetype: str = "solo",
    custom_base_neg: str = ""
) -> str:
    """
    Модульный генератор негативного промпта:
    1. Авторский канон модели (или ручной negative_prompt из art_director_models.json).
    2. Явный пользовательский ввод (--neg).
    """
    neg_tokens = []

    # ── СЛОЙ 1: АВТОРСКИЙ КАНОН / НАСТРОЙКИ МОДЕЛИ ИЗ JSON ──
    if custom_base_neg and custom_base_neg.strip():
        neg_tokens.append(custom_base_neg.strip())
    elif canon_base_neg and canon_base_neg.strip():
        neg_tokens.append(canon_base_neg.strip())
    elif profile_id == "artistic":
        neg_tokens.append("ugly, deformed, noisy, blurry, low contrast")
    elif profile_id == "anime":
        neg_tokens.append("easynegative, (worst quality, low quality:1.4), (normal quality:1.2), lowres, bad anatomy")
    else:
        neg_tokens.append("(worst quality, low quality:1.4), deformed iris, bad anatomy, extra limbs, badhandv4")

    # ── СЛОЙ 2: ЯВНЫЙ РУЧНОЙ ВВОД ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЯ (--neg) ──
    if user_neg and user_neg.strip():
        neg_tokens.append(user_neg.strip())

    # Сборка и очистка от повторяющихся тегов с сохранением исходного порядка
    raw_combined = ", ".join(t for t in neg_tokens if t)
    seen = set()
    cleaned = []
    for chunk in raw_combined.split(","):
        token = chunk.strip()
        if token and token.lower() not in seen:
            seen.add(token.lower())
            cleaned.append(token)

    return ", ".join(cleaned)


_TRANSLATOR = None
_TRANSLATOR_LOCK = threading.Lock()

def _get_argos_ru_en_translator():
    """Argos Translate is deprecated. Returns None."""
    return None


def sanitize_and_translate_tags(prompt_text: str) -> str:
    """Безопасная очистка тегов от лишних символов и кириллицы (0 VRAM)."""
    if not prompt_text:
        return ""
    clean = re.sub(r'[\u0400-\u04ff]', '', prompt_text)
    raw_tags = [t.strip().lower() for t in re.split(r'[,;\n]+', clean) if t.strip()]
    cleaned_tags = list(dict.fromkeys(raw_tags))
    return ", ".join(cleaned_tags)


def warmup_argos():
    """No-op stub for backward compatibility after Argos Translate removal."""
    pass

"""services/art_director/vram_policy.py

Чистый математический модуль для динамического расчета бюджета VRAM
и безопасного порога Hires.fix. Изолирован от Qt, ForgeClient,
SystemMonitor и Director (Pure Logic).
"""

import logging
from typing import Tuple, Union

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Константы по умолчанию
WEIGHTS_SD15_MB = 2048
WEIGHTS_SDXL_FP8_MB = 3584
WEIGHTS_SDXL_FP16_MB = 6758

DEFAULT_FORGE_RESERVE_MB = 450
DEFAULT_SAFETY_MARGIN_MB = 150
DEFAULT_OS_RESERVE_MB = 700
ADETAILER_RESERVE_MB = 650

K_ARCH_SD15 = 170_000  # px/GB при активном VAE Tiling
K_ARCH_SDXL = 95_000

LORA_ADAPTER_WEIGHT_MB = 120


def calculate_max_hires_canvas_area(
    architecture: str = "sd15",
    is_fp8: bool = False,
    total_vram_gb: float = 8.0,
    os_reserve_mb: int = DEFAULT_OS_RESERVE_MB,
    enable_adetailer: bool = False,
    active_lora_count: int = 0
) -> int:
    """Вычисляет максимальную допустимую площадь кадра (в пикселях) для Hires.fix.

    Параметры:
        architecture: Архитектура модели ('sd15', 'sdxl' и т.д.).
        is_fp8: Флаг квантования весов SDXL в FP8.
        total_vram_gb: Общий объем доступной видеопамяти GPU в ГБ.
        os_reserve_mb: Резерв памяти для ОС/монитора (МБ).
        enable_adetailer: Флаг использования ADetailer (+650 МБ резерва).
        active_lora_count: Количество активных LoRA-адаптеров (по 120 МБ на адаптер).

    Возвращает:
        Целочисленный лимит площади пикселей int(avail_gb * K), либо 0,
        если памяти недостаточно или Hires.fix заблокирован.
    """
    arch = str(architecture).strip().lower()
    is_xl = "xl" in arch

    if is_xl:
        base_weights_mb = WEIGHTS_SDXL_FP8_MB if is_fp8 else WEIGHTS_SDXL_FP16_MB
        k_arch = K_ARCH_SDXL
    else:
        base_weights_mb = WEIGHTS_SD15_MB
        k_arch = K_ARCH_SD15

    lora_mb = max(0, int(active_lora_count)) * LORA_ADAPTER_WEIGHT_MB
    total_weights_mb = base_weights_mb + lora_mb

    total_reserve_mb = (
        int(os_reserve_mb)
        + DEFAULT_FORGE_RESERVE_MB
        + DEFAULT_SAFETY_MARGIN_MB
        + (ADETAILER_RESERVE_MB if enable_adetailer else 0)
    )

    total_vram_mb = float(total_vram_gb) * 1024.0
    used_mb = total_reserve_mb + total_weights_mb
    avail_mb = total_vram_mb - used_mb
    avail_gb = avail_mb / 1024.0

    if avail_gb <= 0:
        return 0

    # Если SDXL и доступная динамическая память < 4.5 GB -> Hires заблокирован
    if is_xl and avail_gb < 4.5:
        return 0

    return int(avail_gb * k_arch)


def is_hires_safe(
    width: int,
    height: int,
    architecture: str = "sd15",
    is_fp8: bool = False,
    total_vram_gb: float = 8.0,
    os_reserve_mb: int = DEFAULT_OS_RESERVE_MB,
    enable_adetailer: bool = False,
    active_lora_count: int = 0
) -> bool:
    """Определяет, безопасна ли генерация заданного разрешения с Hires.fix.

    Учитывает:
    - Защиту длинной стороны (max(w, h) > 1280 при VRAM <= 8 GB).
    - Штраф за экстремальные соотношения сторон (Aspect Ratio Penalty).
    - Динамический бюджет VRAM с учетом архитектуры, резервов и LoRA.
    """
    if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
        return False

    # Защита длинной стороны при малом объеме памяти
    if total_vram_gb <= 8.0 and max(width, height) > 1280:
        return False

    max_allowed_area = calculate_max_hires_canvas_area(
        architecture=architecture,
        is_fp8=is_fp8,
        total_vram_gb=total_vram_gb,
        os_reserve_mb=os_reserve_mb,
        enable_adetailer=enable_adetailer,
        active_lora_count=active_lora_count
    )

    if max_allowed_area <= 0:
        return False

    base_area = width * height
    ratio = max(width / height, height / width)

    # Защита от экстремальных соотношений (Aspect Ratio Penalty)
    if ratio > 1.5:
        penalty_factor = 1.0 + (ratio - 1.5) * 0.3
        effective_area = base_area * penalty_factor
    else:
        effective_area = float(base_area)

    return effective_area <= max_allowed_area


def resolve_hardware_vram_budget(system_monitor=None) -> Tuple[float, int]:
    """Безопасный адаптер к метрикам оборудования (SSoT).

    Возвращает (total_vram_gb, os_reserve_mb).
    Гарантирует 100% отказоустойчивость (Safe Fallback) при сбоях NVML/CI/CPU.
    """
    total_vram_gb = 8.0
    os_reserve_mb = DEFAULT_OS_RESERVE_MB

    # 1. Считывание топологии дисплея из LayerBudgeter
    try:
        from services.layer_budgeter import LayerBudgeter
        _, detected_reserve = LayerBudgeter.detect_gpu_topology()
        os_reserve_mb = int(detected_reserve)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug(f"[VRAMPolicy] Fallback топологии дисплея: {e}")

    # 2. Опрос физического объема VRAM через SystemMonitor / NVML
    try:
        if system_monitor and hasattr(system_monitor, "_last_emitted_stats") and system_monitor._last_emitted_stats:
            mb = system_monitor._last_emitted_stats.get("vram_total_mb", 8192)
            total_vram_gb = round(mb / 1024.0, 1)
        elif system_monitor and hasattr(system_monitor, "nvml_initialized") and system_monitor.nvml_initialized:
            import pynvml
            info = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo(system_monitor.gpu_handle)
            total_vram_gb = round(info.total / (1024.0 ** 3), 1)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug(f"[VRAMPolicy] Fallback объема VRAM: {e}")

    return total_vram_gb, os_reserve_mb

class RoutingTestWorker(QThread):
    """Фоновый воркер для вычисления векторного ранжирования скиллов."""
    result_ready = pyqtSignal(list)
    error_occurred = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, query: str, router: EngineerSkillRouter, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.query = query
        self.router = router
        self._is_aborted = False

    def abort(self):
        self._is_aborted = True
        self.requestInterruption()

    def run(self):
        try:
            if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
                return
            results = self.router.test_route_ranking(self.query)
            if not self._is_aborted and not self.isInterruptionRequested():
                self.result_ready.emit(results)
        except Exception as e:
            if not self._is_aborted:
                self.error_occurred.emit(str(e))

    def _populate_skills_list(self, select_id: Optional[str] = None):
        """Заполняет список скиллов из роутера."""
        self.list_skills.blockSignals(True)
        self.list_skills.clear()

        all_skills = self.router.get_all_skills()
        selected_row = 0

        row = 0
        for sid, sdata in all_skills.items():
            item = QListWidgetItem(self.list_skills)
            item.setSizeHint(QSize(220, 52))
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, sid)

            widget = SkillListItemWidget(
                title=sdata.get("title", sid),
                is_builtin=sdata.get("is_builtin", False),
                icon_path=sdata.get("icon_path", "")
            )
            self.list_skills.setItemWidget(item, widget)

            if select_id and sid == select_id:
                selected_row = row
            row += 1

        self.list_skills.blockSignals(False)

        if self.list_skills.count() > 0:
            self.list_skills.setCurrentRow(selected_row)
            self._on_skill_selected(selected_row)

    def _on_skill_selected(self, row: int):
        """Отображает данные выбранного скилла в форме редактирования."""
        item = self.list_skills.item(row)
        if not item:
            return

        sid = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        self._current_selected_id = sid

        all_skills = self.router.get_all_skills()
        skill = all_skills.get(sid, {})

        is_builtin = skill.get("is_builtin", False)

        self.line_skill_id.setText(sid)
        self.line_skill_id.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.line_title.setText(skill.get("title", ""))
        self.line_title.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.text_human_desc.setPlainText(skill.get("human_description", ""))
        self.text_human_desc.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        anchors = skill.get("anchors", [])
        if isinstance(anchors, list):
            self.text_anchors.setPlainText("\n".join(anchors))
        else:
            self.text_anchors.setPlainText(str(anchors))
        self.text_anchors.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.text_architect.setPlainText(skill.get("architect_rules", ""))
        self.text_architect.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.text_worker.setPlainText(skill.get("worker_rules", ""))
        self.text_worker.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.line_artifact.setText(skill.get("default_artifact", "main.py"))
        self.line_artifact.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self._current_icon_path = skill.get("icon_path", "")
        self._update_icon_preview(self._current_icon_path)
        self.btn_choose_icon.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.btn_save.setEnabled(not is_builtin)
        self.btn_delete.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

    def _update_icon_preview(self, icon_path: str):
        if icon_path and Path(icon_path).exists():
            pix = QPixmap(str(icon_path)).scaled(
                42, 42, Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio, Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
            )
            self.lbl_icon_preview.setPixmap(pix)
            self.lbl_icon_preview.setText("")
        else:
            self.lbl_icon_preview.setPixmap(QPixmap())
            self.lbl_icon_preview.setText("🖼️")

    def _on_choose_icon_clicked(self):
        """Диалог выбора картинки и копирование в data/skill_icons/."""
        file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Выберите иконку скилла",
            "",
            "Изображения (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.webp *.svg *.bmp)"
        )
        if not file_path:
            return

        sid = self.line_skill_id.text().strip() or "custom_skill"
        sid = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_", sid.lower())

        dest_dir = SKILL_ICONS_DIR
        dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest_file = dest_dir / f"{sid}.png"

        try:
            shutil.copy2(file_path, dest_file)
            self._current_icon_path = f"data/skill_icons/{sid}.png"
            self._update_icon_preview(str(dest_file))
            InfoBar.success(
                title="Иконка загружена",
                content=f"Файл сохранен: {dest_file.name}",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                duration=2500
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[EngineerSkillsDialog] Ошибка копирования иконки: {e}", exc_info=True)
            InfoBar.error(
                title="Ошибка",
                content=f"Не удалось сохранить иконку: {e}",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                duration=3500
            )

    def _on_add_skill_clicked(self):
        """Очищает форму для создания нового кастомного скилла."""
        self.list_skills.clearSelection()
        self._current_selected_id = None
        self._current_icon_path = ""

        self.line_skill_id.setText("")
        self.line_skill_id.setEnabled(True)
        self.line_skill_id.setFocus()

        self.line_title.setText("")
        self.line_title.setEnabled(True)

        self.text_human_desc.setPlainText("")
        self.text_human_desc.setEnabled(True)

        self.text_anchors.setPlainText("")
        self.text_anchors.setEnabled(True)

        self.text_architect.setPlainText("")
        self.text_architect.setEnabled(True)

        self.text_worker.setPlainText("")
        self.text_worker.setEnabled(True)

        self.line_artifact.setText("main.py")
        self.line_artifact.setEnabled(True)

        self._update_icon_preview("")
        self.btn_choose_icon.setEnabled(True)

        self.btn_save.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_delete.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_save_skill_clicked(self):
        """Валидация и сохранение кастомного скилла в JSON."""
        sid = self.line_skill_id.text().strip()
        title = self.line_title.text().strip()

        if not sid:
            if title:
                sid = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_", title.lower())
                self.line_skill_id.setText(sid)
            else:
                InfoBar.warning(
                    title="Ошибка валидации",
                    content="Укажите ID скилла или название.",
                    parent=self,
                    position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                    duration=3000
                )
                return

        if not title:
            InfoBar.warning(
                title="Ошибка валидации",
                content="Укажите название скилла.",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                duration=3000
            )
            return

        anchors_raw = self.text_anchors.toPlainText()
        anchors = [line.strip() for line in anchors_raw.splitlines() if line.strip()]

        skill_dict = {
            "skill_id": sid,
            "title": title,
            "human_description": self.text_human_desc.toPlainText().strip(),
            "anchors": anchors,
            "triggers": ", ".join(anchors[:5]),
            "architect_rules": self.text_architect.toPlainText().strip(),
            "worker_rules": self.text_worker.toPlainText().strip(),
            "default_artifact": self.line_artifact.text().strip() or "main.py",
            "icon_path": self._current_icon_path,
            "is_builtin": False
        }

        try:
            self.router.save_custom_skill(skill_dict)
            InfoBar.success(
                title="Скилл сохранен",
                content=f"Навык «{title}» успешно сохранен и доступен в роутере.",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                duration=3000
            )
            self._populate_skills_list(select_id=sid)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[EngineerSkillsDialog] Ошибка сохранения скилла: {e}", exc_info=True)
            InfoBar.error(
                title="Ошибка сохранения",
                content=str(e),
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                duration=4000
            )

    def _on_delete_skill_clicked(self):
        """Удаление кастомного скилла."""
        if not self._current_selected_id:
            return

        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Подтверждение удаления",
            f"Вы уверены, что хотите удалить скилл '{self._current_selected_id}'?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return

        try:
            ok = self.router.delete_custom_skill(self._current_selected_id)
            if ok:
                InfoBar.success(
                    title="Скилл удален",
                    content=f"Скилл '{self._current_selected_id}' успешно удален.",
                    parent=self,
                    position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                    duration=2500
                )
                self._populate_skills_list()
            else:
                InfoBar.warning(
                    title="Удаление невозможно",
                    content="Не удалось удалить скилл (возможно, он базовый).",
                    parent=self,
                    position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                    duration=3000
                )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[EngineerSkillsDialog] Ошибка удаления скилла: {e}", exc_info=True)
            InfoBar.error(
                title="Ошибка",
                content=str(e),
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                duration=3500
            )

    def _on_run_test_clicked(self):
        """Запуск проверки сопоставления задачи через FastEmbed."""
        query = self.line_test_query.text().strip()
        if not query:
            InfoBar.warning(
                title="Пустой запрос",
                content="Введите описание задачи для проверки реакции роутера.",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                duration=2500
            )
            return

        self.btn_run_test.setEnabled(False)
        self.result_badge.set_loading()

        if self._worker and self._worker.isRunning():
            self._worker.abort()
            self._worker.wait(500)

        self._worker = RoutingTestWorker(query, self.router, self)
        self._worker.result_ready.connect(self._on_test_results_ready)
        self._worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_test_error)
        self._worker.start()

    def _on_test_results_ready(self, ranking: List[Dict[str, Any]]):
        """Отображение результатов векторного сопоставления в таблице."""
        self.btn_run_test.setEnabled(True)

        if not ranking:
            self.result_badge.set_error("Роутер не вернул результатов.")
            return

        winner = next((r for r in ranking if r.get("is_winner")), ranking[0])
        score = winner.get("score", 0.0)

        if score < CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
            self.result_badge.set_fallback(
                title=winner.get("title", ""),
                skill_id=winner.get("skill_id", ""),
                score=score
            )
        else:
            self.result_badge.set_winner(
                title=winner.get("title", ""),
                skill_id=winner.get("skill_id", ""),
                score=score,
                is_builtin=winner.get("is_builtin", False)
            )

        # Заполнение таблицы
        self.table_results.setRowCount(len(ranking))

        for row, item in enumerate(ranking):
            is_win = item.get("is_winner", False)
            score_val = item.get("score", 0.0)
            icon_path = item.get("icon_path", "")
            is_builtin = item.get("is_builtin", False)

            # Col 0: Иконка
            lbl_icon = QLabel()
            lbl_icon.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            if icon_path and Path(icon_path).exists():
                pix = QPixmap(str(icon_path)).scaled(
                    24, 24, Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio, Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
                )
                lbl_icon.setPixmap(pix)
            else:
                lbl_icon.setText("⚙️" if is_builtin else "💡")
            self.table_results.setCellWidget(row, 0, lbl_icon)

            # Col 1: Скилл
            item_title = QTableWidgetItem(item.get("title", ""))
            item_title.setFlags(item_title.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable)
            if is_win:
                item_title.setForeground(QBrush(QColor("#00F0FF")))
                font = item_title.font()
                font.setBold(True)
                item_title.setFont(font)
                item_title.setBackground(QBrush(QColor(0, 240, 255, 30)))
            self.table_results.setItem(row, 1, item_title)

            # Col 2: Тип
            item_type = QTableWidgetItem("Базовый" if is_builtin else "Пользовательский")
            item_type.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            item_type.setFlags(item_type.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable)
            if is_win:
                item_type.setForeground(QBrush(QColor("#00F0FF")))
                item_type.setBackground(QBrush(QColor(0, 240, 255, 30)))
            self.table_results.setItem(row, 2, item_type)

            # Col 3: Скор
            item_score = QTableWidgetItem(f"{score_val:.4f}")
            item_score.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            item_score.setFlags(item_score.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable)
            if is_win:
                item_score.setForeground(QBrush(QColor("#00F0FF")))
                font = item_score.font()
                font.setBold(True)
                item_score.setFont(font)
                item_score.setBackground(QBrush(QColor(0, 240, 255, 30)))
            self.table_results.setItem(row, 3, item_score)

            # Col 4: Соответствие (ProgressBar)
            pbar_container = QWidget()
            pbar_layout = QHBoxLayout(pbar_container)
            pbar_layout.setContentsMargins(6, 4, 6, 4)

            pbar = QProgressBar(pbar_container)
            pbar.setRange(0, 100)
            pbar_pct = max(0, min(100, int(score_val * 100)))
            pbar.setValue(pbar_pct)
            pbar.setTextVisible(True)
            pbar.setFormat(f"{pbar_pct}%")

            bar_color = "#00F0FF" if is_win else "#38BDF8"
            pbar.setStyleSheet(f"""
                QProgressBar {{
                    background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
                    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    text-align: center;
                    color: #FFFFFF;
                    font-size: 10px;
                    font-weight: bold;
                }}
                QProgressBar::chunk {{
                    background-color: {bar_color};
                    border-radius: 3px;
                }}
            """)
            pbar_layout.addWidget(pbar)
            self.table_results.setCellWidget(row, 4, pbar_container)

    def _on_test_error(self, err_msg: str):
        self.btn_run_test.setEnabled(True)
        self.result_badge.set_error(f"Ошибка тестирования: {err_msg}")

"""
Log Console Dialog for NeonRoute.
Provides real-time terminal log viewer, syntax coloring by log level,
and clipboard export capabilities.
Displays strictly the current application runtime session logs.
"""

import html
import logging
from collections import deque
from typing import Optional, Tuple
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QObject, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtGui import QTextCursor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton,
    QPlainTextEdit, QLabel, QApplication
)

# Lightweight ring buffer storing up to 2000 events strictly for the current app run (~2MB RAM)
_CURRENT_SESSION_LOGS = deque(maxlen=2000)


class QtLogHandler(QObject, logging.Handler):
    """
    Thread-safe logging.Handler that emits PyQt signals when new log records arrive.
    """
    log_record_signal = pyqtSignal(str, str)  # formatted_message, levelname

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        logging.Handler.__init__(self)
        self.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("[%(asctime)s] [%(levelname)s] [%(name)s]: %(message)s"))

    def emit(self, record):
        try:
            msg = self.format(record)
            _CURRENT_SESSION_LOGS.append((msg, record.levelname))
            self.log_record_signal.emit(msg, record.levelname)
        except Exception:
            pass


_GLOBAL_QT_HANDLER: Optional[QtLogHandler] = None


def setup_global_log_handler() -> QtLogHandler:
    """Initializes and registers the singleton QtLogHandler on root logger."""
    global _GLOBAL_QT_HANDLER
    if _GLOBAL_QT_HANDLER is None:
        _GLOBAL_QT_HANDLER = QtLogHandler()
        _GLOBAL_QT_HANDLER.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
        logging.getLogger().addHandler(_GLOBAL_QT_HANDLER)
    return _GLOBAL_QT_HANDLER


class LogConsoleDialog(QDialog):
    """
    Interactive dark terminal dialog displaying current session application logs in real-time.
    """

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Консоль логов — NeonRoute (Текущая сессия)")
        self.resize(880, 540)
        self.setMinimumSize(640, 400)

        self._setup_ui()
        self._load_session_logs()
        self._connect_logger()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QDialog {
                background-color: #080B10;
                color: #CBD5E1;
            }
            QPlainTextEdit {
                background-color: #04060A;
                color: #CBD5E1;
                border: 1px solid #1E283D;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 10px;
                font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Code', 'Courier New', monospace;
                font-size: 12px;
                line-height: 1.45;
            }
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #141C2A;
                color: #E2E8F0;
                border: 1px solid #24344D;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 6px 16px;
                font-weight: 500;
                font-size: 13px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #1C273C;
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
            QPushButton:pressed {
                background-color: #0F1622;
            }
        """)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(14, 14, 14, 14)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        # Header bar
        header_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        title_lbl = QLabel("🖥️ Журнал текущей сессии (Live Console)")
        title_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px; color: #00F0FF;")
        header_layout.addWidget(title_lbl)

        header_layout.addStretch()

        self.status_lbl = QLabel("")
        self.status_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 11px;")
        header_layout.addWidget(self.status_lbl)

        layout.addLayout(header_layout)

        # Log Text Box
        self.text_edit = QPlainTextEdit(self)
        self.text_edit.setReadOnly(True)
        self.text_edit.setMaximumBlockCount(4000)
        layout.addWidget(self.text_edit, stretch=1)

        # Buttons
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()

        self.btn_copy = QPushButton("📋 Копировать логи")
        self.btn_copy.setToolTip("Скопировать весь текст логов в буфер обмена")
        self.btn_copy.clicked.connect(self._copy_logs)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_copy)

        self.btn_clear = QPushButton("🧹 Очистить")
        self.btn_clear.setToolTip("Очистить виджет консоли")
        self.btn_clear.clicked.connect(self._clear_logs)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_clear)

        btn_layout.addStretch()

        self.btn_close = QPushButton("Закрыть")
        self.btn_close.clicked.connect(self.close)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_close)

        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)

    def _load_session_logs(self):
        """Populates the console strictly from current runtime session buffer."""
        self.text_edit.clear()
        for msg, level in _CURRENT_SESSION_LOGS:
            self._append_formatted_log(msg, level)

    def _connect_logger(self):
        handler = setup_global_log_handler()
        handler.log_record_signal.connect(
            self._append_formatted_log,
            Qt.ConnectionType.QueuedConnection
        )

    def _append_formatted_log(self, text: str, levelname: str):
        color_map = {
            "INFO": "#38BDF8",      # Sky Cyan
            "WARNING": "#FBBF24",   # Amber
            "ERROR": "#F43F5E",     # Crimson
            "CRITICAL": "#FF0055",  # Neon Crimson
            "DEBUG": "#64748B"      # Slate
        }
        color = color_map.get(levelname.upper(), "#CBD5E1")

        escaped = html.escape(text)
        # white-space: pre-wrap сохраняет переносы \n и отступы в HTML-виджете
        colored_html = f"<div style='color: {color}; margin: 1px 0; white-space: pre-wrap;'>{escaped}</div>"
        self.text_edit.appendHtml(colored_html)
        self.text_edit.moveCursor(QTextCursor.MoveOperation.End)

    def _copy_logs(self):
        clipboard = QApplication.clipboard()
        clipboard.setText(self.text_edit.toPlainText())
        self.status_lbl.setText("Логи скопированы в буфер обмена!")

    def _clear_logs(self):
        self.text_edit.clear()
        self.status_lbl.setText("Консоль логов очищена.")
