    def _load_previous_messages_chunk(self):
        """Бесшовно подгружает предыдущую пачку сообщений с сохранением скролла."""
        if not hasattr(self, "_all_session_messages") or not self._all_session_messages:
            return

        chunk_size = 25
        cur_offset = getattr(self, "_rendered_messages_offset", 0)
        if cur_offset <= 0:
            if self._btn_load_more_widget:
                self._btn_load_more_widget.deleteLater()
                self._btn_load_more_widget = None
            return

        new_offset = max(0, cur_offset - chunk_size)
        slice_to_insert = self._all_session_messages[new_offset:cur_offset]
        self._rendered_messages_offset = new_offset
        self._is_loading_more_history = True

        # Фиксируем текущий scroll bar через реальные свойства MainWindow
        v_bar = None
        if hasattr(self, "scroll_area") and self.scroll_area:
            v_bar = self.scroll_area.verticalScrollBar()
        elif hasattr(self, "chat_stream") and hasattr(self.chat_stream, "scroll_area") and self.chat_stream.scroll_area:
            v_bar = self.chat_stream.scroll_area.verticalScrollBar()

        old_val = v_bar.value() if v_bar else 0
        old_max = v_bar.maximum() if v_bar else 0

        # Временно блокируем перерисовку для исключения мерцания
        if hasattr(self, "chat_container"):
            self.chat_container.setUpdatesEnabled(False)

        try:
            # Находим индекс вставки (сразу после кнопки load_more)
            insert_idx = 1 if self._btn_load_more_widget else 0
            for msg in slice_to_insert:
                widget = self._render_stored_message(msg, target_index=insert_idx)
                insert_idx += 1

            if new_offset <= 0:
                if self._btn_load_more_widget:
                    self._btn_load_more_widget.deleteLater()
                    self._btn_load_more_widget = None
            else:
                if self._btn_load_more_widget:
                    self._btn_load_more_widget.setText(f"▲ Загрузить более ранние сообщения (осталось: {new_offset})")
        finally:
            if hasattr(self, "chat_container"):
                self.chat_container.setUpdatesEnabled(True)

            # Восстанавливаем позицию скролла, чтобы экран не прыгал
            if v_bar:
                from PyQt6.QtCore import QTimer
                def _restore_scroll():
                    new_max = v_bar.maximum()
                    diff = new_max - old_max
                    target_pos = old_val + diff
                    if hasattr(self, "_sync_scroll_to"):
                        self._sync_scroll_to(target_pos)
                    else:
                        v_bar.setValue(target_pos)
                    self._prev_scroll_max = new_max
                    self._is_loading_more_history = False
                QTimer.singleShot(20, _restore_scroll)

    def _render_stored_message(self, msg: dict, target_index: Optional[int] = None) -> ChatMessageWidget:
        sender = msg.get("sender", "NeonRoute")
        text = msg.get("text", "")
        # Если в истории остался пустой ответ ИИ, восстанавливаем видимый текст
        if not text and not msg.get("is_user") and not msg.get("image_path"):
            text = msg.get("translated_text") or "..." 
        is_user = msg.get("is_user", False)
        is_error = msg.get("is_error", False)
        img_p = Path(msg["image_path"]) if msg.get("image_path") else None
        if img_p and not img_p.exists():
            img_p = None
        audio_p = Path(msg["audio_path"]) if msg.get("audio_path") else None
        
        avatar_p = Path(msg["avatar_path"]) if msg.get("avatar_path") else None
        if not avatar_p or not avatar_p.exists():
            avatar_p = self._get_user_avatar_path() if is_user else self._get_current_avatar_path()

        trans_text = msg.get("translated_text")
        is_showing_trans = msg.get("is_showing_translation", False)
        timestamp = msg.get("timestamp")

        file_ps = []
        for p in msg.get("file_paths", []):
            try:
                pth = Path(p)
                if pth.exists():
                    file_ps.append(pth)
            except Exception:
                pass

        eff_mode = getattr(self, "active_mode", getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant"))
        is_eng = (eff_mode in ("engineer", "engineering")) or (hasattr(self, "is_engineer_mode_active") and self.is_engineer_mode_active()) or (self.current_session.get("type") == "engineering" if getattr(self, "current_session", None) and isinstance(self.current_session, dict) else False)
        is_rp = (eff_mode == "roleplay") or bool(msg.get("is_roleplay", False))
        if is_rp:
            widget_cls = RPChatMessageWidget
        elif is_eng and not is_user:
            from ui.widgets.engineer_task_card import EngineerTaskCardWidget
            widget_cls = EngineerTaskCardWidget
        elif eff_mode == "assistant" and not is_user:
            widget_cls = AssistantChatMessageWidget
        else:
            widget_cls = ChatMessageWidget

        session_id_val = getattr(self, "current_session", {}).get("id") if hasattr(self, "current_session") and isinstance(self.current_session, dict) else None

        widget = widget_cls(
            sender=sender,
            text=text,
            is_user=is_user,
            is_error=is_error,
            image_path=img_p,
            file_paths=file_ps,
            audio_path=audio_p,
            avatar_path=avatar_p,
            translated_text=trans_text,
            is_showing_translation=is_showing_trans,
            font_size=getattr(self, "font_size", getattr(self, "chat_font_size", 13)),
            negative_prompt=msg.get("negative_prompt"),
            timestamp=timestamp,
            is_roleplay=is_rp,
            generation_params=msg.get("generation_params"),
            visual_intent=msg.get("visual_intent"),
            message_id=msg.get("id"),
            session_id=session_id_val,
            parent=getattr(self, "chat_scroll_content", getattr(self, "chat_container", None))
        )
        if msg.get("visual_intent"):
            widget.visual_intent = msg.get("visual_intent")
            if hasattr(widget, "set_scene_art_state"):
                cue_t = widget.visual_intent.get("prompt", "") if isinstance(widget.visual_intent, dict) else getattr(widget.visual_intent, "prompt", "")
                widget.set_scene_art_state(is_ready=True, cue_text=cue_t)
        if msg.get("knowledge_sources") and hasattr(widget, "set_knowledge_sources"):
            widget.set_knowledge_sources(msg.get("knowledge_sources"))
        if msg.get("thought") and hasattr(widget, "set_thought_data"):
            t = msg["thought"]
            widget.set_thought_data(
                text=t.get("content", ""),
                duration=float(t.get("duration", 0.0)),
                token_count=int(t.get("token_count", 0))
            )
        widget.tts_requested.connect(lambda txt, w=widget: self._enqueue_tts_task(txt, w))
        widget.translate_requested.connect(self._on_message_translate_requested)
        widget.regenerate_requested.connect(self._on_message_regenerate_requested)
        widget.delete_requested.connect(self._on_message_delete_requested)
        widget.scene_art_requested.connect(self._on_scene_art_requested)
        widget.run_script_requested.connect(self._execute_workspace_script)
        widget.choice_selected.connect(self._on_rpg_choice_selected)

        is_eng_canvas = (is_eng and not is_user) or widget.__class__.__name__ == "EngineerTaskCardWidget"
        align = Qt.AlignmentFlag(0) if is_eng_canvas else Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop

        if target_index is not None:
            self.chat_layout.insertWidget(target_index, widget, alignment=align)
        else:
            self.chat_layout.insertWidget(self.chat_layout.count() - 1, widget, alignment=align)
        return widget

    def _clear_chat_widgets(self):
        """
        Мгновенно размонтирует и уничтожает все виджеты сообщений из контейнера чата.
        Исключает наложение старых сообщений на новые за счет явного hide() и setParent(None).
        """
        if hasattr(self, "_remove_greeting_cycler_chip"):
            self._remove_greeting_cycler_chip()
        if hasattr(self, "_remove_typing_loader"):
            self._remove_typing_loader()

        self._rendered_messages_offset = 0
        self._all_session_messages = []
        self._btn_load_more_widget = None

        if hasattr(self, "chat_layout") and self.chat_layout is not None:
            # Зачищаем абсолютно все элементы без исключения до 0
            while self.chat_layout.count() > 0:
                item = self.chat_layout.takeAt(0)
                if not item:
                    continue
                w = item.widget()
                if w is not None:
                    # 1. Мгновенно убираем виджет с экрана
                    w.hide()
                    # 2. Физически разрываем связь с chat_container
                    w.setParent(None)
                    # 3. Очищаем медиа-ресурсы, если есть
                    if hasattr(w, "audio_widget") and w.audio_widget:
                        try:
                            w.audio_widget.cleanup()
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    # 4. Освобождаем память C++
                    w.deleteLater()

            # Восстанавливаем чистый концевой распорочный элемент
            self.chat_layout.addStretch()

    def _update_message_attachment(self, widget: ChatMessageWidget, file_path: Path, generation_params: Optional[dict] = None):
        """Appends generated document or image to the message in session storage."""
        if self.current_session and self.current_session.get("messages"):
            str_path = str(file_path)
            target_mid = getattr(widget, "message_id", None)
            target_msg = None
            messages = self.current_session["messages"]

            if target_mid:
                for m in reversed(messages):
                    if m.get("id") == target_mid:
                        target_msg = m
                        break

            if target_msg is None:
                for m in reversed(messages):
                    if m.get("text") == widget.original_text or m.get("text") == widget.raw_text:
                        target_msg = m
                        break

            if target_msg:
                if "file_paths" not in target_msg:
                    target_msg["file_paths"] = []
                if str_path not in target_msg["file_paths"]:
                    target_msg["file_paths"].append(str_path)
                if generation_params:
                    target_msg["generation_params"] = generation_params

            self._save_current_session()

    def _update_last_message_attachment(self, file_path: Path):
        """Appends generated document to the last message in session storage."""
        if self.current_session and self.current_session.get("messages"):
            last_msg = self.current_session["messages"][-1]
            if "file_paths" not in last_msg:
                last_msg["file_paths"] = []
            str_path = str(file_path)
            if str_path not in last_msg["file_paths"]:
                last_msg["file_paths"].append(str_path)
            self._save_current_session()

    def _on_message_translate_requested(self, text: str, widget: ChatMessageWidget):
        self._enqueue_translation_task(text, widget)

    def _update_message_translation_in_session(self, widget: ChatMessageWidget, translated_text: str):
        if not self.current_session or not self.current_session.get("messages"):
            return
        for m in self.current_session["messages"]:
            if m.get("text") == widget.original_text or m.get("text") == widget.raw_text:
                m["translated_text"] = translated_text
                m["is_showing_translation"] = widget.is_showing_translation
                break
        self._save_current_session()

    def _on_rpg_choice_selected(self, choice_text: str):
        if hasattr(self, "input_panel") and self.input_panel and hasattr(self.input_panel, "input_box"):
            self.input_panel.input_box.setPlainText(choice_text)
            if hasattr(self, "_on_send_clicked"):
                self._on_send_clicked()

    def _on_message_regenerate_requested(self, widget: ChatMessageWidget):
        if self.is_busy:
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Дождитесь завершения текущей задачи перед регенерацией.", 4000)
            return

        if not self.current_session or not self.current_session.get("messages"):
            return

        # Find preceding user prompt
        last_user_prompt = ""
        found_widget_idx = None
        target_mid = getattr(widget, "message_id", None)
        messages_list = self.current_session["messages"]

        if target_mid:
            for idx in range(len(messages_list) - 1, -1, -1):
                if messages_list[idx].get("id") == target_mid:
                    found_widget_idx = idx
                    break

        if found_widget_idx is None:
            for idx in range(len(messages_list) - 1, -1, -1):
                m = messages_list[idx]
                if m.get("is_user") == widget.is_user and m.get("text") in (widget.original_text, widget.raw_text):
                    found_widget_idx = idx
                    break

        if found_widget_idx is not None:
            for m in reversed(self.current_session["messages"][:found_widget_idx]):
                if m.get("is_user") and m.get("text"):
                    last_user_prompt = m["text"]
                    break

            # Remove this assistant message from session
            self.current_session["messages"].pop(found_widget_idx)
            if self.chat_history and self.chat_history[-1].get("role") == "assistant":
                self.chat_history.pop()

            self._save_current_session()

        self._remove_message_widget(widget)

        if last_user_prompt:
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Регенерация ответа...", 3000)
            self._route_and_enqueue(last_user_prompt)
        else:
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Предыдущий запрос пользователя не найден.", 4000)

    def _on_message_delete_requested(self, widget: ChatMessageWidget):
        if widget.is_user:
            confirm_msg = "Удалить ваше сообщение и связанный с ним ответ (откат диалога)?"
        else:
            confirm_msg = "Вы уверены, что хотите удалить это сообщение из диалога?"

        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Удаление сообщения",
            confirm_msg,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return

        # 1. Update session messages & chat_history
        if self.current_session and self.current_session.get("messages"):
            idx_to_remove = None
            target_mid = getattr(widget, "message_id", None)
            messages_list = self.current_session["messages"]

            if target_mid:
                for idx in range(len(messages_list) - 1, -1, -1):
                    if messages_list[idx].get("id") == target_mid:
                        idx_to_remove = idx
                        break

            if idx_to_remove is None:
                for idx in range(len(messages_list) - 1, -1, -1):
                    m = messages_list[idx]
                    if m.get("is_user") == widget.is_user and m.get("text") in (widget.original_text, widget.raw_text):
                        idx_to_remove = idx
                        break

            if idx_to_remove is not None:
                if widget.is_user:
                    # Pop subsequent assistant message if present
                    if idx_to_remove + 1 < len(self.current_session["messages"]):
                        next_msg = self.current_session["messages"][idx_to_remove + 1]
                        if not next_msg.get("is_user"):
                            self.current_session["messages"].pop(idx_to_remove + 1)

                    # Pop user message
                    self.current_session["messages"].pop(idx_to_remove)
                else:
                    # Assistant message deletion
                    self.current_session["messages"].pop(idx_to_remove)

                # Детерминированная синхронизация chat_history из оставшихся сообщений сессии
                rebuilt_history = []
                for m in self.current_session.get("messages", []):
                    if m.get("is_error"):
                        continue
                    m_role = "user" if m.get("is_user") else "assistant"
                    m_text = (m.get("text") or "").strip()
                    if m_text and m_text != "🎨 Иллюстрация сцены готова:":
                        rebuilt_history.append({"role": m_role, "content": m_text})
                self.chat_history = rebuilt_history
                self.current_session["chat_history"] = list(self.chat_history)
                self._save_current_session()

        # 2. Update UI widgets
        if widget.is_user:
            w_idx = self.chat_layout.indexOf(widget)
            if w_idx >= 0:
                for idx in range(w_idx + 1, self.chat_layout.count()):
                    item = self.chat_layout.itemAt(idx)
                    if item and item.widget():
                        w = item.widget()
                        if isinstance(w, ChatMessageWidget):
                            if not w.is_user:
                                self._remove_message_widget(w)
                            break

        self._remove_message_widget(widget)
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Сообщение удалено.", 3000)

    def _remove_message_widget(self, widget: QWidget):
        if hasattr(widget, "audio_widget") and widget.audio_widget:
            widget.audio_widget.cleanup()
        self.chat_layout.removeWidget(widget)
        widget.deleteLater()

    def _append_message(
        self,
        sender: str,
        text: str,
        is_user: bool = False,
        is_error: bool = False,
        image_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        file_paths: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        audio_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        avatar_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        translated_text: Optional[str] = None,
        is_showing_translation: bool = False,
        negative_prompt: Optional[str] = None,
        timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
        generation_params: Optional[dict] = None,
        is_roleplay: bool = False,
        visual_intent: Optional[Union[dict, Any]] = None,
        **kwargs
    ) -> ChatMessageWidget:
        # Resolve avatar automatically if not explicitly given
        resolved_avatar = avatar_path
        if not resolved_avatar:
            if is_user:
                resolved_avatar = self._get_user_avatar_path()
            else:
                resolved_avatar = self._get_current_avatar_path()

        eff_mode = getattr(self, "active_mode", getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant"))
        is_eng = (eff_mode in ("engineer", "engineering")) or (hasattr(self, "is_engineer_mode_active") and self.is_engineer_mode_active())

        if eff_mode == "roleplay" or is_roleplay or (getattr(self, "current_mode", "") == "roleplay"):
            widget_cls = RPChatMessageWidget
        elif is_eng and not is_user:
            from ui.widgets.engineer_task_card import EngineerTaskCardWidget
            widget_cls = EngineerTaskCardWidget
        elif eff_mode == "assistant" and not is_user:
            widget_cls = AssistantChatMessageWidget
        else:
            widget_cls = ChatMessageWidget

        session_id_val = getattr(self, "current_session", {}).get("id") if hasattr(self, "current_session") and isinstance(self.current_session, dict) else None

        msg = widget_cls(
            sender=sender,
            text=text,
            is_user=is_user,
            is_error=is_error,
            image_path=image_path,
            file_paths=file_paths,
            audio_path=audio_path,
            avatar_path=resolved_avatar,
            translated_text=translated_text,
            is_showing_translation=is_showing_translation,
            font_size=getattr(self, "font_size", getattr(self, "chat_font_size", 13)),
            negative_prompt=negative_prompt,
            timestamp=timestamp,
            generation_params=generation_params,
            visual_intent=visual_intent,
            session_id=session_id_val,
            parent=getattr(self, "chat_scroll_content", getattr(self, "chat_container", None)),
            **kwargs
        )
        k_sources = kwargs.get("knowledge_sources") or (getattr(self, "_pending_knowledge_sources", None) if not is_user else None)
        if k_sources and hasattr(msg, "set_knowledge_sources"):
            msg.set_knowledge_sources(k_sources)
        msg.tts_requested.connect(lambda txt, w=msg: self._enqueue_tts_task(txt, w))
        msg.translate_requested.connect(self._on_message_translate_requested)
        msg.regenerate_requested.connect(self._on_message_regenerate_requested)
        msg.delete_requested.connect(self._on_message_delete_requested)
        msg.scene_art_requested.connect(self._on_scene_art_requested)
        msg.run_script_requested.connect(self._execute_workspace_script)
        msg.choice_selected.connect(self._on_rpg_choice_selected)

        is_eng_canvas = (is_eng and not is_user) or msg.__class__.__name__ == "EngineerTaskCardWidget"
        align = Qt.AlignmentFlag(0) if is_eng_canvas else Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop

        # Insert before typing_loader if present, else before bottom stretch
        if self.typing_loader is not None:
            idx = self.chat_layout.indexOf(self.typing_loader)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.chat_layout.insertWidget(idx, msg, alignment=align)
            else:
                self.chat_layout.insertWidget(self.chat_layout.count() - 1, msg, alignment=align)
        else:
            self.chat_layout.insertWidget(self.chat_layout.count() - 1, msg, alignment=align)

        # Record in active session and auto-save to history
        if self.current_session is not None and not self._is_switching_session:
            msg_record = {
                "id": getattr(msg, "message_id", None),
                "sender": sender,
                "text": text,
                "is_user": is_user,
                "is_error": is_error,
                "image_path": str(image_path) if image_path else None,
                "file_paths": [str(p) for p in file_paths] if file_paths else [],
                "audio_path": str(audio_path) if audio_path else None,
                "avatar_path": str(resolved_avatar) if resolved_avatar else None,
                "translated_text": translated_text,
                "is_showing_translation": is_showing_translation,
                "negative_prompt": negative_prompt,
                "generation_params": generation_params,
                "timestamp": msg.timestamp,
            }
            if "messages" not in self.current_session:
                self.current_session["messages"] = []
            self.current_session["messages"].append(msg_record)
            self._save_current_session()

        self._scroll_to_bottom()
        return msg

    def _clear_chat(self):
        """Redirects to new session creation."""
        self._on_new_chat_clicked()

    def _get_chat_message_widgets(self) -> List[Any]:
        widgets = []
        for i in range(self.chat_layout.count()):
            item = self.chat_layout.itemAt(i)
            if item and item.widget():
                w = item.widget()
                if isinstance(w, ChatMessageWidget) or w.__class__.__name__ == "EngineerTaskCardWidget":
                    widgets.append(w)
        return widgets

"""
Menu Builder Component for NeonRoute.
Encapsulates declarative top menubar setup and global shortcut bindings.
Modernized with QFluentWidgets RoundMenu and Action components under Agentrules.md.
"""

import os
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QMenuBar, QMenu
from PyQt6.QtGui import QActionGroup, QKeySequence, QShortcut
from qfluentwidgets import (
    RoundMenu,
    Action,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
)
from ui.common.icon_utils import SafeFIF
from config import HISTORY_DIR

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow


class ClickOnlyMenuBar(QMenuBar):
    """
    QMenuBar с открытием выпадающих списков строго по клику ЛКМ (clicked).
    Полностью подавляет открытие и переключение по наведению курсора (hover / mouseMoveEvent / enterEvent),
    обеспечивая стандартное поведение:
    - меню открывается строго по нажатию левой кнопки мыши (LMB);
    - пока меню открыто, клик по другому пункту закрывает предыдущее и открывает новое;
    - повторный клик по активному пункту или клик мимо закрывает меню.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setMouseTracking(False)
        self._closing_action = None

    def addMenu(self, *args, **kwargs):
        action = super().addMenu(*args, **kwargs)
        menu = action.menu() if hasattr(action, "menu") else None
        if not menu and len(args) > 0 and isinstance(args[0], QMenu):
            menu = args[0]
        if menu:
            try:
                menu.aboutToHide.connect(lambda a=action: self._on_menu_about_to_hide(a))
            except Exception:
                pass
        return action

    def _on_menu_about_to_hide(self, action):
        self._closing_action = action
        QTimer.singleShot(180, self._clear_closing_action)

    def _clear_closing_action(self):
        self._closing_action = None

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        # Открытие меню строго по клику левой кнопки мыши
        if event.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            event.ignore()
            return

        action = self.actionAt(event.pos())
        # Повторный клик по уже открытому или закрывающемуся пункту — закрывает меню без повторного открытия
        if action and (action == self.activeAction() or action == self._closing_action):
            self._closing_action = None
            self.setActiveAction(None)
            if action.menu():
                action.menu().close()
            event.accept()
            return

        self._closing_action = None
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event):
        # Полностью подавляем открытие/переключение меню при наведении курсора (hover)
        event.ignore()


def _create_round_menu(title: str, parent=None) -> RoundMenu:
    """Creates and styles a RoundMenu in NeonRoute Glassmorphism aesthetics."""
    menu = RoundMenu(title, parent=parent)
    menu.view.setObjectName("NeonRoundMenuView")
    menu.view.setStyleSheet("""
        MenuActionListWidget#NeonRoundMenuView {
            background-color: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.96);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.22);
            border-radius: 10px;
            outline: none;
            font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, sans-serif;
            font-size: 12px;
            padding: 4px;
        }
        MenuActionListWidget#NeonRoundMenuView::item {
            padding-left: 10px;
            padding-right: 14px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            margin: 1px 4px;
            border: none;
            color: #E2E8F0;
            min-height: 28px;
        }
        MenuActionListWidget#NeonRoundMenuView::item:disabled {
            color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.40);
        }
        MenuActionListWidget#NeonRoundMenuView::item:hover {
            background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12);
            color: #00F0FF;
        }
        MenuActionListWidget#NeonRoundMenuView::item:selected {
            background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.16);
            color: #00F0FF;
        }
    """)
    return menu


class MenuBuilder:

                color: #00F0FF;

        # А. Меню "💬 Диалоги"

        act_engineer_skills.triggered.connect(lambda *_: window._open_engineer_skills_dialog())
        system_menu.addAction(act_engineer_skills)

        act_gallery = Action(FIF.PEOPLE, "Галерея персонажей...", window)
        act_gallery.triggered.connect(lambda *_: window._open_characters_gallery_dialog())
        system_menu.addAction(act_gallery)

        act_engineer_settings = Action(FIF.DEVELOPER_TOOLS, "Выбор моделей по режимам...", window)
        act_engineer_settings.setToolTip("Настройка постоянных LLM моделей для Ассистента, РП и Инженера")
        act_engineer_settings.triggered.connect(lambda *_: window._open_mode_model_settings_dialog())
        system_menu.addAction(act_engineer_settings)

        act_llm_engine_settings = Action(FIF.SETTING, "Настройки движка LLM...", window)
        act_llm_engine_settings.setToolTip("Параметры квантования KV-кэша и Flash Attention")
        act_llm_engine_settings.triggered.connect(lambda *_: window._open_llm_engine_settings_dialog())
        system_menu.addAction(act_llm_engine_settings)

        system_menu.addSeparator()

        act_models_manager = Action(FIF.PALETTE, "Модели генерации...", window)
        act_models_manager.setToolTip("Настройка чекпоинтов Forge, описаний и подсказок LLM")
        act_models_manager.triggered.connect(lambda *_: window._open_models_manager_dialog())
        system_menu.addAction(act_models_manager)

        system_menu.addSeparator()

        act_clean_cache = Action(FIF.DELETE, "Очистить кэш и временные файлы", window)
        act_clean_cache.triggered.connect(lambda *_: window._open_clean_cache_dialog())
        system_menu.addAction(act_clean_cache)

        menubar.addMenu(system_menu)

        # Г. Меню "Справка"
        help_menu = _create_round_menu("Справка", window)

        act_check_deps = Action(FIF.ACCEPT, "Проверка компонентов...", window)
        act_check_deps.setStatusTip("Проверить наличие Git и библиотек для режима Инженер")
        act_check_deps.triggered.connect(window.open_dependency_dialog)
        help_menu.addAction(act_check_deps)

        act_help = Action(FIF.HELP, "Горячие клавиши", window)
        act_help.triggered.connect(lambda *_: window._open_help_dialog())
        help_menu.addAction(act_help)

        act_about = Action(FIF.INFO, "О программе NeonRoute", window)
        act_about.triggered.connect(lambda *_: window._open_about_dialog())
        help_menu.addAction(act_about)

        menubar.addMenu(help_menu)

    @staticmethod
    def setup_shortcuts(window: 'MainWindow') -> None:
        # In-chat Search (Ctrl+F)
        window.sc_search = QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl+F"), window)
        window.sc_search.activated.connect(window._show_search_bar)

        # Font Zoom Shortcuts (11pt to 22pt)
        window.sc_zoom_in_eq = QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl+="), window)
        window.sc_zoom_in_eq.activated.connect(lambda: window._change_chat_font_size(1))

        window.sc_zoom_in_plus = QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl++"), window)
        window.sc_zoom_in_plus.activated.connect(lambda: window._change_chat_font_size(1))

        window.sc_zoom_out = QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl+-"), window)
        window.sc_zoom_out.activated.connect(lambda: window._change_chat_font_size(-1))

        window.sc_zoom_reset = QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl+0"), window)
        window.sc_zoom_reset.activated.connect(window._reset_chat_font_size)

"""
Icon utilities for safe FluentIcon access across NeonRoute UI.
"""

from qfluentwidgets import FluentIcon as FIF


def safe_fif(icon_name: str, fallback=FIF.DOCUMENT):
    """Безопасное получение иконки по строковому имени без риска AttributeError."""
    if icon_name == "BOOK_SHELF":
        return getattr(FIF, "LIBRARY", getattr(FIF, "DICTIONARY", fallback))
    return getattr(FIF, icon_name, fallback)


class SafeFIFMeta(type):
    """Прокси-метакласс: перехватывает любое обращение к SafeFIF.<NAME>."""
    def __getattr__(cls, name):
        if name == "BOOK_SHELF":
            return getattr(FIF, "LIBRARY", getattr(FIF, "DICTIONARY", FIF.DOCUMENT))
        return getattr(FIF, name, FIF.DOCUMENT)


class SafeFIF(metaclass=SafeFIFMeta):
    BOOK_SHELF = getattr(FIF, "LIBRARY", getattr(FIF, "DICTIONARY", FIF.DOCUMENT))

"""
ui_context.py — Единый источник правды (SSOT) состояния интерфейса и диалогового цикла NeonRoute.
Инкапсулирует сессию, активный бабл стриминга и флаги занятости, устраняя дефект 'хрупкого базового класса'.
"""
import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.UIContext")

class UIContext:
    """Контейнер состояния интерфейса и диалогового цикла MainWindow."""

    def __init__(self, main_window: Optional[Any] = None):
        self._main_window = main_window
        self._current_session: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
        self._turn_bubble: Optional[Any] = None
        self._is_busy: bool = False
        self._is_generating: bool = False

    @property
    def current_session(self) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return self._current_session

    @current_session.setter
    def current_session(self, value: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        old_id = self._current_session.get("id") if isinstance(self._current_session, dict) else None
        new_id = value.get("id") if isinstance(value, dict) else None
        if old_id != new_id:
            logger.debug(f"[UIContext] Смена сессии: {old_id} -> {new_id}")
        self._current_session = value

    @property
    def turn_bubble(self) -> Optional[Any]:
        return self._turn_bubble

    @turn_bubble.setter
    def turn_bubble(self, widget: Optional[Any]) -> None:
        self._turn_bubble = widget

    @property
    def is_busy(self) -> bool:
        return self._is_busy

    @is_busy.setter
    def is_busy(self, val: bool) -> None:
        self._is_busy = bool(val)

    def begin_turn(self, bubble_widget: Any) -> None:
        """Атомарный старт хода генерации ответа."""
        self._turn_bubble = bubble_widget
        self._is_generating = True
        self._is_busy = True

    def finish_turn(self) -> None:
        """Атомарное завершение хода генерации ответа."""
        self._turn_bubble = None
        self._is_generating = False
        self._is_busy = False

    def get_session_id(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Безопасное получение ID активной сессии."""
        if isinstance(self._current_session, dict):
            return self._current_session.get("id")
        return None

    def get_mode(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Безопасное получение режима активной сессии."""
        if isinstance(self._current_session, dict):
            return self._current_session.get("mode")
        return None

"""
Assistant Chat Message Bubble Component for NeonRoute.
Specialized bubble for Elaria with interactive neon art proposal chips
and CyberpunkArtPlaceholderWidget loader lifecycle.
Isolated from roleplay mechanics and widgets.
"""

import math
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List, Union, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import (
    Qt, QTimer, QRectF,
    QPropertyAnimation, QEasingCurve, QParallelAnimationGroup
)
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QCursor, QPainter, QColor, QPen, QBrush,
    QLinearGradient, QRadialGradient, QFont
)
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QPushButton, QSizePolicy, QGraphicsOpacityEffect
)
from qfluentwidgets import ToolTipFilter, ToolTipPosition

from ui.components.chat_bubble import ChatMessageWidget

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.AssistantChatBubble")


class CyberpunkArtPlaceholderWidget(QWidget):
    """
    Киберпанк-лоадер / плейсхолдер ожидания кадра для NeonRoute.
    Glassmorphism, обсидиановый фон #0A0D14, акценты Cyan #00F0FF / Sky Blue #38BDF8.
    Мягкая пульсация неонового свечения и технологичных угловых меток.
    """
    TARGET_HEIGHT = 220

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("CyberpunkArtPlaceholder")
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Policy.Preferred)
        self.setMinimumWidth(360)
        self.setMaximumWidth(480)
        self.setMinimumHeight(0)
        self.setMaximumHeight(self.TARGET_HEIGHT)

        self._phase = 0.0
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._on_tick)
        self._timer.start(35)  # ~28 FPS

    def _on_tick(self):
        self._phase += 0.07
        if self._phase > 2 * math.pi:
            self._phase -= 2 * math.pi
        self.update()

    def stop(self):
        if self._timer.isActive():
            self._timer.stop()

    def hideEvent(self, event):
        self.stop()
        super().hideEvent(event)

    def showEvent(self, event):
        if not self._timer.isActive():
            self._timer.start(35)
        super().showEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        h = float(self.height())
        if h <= 4:
            return

        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.TextAntialiasing)

        w = float(self.width())
        rect = QRectF(1.5, 1.5, w - 3.0, h - 3.0)
        radius = min(14.0, h / 2.0)

        pulse = (math.sin(self._phase) + 1.0) / 2.0  # 0.0 .. 1.0

        # 1. Обсидиановый фон с деликатным вертикальным градиентом
        bg_gradient = QLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h)
        bg_gradient.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(14, 18, 28, 240))
        bg_gradient.setColorAt(0.5, QColor(10, 13, 20, 245))
        bg_gradient.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(7, 9, 14, 250))
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(bg_gradient))

        # 2. Неоновая пульсирующая рамка (Cyan #00F0FF -> Sky Blue #38BDF8)
        border_r = int(0 * (1.0 - pulse) + 56 * pulse)
        border_g = int(240 * (1.0 - pulse) + 189 * pulse)
        border_b = int(255 * (1.0 - pulse) + 248 * pulse)
        border_a = int(60 + 110 * pulse)
        border_pen = QPen(QColor(border_r, border_g, border_b, border_a), 1.2)
        painter.setPen(border_pen)
        painter.drawRoundedRect(rect, radius, radius)

        # 3. Внутреннее мягкое радиальное свечение (Ambient holographic glow)
        glow_gradient = QRadialGradient(w / 2.0, h / 2.0, w * 0.45)
        glow_gradient.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(0, 240, 255, int(12 + 18 * pulse)))
        glow_gradient.setColorAt(0.7, QColor(56, 189, 248, int(4 + 8 * pulse)))
        glow_gradient.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(10, 13, 20, 0))
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(glow_gradient))
        painter.drawRoundedRect(rect, radius, radius)

        # При маленькой высоте обрезаем внутреннее содержимое
        if h < 50:
            return

        # 4. Киберпанк-угловые метки видоискателя (HUD Corner brackets)
        corner_pen = QPen(QColor(0, 240, 255, int(140 + 115 * pulse)), 1.8)
        painter.setPen(corner_pen)
        painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
        clen = 14.0
        pad = 8.0

        # Верх-лево
        painter.drawLine(int(rect.left() + pad), int(rect.top() + pad), int(rect.left() + pad + clen), int(rect.top() + pad))
        painter.drawLine(int(rect.left() + pad), int(rect.top() + pad), int(rect.left() + pad), int(rect.top() + pad + clen))
        # Верх-право
        painter.drawLine(int(rect.right() - pad), int(rect.top() + pad), int(rect.right() - pad - clen), int(rect.top() + pad))
        painter.drawLine(int(rect.right() - pad), int(rect.top() + pad), int(rect.right() - pad), int(rect.top() + pad + clen))
        # Низ-лево
        painter.drawLine(int(rect.left() + pad), int(rect.bottom() - pad), int(rect.left() + pad + clen), int(rect.bottom() - pad))
        painter.drawLine(int(rect.left() + pad), int(rect.bottom() - pad), int(rect.left() + pad), int(rect.bottom() - pad - clen))
        # Низ-право
        painter.drawLine(int(rect.right() - pad), int(rect.bottom() - pad), int(rect.right() - pad - clen), int(rect.bottom() - pad))
        painter.drawLine(int(rect.right() - pad), int(rect.bottom() - pad), int(rect.right() - pad), int(rect.bottom() - pad - clen))

        # 5. Центральный голографический видоискатель (Viewfinder icon)
        cx = w / 2.0
        cy = h / 2.0 - 20.0
        vf_size = 38.0
        vf_rect = QRectF(cx - vf_size / 2.0, cy - vf_size / 2.0, vf_size, vf_size)

        vf_pen = QPen(QColor(56, 189, 248, int(80 + 90 * pulse)), 1.2)
        painter.setPen(vf_pen)
        painter.drawRoundedRect(vf_rect, 6.0, 6.0)

        core_alpha = int(170 + 85 * pulse)
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(0, 240, 255, core_alpha)))
        dot_r = 3.0 + 1.2 * pulse
        painter.drawEllipse(QRectF(cx - dot_r, cy - dot_r, dot_r * 2.0, dot_r * 2.0))

        ch_pen = QPen(QColor(0, 240, 255, int(120 + 80 * pulse)), 1.0)
        painter.setPen(ch_pen)
        ch_len = 5.0
        painter.drawLine(int(cx - ch_len), int(cy), int(cx - 2), int(cy))
        painter.drawLine(int(cx + 2), int(cy), int(cx + ch_len), int(cy))
        painter.drawLine(int(cx), int(cy - ch_len), int(cx), int(cy - 2))
        painter.drawLine(int(cx), int(cy + 2), int(cx), int(cy + ch_len))

        if h < 90:
            return

        # 6. Типографика NeonRoute
        title_font = QFont("Inter")
        title_font.setStyleHint(QFont.StyleHint.SansSerif)
        title_font.setPixelSize(11)
        title_font.setBold(True)
        title_font.setLetterSpacing(QFont.SpacingType.AbsoluteSpacing, 1.4)
        painter.setFont(title_font)

        title_alpha = int(210 + 45 * pulse)
        painter.setPen(QColor(0, 240, 255, title_alpha))
        title_rect = QRectF(10, cy + 28, w - 20, 18)
        painter.drawText(title_rect, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, "СИНТЕЗ КАДРА // GENERATING")

        sub_font = QFont("Inter")
        sub_font.setStyleHint(QFont.StyleHint.SansSerif)
        sub_font.setPixelSize(10)
        painter.setFont(sub_font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(148, 163, 184, 180))
        sub_rect = QRectF(10, cy + 48, w - 20, 16)
        painter.drawText(sub_rect, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, "SD WebUI Forge • Рендеринг сцены...")

        # 7. Нижняя неоновая световая нить
        line_w = 90.0 + 50.0 * pulse
        line_x = (w - line_w) / 2.0
        line_y = h - 18.0

        trace_grad = QLinearGradient(line_x, line_y, line_x + line_w, line_y)
        trace_grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(0, 240, 255, 0))
        trace_grad.setColorAt(0.5, QColor(0, 240, 255, int(160 * pulse)))
        trace_grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(56, 189, 248, 0))

        trace_pen = QPen(QBrush(trace_grad), 1.6)
        painter.setPen(trace_pen)
        painter.drawLine(int(line_x), int(line_y), int(line_x + line_w), int(line_y))


class AssistantChatMessageWidget(ChatMessageWidget):
    """
    Специализированный бабл сообщений Эларии.
    Изолирует логику интерактивных неоновых арт-чипов и киберпанк-лоадера от базового и ролевого чатов.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        sender: str,
        text: str,
        is_user: bool = False,
        is_error: bool = False,
        image_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        file_paths: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        audio_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        avatar_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        translated_text: Optional[str] = None,
        is_showing_translation: bool = False,
        font_size: int = 13,
        negative_prompt: Optional[str] = None,
        timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
        is_roleplay: bool = False,
        generation_params: Optional[dict] = None,
        message_id: Optional[str] = None,
        reply_to_id: Optional[str] = None,
        visual_intent: Optional[Union[dict, Any]] = None,
        parent=None,
        **kwargs
    ):
        kwargs.pop("is_roleplay", None)
        super().__init__(
            sender=sender,
            text=text,
            is_user=is_user,
            is_error=is_error,
            image_path=image_path,
            file_paths=file_paths,
            audio_path=audio_path,
            avatar_path=avatar_path,
            translated_text=translated_text,
            is_showing_translation=is_showing_translation,
            font_size=font_size,
            negative_prompt=negative_prompt,
            timestamp=timestamp,
            is_roleplay=False,
            generation_params=generation_params,
            message_id=message_id,
            reply_to_id=reply_to_id,
            visual_intent=visual_intent,
            parent=parent,
            **kwargs
        )
        self.art_proposal_chip: Optional[QPushButton] = None
        self.art_placeholder: Optional[CyberpunkArtPlaceholderWidget] = None
        self._placeholder_anim_group: Optional[QParallelAnimationGroup] = None

    def show_art_loading_placeholder(self):
        """Отображает киберпанк-лоадер синтеза кадра в теле бабла с плавной анимацией разворачивания."""
        if getattr(self, "art_placeholder", None) is not None:
            return

        if getattr(self, "art_proposal_chip", None) is not None:
            self.art_proposal_chip.setVisible(False)

        if not hasattr(self, "bubble_container") or not self.bubble_container:
            return

        # 1. Мгновенное скрытие пустого текста без остаточных отступов
        if not self.raw_text or not self.raw_text.strip():
            if hasattr(self, "text_browser") and self.text_browser:
                self.text_browser.setFixedHeight(0)
                self.text_browser.setVisible(False)
                self.text_browser.hide()

        # 2. Создание плейсхолдера с анимацией разворачивания по высоте и прозрачности
        target_h = CyberpunkArtPlaceholderWidget.TARGET_HEIGHT
        placeholder = CyberpunkArtPlaceholderWidget(self.bubble_container)
        self.art_placeholder = placeholder
        placeholder.setMinimumHeight(0)
        placeholder.setMaximumHeight(0)

        opacity_effect = QGraphicsOpacityEffect(placeholder)
        opacity_effect.setOpacity(0.0)
        placeholder.setGraphicsEffect(opacity_effect)

        layout = self.bubble_container.layout()
        if layout:
            layout.addWidget(placeholder)

        if self.bubble_container:
            self.bubble_container.setMinimumWidth(max(self.bubble_container.minimumWidth(), 380))

        anim_group = QParallelAnimationGroup(self)

        height_anim = QPropertyAnimation(placeholder, b"maximumHeight", anim_group)
        height_anim.setDuration(300)
        height_anim.setStartValue(0)
        height_anim.setEndValue(target_h)
        height_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.OutCubic)

        opacity_anim = QPropertyAnimation(opacity_effect, b"opacity", anim_group)
        opacity_anim.setDuration(300)
        opacity_anim.setStartValue(0.0)
        opacity_anim.setEndValue(1.0)
        opacity_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.OutCubic)

        anim_group.addAnimation(height_anim)
        anim_group.addAnimation(opacity_anim)

        def _on_anim_step():
            self._update_bubble_geometry()
            p = self.parentWidget()
            if p and hasattr(p, "layout") and p.layout():
                p.layout().activate()

        height_anim.valueChanged.connect(lambda _: _on_anim_step())

        def _on_anim_finished():
            placeholder.setFixedHeight(target_h)
            placeholder.setGraphicsEffect(None)
            self._update_bubble_geometry()
            self._adjust_text_height()

        anim_group.finished.connect(_on_anim_finished)
        self._placeholder_anim_group = anim_group
        anim_group.start()

    def hide_art_loading_placeholder(self):
        """Плавно завершает и удаляет плейсхолдер синтеза кадра."""
        if hasattr(self, "_placeholder_anim_group") and self._placeholder_anim_group:
            try:
                self._placeholder_anim_group.stop()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._placeholder_anim_group = None

        placeholder = getattr(self, "art_placeholder", None)
        if placeholder is not None:
            try:
                placeholder.stop()
                placeholder.deleteLater()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.art_placeholder = None
            self._update_bubble_geometry()
            self._adjust_text_height()

    def set_image(self, img_path: Union[str, Path]):
        """Бесшовный монтаж изображения с автоматическим снятием плейсхолдера."""
        if getattr(self, "art_placeholder", None) is not None:
            self.hide_art_loading_placeholder()
        super().set_image(img_path)

    def attach_file(self, file_path: Path, generation_params: Optional[dict] = None):
        """Бесшовное прикрепление файла с автоматическим снятием плейсхолдера."""
        if getattr(self, "art_placeholder", None) is not None:
            self.hide_art_loading_placeholder()
        super().attach_file(file_path, generation_params=generation_params)

    def add_art_proposal_chip(self, prompt: str, on_generate: Optional[callable] = None):
        """Монтирует интерактивный неоновый чип генерации под текстом ответа."""
        if not self.bubble_container:
            return

        if getattr(self, "art_proposal_chip", None) is not None:
            try:
                self.art_proposal_chip.deleteLater()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.art_proposal_chip = None

        chip_btn = QPushButton("🎨 Сгенерировать иллюстрацию", self.bubble_container)
        chip_btn.setObjectName("ArtProposalChip")
        chip_btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        chip_btn.setToolTip(f"Запустить генерацию кадра в Forge:\n{prompt}")
        chip_btn.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(chip_btn, 300, ToolTipPosition.BOTTOM))
        chip_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton#ArtProposalChip {
                background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0,
                    stop:0 rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12),
                    stop:1 rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.18));
                color: #00F0FF;
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45);
                border-radius: 14px;
                padding: 6px 16px;
                font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 600;
                margin-top: 4px;
                margin-bottom: 3px;
                text-align: left;
            }
            QPushButton#ArtProposalChip:hover {
                background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0,
                    stop:0 rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.28),
                    stop:1 rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.36));
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #FFFFFF;
            }
            QPushButton#ArtProposalChip:pressed {
                background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08);
            }
            QPushButton#ArtProposalChip:disabled {
                background-color: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.5);
                border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
                color: #94A3B8;
            }
        """)

        def _safe_generate():
            chip_btn.setEnabled(False)
            chip_btn.setText("⏳ Запуск генерации...")
            if on_generate:
                try:
                    on_generate()
                except Exception as ex:
                    logger.error(f"Art generation invocation failed: {ex}")
                    chip_btn.setEnabled(True)
                    chip_btn.setText("🎨 Сгенерировать иллюстрацию")

        chip_btn.clicked.connect(_safe_generate)

        self.art_proposal_chip = chip_btn

        layout = self.bubble_container.layout()
        if layout:
            if hasattr(self, "footer_layout") and self.footer_layout:
                idx = layout.indexOf(self.footer_layout)
                if idx >= 0:
                    layout.insertWidget(idx, chip_btn)
                elif layout.count() > 1:
                    layout.insertWidget(layout.count() - 1, chip_btn)
                else:
                    layout.addWidget(chip_btn)
            elif layout.count() > 1:
                layout.insertWidget(layout.count() - 1, chip_btn)
            else:
                layout.addWidget(chip_btn)

        self._update_bubble_geometry()
        self._adjust_text_height()

    def set_scene_art_busy(self, busy: bool, text: Optional[str] = None):
        """Переключает чип Эларии в состояние ожидания при рендере."""
        chip = getattr(self, "art_proposal_chip", None)
        if chip is not None:
            try:
                chip.setEnabled(not busy)
                if busy:
                    chip.setText(text or "⏳ Генерация иллюстрации...")
                else:
                    chip.setText("🎨 Сгенерировать иллюстрацию")
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
        if busy:
            self.show_art_loading_placeholder()
        else:
            self.hide_art_loading_placeholder()
        self._update_bubble_geometry()

"""
Embedded Audio Player Component for NeonRoute
Uses PyQt6 QMediaPlayer and QAudioOutput for sleek, in-chat WAV playback.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QUrl
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QPushButton, QSlider, QLabel, QStyle
)
from PyQt6.QtMultimedia import QMediaPlayer, QAudioOutput


class AudioPlayerWidget(QWidget):
    """
    Compact Cyberpunk audio player widget embedded directly into chat messages.
    """
    def __init__(self, audio_file_path: Path | str, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.audio_path = Path(audio_file_path)

        # Multimedia objects
        self.player = QMediaPlayer(self)
        self.audio_output = QAudioOutput(self)
        self.player.setAudioOutput(self.audio_output)
        self.audio_output.setVolume(0.85)

        self._setup_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

        if self.audio_path.exists():
            self.player.setSource(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(self.audio_path.resolve())))

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setObjectName("AudioPlayerWidget")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            #AudioPlayerWidget {
                background-color: #121824;
                border: 1px solid #1F2A3E;
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 4px;
            }
        """)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(8, 4, 8, 4)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        # Play / Pause button
        self.play_btn = QPushButton("▶", self)
        self.play_btn.setFixedSize(32, 32)
        self.play_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #0A0E17;
                font-size: 14px;
                font-weight: bold;
                border-radius: 16px;
                border: none;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #4DF4FF;
            }
        """)
        self.play_btn.clicked.connect(self.toggle_playback)
        layout.addWidget(self.play_btn)

        # Position slider
        self.slider = QSlider(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal, self)
        self.slider.setRange(0, 1000)
        self.slider.sliderMoved.connect(self.set_position)
        layout.addWidget(self.slider)

        # Time label
        self.time_label = QLabel("00:00 / 00:00", self)
        self.time_label.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px;")
        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)

    def _connect_signals(self):
        self.player.positionChanged.connect(self._on_position_changed)
        self.player.durationChanged.connect(self._on_duration_changed)
        self.player.playbackStateChanged.connect(self._on_state_changed)

    def toggle_playback(self):
        if self.player.playbackState() == QMediaPlayer.PlaybackState.PlayingState:
            self.player.pause()
        else:
            self.player.play()

    def set_position(self, position_ratio):
        duration = self.player.duration()
        if duration > 0:
            target_ms = int((position_ratio / 1000.0) * duration)
            self.player.setPosition(target_ms)

    def _on_position_changed(self, pos_ms: int):
        duration = self.player.duration()
        if duration > 0 and not self.slider.isSliderDown():
            ratio = int((pos_ms / duration) * 1000)
            self.slider.setValue(ratio)
        self._update_time_label(pos_ms, duration)

    def _on_duration_changed(self, duration_ms: int):
        self._update_time_label(self.player.position(), duration_ms)

    def _on_state_changed(self, state: QMediaPlayer.PlaybackState):
        if state == QMediaPlayer.PlaybackState.PlayingState:
            self.play_btn.setText("⏸")
        else:
            self.play_btn.setText("▶")
            if self.player.position() >= self.player.duration() and self.player.duration() > 0:
                self.player.setPosition(0)
                self.slider.setValue(0)

    def _update_time_label(self, pos_ms: int, dur_ms: int):
        cur_sec = max(0, pos_ms // 1000)
        dur_sec = max(0, dur_ms // 1000)
        self.time_label.setText(f"{cur_sec // 60:02d}:{cur_sec % 60:02d} / {dur_sec // 60:02d}:{dur_sec % 60:02d}")

    def cleanup(self):
        """Stops player and releases audio output when parent message is removed."""
        try:
            self.player.stop()
            self.player.setSource(QUrl())
        except Exception:
            pass

"""
Chat Background Viewport Component for NeonRoute
Provides high-performance wallpaper rendering with KeepAspectRatioByExpanding,
pre-scaled QPixmap caching in resizeEvent, adaptive dimming, and frosted glass support.
"""

from typing import Optional
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPainter, QColor, QPixmap, QCursor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QMenu


class ChatBackgroundViewport(QWidget):
    change_background_requested = pyqtSignal()
    change_dimming_requested = pyqtSignal()
    reset_background_requested = pyqtSignal()

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_StyledBackground, False)
        self.setAutoFillBackground(False)
        self._bg_pixmap: Optional[QPixmap] = None
        self._scaled_pixmap: Optional[QPixmap] = None
        self._dim_alpha: int = 150  # Default ~60% darkening (0-255)

        self.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)
        self.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_context_menu)

    def set_background(self, pixmap: Optional[QPixmap], alpha: int = 150):
        """Sets the raw background pixmap and dimming alpha, updating cached scaled pixmap."""
        if pixmap is not None and pixmap.isNull():
            pixmap = None
        self._bg_pixmap = pixmap
        self._dim_alpha = max(20, min(240, alpha))
        # Если картинка задана — выключаем сквозную прозрачность, чтобы буфер рисовался
        if self._bg_pixmap is not None:
            self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, False)
        else:
            self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)
        self._update_scaled_pixmap()
        self.update()

    def set_dim_alpha(self, alpha: int):
        """Updates dimming alpha level without reloading pixmap."""
        self._dim_alpha = max(20, min(240, alpha))
        self.update()

    def get_dim_alpha(self) -> int:
        return self._dim_alpha

    def has_background(self) -> bool:
        return self._bg_pixmap is not None and not self._bg_pixmap.isNull()

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        # CRITICAL OPTIMIZATION: Cache scaled pixmap strictly on resize, never in paintEvent
        self._update_scaled_pixmap()

    def _update_scaled_pixmap(self):
        if self._bg_pixmap and not self._bg_pixmap.isNull():
            sz = self.size()
            if sz.width() > 10 and sz.height() > 10:
                self._scaled_pixmap = self._bg_pixmap.scaled(
                    sz,
                    Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatioByExpanding,
                    Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
                )
            else:
                self._scaled_pixmap = None
        else:
            self._scaled_pixmap = None

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        painter = QPainter(self)
        if self._scaled_pixmap and not self._scaled_pixmap.isNull():
            # Center the scaled wallpaper
            x = (self.width() - self._scaled_pixmap.width()) // 2
            y = (self.height() - self._scaled_pixmap.height()) // 2
            painter.drawPixmap(x, y, self._scaled_pixmap)

            # Apply adaptive darkening layer
            painter.fillRect(self.rect(), QColor(10, 12, 18, self._dim_alpha))
        else:
            # Когда картинки нет — оставляем прозрачным для просвечивания дефолтного окна
            painter.fillRect(self.rect(), QColor(0, 0, 0, 0))
        painter.end()

    def _show_context_menu(self, pos):
        menu = QMenu(self)
        menu.setStyleSheet("""
            QMenu {
                background-color: #121824;
                color: #E2E8F0;
                border: 1px solid #1E283D;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 4px;
            }
            QMenu::item {
                padding: 6px 18px;
                border-radius: 4px;
            }
            QMenu::item:selected {
                background-color: #1C263B;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
            QMenu::separator {
                height: 1px;
                background-color: #1E283D;
                margin: 4px 6px;
            }
        """)

        act_change = menu.addAction("🖼️ Сменить фон чата...")
        act_change.triggered.connect(self.change_background_requested.emit)

        if self.has_background():
            act_dim = menu.addAction("🌓 Настроить затемнение фона...")
            act_dim.triggered.connect(self.change_dimming_requested.emit)

            act_reset = menu.addAction("🔄 Сбросить фон (дефолтная тема)")
            act_reset.triggered.connect(self.reset_background_requested.emit)

        menu.exec(QCursor.pos())

class SelectableTextBrowser(QTextBrowser):
    """
    Subclass of QTextBrowser that automatically clears text selection
    when losing focus and strictly prevents horizontal scrolling/dragging.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setLineWrapMode(QTextBrowser.LineWrapMode.WidgetWidth)
        self.setWordWrapMode(QTextOption.WrapMode.WrapAtWordBoundaryOrAnywhere)
        self.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)

    def wheelEvent(self, event):
        """Пересылает прокрутку мыши родителю, исключая внутренний скроллинг."""
        event.ignore()

    def scrollContentsBy(self, dx: int, dy: int):
        super().scrollContentsBy(0, dy)

    def focusOutEvent(self, event: QFocusEvent):
        cursor = self.textCursor()
        if cursor.hasSelection():
            cursor.clearSelection()
            self.setTextCursor(cursor)
        super().focusOutEvent(event)

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        if event.oldSize().width() != event.size().width():
            doc = self.document()
            w = max(100.0, float(self.viewport().width()))
            if abs(doc.textWidth() - w) > 6:
                doc.setTextWidth(w)

        self.image_preview_lbl = QLabel(self.bubble_container)

        if self.image_path and self.image_path.exists():

            if not rounded_pix.isNull():
                img_sz = QImageReader(str(self.image_path)).size()
                orig_w, orig_h = (img_sz.width(), img_sz.height()) if img_sz.isValid() else (rounded_pix.width(), rounded_pix.height())
                scaled_pix = rounded_pix
                file_sz_kb = self.image_path.stat().st_size / 1024 if self.image_path.exists() else 0
                sz_str = f"{file_sz_kb / 1024:.2f} MB" if file_sz_kb > 1024 else f"{file_sz_kb:.0f} KB"

                self.art_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)

                    if m_match:

                self.image_preview_lbl.mousePressEvent = lambda e: self._open_image_preview(self.image_path) if (not hasattr(e, "button") or e.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton) else None
                self.image_preview_lbl.setVisible(True)
                self.art_layout.addWidget(self.image_preview_lbl)

                if model_info:

            self.image_preview_lbl.setVisible(False)

        for f_path in self.file_paths:

        self.copy_btn.setToolTip("Копировать текст")

            self.btn_regen.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(self.btn_regen, 300, ToolTipPosition.BOTTOM))

        # Оборачиваем бабл и его независимые кнопки в вертикальную колонку
        msg_column = QVBoxLayout()

    def append_stream_chunk(self, chunk: str):
        """Плавное добавление потокового токена в видимый бабл без лагов перерисовки."""
        if getattr(self, "footer_container", None) and self.footer_container.isVisible():
            self.footer_container.setVisible(False)
        if not chunk:
            return
        self.raw_text += chunk
        self.original_text += chunk

        if not self.text_browser and self.bubble_container:
            self.text_browser = SelectableTextBrowser(self.bubble_container)
            self.text_browser.setReadOnly(True)
            self.text_browser.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
            self.text_browser.setOpenExternalLinks(False)
            self.text_browser.setOpenLinks(False)
            self.text_browser.anchorClicked.connect(self._on_anchor_clicked)
            self.text_browser.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
            self.text_browser.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
            self.text_browser.setTextInteractionFlags(
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse |
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByKeyboard |
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.LinksAccessibleByMouse |
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.LinksAccessibleByKeyboard
            )
            self.text_browser.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)
            self.text_browser.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_context_menu)

            font = QFont("Inter", self.font_size)
            font.setFamilies(["Inter", "Segoe UI", "sans-serif"])
            self.text_browser.setFont(font)
            if self.text_browser.document():
                self.text_browser.document().setDefaultFont(font)

            text_color = "#FCA5A5" if self.is_error else ("#FFFFFF" if self.is_user else "#F1F5F9")
            self.text_browser.setStyleSheet(f"""
                QTextBrowser {{
                    background-color: transparent;
                    color: {text_color};
                    border: none;
                    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
                    font-size: {self.font_size}px;
                    line-height: 1.18;
                    selection-background-color: #00F0FF;
                    selection-color: #000000;
                }}
            """)
            layout_ref = getattr(self, "bubble_layout", None) or (self.bubble_container.layout() if self.bubble_container else None)
            if layout_ref:
                # Текст ответа всегда монтируется на первую позицию под заголовок (индекс 1)
                layout_ref.insertWidget(1, self.text_browser)

        if self.text_browser:
            self.text_browser.setHtml(self._markdown_to_html(self.raw_text))
            self._update_bubble_geometry()
            self._adjust_text_height()

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._update_bubble_geometry()
        self._adjust_text_height()

    def _refresh_layout(self):
        """Безопасный перерасчет геометрии и высоты документа без реэнтерабельного processEvents."""
        self._update_bubble_geometry()
        if self.bubble_container and self.bubble_container.layout():
            self.bubble_container.layout().activate()
        self._adjust_text_height()
        self.updateGeometry()

    def _update_bubble_geometry(self):
        if getattr(self, "_is_resizing_geometry", False):
            return
        self._is_resizing_geometry = True
        try:
            if self.bubble_container is None:
                return
            
            # АРХИТЕКТУРНОЕ ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: 100% разрыв петли обратной связи.
            # Ищем строго жесткое окно QScrollArea через isinstance.
            safe_parent_w = 1000
            p = self.parentWidget()
            from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QScrollArea
            while p:
                if isinstance(p, QScrollArea):
                    safe_parent_w = p.width()
                    break
                p = p.parentWidget()

            if safe_parent_w <= 100:
                return

            # Квантование ширины родителя с шагом не менее 16px
            safe_parent_w = (safe_parent_w // 16) * 16

            text = self.translated_text if (self.is_showing_translation and self.translated_text) else (self.raw_text or "")
            
            line_count = len(text.splitlines()) if text else 1
            char_count = len(text)
            has_code_or_art = bool(self.image_path or self.file_paths or "```" in text or "<pre" in text)

            # Ратчет (храповик) контента
            if not hasattr(self, "_peak_char_count"):
                self._peak_char_count = char_count
            if char_count > self._peak_char_count:
                self._peak_char_count = char_count
                
            if not hasattr(self, "_peak_line_count"):
                self._peak_line_count = line_count
            if line_count > self._peak_line_count:
                self._peak_line_count = line_count

            eval_chars = max(char_count, self._peak_char_count)
            eval_lines = max(line_count, self._peak_line_count)

            if has_code_or_art or eval_lines >= 40 or eval_chars > 1200:
                active_tier = 4
                user_ratio, asst_ratio = 0.92, 0.98
            elif eval_lines >= 20 or eval_chars > 500:
                active_tier = 3
                user_ratio, asst_ratio = 0.82, 0.88
            elif eval_lines >= 8 or eval_chars > 180:
                active_tier = 2
                user_ratio, asst_ratio = 0.70, 0.78
            else:
                active_tier = 1
                user_ratio, asst_ratio = 0.55, 0.65

            # Учет системных элементов строки:
            ROW_UI_OVERHEAD = 120
            RIGHT_MARGIN_4CM = 152
            available_net_w = max(260, safe_parent_w - ROW_UI_OVERHEAD - RIGHT_MARGIN_4CM)

            if self.is_user:
                max_w = min(int(available_net_w * user_ratio), 1000)
            else:
                max_w = min(int(available_net_w * asst_ratio), 1200)

            # Квантование max_w шагом не менее 16px
            max_w = (max_w // 16) * 16

            # ЖЕСТКИЙ БЛОК (Solid Block Architecture)
            if active_tier >= 2:
                target_min = max_w
            else:
                current_w = max(self.bubble_container.width(), self.bubble_container.sizeHint().width())
                if not hasattr(self, "_peak_actual_w"):
                    self._peak_actual_w = current_w

                if self._peak_actual_w > max_w:
                    self._peak_actual_w = max_w

                if current_w > self._peak_actual_w:
                    self._peak_actual_w = current_w
                
                target_min = self._peak_actual_w

            target_min = min(target_min, max_w)
            target_min = (target_min // 16) * 16

            if self.bubble_container.minimumWidth() != target_min or self.bubble_container.maximumWidth() != max_w:
                self.bubble_container.setMinimumWidth(target_min)
                self.bubble_container.setMaximumWidth(max_w)
        finally:
            self._is_resizing_geometry = False

    def _adjust_text_height(self):
        if getattr(self, "_is_resizing_geometry", False):
            return
        self._is_resizing_geometry = True
        try:
            if not hasattr(self, "text_browser") or not self.text_browser:
                return

            if not self.raw_text or not self.raw_text.strip():
                self.text_browser.setFixedHeight(0)
                self.text_browser.setVisible(False)
                return
            else:
                self.text_browser.setVisible(True)

            doc = self.text_browser.document()
            doc.setDocumentMargin(6)

            target_w = 0
            if self.bubble_container and self.bubble_container.width() > 100:
                target_w = self.bubble_container.width() - 40
            elif self.width() > 100:
                target_w = int(self.width() * 0.85) - 40
            else:
                target_w = 780

            # Квантование ширины документа шагом не менее 16px
            target_w = (target_w // 16) * 16

            # АРХИТЕКТУРНОЕ ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Абсолютная точность ширины документа
            if target_w > 80:
                doc.setTextWidth(target_w)

            ideal_h = int(doc.documentLayout().documentSize().height())
            final_h = max(ideal_h + 12, 24)
            if abs(self.text_browser.height() - final_h) > 4:
                self.text_browser.setFixedHeight(final_h)
        finally:
            self._is_resizing_geometry = False

    def set_knowledge_sources(self, sources: List[Dict[str, Any]]):
        """
        Устанавливает список использованных источников базы знаний.
        Если sources пуст, HUD-контейнер скрывается без остаточных отступов.
        Если sources содержит элементы, монтируется неоновый HUD-контейнер с микро-чипами.
        """
        self.knowledge_sources = sources or []
        if getattr(self, "knowledge_hud", None) is not None:
            self.knowledge_hud.set_sources(self.knowledge_sources)
            self._update_bubble_geometry()

    def get_or_create_thought_spoiler(self):
        """Возвращает существующий или создает ThoughtSpoilerWidget над текстовым блоком."""
        if getattr(self, "thought_spoiler", None) is None:
            from ui.components.thought_spoiler_widget import ThoughtSpoilerWidget
            self.thought_spoiler = ThoughtSpoilerWidget(self.bubble_container)
            if hasattr(self, "bubble_layout"):
                if getattr(self, "knowledge_hud", None):
                    idx = self.bubble_layout.indexOf(self.knowledge_hud)
                    self.bubble_layout.insertWidget(idx + 1, self.thought_spoiler)
                else:
                    self.bubble_layout.insertWidget(1, self.thought_spoiler)
            self.thought_spoiler.setVisible(False)
            self.thought_spoiler.hide()
        return self.thought_spoiler

    def append_thought_chunk(self, chunk: str):
        """Дописывает чанк токенов в спойлер мыслей и показывает его."""
        spoiler = self.get_or_create_thought_spoiler()
        if not spoiler.isVisible():
            spoiler.setVisible(True)
            spoiler.show()
        spoiler.append_thought_chunk(chunk)
        self._update_bubble_geometry()

    def finalize_thought(self, duration_sec: float = 0.0, token_count: Union[int, str] = 0):
        """Фиксирует метрики мыслей и сворачивает спойлер."""
        if isinstance(token_count, str) and not token_count.isdigit():
            spoiler = self.get_or_create_thought_spoiler()
            spoiler.set_thought_data(token_count, duration_sec)
            self._update_bubble_geometry()
            return

        if getattr(self, "thought_spoiler", None) is not None:
            self.thought_spoiler.finalize_thought(duration_sec, token_count)
            self._update_bubble_geometry()

    def set_thought_data(self, text: str, duration: float = 0.0, token_count: int = 0):
        """Устанавливает готовый блок мыслей (из истории или после завершения генерации)."""
        clean = str(text or "").strip()
        if not clean:
            if getattr(self, "thought_spoiler", None) is not None:
                self.thought_spoiler.setVisible(False)
                self.thought_spoiler.hide()
                self._update_bubble_geometry()
            return

        spoiler = self.get_or_create_thought_spoiler()
        self.thought_data = {
            "content": clean,
            "duration": float(duration),
            "token_count": int(token_count)
        }
        spoiler.set_thought_data(clean, duration, token_count)
        self._update_bubble_geometry()

    def set_text(self, text: str):
        self.original_text = text
        self.raw_text = text
        self._update_rendered_text()
        self._refresh_layout()
        if getattr(self, "footer_container", None):
            self.footer_container.setVisible(True)

    def update_avatar(self, new_avatar_path: Optional[Path]):
        self.avatar_path = Path(new_avatar_path) if new_avatar_path else None
        if hasattr(self, "avatar_lbl") and self.avatar_lbl:
            self.avatar_lbl.setPixmap(
                render_circular_avatar(
                    avatar_path=self.avatar_path,
                    name=self.sender,
                    size=64,
                    is_user=self.is_user,
                    is_error=self.is_error
                )
            )

    def set_negative_prompt(self, negative_prompt: str):
        self.negative_prompt = negative_prompt
        if not self.generation_params:
            self.generation_params = {}
        self.generation_params["negative_prompt"] = negative_prompt
        self.set_generation_params(self.generation_params)

    def _render_generation_info_accordion(self, target_layout: Optional[QLayout] = None, max_width: Optional[int] = None):
        if not self.generation_params:
            return
        if self.gen_info_widget is not None:
            self.gen_info_widget.deleteLater()
            self.gen_info_widget = None

        accordion = GenerationInfoAccordionWidget(self.generation_params, max_width=max_width, parent=self)
        self.gen_info_widget = accordion
        if target_layout is not None:
            target_layout.addWidget(accordion)
        elif self.bubble_container and self.bubble_container.layout():
            layout = self.bubble_container.layout()
            layout.addWidget(accordion)

    def set_generation_params(self, params: dict):
        self.generation_params = params
        if self.negative_prompt and "negative_prompt" not in self.generation_params:
            self.generation_params["negative_prompt"] = self.negative_prompt

        target_layout = None
        if self.gen_info_widget is not None and self.gen_info_widget.parent():
            target_layout = self.gen_info_widget.parent().layout()
        if not target_layout:
            target_layout = getattr(self, "art_layout", None) or (self.bubble_container.layout() if self.bubble_container else None)
        self._render_generation_info_accordion(target_layout=target_layout, max_width=None)
