        if self.btn_translate:
            self.btn_translate.setText("🌐 Оригинал")
        self._update_rendered_text()
        self._refresh_layout()

    def _toggle_translation(self):
        if not self.translated_text:
            if self.btn_translate:
                self.btn_translate.setText("⏳ Перевод...")
                self.btn_translate.setToolTip("Выполняется перевод сообщения...")
                self._refresh_layout()
            self.translate_requested.emit(self.original_text, self)
            return

        self.is_showing_translation = not self.is_showing_translation
        self._update_rendered_text()
        if self.btn_translate:
            self.btn_translate.setText("🌐 Оригинал" if self.is_showing_translation else "🌐 Перевести")
            self.btn_translate.setToolTip("Показать оригинал" if self.is_showing_translation else "Перевести на русский")
        self._refresh_layout()

    def set_scene_art_state(self, is_ready: bool, cue_text: str = ""):
        """
        Управляет доступностью и внешним видом кнопки арт-сцены:
        - is_ready=False: анализ еще идет, клик заблокирован, текст '⏳ Подготовка сцены...'
        - is_ready=True: сцена готова, кнопка активна, превью кадра в тултипе.
        """
        if not getattr(self, "btn_scene_art", None):
            return

        try:
            self.btn_scene_art.setEnabled(is_ready)
            if not is_ready:
                self.btn_scene_art.setText("⏳ Подготовка сцены...")
                self.btn_scene_art.setStyleSheet("""
                    QPushButton {
                        background: transparent;
                        border: none;
                        color: #64748B;
                        font-size: 11px;
                        padding: 0px 2px;
                    }
                """)
                self.btn_scene_art.setToolTip("Идет фоновый анализ окружения и динамики сцены...")
                
                # АРХИТЕКТУРНОЕ ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Таймер-предохранитель (Failsafe)
                if not hasattr(self, "_scene_art_timer"):
                    from PyQt6.QtCore import QTimer
                    self._scene_art_timer = QTimer(self)
                    self._scene_art_timer.setSingleShot(True)
                    self._scene_art_timer.timeout.connect(lambda: self.set_scene_art_state(True))
                self._scene_art_timer.start(12000)
            else:
                if hasattr(self, "_scene_art_timer"):
                    self._scene_art_timer.stop()
                self.btn_scene_art.setText("🎨 Арт сцены")
                self.btn_scene_art.setStyleSheet("""
                    QPushButton {
                        background: transparent;
                        border: none;
                        color: #C084FC;
                        font-size: 11px;
                        padding: 0px 2px;
                        font-weight: 600;
                    }
                    QPushButton:hover {
                        color: #00F0FF;
                    }
                """)
                if cue_text:
                    self.btn_scene_art.setToolTip(f"Готовый кадр сцены:\n{cue_text}")
                else:
                    self.btn_scene_art.setToolTip("Создать иллюстрацию сцены через SD WebUI Forge")

            # Форсируем перерасчет макета для предотвращения визуальных артефактов
            self._refresh_layout()
        except RuntimeError:
            pass

    def _update_rendered_text(self):
        current = self.translated_text if (self.is_showing_translation and self.translated_text) else self.original_text
        self.raw_text = current

        if not getattr(self, "text_browser", None) and getattr(self, "bubble_container", None):
            self.text_browser = SelectableTextBrowser(self.bubble_container)
            self.text_browser.setReadOnly(True)
            self.text_browser.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
            self.text_browser.setOpenExternalLinks(False)
            self.text_browser.setOpenLinks(False)
            self.text_browser.anchorClicked.connect(self._on_anchor_clicked)
            self.text_browser.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
            self.text_browser.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
            self.text_browser.setTextInteractionFlags(
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse |
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByKeyboard |
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.LinksAccessibleByMouse |
                Qt.TextInteractionFlag.LinksAccessibleByKeyboard
            )
            self.text_browser.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)
            self.text_browser.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_context_menu)

            font = QFont("Inter", self.font_size)
            font.setFamilies(["Inter", "Segoe UI", "sans-serif"])
            self.text_browser.setFont(font)
            if self.text_browser.document():
                self.text_browser.document().setDefaultFont(font)

            text_color = "#FCA5A5" if self.is_error else ("#FFFFFF" if self.is_user else "#F1F5F9")
            self.text_browser.setStyleSheet(f"""
                QTextBrowser {{
                    background-color: transparent;
                    color: {text_color};
                    border: none;
                    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
                    font-size: {self.font_size}px;
                    line-height: 1.18;
                    selection-background-color: #00F0FF;
                    selection-color: #000000;
                }}
            """)
            if self.bubble_container.layout():
                self.bubble_container.layout().insertWidget(1, self.text_browser)

        if self.text_browser:
            self.text_browser.setHtml(self._markdown_to_html(current))
            self._update_bubble_geometry()
            self._adjust_text_height()

    def set_font_size(self, size: int):
        self.font_size = size
        if hasattr(self, "text_browser") and self.text_browser:

            self.text_browser.setFont(font)

            text_color = "#FCA5A5" if self.is_error else ("#FFFFFF" if self.is_user else "#F1F5F9")

                QTextBrowser {{

            self._adjust_text_height()

    def set_image(self, img_path: Union[str, Path]):
        p = Path(img_path)
        self.image_path = p
        if hasattr(self, "bubble_container") and self.bubble_container:
            for child in self.bubble_container.findChildren(QWidget, "DynamicImageContainer"):
                try:

            self.hide_art_loading_placeholder()
        self.attach_file(p)

    def attach_file(self, file_path: Path, generation_params: Optional[dict] = None):
        if not self.bubble_container:
            return
        if getattr(self, "art_placeholder", None) is not None:
            self.hide_art_loading_placeholder()
        if getattr(self, "art_proposal_chip", None):
            self.art_proposal_chip.deleteLater()
            self.art_proposal_chip = None
        if generation_params:
            self.generation_params = generation_params
        elif self.negative_prompt:
            if not self.generation_params:
                self.generation_params = {}
            if "negative_prompt" not in self.generation_params:
                self.generation_params["negative_prompt"] = self.negative_prompt
        ext = file_path.suffix.lower()
        layout = self.bubble_container.layout()
        if ext in ('.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.webp'):
            img_w = self._create_image_thumbnail(file_path, generation_params=generation_params or self.generation_params)
            target_w = img_w
        else:
            card = FileCardWidget(file_path, self.bubble_container)
            target_w = card

        layout.addWidget(target_w)
            
        # АРХИТЕКТУРНОЕ ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: Пересчет ширины при вставке медиа
        self._refresh_layout()

    def _create_image_thumbnail(self, image_path: Path, generation_params: Optional[dict] = None) -> QWidget:
        container = QWidget(self.bubble_container)
        container.setObjectName("DynamicImageContainer")
        container.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Minimum, QSizePolicy.Policy.Minimum)
        container.setStyleSheet("background: transparent; border: none;")
        c_layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        c_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 4, 0, 4)
        c_layout.setSpacing(4)
        c_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)

        img_btn = QPushButton(container)
        img_btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        img_btn.setToolTip("Клик — полноразмерный просмотр")

        rounded_thumb = get_cached_art_pixmap(image_path, target_size=380, radius=14.0)
        thumb_w = 380
        if not rounded_thumb.isNull():
            thumb_w = rounded_thumb.width()
            img_btn.setIcon(QIcon(rounded_thumb))
            img_btn.setIconSize(rounded_thumb.size())
            img_btn.setFixedSize(rounded_thumb.size())
            container.setMinimumWidth(thumb_w)

        img_btn.setStyleSheet("QPushButton { background: transparent; border: none; padding: 0px; }")

        img_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: ImagePreviewDialog(image_path, self).exec())
        c_layout.addWidget(img_btn)

        eff_params = generation_params or self.generation_params
        if eff_params:
            accordion = GenerationInfoAccordionWidget(eff_params, max_width=None, parent=container)
            c_layout.addWidget(accordion)
            self.gen_info_widget = accordion

        return container

    def _open_image_preview(self, image_path: Path):
        if image_path and image_path.exists():
            dlg = ImagePreviewDialog(image_path, self)
            dlg.exec()

    def _copy_text(self):
        if hasattr(self, "text_browser") and self.text_browser:
            cursor = self.text_browser.textCursor()
            selected = cursor.selectedText()
            if selected:
                cleaned = selected.replace('\u2029', '\n').replace('\u2028', '\n')
                QApplication.clipboard().setText(cleaned)
                return
        raw = getattr(self, "raw_text", "") or ""
        cleaned_raw = raw.replace('\u2029', '\n').replace('\u2028', '\n')
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(cleaned_raw)

    def _show_context_menu(self, pos):
        menu = QMenu(self)
        menu.setStyleSheet("""
            QMenu {
                background-color: #121824;
                color: #E2E8F0;
                border: 1px solid #1E283D;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 4px;
            }
            QMenu::item {
                padding: 6px 18px;
                border-radius: 4px;
            }
            QMenu::item:selected {
                background-color: #1C263B;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
            QMenu::separator {
                height: 1px;
                background-color: #1E283D;
                margin: 4px 6px;
            }
        """)

        selected_text = ""
        if hasattr(self, "text_browser") and self.text_browser:
            cursor = self.text_browser.textCursor()
            selected_text = cursor.selectedText().strip()

        if selected_text:
            act_copy_sel = menu.addAction("📋 Копировать выделенный фрагмент")
            act_copy_sel.triggered.connect(lambda: QApplication.clipboard().setText(selected_text))

        act_copy_all = menu.addAction("📋 Копировать весь текст сообщения")
        act_copy_all.triggered.connect(lambda: QApplication.clipboard().setText(self.raw_text))

        menu.addSeparator()
        if not self.is_error:
            trans_act_title = "🌐 Показать оригинал" if (self.is_showing_translation and self.translated_text) else "🌐 Перевести"
            act_trans = menu.addAction(trans_act_title)
            act_trans.triggered.connect(self._toggle_translation)

        if not self.is_user and not self.is_error:
            if getattr(self, "is_roleplay", False):
                act_art = menu.addAction("🎨 Иллюстрация сцены")
                act_art.triggered.connect(lambda: self._on_scene_art_click())

            act_tts = menu.addAction("🔊 Озвучить через F5-TTS")
            act_tts.triggered.connect(lambda: self.tts_requested.emit(self.raw_text))

            act_regen = menu.addAction("🔄 Регенерировать ответ")
            act_regen.triggered.connect(lambda: self.regenerate_requested.emit(self))

        if self.image_path and self.image_path.exists():
            menu.addSeparator()
            act_open_full = menu.addAction("🖼️ Открыть оригинал в Windows (100% Full-res)")
            act_open_full.triggered.connect(lambda: os.startfile(str(self.image_path)))

            act_show_file = menu.addAction("📁 Показать файл в проводнике")
            act_show_file.triggered.connect(lambda: subprocess.Popen(f'explorer /select,"{self.image_path}"'))

        menu.addSeparator()
        act_del = menu.addAction("🗑️ Удалить сообщение")
        act_del.triggered.connect(lambda: self.delete_requested.emit(self))

        menu.exec(QCursor.pos())

    def _on_anchor_clicked(self, qurl: QUrl):
        raw_url = qurl.toString().strip()
        if raw_url.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            QDesktopServices.openUrl(qurl)
            return

        # Очистка служебных префиксов (run: и open: исключены в целях безопасности)
        clean_path = raw_url
        for pref in ("file:///", "file://", "file:"):
            if clean_path.lower().startswith(pref):
                clean_path = clean_path[len(pref):]
                break

        clean_path = clean_path.replace("/", "\\").strip('"\'')
        target = Path(clean_path)
        if not target.is_absolute():
            target = WORKSPACE_DIR / target.name

        DANGEROUS_EXTS = {".exe", ".bat", ".cmd", ".vbs", ".ps1", ".msi", ".dll"}
        if target.suffix.lower() in DANGEROUS_EXTS:
            logger.warning(f"[ChatBubble] Запуск исполняемого файла заблокирован из соображений безопасности: {target}")
            return

        try:
            if target.exists():
                norm = os.path.normpath(str(target.resolve()))
                if sys.platform == "win32":
                    import ctypes
                    if target.is_file():
                        ctypes.windll.shell32.ShellExecuteW(None, "open", "explorer.exe", f'/select,"{norm}"', None, 1)
                    else:
                        ctypes.windll.shell32.ShellExecuteW(None, "open", norm, None, None, 1)
                else:
                    subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", norm], shell=False)
            elif WORKSPACE_DIR.exists() and "workspace" in clean_path.lower():
                norm = os.path.normpath(str(WORKSPACE_DIR.resolve()))
                if sys.platform == "win32":
                    import ctypes
                    ctypes.windll.shell32.ShellExecuteW(None, "open", norm, None, None, 1)
                else:
                    subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", norm], shell=False)
            else:
                QDesktopServices.openUrl(qurl)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[ChatBubble] Ошибка открытия ссылки/файла '{raw_url}': {e}")

    def add_workspace_file_card(self, file_path: Path | str, on_run: Optional[callable] = None) -> WorkspaceFileCardWidget:
        p = Path(file_path).resolve()
        for child in self.findChildren(WorkspaceFileCardWidget):
            try:
                if child.file_path.resolve() == p:
                    return child
            except Exception:
                pass

        card = WorkspaceFileCardWidget(file_path, on_run=None, parent=self.bubble_container)
        if on_run:
            card.run_script_requested.connect(on_run)
        else:
            card.run_script_requested.connect(self.run_script_requested.emit)
        if self.bubble_container and self.bubble_container.layout():
            layout = self.bubble_container.layout()
            layout.addWidget(card)
        return card

    def add_console_spoiler(
        self,
        title: str = "Консоль вывода",
        output: str = "",
        is_error: bool = False,
        return_code: int = 0
    ) -> ConsoleOutputSpoilerWidget:
        for child in self.findChildren(ConsoleOutputSpoilerWidget):
            if getattr(child, "title", None) == title:
                child.output = output.strip() if output else "(нет вывода)"
                child.is_error = is_error or (return_code != 0)
                child.return_code = return_code
                if hasattr(child, "console_browser"):
                    child.console_browser.setPlainText(child.output)
                child._update_header_text()
                return child

        spoiler = ConsoleOutputSpoilerWidget(
            title=title,
            output=output,
            is_error=is_error,
            return_code=return_code,
            parent=self.bubble_container
        )
        if self.bubble_container and self.bubble_container.layout():
            layout = self.bubble_container.layout()
            layout.addWidget(spoiler)
        return spoiler

    def _markdown_to_html(self, text: str) -> str:
        if not text:
            return ""
        normalized_text = text.replace(chr(8232), '\n').replace(chr(8233), '\n').replace('\r\n', '\n')
        escaped = html.escape(normalized_text)

        def code_block_sub(match):
            code = match.group(1)
            return f"<pre style='background-color:#080B11; border:1px solid #1E273A; border-radius:6px; padding:8px; color:#00F0FF; font-family:Consolas, monospace; white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word;'>{code}</pre>"
        escaped = re.sub(r'```(?:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)?\n(.*?)```', code_block_sub, escaped, flags=re.DOTALL)

        escaped = re.sub(r'`([^`]+)`', r"<code style='background-color:#141C2B; color:#38BDF8; padding:1px 4px; border-radius:4px; font-family:Consolas;'>\1</code>", escaped)

        def path_link_sub(match):
            raw_path = match.group(1)
            raw_path = re.sub(r'(&(?:#x27|#39|quot|amp|lt|gt);|[,.;:!?\"\'])*$', '', raw_path)
            norm_path = raw_path.replace('\\', '/')
            return f'<a href="file:///{norm_path}" style="color:#00F0FF; text-decoration:none;" title="Открыть в проводнике">{raw_path}</a>'

        escaped = re.sub(r'(?<!href=[\"\']file:///)((?:[a-zA-Z]:[\\/]|(?:workspace[\\/]))[^\s<>\[\]\"\'\)\(&;]+)', path_link_sub, escaped)

        escaped = re.sub(r'\*\*(.*?)\*\*', r"<strong>\1</strong>", escaped)
        escaped = re.sub(r'\*([^*]+)\*', r"<em style='color:#A78BFA;'>*\1*</em>", escaped)

        escaped = re.sub(r'^### (.*)$', r"<h3 style='color:#38BDF8; margin-top:4px; margin-bottom:2px;'>\1</h3>", escaped, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        escaped = re.sub(r'^## (.*)$', r"<h2 style='color:#00F0FF; margin-top:5px; margin-bottom:2px;'>\1</h2>", escaped, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        escaped = re.sub(r'^# (.*)$', r"<h1 style='color:#F8FAFC; margin-top:6px; margin-bottom:3px;'>\1</h1>", escaped, flags=re.MULTILINE)

        escaped = escaped.replace('\n', '<br>')
        return f"""<div style="font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; overflow-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-word; margin: 0; padding: 0;">{escaped}</div>"""

    def update_font_size(self, font_size: int):
        self.set_font_size(font_size)


def __getattr__(name: str):
    if name == "CyberpunkArtPlaceholderWidget":
        from ui.components.assistant_chat_bubble import CyberpunkArtPlaceholderWidget
        return CyberpunkArtPlaceholderWidget
    if name == "RPChatMessageWidget":
        from ui.components.rp.rp_chat_bubble import RPChatMessageWidget
        return RPChatMessageWidget
    if name == "AssistantChatMessageWidget":
        from ui.components.assistant_chat_bubble import AssistantChatMessageWidget
        return AssistantChatMessageWidget
    raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")

"""

Contains Avatar, Title, Status Label, Scene Background Menu,

Modernized with QFluentWidgets components under Agentrules.md.

    QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QLabel, QGraphicsDropShadowEffect
)
from qfluentwidgets import (
    ComboBox,
    DropDownPushButton,

class HeaderAvatarWidget(QLabel):
    """
    Интерактивный аватар собеседника для ChatHeaderBar.
    Исключает жесткие QSS-рамки, сдвигающие геометрию и обрезающие круглый pixmap.
    Обеспечивает мягкую рассеянную глубину в покое и деликатное бирюзовое свечение при наведении.
    Предотвращает залипание hover-эффекта при открытии контекстных меню.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFixedSize(48, 48)
        self.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QLabel {
                border: none;
                outline: none;
                background: transparent;
                padding: 0px;
                margin: 0px;
            }
        """)

        self._is_hovered = False
        self._shadow = QGraphicsDropShadowEffect(self)
        self._shadow.setOffset(0, 1)
        self._shadow.setBlurRadius(8)
        self._shadow.setColor(QColor(0, 0, 0, 75))
        self.setGraphicsEffect(self._shadow)
        self._click_handler = None

    def set_click_handler(self, handler):
        self._click_handler = handler

    def set_hovered(self, hovered: bool):
        self._is_hovered = hovered
        if hovered:
            self._shadow.setOffset(0, 0)
            self._shadow.setBlurRadius(16)
            self._shadow.setColor(QColor(0, 240, 255, 120))
        else:
            self._shadow.setOffset(0, 1)
            self._shadow.setBlurRadius(8)
            self._shadow.setColor(QColor(0, 0, 0, 75))
        self.update()

    def reset_hover(self):
        self.set_hovered(False)

    def enterEvent(self, event):
        self.set_hovered(True)
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):
        self.reset_hover()
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        self.reset_hover()
        if self._click_handler:
            self._click_handler(event)
        else:
            super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event):
        pos = event.position().toPoint() if hasattr(event, "position") else event.pos()
        if not self.rect().contains(pos):
            self.reset_hover()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

"""
Chat Input Panel Component for NeonRoute.
Encapsulates the bottom input capsule, attachment chips, action buttons
(Attach, Mic, Emoji), and ChatInputBox.
Modernized with QFluentWidgets components under Agentrules.md.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, TYPE_CHECKING
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtGui import QCursor, QColor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QFrame, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QPushButton, QWidget, QGraphicsDropShadowEffect
)
from qfluentwidgets import (
    TransparentToolButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    ToolTipFilter,
    ToolTipPosition,
)
from ui.components.input_box import ChatInputBox

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow


class ChatInputPanel(QFrame):
    def __init__(self, window: 'MainWindow'):
        super().__init__(window)
        self.window = window
        self.attached_files: List[Path] = []
        self.setObjectName("InputAreaContainer")
        self._setup_style()
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_style(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#InputAreaContainer {
                background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:0, y2:1, stop:0 rgba(16, 22, 36, 0.72), stop:1 rgba(10, 14, 22, 0.82));
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
                border-radius: 14px;
                margin: 0px 14px 12px 14px;
            }
            TransparentToolButton#AttachButton,
            TransparentToolButton#MicButton,
            TransparentToolButton#EmojiButton {
                border-radius: 9px;
                border: 1px solid transparent;
            }
            TransparentToolButton#AttachButton:hover,
            TransparentToolButton#MicButton:hover,
            TransparentToolButton#EmojiButton:hover {
                background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35);
            }
            TransparentToolButton#AttachButton:pressed,
            TransparentToolButton#MicButton:pressed,
            TransparentToolButton#EmojiButton:pressed {
                background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.22);
                border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
            }
        """)
        shadow = QGraphicsDropShadowEffect(self)
        shadow.setBlurRadius(24)
        shadow.setYOffset(6)
        shadow.setXOffset(0)
        shadow.setColor(QColor(0, 0, 0, 200))
        self.setGraphicsEffect(shadow)

    def _setup_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        # 1. Attachments Chips Container
        self.attachments_container = QWidget(self)
        self.attachments_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.attachments_container)
        self.attachments_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.attachments_layout.setSpacing(6)
        self.attachments_container.setVisible(False)
        layout.addWidget(self.attachments_container)

        # 2. Main Input Row
        edit_row = QHBoxLayout()
        edit_row.setSpacing(6)
        edit_row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)

        # Attach button
        attach_icon = getattr(FIF, "ATTACH", getattr(FIF, "DOCUMENT", FIF.PIN))
        self.btn_attach = TransparentToolButton(attach_icon, self)
        self.btn_attach.setObjectName("AttachButton")
        self.btn_attach.setToolTip("Прикрепить файл или изображение")
        self.btn_attach.setFixedSize(34, 34)
        self.btn_attach.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.btn_attach.installEventFilter(
            ToolTipFilter(self.btn_attach, showDelay=300, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP)
        )
        self.btn_attach.clicked.connect(self.window._select_attachment)
        edit_row.addWidget(self.btn_attach, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignBottom)

        # Mic (voice input) button
        self.btn_mic = TransparentToolButton(FIF.MICROPHONE, self)
        self.btn_mic.setObjectName("MicButton")
        self.btn_mic.setToolTip("Голосовой ввод (Faster-Whisper)")
        self.btn_mic.setFixedSize(34, 34)
        self.btn_mic.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.btn_mic.installEventFilter(
            ToolTipFilter(self.btn_mic, showDelay=300, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP)
        )
        self.btn_mic.clicked.connect(self.window._toggle_voice_input)

        # Intercept setText to support STT recording indicator ("🔴" / "🎙️") seamlessly
        orig_mic_setText = self.btn_mic.setText

        def _mic_setText(text: str):
            if text == "🔴":
                self.btn_mic.setStyleSheet("""
                    TransparentToolButton#MicButton {
                        background-color: rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.28);
                        border: 1px solid #FF007F;
                        border-radius: 9px;
                    }
                """)
            else:
                self.btn_mic.setStyleSheet("")
                self.btn_mic.setIcon(FIF.MICROPHONE)
            orig_mic_setText(text)

        self.btn_mic.setText = _mic_setText
        edit_row.addWidget(self.btn_mic, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignBottom)

        # Emoji button
        emoji_icon = getattr(FIF, "EMOJI_TAB_SYM", getattr(FIF, "EMOJI_TAB_SYMBOLS", FIF.CHAT))
        self.btn_emoji = TransparentToolButton(emoji_icon, self)
        self.btn_emoji.setObjectName("EmojiButton")
        self.btn_emoji.setToolTip("Вставить эмодзи")
        self.btn_emoji.setFixedSize(34, 34)
        self.btn_emoji.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.btn_emoji.installEventFilter(
            ToolTipFilter(self.btn_emoji, showDelay=300, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP)
        )
        self.btn_emoji.clicked.connect(self.window._show_emoji_picker)
        edit_row.addWidget(self.btn_emoji, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignBottom)

        # Chat input text box
        self.input_box = ChatInputBox(self)
        self.input_box.send_requested.connect(self.window._on_send_clicked)
        self.input_box.stop_requested.connect(self.window._on_stop_clicked)
        self.input_box.image_pasted.connect(self.window._on_image_pasted)
        self.input_box.files_dropped.connect(self.window._on_files_dropped)
        edit_row.addWidget(self.input_box, stretch=1)

        layout.addLayout(edit_row)

    # --- Attachment Management ---
    def add_attachment(self, file_path: Path):
        if file_path not in self.attached_files:
            self.attached_files.append(file_path)
            self.update_attachments_ui()

    def remove_attachment(self, file_path: Path):
        if file_path in self.attached_files:
            self.attached_files.remove(file_path)
            self.update_attachments_ui()

    def clear_attachments(self):
        self.attached_files.clear()
        self.update_attachments_ui()

    def update_attachments_ui(self):
        while self.attachments_layout.count():
            item = self.attachments_layout.takeAt(0)
            if item.widget():
                item.widget().deleteLater()

        if not self.attached_files:
            self.attachments_container.setVisible(False)
            self.input_box.set_has_attachments(False)
            return

        self.input_box.set_has_attachments(True)
        self.attachments_container.setVisible(True)

        for f in self.attached_files:
            chip = QFrame(self.attachments_container)
            chip.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame {
                    background-color: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.75);
                    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35);
                    border-radius: 12px;
                }
                QFrame:hover {
                    border-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.60);
                    background-color: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.90);
                }
            """)
            c_layout = QHBoxLayout(chip)
            c_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 3, 6, 3)
            c_layout.setSpacing(6)

            suffix = f.suffix.lower()
            if suffix in ('.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.webp', '.bmp', '.gif'):
                icon_prefix = "🖼️"
            else:
                icon_prefix = "📄"

            display_name = f.name if len(f.name) <= 18 else f.name[:15] + "..."
            lbl = QLabel(f"{icon_prefix} {display_name}", chip)
            lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #F1F5F9; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: transparent; border: none;")
            c_layout.addWidget(lbl)

            rm_btn = QPushButton("✕", chip)
            rm_btn.setFixedSize(18, 18)
            rm_btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
            rm_btn.setToolTip(f"Удалить {f.name}")
            rm_btn.installEventFilter(
                ToolTipFilter(rm_btn, showDelay=300, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP)
            )
            rm_btn.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton {
                    background: transparent;
                    border: none;
                    color: #94A3B8;
                    font-size: 11px;
                    font-weight: bold;
                    border-radius: 9px;
                    padding: 0px;
                }
                QPushButton:hover {
                    background-color: rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.25);
                    color: #FF007F;
                }
                QPushButton:pressed {
                    background-color: rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.45);
                    color: #FFFFFF;
                }
            """)
            rm_btn.clicked.connect(lambda checked=False, target=f: self.remove_attachment(target))
            c_layout.addWidget(rm_btn)

            self.attachments_layout.addWidget(chip)

        self.attachments_layout.addStretch()

"""
Chat Session List Item Widget for NeonRoute Sidebar.
Renders circular avatars for both Assistant (NeonRoute avatar) and Roleplay (Character avatar).
Uses QFluentWidgets InfoBadge for mode chips, TransparentToolButton for delete, and RoundMenu for context menu.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtGui import QCursor, QColor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QLabel
from qfluentwidgets import (
    InfoBadge,
    TransparentToolButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    RoundMenu,
    Action,
    ToolTipFilter,
    ToolTipPosition,
)

from ui.components.chat_bubble import render_circular_avatar


class ChatSessionItemWidget(QWidget):
    delete_requested = pyqtSignal(str)
    rename_requested = pyqtSignal(str)
    change_persona_requested = pyqtSignal(str, str)

    def __init__(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        title: str,
        mode: str = "assistant",
        char_name: Optional[str] = None,
        avatar_path: Optional[str] = None,
        session_type: Optional[str] = None,
        parent=None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.session_id = session_id
        self.mode = mode
        self.session_type = session_type
        self.char_name = char_name
        self.avatar_path = avatar_path

        self._setup_ui(title)

    def _setup_ui(self, title: str):
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 4, 6, 4)
        layout.setSpacing(8)

        # 1. Circular Avatar (30x30)
        self.avatar_lbl = QLabel(self)
        self.avatar_lbl.setFixedSize(30, 30)
        self.avatar_lbl.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents)
        layout.addWidget(self.avatar_lbl)

        # 2. Text layout (Title + Badge chip)
        text_layout = QVBoxLayout()
        text_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        text_layout.setSpacing(3)

        self.title_lbl = QLabel(title, self)
        self.title_lbl.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents)
        text_layout.addWidget(self.title_lbl)

        # Mode Chip via QFluentWidgets InfoBadge (Soft/Pill style)
        self.badge_lbl = InfoBadge(self)
        self.badge_lbl.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents)
        text_layout.addWidget(self.badge_lbl)

        self._apply_theme_and_avatar()

        layout.addLayout(text_layout, stretch=1)

        # 3. Compact Delete button with soft hover
        self.btn_del = TransparentToolButton(FIF.DELETE, self)
        self.btn_del.setFixedSize(26, 26)
        self.btn_del.setToolTip("Удалить диалог")
        self.btn_del.installEventFilter(
            ToolTipFilter(self.btn_del, showDelay=300, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP)
        )
        self.btn_del.setStyleSheet("""
            TransparentToolButton {
                border-radius: 4px;
                padding: 2px;
            }
            TransparentToolButton:hover {
                background-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
            }
        """)
        self.btn_del.clicked.connect(lambda checked=False: self.delete_requested.emit(self.session_id))
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_del)

        self.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)
        self.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_context_menu)

    def _apply_theme_and_avatar(self):
        raw_mode = str(self.mode or "").lower()
        raw_type = str(self.session_type or "").lower()
        is_engineer = (raw_type == "engineering" or raw_mode in ("engineer", "engineering"))
        is_rp = (raw_mode in ("roleplay", "rp")) and not is_engineer
        p = Path(self.avatar_path) if self.avatar_path and Path(self.avatar_path).exists() else None

        if is_engineer:
            pix = render_circular_avatar(p, "Инженер", size=30, is_user=False)
            self.avatar_lbl.setPixmap(pix)
            self.title_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #F59E0B; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; background: transparent;")
            self.badge_lbl.setText("🛠️ Инженер")
            self.badge_lbl.setCustomBackgroundColor(QColor(245, 158, 11, 38), QColor(245, 158, 11, 38))
            self.badge_lbl.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #FBBF24; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 7px; "
                "border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent;"
            )
        elif is_rp:
            name_seed = self.char_name or "Roleplay"
            pix = render_circular_avatar(p, name_seed, size=30, is_user=False)
            self.avatar_lbl.setPixmap(pix)
            self.title_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #E879F9; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; background: transparent;")
            badge_text = f"🎭 {self.char_name}" if self.char_name else "🎭 Ролевой чат"
            self.badge_lbl.setText(badge_text)
            self.badge_lbl.setCustomBackgroundColor(QColor(192, 132, 252, 40), QColor(192, 132, 252, 40))
            self.badge_lbl.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #D8B4FE; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 7px; "
                "border: 1px solid rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.35); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent;"
            )
        else:
            # Ассистент
            pix = render_circular_avatar(p, "Элария", size=30, is_user=False)
            self.avatar_lbl.setPixmap(pix)
            self.title_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; background: transparent;")
            self.badge_lbl.setText("⚡ Ассистент")
            self.badge_lbl.setCustomBackgroundColor(QColor(0, 240, 255, 34), QColor(0, 240, 255, 34))
            self.badge_lbl.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #00F0FF; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 7px; "
                "border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent;"
            )

    def update_avatar(self, avatar_path: Optional[str]):
        self.avatar_path = avatar_path
        self._apply_theme_and_avatar()

    def update_title(self, title: str):
        self.title_lbl.setText(title)

    def update_mode(self, mode: str, char_name: Optional[str] = None, avatar_path: Optional[str] = None, session_type: Optional[str] = None):
        self.mode = mode
        if session_type is not None:
            self.session_type = session_type
        self.char_name = char_name
        if avatar_path is not None:
            self.avatar_path = avatar_path
        self._apply_theme_and_avatar()

    def _show_context_menu(self, pos):
        menu = RoundMenu(parent=self)

        act_rename = Action(FIF.EDIT, "✏️ Переименовать", self)
        act_rename.triggered.connect(lambda: self.rename_requested.emit(self.session_id))
        menu.addAction(act_rename)

        if self.mode == "roleplay":
            try:
                from services.session_manager import SessionManager
                profiles = SessionManager.load_user_profiles()
                rp = profiles.get("rp_settings", {})
                personas = rp.get("personas", {})
                sess = SessionManager.load_session(self.session_id)
                active_p_id = (sess.get("user_persona_id") if sess else None) or rp.get("active_persona_id", "persona_default")
                if active_p_id not in personas:
                    active_p_id = rp.get("active_persona_id") or (next(iter(personas.keys())) if personas else None)

                if personas:
                    sub_menu = RoundMenu("👤 Персонаж игрока", self)
                    sub_menu.setIcon(FIF.PEOPLE)
                    for pid, pdata in personas.items():
                        pname = pdata.get("name", "Игрок")
                        act = Action(pname, self)
                        act.setCheckable(True)
                        if pid == active_p_id:
                            act.setChecked(True)
                        act.triggered.connect(
                            lambda checked=False, target_id=pid: self.change_persona_requested.emit(self.session_id, target_id)
                        )
                        sub_menu.addAction(act)
                    menu.addMenu(sub_menu)
            except Exception:
                pass

        menu.addSeparator()
        act_del = Action(FIF.DELETE, "🗑️ Удалить диалог", self)
        act_del.triggered.connect(lambda: self.delete_requested.emit(self.session_id))
        menu.addAction(act_del)

        menu.exec(QCursor.pos())

"""
Knowledge HUD and Chat Message Widget Components for NeonRoute.
Provides:
1. KnowledgeSourceChip: compact neon micro-chip / badge with icon, filename, chunk number, and citation tooltip.
2. KnowledgeHUDWidget: Glassmorphism container displaying chips above assistant response bubble.
3. Re-exports ChatMessageWidget and AssistantChatMessageWidget for unified access.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Union

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QLayout, QSizePolicy
)
from qfluentwidgets import (
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    IconWidget,
    ToolTipFilter,
    ToolTipPosition,
)

# Re-exports for clean API and tests
from ui.common.icon_utils import SafeFIF
from ui.components.chat_bubble import ChatMessageWidget
from ui.components.assistant_chat_bubble import AssistantChatMessageWidget
from ui.components.thought_spoiler_widget import ThoughtSpoilerWidget


class KnowledgeSourceChip(QFrame):
    """
    Микро-чип / бейдж источника знаний для HUD-индикатора.
    - Иконка: FIF.DOCUMENT или SafeFIF.BOOK_SHELF (для таблиц .csv/.xlsx — FIF.DOCUMENT).
    - Текст бейджа: компактное имя файла и номер чанка (#4).
    - Tooltip: всплывающая подсказка с цитатой и релевантностью.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        filename: str,
        chunk_id: Any = 0,
        snippet: str = "",
        score: float = 0.0,
        parent: Optional[QWidget] = None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("KnowledgeSourceChip")
        self.filename = filename or "Документ"
        self.chunk_id = chunk_id
        self.snippet = snippet or ""
        self.score = float(score)

        # Вычисление номера чанка
        cid_str = str(chunk_id) if chunk_id is not None else "0"
        if "#c" in cid_str:
            c_num = cid_str.split("#c")[-1]
        elif cid_str.startswith("#"):
            c_num = cid_str[1:]
        else:
            c_num = cid_str

        c_display = f"#{c_num}" if c_num not in ("", "None") else ""
        compact_name = Path(self.filename).name
        badge_text = f"{compact_name} {c_display}".strip() if c_display else compact_name

        # Выбор иконки
        ext = Path(self.filename).suffix.lower()
        if ext in (".csv", ".tsv", ".xlsx"):
            icon = FIF.DOCUMENT
        elif ext in (".pdf", ".fb2", ".epub", ".docx"):
            icon = SafeFIF.BOOK_SHELF
        else:
            icon = FIF.DOCUMENT

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 2, 6, 2)
        layout.setSpacing(5)
        layout.setSizeConstraint(QLayout.SizeConstraint.SetFixedSize)

        icon_w = IconWidget(icon, self)
        icon_w.setFixedSize(12, 12)
        layout.addWidget(icon_w)

        lbl = QLabel(badge_text, self)
        lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #38BDF8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; "
            "font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', sans-serif; background: transparent;"
        )
        layout.addWidget(lbl)

        self.setStyleSheet("""
            #KnowledgeSourceChip {
                background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25);
                border-radius: 4px;
            }
            #KnowledgeSourceChip:hover {
                background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.16);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.50);
            }
        """)

        # Формирование тултипа с цитатой
        clean_snip = self.snippet.strip()
        if len(clean_snip) > 280:
            clean_snip = clean_snip[:280] + "..."
        elif clean_snip and not clean_snip.endswith("..."):
            clean_snip += "..."

        frag_str = f"Фрагмент #{c_num}" if c_num not in ("", "None") else "Фрагмент #0"
        self.tooltip_text = (
            f"Источник: {self.filename}\n"
            f"{frag_str} (релевантность: {self.score:.0%})\n"
            f"---\n"
            f"{clean_snip}"
        )
        self.setToolTip(self.tooltip_text)
        self.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(self, showDelay=150, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP))


class KnowledgeHUDWidget(QFrame):
    """
    Компактный HUD-контейнер использованных источников базы знаний.
    Стилизация: полупрозрачный фон Glassmorphism (rgba(10, 13, 20, 0.75)),
    тонкая неоновая рамка Cyan (rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2)), радиус скругления 6–8px.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("KnowledgeHUDContainer")
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Policy.Maximum)

        self.hud_layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        self.hud_layout.setContentsMargins(6, 4, 6, 4)
        self.hud_layout.setSpacing(6)
        self.hud_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)

        self.setStyleSheet("""
            #KnowledgeHUDContainer {
                background-color: rgba(10, 13, 20, 0.75);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.20);
                border-radius: 7px;
            }
        """)
        self.chips: List[KnowledgeSourceChip] = []
        self.setVisible(False)

    def set_sources(self, sources: List[Dict[str, Any]]):
        """Монтирует чипы для переданных источников либо скрывает контейнер при их отсутствии."""
        while self.hud_layout.count():
            item = self.hud_layout.takeAt(0)
            w = item.widget()
            if w:
                w.deleteLater()
        self.chips.clear()

        if not sources:
            self.setVisible(False)
            self.hide()
            return

        seen = set()
        for s in sources:
            fn = s.get("filename", "")
            cid = s.get("chunk_id", 0)
            key = (fn, str(cid))
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)

            chip = KnowledgeSourceChip(
                filename=fn,
                chunk_id=cid,
                snippet=s.get("snippet", ""),
                score=float(s.get("score", 0.0)),
                parent=self
            )
            self.chips.append(chip)
            self.hud_layout.addWidget(chip)

        self.hud_layout.addStretch()
        self.setVisible(True)
        self.show()

"""
Chat Stream Widget Component for NeonRoute.
Encapsulates SmoothScrollArea, ChatBackgroundViewport, dynamic message bubble layout,
automatic bottom-stickiness, and Ctrl+Wheel font scaling.
Modernized with QFluentWidgets components under Agentrules.md.
"""

from typing import Optional, TYPE_CHECKING
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QEvent
from PyQt6.QtGui import QCursor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QFrame,
    QPushButton, QApplication
)
from qfluentwidgets import SmoothScrollArea
from ui.components.chat_background import ChatBackgroundViewport
from ui.components.chat_bubble import ChatMessageWidget
from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow


class ChatStreamWidget(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, window: 'MainWindow'):
        super().__init__(window)
        self.window = window
        self.font_size: int = self.window.app_config.get("chat_font_size", 13)
        self._btn_load_more: Optional[QPushButton] = None
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
        root_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        root_layout.setSpacing(0)

        # 1. Smooth Scroll Area (Windows 11 Fluid Scrolling)
        self.scroll_area = SmoothScrollArea(self)
        self.scroll_area.setObjectName("ChatScrollArea")
        self.scroll_area.setStyleSheet("""
            QScrollArea#ChatScrollArea {
                background: transparent;
                border: none;
            }
            QScrollBar:vertical {
                background: transparent;
                width: 6px;
                margin: 0px;
            }
            QScrollBar::handle:vertical {
                background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
                min-height: 24px;
                border-radius: 3px;
            }
            QScrollBar::handle:vertical:hover {
                background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.45);
            }
            QScrollBar::add-line:vertical, QScrollBar::sub-line:vertical {
                height: 0px;
                background: none;
            }
            QScrollBar::add-page:vertical, QScrollBar::sub-page:vertical {
                background: none;
            }
        """)
        self.scroll_area.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self.scroll_area.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        self.scroll_area.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)

        # 2. Viewport with custom background support
        self.chat_viewport = ChatBackgroundViewport(self.scroll_area)
        self.chat_viewport.change_background_requested.connect(self.window._open_background_settings_dialog)
        self.chat_viewport.change_dimming_requested.connect(self.window._open_background_settings_dialog)
        self.chat_viewport.reset_background_requested.connect(self.window._on_background_reset)
        self.scroll_area.setViewport(self.chat_viewport)

        # Reinstall smooth scroll delegate on custom viewport
        if hasattr(self.scroll_area, "delegate") and self.scroll_area.delegate:
            self.chat_viewport.installEventFilter(self.scroll_area.delegate)

        # 3. Inner Container & Vertical Bubble Layout
        self.chat_container = QWidget()
        self.chat_container.setObjectName("ChatContainer")
        self.chat_container.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)
        self.chat_container.setAutoFillBackground(False)
        self.chat_container.setStyleSheet("background: transparent; background-color: transparent;")

        self.chat_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.chat_container)
        self.chat_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 16, 16, 16)
        self.chat_layout.setSpacing(12)
        self.chat_layout.addStretch()

        self.scroll_area.setWidget(self.chat_container)

        # 4. Auto bottom-stickiness управляется контроллером окна MainWindow
        pass

        # Install event filters for Ctrl+Wheel zoom
        self.scroll_area.installEventFilter(self)
        self.chat_viewport.installEventFilter(self)

        root_layout.addWidget(self.scroll_area)

    def eventFilter(self, source, event):
        if source in (self.scroll_area, self.scroll_area.viewport(), self.chat_viewport):
            if event.type() == QEvent.Type.Wheel:
                if QApplication.keyboardModifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier:
                    delta = event.angleDelta().y()
                    if delta > 0:
                        self.change_font_size(1)
                    elif delta < 0:
                        self.change_font_size(-1)
                    return True
        return super().eventFilter(source, event)

    def change_font_size(self, delta: int):
        new_size = max(11, min(22, self.font_size + delta))
        if new_size != self.font_size:
            self.font_size = new_size
            self.window.chat_font_size = new_size
            self.window.app_config["chat_font_size"] = new_size
            ConfigManager.save_config(self.window.app_config)
            self.apply_font_size(new_size)
            self.window.statusBar().showMessage(f"Масштаб шрифта чата: {new_size} pt", 1500)

    def reset_font_size(self):
        self.font_size = 13
        self.window.chat_font_size = 13
        self.window.app_config["chat_font_size"] = 13
        ConfigManager.save_config(self.window.app_config)
        self.apply_font_size(13)
        self.window.statusBar().showMessage("Масштаб шрифта сброшен (13 pt)", 1500)

    def apply_font_size(self, size: int):
        for i in range(self.chat_layout.count()):
            item = self.chat_layout.itemAt(i)
            if item and item.widget() and isinstance(item.widget(), ChatMessageWidget):
                item.widget().set_font_size(size)

    def scroll_to_bottom(self):
        if hasattr(self.window, "_scroll_to_bottom"):
            self.window._scroll_to_bottom()
        else:
            sb = self.scroll_area.verticalScrollBar()
            sb.setValue(sb.maximum())

    def create_load_more_button(self, remaining: int, on_click_callback) -> Optional[QPushButton]:
        if self._btn_load_more is not None:
            return self._btn_load_more
        if remaining <= 0:
            return None

        btn = QPushButton(f"▲ Загрузить более ранние сообщения (осталось: {remaining})", self.chat_container)
        btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        btn.setFixedHeight(34)
        btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:0, stop:0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8), stop:1 rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8));
                color: #38BDF8;
                border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
                border-radius: 8px;
                font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
                font-size: 11px;
                font-weight: 600;
                margin: 4px 18px 8px 18px;
                padding: 4px 12px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
        """)
        btn.clicked.connect(on_click_callback)
        self._btn_load_more = btn
        self.chat_layout.insertWidget(0, btn, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        return btn

    def remove_load_more_button(self):
        if self._btn_load_more is not None:
            try:
                self.chat_layout.removeWidget(self._btn_load_more)
                self._btn_load_more.deleteLater()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._btn_load_more = None

    def set_knowledge_sources(self, sources: list):
        """Пробрасывает метаданные источников знаний в активный виджет сообщения ассистента."""
        target = getattr(self.window, "_turn_bubble", None) or getattr(self.window, "_current_streaming_widget", None)
        if target is None and hasattr(self, "chat_layout"):
            for i in reversed(range(self.chat_layout.count())):
                item = self.chat_layout.itemAt(i)
                w = item.widget() if item else None
                if w and getattr(w, "is_user", None) is False:
                    target = w
                    break
        if target and hasattr(target, "set_knowledge_sources"):
            target.set_knowledge_sources(sources)

"""
Emoji Picker Menu Component for NeonRoute.
Provides category tabs and grid selection for expressive chat input.
"""

from typing import List, Tuple
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QPoint
from PyQt6.QtGui import QCursor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QMenu, QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel, QPushButton, QGridLayout, QWidgetAction
)


class EmojiPickerMenu(QMenu):
    CATEGORIES: List[Tuple[str, List[str]]] = [
        ("Эмоции & Реакции", [
            "😀", "😂", "😊", "🥺", "😳", "😡", "🤔", "🤫", "😍", "🤣", "😭", "😴",
            "👍", "👎", "❤️", "💔", "🖤", "🔥", "💯", "👏", "🎉", "⚡", "⚠️", "✨"
        ]),
        ("Атмосфера & Ролеплей", [
            "👑", "🍷", "⚔️", "💀", "🌙", "🗡️", "🥀", "🕯️", "🔮", "🩸", "⛓️", "🗝️",
            "🎭", "🐺", "🐱", "🦊", "🌹", "🏹", "🛡️", "💎", "💍", "💋", "🌸", "☕"
        ])
    ]

    def __init__(self, target_input, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.target_input = target_input
        self.setObjectName("EmojiPickerMenu")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QMenu#EmojiPickerMenu {
                background-color: rgba(13, 18, 30, 0.96);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4);
                border-radius: 10px;
                padding: 6px;
            }
        """)
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        container = QWidget(self)
        container.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
        c_layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        c_layout.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        c_layout.setSpacing(6)

        for cat_name, emojis in self.CATEGORIES:
            cat_lbl = QLabel(cat_name, container)
            cat_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 2px;")
            c_layout.addWidget(cat_lbl)

            grid_w = QWidget(container)
            grid = QGridLayout(grid_w)
            grid.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
            grid.setSpacing(2)

            cols = 8
            for idx, emoji_char in enumerate(emojis):
                row = idx // cols
                col = idx % cols
                btn = QPushButton(emoji_char, grid_w)
                btn.setFixedSize(28, 28)
                btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
                btn.setStyleSheet("""
                    QPushButton {
                        background-color: transparent;
                        border: none;
                        font-size: 14px;
                        border-radius: 4px;
                        padding: 0px;
                    }
                    QPushButton:hover {
                        background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2);
                    }
                """)
                btn.clicked.connect(lambda _, em=emoji_char: self._on_emoji_clicked(em))
                grid.addWidget(btn, row, col)

            c_layout.addWidget(grid_w)

        action = QWidgetAction(self)
        action.setDefaultWidget(container)
        self.addAction(action)
        self._container = container

    def _on_emoji_clicked(self, emoji_char: str):
        if self.target_input:
            self.target_input.insertPlainText(emoji_char)
            self.target_input.setFocus()
        self.close()

    def show_above_widget(self, anchor_widget: QWidget):
        btn_pos = anchor_widget.mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, 0))
        menu_height = self._container.sizeHint().height() + 16
        pos = QPoint(btn_pos.x(), max(10, btn_pos.y() - menu_height))
        self.exec(pos)

"""
Interactive File Card Component for NeonRoute
Displays generated or attached documents (.xlsx, .docx, images)
with one-click launch ("Открыть файл") and folder location buttons.
"""

import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton
)


class FileCardWidget(QWidget):
    """
    Cyberpunk card representing an exported or attached document.
    """
    def __init__(self, file_path: Path | str, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.file_path = Path(file_path)
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setObjectName("FileCardWidget")

        ext = self.file_path.suffix.lower()
        if ext in (".xlsx", ".xls"):
            icon_char = "📊"
            type_label = "EXCEL"
            badge_color = "#10B981"
            border_color = "#059669"
        elif ext in (".docx", ".doc"):
            icon_char = "📄"
            type_label = "WORD"
            badge_color = "#3B82F6"
            border_color = "#2563EB"
        elif ext in (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp"):
            icon_char = "🖼️"
            type_label = "IMAGE"
            badge_color = "#D946EF"
            border_color = "#C026D3"
        elif ext in (".wav", ".mp3"):
            icon_char = "🎵"
            type_label = "AUDIO"
            badge_color = "#00F0FF"
            border_color = "#0891B2"
        else:
            icon_char = "📄"
            type_label = "FILE"
            badge_color = "#94A3B8"
            border_color = "#475569"

        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            #FileCardWidget {{
                background-color: #111723;
                border: 1px solid {border_color};
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 4px;
            }}
        """)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        # Icon
        icon_label = QLabel(icon_char, self)
        icon_label.setStyleSheet("font-size: 22px;")
        layout.addWidget(icon_label)

        # File Details (Name, Size, Type badge)
        details_layout = QVBoxLayout()
        details_layout.setSpacing(2)

        title_label = QLabel(self.file_path.name, self)
        title_label.setStyleSheet("color: #F8FAFC; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;")
        details_layout.addWidget(title_label)

        # Size calculation
        size_str = "0 KB"
        if self.file_path.exists():
            bytes_size = self.file_path.stat().st_size
            if bytes_size > 1024 * 1024:
                size_str = f"{bytes_size / (1024 * 1024):.1f} MB"
            else:
                size_str = f"{bytes_size / 1024:.1f} KB"

        meta_label = QLabel(f"<span style='color:{badge_color}; font-weight:bold;'>[{type_label}]</span> {size_str}", self)
        meta_label.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #94A3B8;")
        details_layout.addWidget(meta_label)

        layout.addLayout(details_layout, stretch=1)

        # Action Buttons
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_layout.setSpacing(6)

        open_btn = QPushButton("Открыть файл", self)
        open_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #1E293B;
                color: #00F0FF;
                border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
                border-radius: 5px;
                padding: 5px 10px;
                font-weight: bold;
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #050B14;
            }
        """)
        open_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_file)
        btn_layout.addWidget(open_btn)

        folder_btn = QPushButton("Папка", self)
        folder_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #1E293B;
                color: #94A3B8;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                border-radius: 5px;
                padding: 5px 8px;
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                border-color: #64748B;
                color: #F8FAFC;
            }
        """)
        folder_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_in_folder)
        btn_layout.addWidget(folder_btn)

        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)

    def _open_file(self):
        """Launches the file in system default application."""
        if self.file_path.exists():
            try:
                os.startfile(str(self.file_path.resolve()))
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error opening file {self.file_path}: {e}")

    def _open_in_folder(self):
        """Highlights the file in Windows Explorer."""
        if self.file_path.exists():
            try:
                subprocess.Popen(f'explorer /select,"{str(self.file_path.resolve())}"')
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error highlighting file in explorer: {e}")

"""
Cyberpunk / Glassmorphic Multi-line Input Box for NeonRoute.
Features:
- Integrated circular Fluent action button (36x36 px): Send (FIF.SEND) ⇄ Stop (⏹)
- Dynamic Mode Highlighting: Button turns Neon Cyan (#00F0FF) on text entry,
  Soft Purple (#C084FC) on !art prompt, and Warning Crimson (#FF007F) during generation
- Viewport right padding (48px) to prevent text overlap with action button
- Dynamic smooth height expansion (42px base up to 250px)
- Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline
- Direct clipboard image capture (Ctrl+V)
- Drag and drop file support
- Guaranteed translucent Glassmorphism styling with outline disabled
"""

import time
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSignal, QSize, QEvent
from PyQt6.QtGui import QKeyEvent, QImage, QCursor, QColor, QPalette, QIcon, QPixmap, QPainter, QFont
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QTextEdit, QApplication
from qfluentwidgets import (
    TransparentToolButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    ToolTipFilter,
    ToolTipPosition,
)

from config import OUTPUTS_DIR


def _create_stop_square_icon(color: str = "#FF007F", size: int = 32) -> QIcon:
    """Creates a high-DPI rounded square stop icon."""
    pix = QPixmap(size, size)
    pix.fill(QColor(0, 0, 0, 0))
    painter = QPainter(pix)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
    painter.setBrush(QColor(color))
    painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
    # Centered 14x14 square with 2.5px radius
    offset = (size - 14) / 2.0
    painter.drawRoundedRect(int(offset), int(offset), 14, 14, 2.5, 2.5)
    painter.end()
    return QIcon(pix)


class ChatInputBox(QTextEdit):

    """
    send_requested = pyqtSignal()

    image_pasted = pyqtSignal(Path)
    files_dropped = pyqtSignal(list)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("ChatInputField")
        self.setPlaceholderText("Введите сообщение... (Enter — отправить, Shift+Enter — новая строка)")

        self.min_height = 42
        self.max_height = 250

        self.has_attachments = False
        self.is_engineer_mode = False

        self.setFixedHeight(self.min_height)
        self.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)

        # Ensure margins keep text clean from edges and away from 36px action button.
        # Top/bottom margins are strictly 0 to avoid viewport clipping/caret offset artifacts.
        self.setViewportMargins(12, 0, 46, 0)
        self.document().setDocumentMargin(6)
        self.setCursorWidth(2)

        # Synchronize programmatic font and document font with UI font metrics
        ui_font = QFont("Segoe UI", 10)
        self.setFont(ui_font)
        self.document().setDefaultFont(ui_font)

        # Install event filter on viewport to intercept mouse leave/enter cleanly
        self.viewport().installEventFilter(self)

        pal = self.palette()
        pal.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Text, QColor("#F1F5F9"))
        pal.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Highlight, QColor(0, 240, 255, 110))
        pal.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.HighlightedText, QColor("#FFFFFF"))
        self.setPalette(pal)

        # Seamless Sunken Well: deep dark base, no border, no outline, no QSS padding.
        # :hover is scoped to :!focus so focused blinking caret background is 100% stable.
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QTextEdit#ChatInputField, ChatInputBox#ChatInputField {
                background-color: rgba(10, 15, 26, 0.75);
                color: #F8FAFC;
                border: none;
                border-radius: 11px;
                font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
                font-size: 14px;
                outline: none;
            }
            QTextEdit#ChatInputField:hover:!focus, ChatInputBox#ChatInputField:hover:!focus {
                background-color: rgba(13, 20, 34, 0.82);
                border: none;
                outline: none;
            }
            QTextEdit#ChatInputField:focus, ChatInputBox#ChatInputField:focus {
                background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92);
                border: none;
                outline: none;
            }
        """)

        # Circular Fluent UI Transformer Action Button (36x36 px)
        self.action_btn = TransparentToolButton(parent=self)
        self.action_btn.setObjectName("ChatInputTransformerBtn")
        self.action_btn.setFixedSize(36, 36)
        self.action_btn.setIconSize(QSize(18, 18))
        self.action_btn.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.action_btn.installEventFilter(
            ToolTipFilter(self.action_btn, showDelay=300, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP)
        )
        self.action_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_action_clicked)

        # Pre-create icon variants for optimal performance
        self._icon_idle = FIF.SEND.colored(QColor("#64748B"), QColor("#94A3B8"))
        self._icon_cyan = FIF.SEND.colored(QColor("#00F0FF"), QColor("#00F0FF"))
        self._icon_purple = FIF.SEND.colored(QColor("#C084FC"), QColor("#C084FC"))
        self._icon_stop = _create_stop_square_icon("#FF007F", 32)

        self._update_action_button_style()
        self._update_button_position()

        self.textChanged.connect(self._on_text_changed)

    def set_engineer_mode(self, is_engineer: bool):
        self.is_engineer_mode = is_engineer
        self._update_action_button_style()

    def _is_art_prompt(self, text: str) -> bool:
        if self.is_engineer_mode or not text:
            return False
        clean = text.strip().lower()
        if clean.startswith(("!art", "!арт", "!img", "!картинка")):
            return True
        art_triggers = [
            r'^(?:нарисуй|сгенерируй|сделай арт|изобрази|нарисуй мне|draw|generate art|paint)\b',
            r'\b(?:портрет|пейзаж|аниме арт|фотосессия|концепт-арт)\b'
        ]
        return any(bool(re.search(pat, clean)) for pat in art_triggers)

    def _on_text_changed(self):
        self._adjust_height()
        self._update_action_button_style()

    def _adjust_height(self):
        doc_h = int(self.document().size().height()) + 8
        target_h = max(self.min_height, min(doc_h, self.max_height))

        if abs(self.height() - target_h) >= 2:
            self.setFixedHeight(target_h)

        if doc_h > self.max_height:
            self.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAsNeeded)
        else:
            self.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)

        self._update_button_position()

    def _update_button_position(self):
        if hasattr(self, "action_btn") and self.action_btn:
            pad_right = 5
            # Center vertically when at base single-line height, otherwise anchor near bottom
            if self.height() <= self.min_height + 4:
                by = max(0, (self.height() - self.action_btn.height()) // 2)
            else:
                by = max(0, self.height() - self.action_btn.height() - 4)
            bx = self.width() - self.action_btn.width() - pad_right
            self.action_btn.move(max(0, bx), max(0, by))

    def _update_action_button_style(self):
        if not hasattr(self, "action_btn") or not self.action_btn:
            return

        if self.is_busy:
            self.action_btn.setIcon(self._icon_stop)
            self.action_btn.setText("⏹")
            self.action_btn.setToolTip("Остановить генерацию (Stop)")
            self.action_btn.setStyleSheet("""
                TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn {
                    background-color: rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.30);
                    border: none;
                    border-radius: 18px;
                }
                TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:hover {
                    background-color: rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.50);
                    border: none;
                }
                TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:pressed {
                    background-color: rgba(255, 0, 127, 0.70);
                    border: none;
                }
            """)
        else:
            raw_text = self.toPlainText()
            has_content = bool(raw_text.strip()) or self.has_attachments
            self.action_btn.setText("➤")

            if has_content:
                if self._is_art_prompt(raw_text):
                    self.action_btn.setIcon(self._icon_purple)
                    self.action_btn.setToolTip("Создать арт в Forge (Enter)")
                    self.action_btn.setStyleSheet("""
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn {
                            background-color: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.25);
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: 18px;
                        }
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:hover {
                            background-color: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.45);
                            border: none;
                        }
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:pressed {
                            background-color: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.65);
                            border: none;
                        }
                    """)
                else:
                    self.action_btn.setIcon(self._icon_cyan)
                    self.action_btn.setToolTip("Отправить сообщение (Enter)")
                    self.action_btn.setStyleSheet("""
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn {
                            background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.22);
                            border: none;
                            border-radius: 18px;
                        }
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:hover {
                            background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.40);
                            border: none;
                        }
                        TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:pressed {
                            background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.60);
                            border: none;
                        }
                    """)
            else:
                self.action_btn.setIcon(self._icon_idle)
                self.action_btn.setToolTip("Введите сообщение...")
                self.action_btn.setStyleSheet("""
                    TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn {
                        background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
                        border: none;
                        border-radius: 18px;
                    }
                    TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:hover {
                        background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
                        border: none;
                    }
                    TransparentToolButton#ChatInputTransformerBtn:pressed {
                        background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
                        border: none;
                    }
                """)

    def _on_action_clicked(self):
        if self.is_busy:
            self.stop_requested.emit()
        else:
            if self.toPlainText().strip() or self.has_attachments:
                self.send_requested.emit()

    def set_busy(self, is_busy: bool):
        self.is_busy = is_busy
        self._update_action_button_style()

    def set_has_attachments(self, has_attachments: bool):
        self.has_attachments = has_attachments
        self._update_action_button_style()

    def clear(self):
        super().clear()
        self.setFixedHeight(self.min_height)
        self.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self._update_action_button_style()
        self._update_button_position()

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._update_button_position()

    def eventFilter(self, obj, event: QEvent):
        if obj is self.viewport() and event.type() in (QEvent.Type.Leave, QEvent.Type.Enter):
            self.viewport().update()
        return super().eventFilter(obj, event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):
        super().leaveEvent(event)
        self.viewport().update()

    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent):
        if event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter):
            if not (event.modifiers() & Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier):
                if not self.is_busy and (self.toPlainText().strip() or self.has_attachments):
                    self.send_requested.emit()
                event.accept()
                return

        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_V and (event.modifiers() & Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier):
            clipboard = QApplication.clipboard()
            mime_data = clipboard.mimeData()
            if mime_data.hasImage():
                image: QImage = clipboard.image()
                if not image.isNull():
                    filename = f"clip_{int(time.time())}.png"
                    img_path = OUTPUTS_DIR / filename
                    image.save(str(img_path), "PNG")
                    self.image_pasted.emit(img_path)
                    event.accept()
                    return

        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def dragEnterEvent(self, event):
        if event.mimeData().hasUrls():
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            super().dragEnterEvent(event)

    def dragMoveEvent(self, event):
        if event.mimeData().hasUrls():
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            super().dragMoveEvent(event)

    def dropEvent(self, event):
        if event.mimeData().hasUrls():
            paths = []
            for url in event.mimeData().urls():
                p = Path(url.toLocalFile())
                if p.exists():
                    paths.append(p)
            if paths:
                self.files_dropped.emit(paths)
                event.acceptProposedAction()
                return
        super().dropEvent(event)
