"""
Modular RPG UI Elements Component for NeonRoute.
Parses roleplay markup (<stats>, <thought>, <choices>, <meters>, <check>, <terminal>, <sms>)
and renders glassmorphic Cyberpunk widgets and formatted HTML blocks.
"""

import re
import html
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, Tuple, List
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtGui import QCursor
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QFrame, QVBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QPushButton, QTextBrowser
)


class RPGBundle:
    def __init__(
        self,
        clean_text: str,
        stats: Optional[Any] = None,
        thought: Optional[str] = None,
        choices: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        meters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    ):
        self.clean_text = clean_text
        self.stats = stats
        self.thought = thought
        self.choices = choices
        self.meters = meters


class RPGContentParser:
    THOUGHT_RE = re.compile(r'<(thought|think)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    CHOICES_RE = re.compile(r'<(choices|options)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    STATS_RE = re.compile(r'<(stats|status)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    METERS_RE = re.compile(r'<(meters|affection)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    CHECK_RE = re.compile(r'<check>\s*(.*?)\s*</check>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    TERMINAL_RE = re.compile(r'<terminal>\s*(.*?)\s*</terminal>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    SMS_RE = re.compile(r'<(sms|phone)>\s*(.*?)\s*</\1>', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, text: str) -> RPGBundle:
        if not text or ("<" not in text and "```" not in text):
            return RPGBundle(clean_text=text)

        norm = text.replace('\u2028', '\n').replace('\u2029', '\n').replace('\r\n', '\n')

        thought_text = None
        m_th = cls.THOUGHT_RE.search(norm)
        if m_th:
            thought_text = m_th.group(2).strip()
            norm = cls.THOUGHT_RE.sub('', norm)

        choices_list = None
        m_ch = cls.CHOICES_RE.search(norm)
        if m_ch:
            raw_c = m_ch.group(2).strip()
            lines = [ln.strip() for ln in raw_c.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
            if lines:
                choices_list = lines
            norm = cls.CHOICES_RE.sub('', norm)

        stats_data = None
        m_st = cls.STATS_RE.search(norm)
        if m_st:
            raw_st = m_st.group(2).strip()
            stats_data = cls._parse_key_values(raw_st)
            norm = cls.STATS_RE.sub('', norm)

        meters_data = None
        m_mt = cls.METERS_RE.search(norm)
        if m_mt:
            raw_mt = m_mt.group(2).strip()
            meters_data = cls._parse_meters(raw_mt)
            norm = cls.METERS_RE.sub('', norm)

        clean_text = norm.strip()
        bundle = RPGBundle(clean_text, stats_data, thought_text, choices_list, meters_data)

        # Fallback: Detect raw markdown code blocks containing RPG stats if <stats> tag was omitted
        if not bundle.stats and "```" in bundle.clean_text:
            code_block_pattern = re.compile(r'```(?:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)?\s*\n?(.*?)```', re.DOTALL)
            stat_markers = (
                "physical status:", "inventory:", "equipment:", "level:", "lvl:",
                "уровень:", "hp:", "health:", "здоровье:", "class:", "класс:",
                "battle power:", "bp:", "gold:", "золото:", "threat level:",
                "reputation:", "skills:", "spells:", "abilities:", "objectives:"
            )
            for match in code_block_pattern.finditer(bundle.clean_text):
                block_content = match.group(1).strip()
                block_lower = block_content.lower()
                matches_count = sum(1 for marker in stat_markers if marker in block_lower)
                if matches_count >= 2:
                    bundle.stats = block_content
                    # Clean out the code block from visible chat text
                    start_idx, end_idx = match.span()
                    bundle.clean_text = (bundle.clean_text[:start_idx] + bundle.clean_text[end_idx:]).strip()
                    break

        return bundle

    @classmethod
    def format_inline_rpg_blocks(cls, escaped_html: str) -> str:
        """Formats inline XML blocks safely AFTER html.escape to prevent double-escaping bugs."""
        # 1. Check (D&D d20)
        def _check_sub(m):
            raw_body = m.group(1).strip().replace('\n', '<br>')
            is_success = "успех" in raw_body.lower() or "success" in raw_body.lower()
            is_fail = "провал" in raw_body.lower() or "failure" in raw_body.lower()
            color = "#10B981" if is_success else ("#EF4444" if is_fail else "#F59E0B")
            badge = "✔ УСПЕХ" if is_success else ("✖ ПРОВАЛ" if is_fail else "🎲 ПРОВЕРКА")
            return (
                f"<div style='background:rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9); border:1px solid {color}; "
                f"border-left:4px solid {color}; border-radius:6px; padding:6px 10px; margin:6px 0;'>"
                f"<div style='color:{color}; font-weight:bold; font-size:11px; margin-bottom:3px;'>🎲 {badge}</div>"
                f"<div style='color:#E2E8F0; font-size:11px; line-height:1.3;'>{raw_body}</div></div>"
            )
        escaped_html = re.sub(r'&lt;check&gt;\s*(.*?)\s*&lt;/check&gt;', _check_sub, escaped_html, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

        # 2. Terminal
        def _term_sub(m):
            raw_body = m.group(1).strip().replace('\n', '<br>')
            return (
                f"<div style='background:#050D0A; border:1px solid #10B981; border-radius:6px; "
                f"padding:8px 12px; margin:6px 0; font-family:Consolas, monospace;'>"
                f"<div style='color:#34D399; font-weight:bold; font-size:10px; margin-bottom:4px;'>📟 ТЕРМИНАЛ СВЯЗИ</div>"
                f"<div style='color:#A7F3D0; font-size:11px; line-height:1.3;'>{raw_body}</div></div>"
            )
        escaped_html = re.sub(r'&lt;terminal&gt;\s*(.*?)\s*&lt;/terminal&gt;', _term_sub, escaped_html, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

        # 3. SMS / Phone
        def _sms_sub(m):
            raw_body = m.group(2).strip().replace('\n', '<br>')
            return (
                f"<div style='background:rgba(10, 16, 28, 0.95); border:1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4); "
                f"border-left:3px solid #00F0FF; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 12px; margin:6px 0;'>"
                f"<div style='color:#00F0FF; font-weight:bold; font-size:10px; margin-bottom:3px;'>📱 ВХОДЯЩЕЕ СООБЩЕНИЕ</div>"
                f"<div style='color:#F1F5F9; font-size:11px; line-height:1.3;'>{raw_body}</div></div>"
            )
        escaped_html = re.sub(r'&lt;(sms|phone)&gt;\s*(.*?)\s*&lt;/\1&gt;', _sms_sub, escaped_html, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

        return escaped_html

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_key_values(raw_text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        for line in raw_text.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or ":" not in line:
                continue
            k, v = line.split(":", 1)
            key, val = k.strip(), v.strip().rstrip(',')
            if val.startswith('[') and val.endswith(']'):
                inner = val[1:-1].strip()
                items = []
                if inner:
                    for raw_item in re.split(r',\s*(?=(?:[^\"]*\"[^\"]*\")*[^\"]*$)', inner):
                        c = raw_item.strip().strip('\'"').strip()
                        if c:
                            items.append(c)
                data[key] = items
            else:
                data[key] = val.strip('\'"')
        return data

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_meters(raw_text: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        meters: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for line in raw_text.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or ":" not in line:
                continue
            k, v = line.split(":", 1)
            key = k.strip()
            val = v.strip()
            pct_m = re.search(r'(\d+)\s*%', val)
            pct = int(pct_m.group(1)) if pct_m else None
            if pct is None:
                slash_m = re.search(r'(\d+)\s*/\s*(\d+)', val)
                if slash_m:
                    num, den = float(slash_m.group(1)), float(slash_m.group(2))
                    pct = int((num / den) * 100) if den > 0 else 0
            if pct is None:
                filled = val.count('█') + val.count('#')
                empty = val.count('░') + val.count('-')
                if (filled + empty) > 0:
                    pct = int((filled / (filled + empty)) * 100)
            note_m = re.search(r'\((.*?)\)', val)
            note = note_m.group(1).strip() if note_m else ""
            meters[key] = {"pct": min(100, max(0, pct if pct is not None else 50)), "note": note, "raw": val}
        return meters

    def update_data(self, stats: Any, meters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None):
        if isinstance(stats, str):
            self.stats_data = RPGContentParser._parse_key_values(stats)
            if not self.stats_data:
                self.stats_data = {"Status": stats}
        else:
            self.stats_data = stats or {}
        if meters:
            self.meters_data = meters
        self._update_header()

        self.update_data(stats, meters)

    def _render_content(self):
        blocks = []
        scalars, lists = [], []

        for k, v in self.stats_data.items():
            if isinstance(v, list):
                lists.append((k, v))
            else:
                scalars.append((k, str(v)))

        # 1. Grid of Scalar Stats
        if scalars:
            cells = []
            for k, val in scalars:
                icon = self.KEY_ICONS.get(k.lower(), "🔹")
                cells.append(
                    f"<div style='display:inline-block; margin-right:12px; margin-bottom:4px;'>"
                    f"<span style='color:#64748B;'>{icon} {html.escape(k)}:</span> "
                    f"<strong style='color:#38BDF8;'>{html.escape(val)}</strong></div>"
                )
            blocks.append(f"<div style='margin-bottom:6px;'>{''.join(cells)}</div>")

        # 2. Graphical Progress Bars for Meters / Affection
        if self.meters_data:
            meter_rows = []
            for m_name, m_info in self.meters_data.items():
                pct = m_info.get("pct", 50)
                note = html.escape(m_info.get("note", ""))
                note_str = f" <span style='color:#34D399; font-size:10px;'>({note})</span>" if note else ""
                bar_color = "#EC4899" if any(w in m_name.lower() for w in ("любовь", "привяз", "влеч", "love")) else "#00F0FF"
                meter_rows.append(
                    f"<table width='100%' cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0' style='margin-bottom:5px;'>"
                    f"<tr><td style='color:#E2E8F0; font-size:11px; font-weight:600;'>📊 {html.escape(m_name)}</td>"
                    f"<td align='right' style='color:{bar_color}; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold;'>{pct}%{note_str}</td></tr>"
                    f"<tr><td colspan='2' style='padding-top:2px;'>"
                    f"<table width='100%' cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0' style='background-color:#1E293B; height:6px; border-radius:3px;'>"
                    f"<tr><td width='{pct}%' style='background-color:{bar_color}; height:6px; border-radius:3px;'></td>"
                    f"<td width='{100 - pct}%'></td></tr></table></td></tr></table>"
                )
            blocks.append(f"<div style='margin-top:4px; margin-bottom:6px;'>{''.join(meter_rows)}</div>")

        # 3. Lists & Chips
        if lists:
            list_rows = []
            for k, items in lists:
                icon = self.KEY_ICONS.get(k.lower(), "📦")
                if not items:
                    chips = "<span style='color:#475569; font-style:italic;'>пусто</span>"
                else:
                    chip_tags = [
                        f"<span style='background:rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12); color:#00F0FF; "

                        f"padding:1px 6px; margin-right:4px; font-weight:500; font-size:11px;'>{html.escape(str(itm))}</span>"
                        for itm in items
                    ]
                    chips = " ".join(chip_tags)
                list_rows.append(
                    f"<div style='margin-top:3px; margin-bottom:4px;'>"
                    f"<span style='color:#94A3B8; font-weight:600;'>{icon} {html.escape(k)}:</span> {chips}</div>"
                )
            blocks.append("".join(list_rows))

        full_html = f"<div style='font-family:\"Inter\",\"Segoe UI\",sans-serif; line-height:1.35;'>{''.join(blocks)}</div>"

        h = int(doc.size().height()) + 8

"""
Floating Scroll Down Button for NeonRoute Chat.
Provides an aesthetic, minimalist Fluent / Dark Glass button with neon glow.
"""

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QPointF, QVariantAnimation, QEasingCurve
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QPainter, QColor, QPainterPath, QPen, QLinearGradient,
    QCursor, QPaintEvent, QEnterEvent
)
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QPushButton, QGraphicsDropShadowEffect, QWidget


class FloatingScrollDownButton(QPushButton):
    """
    Floating circular button styled in Fluent / Dark Glass aesthetics.
    Drawn using QPainter with a delicate dark shadow in normal state and
    a diffused cyan/neon blue halo glow on hover.
    """

    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget = None, diameter: int = 38):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._diameter = diameter
        self.setFixedSize(diameter, diameter)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        self.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent; border: none;")

        # Shadow & Glow effect
        self._shadow = QGraphicsDropShadowEffect(self)
        self._shadow.setColor(QColor(0, 0, 0, 140))
        self._shadow.setBlurRadius(10)
        self._shadow.setOffset(0, 2.5)
        self.setGraphicsEffect(self._shadow)

        # Hover animation progress: 0.0 (normal) to 1.0 (hovered)
        self._hover_progress = 0.0
        self._anim = QVariantAnimation(self)
        self._anim.setDuration(160)
        self._anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.Type.InOutCubic)
        self._anim.valueChanged.connect(self._on_anim_value_changed)

    def _on_anim_value_changed(self, val):
        self._hover_progress = float(val)
        t = self._hover_progress

        # Blend shadow between deep dark depth and neon cyan glow
        r = int(0 * (1.0 - t) + 0 * t)
        g = int(0 * (1.0 - t) + 240 * t)
        b = int(0 * (1.0 - t) + 255 * t)
        a = int(140 * (1.0 - t) + 180 * t)
        blur = int(10 * (1.0 - t) + 18 * t)
        offset_y = 2.5 * (1.0 - t)

        self._shadow.setColor(QColor(r, g, b, a))
        self._shadow.setBlurRadius(blur)
        self._shadow.setOffset(0, offset_y)
        self.update()

    def enterEvent(self, event: QEnterEvent):
        super().enterEvent(event)
        self._anim.stop()
        self._anim.setStartValue(self._hover_progress)
        self._anim.setEndValue(1.0)
        self._anim.start()

    def leaveEvent(self, event):
        super().leaveEvent(event)
        self._anim.stop()
        self._anim.setStartValue(self._hover_progress)
        self._anim.setEndValue(0.0)
        self._anim.start()

    def paintEvent(self, event: QPaintEvent):
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

        t = self._hover_progress
        w = float(self.width())
        h = float(self.height())
        radius = min(w, h) / 2.0 - 1.5
        center = QPointF(w / 2.0, h / 2.0)

        # 1. Dark Acrylic Glass Body (Matte semi-transparent acrylic)
        grad = QLinearGradient(center.x(), 1.5, center.x(), h - 1.5)
        bg_top = QColor(
            int(18 + 6 * t),
            int(24 + 10 * t),
            int(38 + 18 * t),
            int(220 + 20 * t)
        )
        bg_bot = QColor(
            int(10 + 4 * t),
            int(14 + 6 * t),
            int(24 + 10 * t),
            int(230 + 15 * t)
        )
        if self.isDown():
            bg_top = bg_top.darker(115)
            bg_bot = bg_bot.darker(115)

        grad.setColorAt(0.0, bg_top)
        grad.setColorAt(1.0, bg_bot)
        painter.setBrush(grad)

        # 2. Border with subtle cyan glow on hover
        border_r = int(56 * (1.0 - t) + 0 * t)
        border_g = int(189 * (1.0 - t) + 240 * t)
        border_b = int(248 * (1.0 - t) + 255 * t)
        border_a = int(45 * (1.0 - t) + 190 * t)
        border_pen = QPen(QColor(border_r, border_g, border_b, border_a), 1.2)
        painter.setPen(border_pen)
        painter.drawEllipse(center, radius, radius)

        # 3. Minimalist, thin, elegant Chevron Down
        chevron_path = QPainterPath()
        cx = center.x()
        cy = center.y() + (1.0 if self.isDown() else 0.0)

        chevron_path.moveTo(cx - 5.5, cy - 2.0)
        chevron_path.lineTo(cx, cy + 3.0)
        chevron_path.lineTo(cx + 5.5, cy - 2.0)

        chev_r = int(203 * (1.0 - t) + 0 * t)
        chev_g = int(213 * (1.0 - t) + 240 * t)
        chev_b = int(225 * (1.0 - t) + 255 * t)
        chev_a = int(220 * (1.0 - t) + 255 * t)

        icon_pen = QPen(QColor(chev_r, chev_g, chev_b, chev_a), 1.8)
        icon_pen.setCapStyle(Qt.PenCapStyle.RoundCap)
        icon_pen.setJoinStyle(Qt.PenJoinStyle.RoundJoin)

        painter.setPen(icon_pen)
        painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
        painter.drawPath(chevron_path)

"""
Search Bar Component for NeonRoute Chat.
Provides Ctrl+F in-chat search, match counting, next/previous navigation,
and smooth scrolling to highlighted message.
Modernized with QFluentWidgets components and Glassmorphism styling under Agentrules.md.
"""

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSignal, QSize, QEvent
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel
from qfluentwidgets import (
    SearchLineEdit,
    TransparentToolButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    ToolTipFilter,
    ToolTipPosition,
)


class SearchBarWidget(QFrame):
    """
    Compact popup / top search bar for searching text across chat messages.
    """
    search_changed = pyqtSignal(str)
    next_requested = pyqtSignal()
    prev_requested = pyqtSignal()
    close_requested = pyqtSignal()

    # Aliases
    query_changed = search_changed
    find_next = next_requested
    find_prev = prev_requested
    closed = close_requested

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("SearchBarWidget")
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""

        self.btn_prev.clicked.connect(self.prev_requested.emit)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_prev)

        self.btn_next.setFixedSize(28, 28)

        self.btn_next.clicked.connect(self.next_requested.emit)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_next)

        self.btn_close = TransparentToolButton(FIF.CLOSE, self)
        self.btn_close.setObjectName("CloseSearchBtn")
        self.btn_close.setFixedSize(28, 28)
        self.btn_close.setIconSize(QSize(12, 12))
        self.btn_close.setToolTip("Закрыть поиск (Esc)")
        self.btn_close.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(self.btn_close, 300, ToolTipPosition.BOTTOM))
        self.btn_close.clicked.connect(self.close_requested.emit)
        layout.addWidget(self.btn_close)

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event):
        if watched == self.input_field and event.type() == QEvent.Type.KeyPress:
            if event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter):
                if event.modifiers() & Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier:
                    self.prev_requested.emit()
                else:
                    self.next_requested.emit()
                return True
            elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Escape:
                self.close_requested.emit()
                return True
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def set_match_status(self, current: int, total: int):
        """Updates match counter label."""
        if total == 0:
            self.lbl_count.setText("0 совпадений")
            self.lbl_count.setStyleSheet("color: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.85); font-size: 11px;")
        else:
            self.lbl_count.setText(f"{current} из {total}")
            self.lbl_count.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;")

    def set_match_info(self, current: int, total: int):
        self.set_match_status(current, total)

    @property
    def search_input(self):
        return self.input_field

    @property
    def counter_label(self):
        return self.lbl_count

    def focus_input(self):
        """Activates and selects text in the search input."""
        self.input_field.setFocus()
        self.input_field.selectAll()

    def show_and_focus(self):
        self.setVisible(True)
        self.focus_input()

    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Escape:
            self.close_requested.emit()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

        self.char_card_widget.setVisible(is_roleplay)

            return

            self.char_name_lbl.setText(f"🎭 {char_name}")
            self.btn_campaign_info.setEnabled(True)
            self.btn_campaign_info.setText("📜 Правила мира и Лор ↗")
            self.btn_campaign_info.setToolTip("Просмотреть лор, правила мира и системный контекст")

            if has_user_messages:
                self.btn_load_character.setEnabled(False)
                self.btn_load_character.setText("🔒 Персонаж зафиксирован")
                self.btn_load_character.setToolTip("Смена персонажа заблокирована после старта диалога. Для выбора другого начните новый чат.")
            else:
                self.btn_load_character.setEnabled(True)
                self.btn_load_character.setText("🎴 Сменить компаньона")
                self.btn_load_character.setToolTip("Выбрать другую карточку персонажа из галереи")
        else:
            self.char_name_lbl.setText("Компаньон не выбран")
            self.btn_campaign_info.setEnabled(False)
            self.btn_campaign_info.setText("📜 Модуль не загружен")
            self.btn_campaign_info.setToolTip("Выберите персонажа для загрузки лора")

            self.btn_load_character.setEnabled(True)
            self.btn_load_character.setText("🎴 Выбор компаньона")
            self.btn_load_character.setToolTip("Открыть галерею персонажей")

    def _handle_new_chat_clicked(self):
        """Открытие диалога NewChatDialog с выбором целевого режима (РП / Ассистент / Инженер)."""
        if hasattr(self.window, "show_new_chat_dialog"):
            self.window.show_new_chat_dialog()
        elif hasattr(self.window, "_open_new_chat_dialog"):
            self.window._open_new_chat_dialog()
        else:
            from ui.dialogs.new_chat_dialog import NewChatDialog
            from PyQt6.QtCore import QPoint
            from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QDialog
            dlg = NewChatDialog(parent=self.window)
            btn = self.btn_new_chat
            pos = btn.mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, btn.height() + 4))
            dlg.move(pos)
            if dlg.exec() == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted and dlg.selected_mode:
                if hasattr(self.window, "create_chat"):
                    self.window.create_chat(mode=dlg.selected_mode)

    @staticmethod
    def _safe_open_folder(folder_path):
        try:
            p = Path(folder_path)
            p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            os.startfile(str(p.resolve()))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[Sidebar] Не удалось открыть папку {folder_path}: {e}")

"""
Status Bar Component for NeonRoute.
Encapsulates hardware telemetry (VRAM/RAM ProgressBars), server process controls,
and service health indicators modernized with QFluentWidgets.
"""

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
from config import EMERGENCY_VRAM_THRESHOLD_MB
import re
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSlot
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QStatusBar, QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QLabel

    ProgressBar,

class ServiceStatusBadge(QWidget):
    """
    Service status indicator featuring a QFluentWidgets DotInfoBadge,
    compact label, and ToolTipFilter.
    """

    def __init__(self, name: str, port: int, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.name = name
        self.port = port
        self.is_online = False
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 2, 8, 2)
        layout.setSpacing(6)
        layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)

        # Dot info badge indicator (green when active, red when inactive)
        self.dot = DotInfoBadge(self)
        self.dot.setFixedSize(6, 6)
        self.dot.setLevel(InfoLevel.ERROR)
        self.dot.setCustomBackgroundColor("#EF4444", "#EF4444")
        self.dot.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True)
        layout.addWidget(self.dot)

        # Service name & port label
        self.label = QLabel(f"{self.name} ({self.port})", self)
        self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
        self.label.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True)
        layout.addWidget(self.label)

        self.setStyleSheet("""
            ServiceStatusBadge {
                background-color: #111622;
                border: 1px solid #1E273A;
                border-radius: 10px;
            }
        """)

        self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} ({self.port}) — Офлайн: Сервис недоступен")
        self.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(self, showDelay=250, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP))

    def set_status(self, online: bool, message: str = ""):
        self.is_online = online
        if online:
            self.dot.setLevel(InfoLevel.SUCCESS)
            self.dot.setCustomBackgroundColor("#10B981", "#10B981")
            self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #E2E8F0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
            self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} ({self.port}) — Онлайн ({message or 'Готов к работе'})")
        else:
            self.dot.setLevel(InfoLevel.ERROR)
            self.dot.setCustomBackgroundColor("#EF4444", "#EF4444")
            self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
            self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} ({self.port}) — Офлайн ({message or 'Сервис недоступен'})")

class VramLabel(QLabel):
    """
    Hardware metric label for VRAM with two-way synchronization to QFluentWidgets ProgressBar.
    Applies colors strictly per Agentrules hardware thresholds:
    - Free >= 1200 MB: Calm green accent (#10B981)
    - Free 150 - 1199 MB: Warning amber tint (#F59E0B)
    - Free < 150 MB: Critical load indicator (#EF4444)
    """

    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: Optional[QWidget] = None, progress_bar: Optional[ProgressBar] = None):
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self.progress_bar = progress_bar
        self._current_color = "#10B981"

    def update_vram(self, v_used: int, v_total: int, v_pct: float, temp: Optional[int] = None):
        free_mb = max(0, v_total - v_used)
        if free_mb >= 1200:
            color = "#10B981"
        elif EMERGENCY_VRAM_THRESHOLD_MB <= free_mb < 1200:
            color = "#F59E0B"
        else:
            color = "#EF4444"

        self._current_color = color
        temp_str = f" • {temp}°C" if temp else ""
        super().setText(f"VRAM: {v_used} / {v_total} MB ({v_pct}%){temp_str}")
        super().setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 6px;")

        if self.progress_bar:
            self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 100)
            self.progress_bar.setValue(int(round(v_pct)))
            self.progress_bar.setCustomBarColor(color, color)
            self.progress_bar.setToolTip(f"VRAM: {v_used} / {v_total} MB ({v_pct}%)\nСвободно: {free_mb} MB{temp_str}")

    def setText(self, text: str):
        # Auto-parse text if called by legacy slot
        m = re.search(r"VRAM:\s*(\d+)\s*/\s*(\d+)\s*MB\s*\(([0-9.]+)%\)", text)
        if m:
            v_used = int(m.group(1))
            v_total = int(m.group(2))
            v_pct = float(m.group(3))
            m_temp = re.search(r"•\s*(\d+)\s*°C", text)
            temp = int(m_temp.group(1)) if m_temp else None
            self.update_vram(v_used, v_total, v_pct, temp)
        else:
            super().setText(text)

    def setStyleSheet(self, style: str):
        # Preserve threshold-based color
        super().setStyleSheet(f"color: {self._current_color}; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 6px;")


class RamLabel(QLabel):
    """
    Hardware metric label for RAM with synchronization to QFluentWidgets ProgressBar.
    """

    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: Optional[QWidget] = None, progress_bar: Optional[ProgressBar] = None):
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self.progress_bar = progress_bar

    def update_ram(self, r_used: float, r_total: float, r_pct: float):
        super().setText(f"RAM: {r_used:.1f} / {r_total:.1f} GB ({r_pct}%)")
        super().setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; margin-right: 6px;")

        if self.progress_bar:
            self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 100)
            self.progress_bar.setValue(int(round(r_pct)))
            self.progress_bar.setCustomBarColor("#38BDF8", "#38BDF8")
            self.progress_bar.setToolTip(f"RAM: {r_used:.1f} / {r_total:.1f} GB ({r_pct}%)")

    def setText(self, text: str):
        m = re.search(r"RAM:\s*([0-9.]+)\s*/\s*([0-9.]+)\s*GB\s*\(([0-9.]+)%\)", text)
        if m:
            r_used = float(m.group(1))
            r_total = float(m.group(2))
            r_pct = float(m.group(3))
            self.update_ram(r_used, r_total, r_pct)
        else:
            super().setText(text)


class MainStatusBar(QStatusBar):
    """
    Modernized Status Bar Component for NeonRoute.
    Encapsulates QFluentWidgets ProgressBars for VRAM and RAM,
    PillPushButtons for LMS and SD Forge process controls,
    and DotInfoBadge service monitors.
    """

    def __init__(self, window: 'MainWindow'):
        super().__init__(window)
        self.window = window
        self.setSizeGripEnabled(False)
        self._setup_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        # 1. VRAM Hardware Telemetry
        self.bar_vram = ProgressBar(self)
        self.bar_vram.setFixedWidth(70)
        self.bar_vram.setFixedHeight(4)
        self.bar_vram.setRange(0, 100)
        self.bar_vram.setValue(0)
        self.bar_vram.setToolTip("Загрузка VRAM")

    def _connect_signals(self):
        if hasattr(self.window, "system_monitor") and self.window.system_monitor is not None:
            self.window.system_monitor.stats_updated.connect(self._on_hardware_stats)
        if hasattr(self.window, "health_worker") and self.window.health_worker is not None:
            self.window.health_worker.health_updated.connect(self._on_health_updated)

    @pyqtSlot(dict)
    def _on_hardware_stats(self, stats: dict):
        v_used = stats.get("vram_used_mb", 0)
        v_total = stats.get("vram_total_mb", 8192)
        v_pct = stats.get("vram_percent", 0.0)
        temp = stats.get("gpu_temp_c")

        if hasattr(self.lbl_vram, "update_vram"):
            self.lbl_vram.update_vram(v_used, v_total, v_pct, temp)

        r_used = stats.get("ram_used_gb", 0.0)
        r_total = stats.get("ram_total_gb", 16.0)
        r_pct = stats.get("ram_percent", 0.0)

        if hasattr(self.lbl_ram, "update_ram"):
            self.lbl_ram.update_ram(r_used, r_total, r_pct)

    @pyqtSlot(dict)
    def _on_health_updated(self, health: dict):
        lm_ok = health.get("lm_ok", False)
        lm_msg = health.get("lm_msg", "LM Studio Offline")
        self.pill_lm.set_status(lm_ok, lm_msg)

        forge_ok = health.get("forge_ok", False)
        forge_msg = health.get("forge_msg", "SD Forge Offline")
        self.pill_forge.set_status(forge_ok, forge_msg)

        tts_ok = health.get("tts_ok", False)
        tts_msg = health.get("tts_msg", "F5-TTS Offline")
        self.pill_tts.set_status(tts_ok, tts_msg)

"""
Backend Status Indicator Pill for NeonRoute
Displays live connection states for LM Studio, SD Forge, and F5-TTS.
"""

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QLabel


class StatusPill(QWidget):
    """
    Compact status badge with glowing LED indicator.
    """
    def __init__(self, name: str, port: int, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.name = name
        self.port = port
        self.is_online = False
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(6, 2, 6, 2)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        # LED Indicator Dot
        self.dot = QLabel("●", self)
        self.dot.setStyleSheet("color: #EF4444; font-size: 11px;")
        layout.addWidget(self.dot)

        # Name & Port label
        self.label = QLabel(f"{self.name} ({self.port})", self)
        self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
        layout.addWidget(self.label)

        self.setStyleSheet("""
            background-color: #111622;
            border: 1px solid #1E273A;
            border-radius: 12px;
        """)

    def set_status(self, online: bool, message: str = ""):
        self.is_online = online
        if online:
            self.dot.setStyleSheet("color: #00FF66; font-size: 11px;")  # Neon lime/emerald
            self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #E2E8F0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
            self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} Online ({message or 'Ready'})")
        else:
            self.dot.setStyleSheet("color: #EF4444; font-size: 11px;")  # Neon red/coral
            self.label.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;")
            self.setToolTip(f"{self.name} Offline: {message or 'Service unreachable'}")

﻿"""
Кнопка перевода со встроенным пошаговым индикатором прогресса
на базе компонентов PyQt-Fluent-Widgets (ProgressRing, ProgressBar, PushButton).
"""
from typing import Optional
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import pyqtSignal, QObject
from PyQt6.QtGui import QIcon
from qfluentwidgets import PushButton, ProgressRing, ProgressBar, FluentIcon as FIF


class CardProgressBridge(QObject):
    """Потокобезопасный мост для передачи сигналов прогресса из фонового воркера в GUI."""
    progress_changed = pyqtSignal(int, int, str)


class StepProgressButton(PushButton):
    """
    Кнопка Fluent Design со встроенным круговым кольцом прогресса (16x16)
    и нижней линией ProgressBar (3px), отображающая текущий слот карточки.
    """
    SLOT_TITLES = {
        "DESCRIPTION": "Описание",
        "PERSONALITY": "Личность",
        "SCENARIO": "Сценарий",
        "MES_EXAMPLE": "Диалоги",
        "FIRST_MES": "Приветствие",
    }

    def __init__(
        self,
        icon=FIF.LANGUAGE,
        text: str = "🌐 Перевести всё (RU)",
        parent: Optional[QWidget] = None
    ):
        # Инициализируем только parent, чтобы исключить рекурсию перегрузок @overload
        super().__init__(parent=parent)
        self.setText(text)
        self.setIcon(icon)
        self._default_icon = icon
        self._default_text = text
        self.setFixedHeight(32)
        self.setMinimumWidth(220)

        # 1. Круговой индикатор 16x16 слева
        self.ring = ProgressRing(self)
        self.ring.setTextVisible(False)
        self.ring.setFixedSize(16, 16)
        self.ring.setStrokeWidth(2.5)
        self.ring.hide()

        # 2. Микро-полоса ProgressBar (3px) по нижней кромке
        self.bar = ProgressBar(self)
        self.bar.setFixedHeight(3)
        self.bar.setRange(0, 100)
        self.bar.setValue(0)
        self.bar.hide()

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self.bar.setGeometry(0, self.height() - 3, self.width(), 3)
        self.ring.move(10, (self.height() - 16) // 2)

    def update_step_progress(self, current: int, total: int, slot_key: str):
        """Слот обновления прогресса: вызывается в главном GUI-потоке."""
        self.setEnabled(False)
        self.setIcon(QIcon())  # освобождаем место под ProgressRing
        self.setStyleSheet("text-align: left; padding-left: 34px;")
        self.ring.show()
        self.bar.show()

        if slot_key.startswith("ALT_GREETING_"):
            num = slot_key.split("_")[-1]
            title = f"Альт. приветствие {num}"
        else:
            title = self.SLOT_TITLES.get(slot_key.upper(), slot_key)

        percent = int((current / max(1, total)) * 100)
        self.ring.setValue(percent)
        self.bar.setValue(percent)
        self.setText(f"{title} ({current}/{total})...")

    def reset_state(self, success: bool = True):
        """Сбрасывает состояние кнопки после окончания конвейера."""
        self.ring.hide()
        self.bar.hide()
        self.setStyleSheet("")
        self.setEnabled(True)
        if success:
            self.setIcon(self._default_icon)
            self.setText(self._default_text)
        else:
            self.setIcon(FIF.CANCEL)
            self.setText("❌ Сбой перевода")

"""
Thought Spoiler Widget for NeonRoute Assistant (Elaria).
Cyberpunk Glassmorphism styling:
- Translucent dark slate background (rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65))
- Delicate neon Cyan/SkyBlue border (rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25))
- Collapsible content area with monospaced muted text (#94A3B8)
- Real-time token streaming and status/duration metrics
"""

import re
from typing import Optional, Union
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QFrame, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel,
    QTextBrowser, QSizePolicy, QLayout
)
from qfluentwidgets import (
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    TransparentToolButton,
    StrongBodyLabel,
    CaptionLabel,
    ToolTipFilter,
    ToolTipPosition
)


def clean_thought_chunk(chunk: str) -> str:
    """Вырезает служебные теги инструментов из потока мыслей модели."""
    # Удаляем <<TOOL:write_file ...>> и <</TOOL>>
    cleaned = re.sub(r'<<?/?(?:TOOL|tool)(?::\w+)?(?:\s+[^>\r\n]*?)?>>?', '', chunk)
    # Удаляем маркеры Markdown-блоков кода и имена файлов
    cleaned = re.sub(r'`{3}(?:python|py)?(?:\s+filename=[^\r\n]+)?', '', cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'`{3}', '', cleaned)
    return cleaned


class ThoughtHeaderWidget(QWidget):
    """Кликабельная шапка спойлера с иконкой, заголовком и метриками."""
    clicked = pyqtSignal()

    def __init__(self, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_Hover, True)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit()
            event.accept()
        else:
            super().mousePressEvent(event)


class ThoughtSpoilerWidget(QFrame):
    """
    Сворачиваемый виджет «Ход мыслей» в стилистике NeonRoute Glassmorphism.
    Размещается в бабле ассистента над основным текстом ответа.
    """

    toggled = pyqtSignal(bool)  # is_collapsed

    def __init__(self, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("ThoughtSpoilerWidget")
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Policy.Maximum)

        self._thought_text: str = ""
        self._is_collapsed: bool = True
        self._is_streaming: bool = True
        self._duration: float = 0.0
        self._token_count: int = 0

        self._setup_ui()
        self._apply_styles()
        self.set_collapsed(True)

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.main_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.main_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.main_layout.setSpacing(0)

        # 1. Шапка спойлера
        self.header_widget = ThoughtHeaderWidget(self)
        self.header_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.header_widget)
        self.header_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 6, 8, 6)
        self.header_layout.setSpacing(8)

        # Иконка 🧠
        self.icon_lbl = QLabel("🧠", self.header_widget)
        self.icon_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 13px; background: transparent;")
        self.header_layout.addWidget(self.icon_lbl)

        # Заголовок
        self.title_lbl = StrongBodyLabel("Ход мыслей", self.header_widget)
        self.title_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #E2E8F0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: transparent;")
        self.header_layout.addWidget(self.title_lbl)

        # Метрики генерации / бейдж статуса
        self.metrics_label = CaptionLabel("Анализ данных...", self.header_widget)
        self.metrics_label.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 11px; background: transparent;")
        self.header_layout.addWidget(self.metrics_label)

        self.header_layout.addStretch()

        # Кнопка сворачивания/разворачивания
        self.chevron_btn = TransparentToolButton(FIF.CHEVRON_RIGHT, self.header_widget)
        self.chevron_btn.setFixedSize(24, 24)
        self.chevron_btn.setToolTip("Развернуть ход мыслей")
        self.chevron_btn.installEventFilter(ToolTipFilter(self.chevron_btn, showDelay=150, position=ToolTipPosition.TOP))
        self.chevron_btn.clicked.connect(self.toggle_collapsed)
        self.header_layout.addWidget(self.chevron_btn)

        self.header_widget.clicked.connect(self.toggle_collapsed)
        self.main_layout.addWidget(self.header_widget)

        # 2. Область содержимого мыслей
        self.content_area = QFrame(self)
        self.content_area.setObjectName("ThoughtContentArea")
        self.content_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.content_area)
        self.content_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 8)
        self.content_layout.setSpacing(0)

        self.text_browser = QTextBrowser(self.content_area)
        self.text_browser.setObjectName("ThoughtTextBrowser")
        self.text_browser.setReadOnly(True)
        self.text_browser.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
        self.text_browser.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAsNeeded)
        self.text_browser.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.text_browser.setMaximumHeight(260)
        self.text_browser.setMinimumHeight(40)
        self.text_browser.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Policy.Preferred)

        self.content_layout.addWidget(self.text_browser)
        self.main_layout.addWidget(self.content_area)

    def _apply_styles(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            #ThoughtSpoilerWidget {
                background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);
                border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
            #ThoughtContentArea {
                background: transparent;
                border: none;
            }
            #ThoughtTextBrowser {
                background: transparent;
                border: none;
                color: #94A3B8;
                font-family: 'Consolas', 'Fira Code', 'Cascadia Code', 'Segoe UI', monospace;
                font-size: 11px;
                line-height: 1.45;
                padding: 4px;
            }
        """)

    @property
    def is_collapsed(self) -> bool:
        return self._is_collapsed

    def get_thought_text(self) -> str:
        return self._thought_text

    def append_thought_chunk(self, chunk: str):
        """
        Дописывание входящего потока токенов рассуждений.
        Во время стриминга спойлер открыт, отображается статус «Анализ данных...».
        """
        if not chunk:
            return

        cleaned = clean_thought_chunk(chunk)
        if not cleaned:
            return

        self._thought_text += cleaned
        self.text_browser.setPlainText(self._thought_text)

        # Автопрокрутка вниз
        sb = self.text_browser.verticalScrollBar()
        if sb:
            sb.setValue(sb.maximum())

        if self._is_streaming:
            self.metrics_label.setText("Анализ данных...")
            self.metrics_label.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 11px; background: transparent;")
            if self._is_collapsed:
                self.set_collapsed(False)

    def finalize_thought(self, duration_sec: float = 0.0, token_count: Union[int, str] = 0):
        """
        Фиксация таймера мыслей, смена бейджа на «{N} токенов • {X.X} сек»
        и автоматическое аккуратное сворачивание спойлера по умолчанию.
        """
        self._is_streaming = False
        self._duration = max(0.0, float(duration_sec))
        if isinstance(token_count, str) and not token_count.isdigit():
            self._thought_text = clean_thought_chunk(token_count)
            self.text_browser.setPlainText(self._thought_text)
            self._token_count = max(1, len(self._thought_text.strip()) // 4)
        else:
            self._token_count = int(token_count)
            if self._token_count <= 0 and self._thought_text:
                self._token_count = max(1, len(self._thought_text.strip()) // 4)

        dur_text = f"{self._duration:.1f}".replace(",", ".")
        self.metrics_label.setText(f"{self._token_count} токенов • {dur_text} сек")
        self.metrics_label.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 11px; background: transparent;")

        # Автоматическое сворачивание после завершения
        self.set_collapsed(True)

    def set_thought_data(self, text: str, duration: float = 0.0, token_count: int = 0):
        """Восстановление мыслей из истории (в свёрнутом виде)."""
        clean_text = clean_thought_chunk(str(text or "")).strip()
        if not clean_text:
            self.setVisible(False)
            self.hide()
            return

        self._thought_text = clean_text
        self._is_streaming = False
        self._duration = max(0.0, float(duration))
        self._token_count = int(token_count)
        if self._token_count <= 0:
            self._token_count = max(1, len(clean_text) // 4)

        self.text_browser.setPlainText(clean_text)
        dur_text = f"{self._duration:.1f}".replace(",", ".")
        self.metrics_label.setText(f"{self._token_count} токенов • {dur_text} сек")
        self.metrics_label.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 11px; background: transparent;")

        self.set_collapsed(True)
        self.setVisible(True)
        self.show()

    def toggle_collapsed(self):
        """Переключение состояния спойлера (развернуть/свернуть)."""
        self.set_collapsed(not self._is_collapsed)

    def set_collapsed(self, collapsed: bool):
        """Установка состояния свёрнутости."""
        self._is_collapsed = collapsed
        self.content_area.setVisible(not collapsed)
        if collapsed:
            self.chevron_btn.setIcon(FIF.CHEVRON_RIGHT)
            self.chevron_btn.setToolTip("Развернуть ход мыслей")
        else:
            self.chevron_btn.setIcon(FIF.CHEVRON_DOWN_MED)
            self.chevron_btn.setToolTip("Свернуть ход мыслей")

        self.toggled.emit(self._is_collapsed)
        # Уведомляем родительский виджет об изменении геометрии
        parent = self.parentWidget()
        if parent and hasattr(parent, "_update_bubble_geometry"):
            parent._update_bubble_geometry()

"""
Typing Loader Indicator for NeonRoute
Displays a pulsing cyberpunk bubble while LLM, Translation, or Forge tasks are executing.
Adheres to Telegram/WhatsApp style with circular avatar and dynamic dancing dots.
"""

import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QLabel

from ui.components.chat_bubble import render_circular_avatar


class TypingLoaderWidget(QWidget):
    """
    Compact animated typing loader bubble in Telegram/WhatsApp style.
    Displays circular avatar of the sender on the left, a glassmorphic bubble with
    clean status text, and dynamically animated dancing dots.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        sender_name: str = "NeonRoute",
        action_text: str = "печатает",
        avatar_path: Optional[Path | str] = None,
        icon: Optional[str] = None,
        parent=None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.sender_name = sender_name
        # Clean action text of any static trailing dots and leading duplicate emojis
        clean_action = re.sub(r'[\.\s]+$', '', action_text).strip()
        self.action_text = clean_action
        self.avatar_path = Path(avatar_path) if avatar_path else None
        self.dot_count = 1

        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 4, 10, 4)
        layout.setSpacing(10)
        layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)

        # 1. Circular Avatar (36x36)
        self.avatar_lbl = QLabel(self)
        self.avatar_lbl.setFixedSize(36, 36)
        self.avatar_lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self.avatar_lbl.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
        self.avatar_lbl.setPixmap(
            render_circular_avatar(
                avatar_path=self.avatar_path,
                name=self.sender_name,
                size=36,
                is_user=False
            )
        )
        layout.addWidget(self.avatar_lbl, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)

        # 2. Glassmorphic Bubble
        self.bubble = QFrame(self)
        self.bubble.setObjectName("TypingLoaderBubble")
        self.bubble.setStyleSheet("""
            #TypingLoaderBubble {
                background-color: rgba(28, 30, 38, 0.82);
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
                border-radius: 16px;
                border-top-left-radius: 4px;
                padding: 8px 14px;
            }
        """)

        bubble_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.bubble)
        bubble_layout.setContentsMargins(4, 2, 4, 2)
        bubble_layout.setSpacing(4)

        self.lbl_text = QLabel(self.action_text, self.bubble)
        self.lbl_text.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: transparent;")
        bubble_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_text)

        self.lbl_dots = QLabel(".", self.bubble)
        self.lbl_dots.setFixedWidth(24)
        self.lbl_dots.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; background: transparent;")
        bubble_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_dots)

        layout.addWidget(self.bubble, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
        layout.addStretch(1)

        # Dynamic Animation timer (every 350 ms: . -> .. -> ... -> "")
        self.timer = QTimer(self)
        self.timer.timeout.connect(self._animate_tick)
        self.timer.start(350)

    def _animate_tick(self):
        self.dot_count = (self.dot_count + 1) % 4
        self.lbl_dots.setText("." * self.dot_count)

    def stop_animation(self):
        """Stops the animation timer cleanly."""
        self.cleanup()

    def cleanup(self):
        """Stops the animation timer cleanly."""
        if hasattr(self, "timer") and self.timer.isActive():
            self.timer.stop()

class InteractiveTitleChip(QPushButton):
    """Интерактивный заголовок-чип песочницы без рамок.
    ЛКМ — открытие директории песочницы.
    ПКМ — переименование сессии.
    """
    left_clicked = pyqtSignal()
    right_clicked = pyqtSignal()

    def __init__(self, text: str = "📁 Песочница", parent=None):
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setToolTip("ЛКМ: Открыть папку песочницы в Проводнике\nПКМ: Переименовать диалог")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            InteractiveTitleChip {
                background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
                border: none;
                border-radius: 6px;
                color: #00F0FF;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: bold;
                padding: 4px 10px;
                text-align: left;
            }
            InteractiveTitleChip:hover {
                background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
                color: #38BDF8;
            }
            InteractiveTitleChip:pressed {
                background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
            }
        """)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.left_clicked.emit()
            super().mousePressEvent(event)
        elif event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.RightButton:
            self.right_clicked.emit()
            event.accept()
        else:
            super().mousePressEvent(event)

class LineNumberArea(QWidget):
    """Боковая полоса нумерации строк с маркером ошибок."""
    def __init__(self, editor):
        super().__init__(editor)
        self.code_editor = editor

    def sizeHint(self):
        return self.code_editor.lineNumberAreaSize()

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        self.code_editor.lineNumberAreaPaintEvent(event)


class PythonHighlighter(QSyntaxHighlighter):
    """Легковесная неоновая подсветка синтаксиса Python."""
    def __init__(self, document):
        super().__init__(document)
        self.rules = []
        kw_fmt = QTextCharFormat()
        kw_fmt.setForeground(QColor("#00F0FF"))
        kw_fmt.setFontWeight(QFont.Weight.Bold)
        keywords = [
            "def", "class", "return", "if", "elif", "else", "while", "for",
            "in", "try", "except", "finally", "import", "from", "as", "with",
            "None", "True", "False", "lambda", "pass", "raise"
        ]
        for kw in keywords:
            pattern = rf"\b{kw}\b"
            import re
            self.rules.append((re.compile(pattern), kw_fmt))

        str_fmt = QTextCharFormat()
        str_fmt.setForeground(QColor("#FBBF24"))
        self.rules.append((re.compile(r"(['\"].*?['\"])"), str_fmt))

        comm_fmt = QTextCharFormat()
        comm_fmt.setForeground(QColor("#64748B"))
        self.rules.append((re.compile(r"#[^\n]*"), comm_fmt))

    def highlightBlock(self, text: str):
        for pattern, fmt in self.rules:
            for match in pattern.finditer(text):
                start, end = match.span()
                self.setFormat(start, end - start, fmt)


class CodeEditorViewer(QPlainTextEdit):
    """Просмотрщик и редактор кода с нумерацией строк, хоткеями и подсветкой ошибок."""
    sig_save_requested = pyqtSignal()
    sig_test_requested = pyqtSignal()

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setReadOnly(False)
        self.line_number_area = LineNumberArea(self)
        self.error_lineno: Optional[int] = None
        self.error_message: str = ""
        self.highlighter = PythonHighlighter(self.document())

        font = QFont("Cascadia Code, Consolas, Courier New", 10)
        self.setFont(font)
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QPlainTextEdit {
                background-color: #0A0E17;
                color: #CBD5E1;
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
        """)

        self.blockCountChanged.connect(self.updateLineNumberAreaWidth)
        self.updateRequest.connect(self.updateLineNumberArea)
        self.updateLineNumberAreaWidth(0)

    def keyPressEvent(self, event: QKeyEvent):
        if (event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier) and event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_S:
            self.sig_save_requested.emit()
            event.accept()
            return
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_F5 or ((event.modifiers() == Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier) and event.key() in (Qt.Key.Key_Return, Qt.Key.Key_Enter)):
            self.sig_test_requested.emit()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def lineNumberAreaWidth(self) -> int:
        digits = len(str(max(1, self.blockCount())))
        return 16 + self.fontMetrics().horizontalAdvance('9') * digits

    def updateLineNumberAreaWidth(self, _):
        self.setViewportMargins(self.lineNumberAreaWidth(), 0, 0, 0)

    def updateLineNumberArea(self, rect, dy):
        if dy:
            self.line_number_area.scroll(0, dy)
        else:
            self.line_number_area.update(0, rect.y(), self.line_number_area.width(), rect.height())
        if rect.contains(self.viewport().rect()):
            self.updateLineNumberAreaWidth(0)

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        cr = self.contentsRect()
        self.line_number_area.setGeometry(QRect(cr.left(), cr.top(), self.lineNumberAreaWidth(), cr.height()))

    def lineNumberAreaPaintEvent(self, event):
        painter = QPainter(self.line_number_area)
        painter.fillRect(event.rect(), QColor("#06090F"))
        block = self.firstVisibleBlock()
        block_num = block.blockNumber()
        top = round(self.blockBoundingGeometry(block).translated(self.contentOffset()).top())
        bottom = top + round(self.blockBoundingRect(block).height())

        while block.isValid() and top <= event.rect().bottom():
            if block.isVisible() and bottom >= event.rect().top():
                line_str = str(block_num + 1)
                is_err = (self.error_lineno == (block_num + 1))
                painter.setPen(QColor("#F43F5E") if is_err else QColor("#475569"))
                if is_err:
                    painter.drawText(2, top, 12, self.fontMetrics().height(), Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, "❌")
                painter.drawText(
                    0, top, self.line_number_area.width() - 4, self.fontMetrics().height(),
                    Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight, line_str
                )
            block = block.next()
            top = bottom
            bottom = top + round(self.blockBoundingRect(block).height())
            block_num += 1

    def highlight_error_line(self, line_num: int, err_msg: str = ""):
        self.error_lineno = line_num
        self.error_message = err_msg

        selections = []
        if line_num > 0:
            block = self.document().findBlockByNumber(line_num - 1)
            if block.isValid():
                sel = QTextEdit.ExtraSelection()
                sel.format.setBackground(QColor(244, 63, 94, 60))
                sel.format.setProperty(QTextFormat.Property.FullWidthSelection, True)
                cursor = self.textCursor()
                cursor.setPosition(block.position())
                sel.cursor = cursor
                selections.append(sel)
                self.setTextCursor(cursor)
                self.ensureCursorVisible()

        self.setExtraSelections(selections)
        self.line_number_area.update()

    def clear_error_highlight(self):
        self.error_lineno = None
        self.error_message = ""
        self.setExtraSelections([])
        self.line_number_area.update()

    def start_streaming_mode(self, filename: str):
        """Подготавливает редактор к приёму живого потока токенов."""
        self.setReadOnly(True)
        self.blockSignals(True)
        self.clear()
        self.clear_error_highlight()
        self.blockSignals(False)

    def append_stream_chunk(self, chunk: str):
        """Потокобезопасно добавляет фрагмент кода и прокручивает каретку вниз."""
        cursor = self.textCursor()
        cursor.movePosition(cursor.MoveOperation.End)
        cursor.insertText(chunk)
        self.setTextCursor(cursor)
        self.ensureCursorVisible()

    def finish_streaming_mode(self, clean_code: Optional[str] = None):
        """Завершает стриминг, синхронизирует финальный чистый код и обновляет подсветку."""
        if clean_code is not None:
            sb = self.verticalScrollBar()
            val = sb.value() if sb else 0
            self.setPlainText(clean_code)
            if sb:
                sb.setValue(val)
        self.setReadOnly(False)

class WorkspaceInspectorWidget(CardWidget):
    """Правая панель инспектора песочницы с ручным редактированием, автосинхронизацией и запуском тестов."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):

        main_layout.addWidget(self.verification_panel)

        # Привязка сигналов стриминга
        self.sig_stream_started.connect(self._on_stream_started)
        self.sig_stream_chunk.connect(self._on_stream_chunk)
        self.sig_stream_finished.connect(self._on_stream_finished)

        # Привязка сигналов ручного редактирования и кнопок
        self.editor.textChanged.connect(self._on_text_modified)
        self.editor.sig_save_requested.connect(self.save_manual_edits)
        self.editor.sig_test_requested.connect(self.run_manual_test)
        self.btn_save.clicked.connect(self.save_manual_edits)
        self.btn_test.clicked.connect(self.run_manual_test)

        # Автоматическое отслеживание изменений файловой системы
        self._watcher = QFileSystemWatcher(self)
        self._debounce_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._debounce_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._debounce_timer.setInterval(250)
        self._debounce_timer.timeout.connect(self.refresh_files)

        self._watcher.directoryChanged.connect(lambda _: self._debounce_timer.start())
        self._watcher.fileChanged.connect(lambda _: self._debounce_timer.start())
        self._init_watcher()

    def open_workspace_folder(self):
        """Открывает папку текущей песочницы в Проводнике Windows."""
        try:
            ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()
            ws_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            import os
            os.startfile(str(ws_dir))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Не удалось открыть папку песочницы: {e}")

    def _on_right_click_rename(self):
        """Эмитит сигнал запроса переименования для активной сессии."""
        try:
            sess_id = SandboxManager.get_active_session_id()
            if sess_id:
                self.rename_session_requested.emit(sess_id)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Ошибка запроса переименования: {e}")

    def update_title(self, title: str):
        """Обновляет текст заголовка песочницы."""
        clean = (title or "").strip()
        if not clean or clean.lower() == "диалог":
            clean = "Песочница"
        display_text = f"📁 {clean}" if not clean.startswith("📁") else clean
        if hasattr(self, "title_btn"):
            self.title_btn.setText(display_text)

    @property
    def current_file_path(self) -> Optional[Path]:
        return self.active_file_path

    @current_file_path.setter
    def current_file_path(self, path: Optional[Path]):
        self.active_file_path = path

    def _init_watcher(self):
        """Регистрирует директорию песочницы в наблюдателе."""
        ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()
        if not ws_dir.exists():
            try:
                ws_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            except Exception:
                return

        watched = set(self._watcher.directories())
        ws_str = str(ws_dir.resolve())
        if ws_str not in watched:
            self._watcher.addPath(ws_str)

    def refresh_files(self):
        """Сканирует workspace, обновляет дерево и автоматически открывает новые файлы."""
        self._init_watcher()
        ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()
        if not ws_dir.exists():
            return

        ignored = {".git", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".neonroute_last_failure.json"}
        current_files = []
        new_files = []

        # Актуализация отслеживаемых подкаталогов
        for root, dirs, _ in os.walk(ws_dir):
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ignored]
            r_path = Path(root).resolve()
            r_str = str(r_path)
            if r_str not in self._watcher.directories():
                try:
                    self._watcher.addPath(r_str)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        for p in sorted(ws_dir.rglob("*")):
            if any(ign in p.parts for ign in ignored) or p.is_dir():
                continue
            p_str = str(p.resolve())
            current_files.append(p)
            if p_str not in self._known_files:
                new_files.append(p)

        self.file_tree.clear()
        items_map = {}
        target_tree_item = None

        for p in current_files:
            rel = p.relative_to(ws_dir)
            parent_item = self.file_tree
            if len(rel.parts) > 1:
                parent_dir = rel.parts[0]
                if parent_dir not in items_map:
                    dir_item = QTreeWidgetItem(self.file_tree, [f"📁 {parent_dir}"])
                    items_map[parent_dir] = dir_item
                parent_item = items_map[parent_dir]

            icon = "🐍" if p.suffix == ".py" else ("📊" if p.suffix in (".xlsx", ".csv") else ("📝" if p.suffix == ".docx" else "📄"))
            item = QTreeWidgetItem(parent_item, [f"{icon} {p.name}"])
            p_res = str(p.resolve())
            item.setData(0, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, p_res)

            if self.active_file_path and str(self.active_file_path.resolve()) == p_res:
                target_tree_item = item

        self.file_tree.expandAll()

        # Автоматический выбор и отображение:
        if new_files:
            latest_file = new_files[-1]
            self.open_file(latest_file)
        elif self.active_file_path and self.active_file_path.is_file():
            if not self.is_dirty:
                self._reload_active_file()
            if target_tree_item:
                self.file_tree.setCurrentItem(target_tree_item)
        elif current_files and not self.active_file_path:
            py_files = [f for f in current_files if f.suffix == ".py"]
            target = py_files[0] if py_files else current_files[0]
            self.open_file(target)

        self._known_files = {str(p.resolve()) for p in current_files}

    def _on_tree_item_clicked(self, item, _):
        path_str = item.data(0, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if path_str and Path(path_str).is_file():
            self.open_file(Path(path_str))

    def _show_tree_context_menu(self, pos):
        """Контекстное меню ПКМ по элементу дерева файлов песочницы."""
        item = self.file_tree.itemAt(pos)
        if not item:
            return

        self.file_tree.setCurrentItem(item)
        path_str = item.data(0, Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)

        file_path = None
        if path_str:
            file_path = Path(path_str)
            file_name = file_path.name
        else:
            raw_text = item.text(0)
            file_name = raw_text.split()[-1] if raw_text else ""

        if not file_name:
            return

        menu = RoundMenu(parent=self.file_tree)

        # 1. Открыть в редакторе (если это файл)
        if file_path and file_path.is_file():
            act_open = Action(FIF.EDIT, "Открыть в редакторе", self)
            act_open.triggered.connect(lambda: self.open_file(file_path))
            menu.addAction(act_open)
            menu.addSeparator()

        # 2. Скопировать имя файла
        act_copy_name = Action(FIF.COPY, "Копировать имя файла", self)
        act_copy_name.triggered.connect(lambda: QApplication.clipboard().setText(file_name))
        menu.addAction(act_copy_name)

        # 3. Скопировать относительный путь (workspace/...)
        if file_path:
            try:
                ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()
                rel_path = str(file_path.relative_to(ws_dir)).replace("\\", "/")
                act_copy_rel = Action(FIF.DOCUMENT, "Копировать относительный путь", self)
                act_copy_rel.triggered.connect(lambda: QApplication.clipboard().setText(rel_path))
                menu.addAction(act_copy_rel)
            except Exception:
                pass

            # 4. Скопировать полный путь
            act_copy_full = Action(FIF.FOLDER, "Копировать полный путь", self)
            act_copy_full.triggered.connect(lambda: QApplication.clipboard().setText(str(file_path.resolve())))
            menu.addAction(act_copy_full)

        global_pos = self.file_tree.viewport().mapToGlobal(pos)
        menu.exec(global_pos)

    def _show_file_label_context_menu(self, pos):
        """Контекстное меню ПКМ по названию файла над редактором."""
        if not getattr(self, "active_file_path", None):
            return

        menu = RoundMenu(parent=self.file_name_lbl)
        act_copy = Action(FIF.COPY, f"Копировать имя файла ({self.active_file_path.name})", self)
        act_copy.triggered.connect(lambda: QApplication.clipboard().setText(self.active_file_path.name))
        menu.addAction(act_copy)

        try:
            ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()
            rel_path = str(self.active_file_path.relative_to(ws_dir)).replace("\\", "/")
            act_copy_rel = Action(FIF.DOCUMENT, "Копировать относительный путь", self)
            act_copy_rel.triggered.connect(lambda: QApplication.clipboard().setText(rel_path))
            menu.addAction(act_copy_rel)
        except Exception:
            pass

        menu.exec(self.file_name_lbl.mapToGlobal(pos))

    def open_file(self, file_path: Path):
        self.active_file_path = file_path
        self.file_name_lbl.setText(f"📄 {file_path.name}")
        self.file_name_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-weight: bold;")
        self.is_dirty = False
        self._reload_active_file()

    def _reload_active_file(self):
        if not self.active_file_path or not self.active_file_path.is_file():
            return
        try:
            self.editor.blockSignals(True)
            content = self.active_file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
            curr_cursor = self.editor.textCursor()
            curr_pos = curr_cursor.position()
            self.editor.setPlainText(content)
            curr_cursor.setPosition(min(curr_pos, len(content)))
            self.editor.setTextCursor(curr_cursor)
        except Exception as e:
            self.editor.setPlainText(f"# Не удалось прочитать файл: {e}")
        finally:
            self.editor.blockSignals(False)
            self.is_dirty = False

    def _on_text_modified(self):
        """Отслеживание изменений в редакторе (грязный буфер)."""
        if not self.is_dirty and self.active_file_path:
            self.is_dirty = True
            self.lbl_current_file.setText(f"📄 {self.active_file_path.name} *")
            self.lbl_current_file.setStyleSheet("color: #FBBF24; font-weight: bold;")

    def save_manual_edits(self):
        """Сохраняет правки файла, анализирует git diff, запрашивает комментарий и фиксирует коммит."""
        if not self.active_file_path or not self.active_file_path.is_file():
            return

        new_code = self.editor.toPlainText()
        self.active_file_path.write_text(new_code, encoding="utf-8")
        ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()
        filename = self.active_file_path.name

        line_ranges = SandboxManager.get_changed_line_ranges(ws_dir, filename)

        user_comment = ""
        try:
            dlg = InputDialog("Комментарий к коммиту", f"Изменения в {filename} ({line_ranges}):", self)
            dlg.input_line_edit.setPlaceholderText("Опишите суть изменений (или оставьте пустым)")
            if dlg.exec():
                user_comment = dlg.text().strip()
                SandboxManager.commit_manual_edit(ws_dir, filename, user_comment, line_ranges)
        except Exception:
            SandboxManager.commit_manual_edit(ws_dir, filename, user_comment, line_ranges)

        self.is_dirty = False
        self.lbl_current_file.setText(f"📄 {filename}")
        self.lbl_current_file.setStyleSheet("color: #CBD5E1; font-weight: normal;")
        self.verification_panel.lbl_details.setText(f"Сохранено: {line_ranges}")

    def run_manual_test(self):
        """Изолированный перезапуск проверки файла без обращения к LLM."""
        if not self.active_file_path:
            return
        if self.is_dirty:
            self.save_manual_edits()
        self.mark_running(f"Тестирование {self.active_file_path.name}...")
        ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()
        success, err_type, err_msg, err_line = SandboxManager.verify_single_file(ws_dir, self.active_file_path.name)
        if success:
            self.mark_success()
        else:
            self.show_error(self.active_file_path.name, err_line, err_msg, err_type=err_type)

    def _on_stream_started(self, filename: str):
        self.is_dirty = False
        self.lbl_current_file.setText(f"📄 {filename} (генерация...)")
        self.lbl_current_file.setStyleSheet("color: #38BDF8; font-weight: bold;")
        self.editor.start_streaming_mode(filename)
        self.verification_panel.set_running(f"Генерация исходного кода {filename}...")

    def _on_stream_chunk(self, chunk: str):
        self.editor.append_stream_chunk(chunk)

    def _on_stream_finished(self, filename: str, final_code: str):
        self.lbl_current_file.setText(f"📄 {filename}")
        self.lbl_current_file.setStyleSheet("color: #CBD5E1; font-weight: normal;")
        self.editor.blockSignals(True)
        self.editor.finish_streaming_mode(final_code)
        self.editor.blockSignals(False)
        self.is_dirty = False

    def show_error(self, filename: str, line_num: int, error_msg: str, err_type: str = "Runtime / Syntax"):
        if filename:
            ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()
            target = ws_dir / filename
            if target.is_file() and (not self.active_file_path or self.active_file_path.name != filename):
                self.open_file(target)
        if hasattr(self, "verification_panel"):
            self.verification_panel.set_error(err_type, error_msg, line=line_num)
        if hasattr(self, "editor"):
            self.editor.highlight_error_line(line_num or 0, error_msg)

    def mark_success(self):
        if hasattr(self, "verification_panel"):
            self.verification_panel.set_success()
        if hasattr(self, "editor"):
            self.editor.clear_error_highlight()

    def mark_running(self, text: str = "Выполняется верификация..."):
        if hasattr(self, "verification_panel"):
            self.verification_panel.set_running(text)
