class DialogControllerMixin:
    """Миксин для открытия диалоговых окон, настроек и экшенов меню."""

    def _open_user_settings_dialog(self, initial_tab: int = 0):
        try:
            dlg = UserSettingsDialog(initial_tab=initial_tab, parent=self)
            dlg.settings_applied.connect(self._on_settings_applied)
            dlg.profiles_updated.connect(self._on_user_profiles_updated)
            dlg.exec()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[NeonRoute] Ошибка открытия окна настроек Эларии: {e}", exc_info=True)
            from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QMessageBox
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Ошибка настроек", f"Не удалось открыть настройки профиля:\n{e}")

    def _on_settings_applied(self, new_config: dict):
        self.app_config = new_config
        if hasattr(self, "chat_controller"):
            self.chat_controller.update_config(new_config)

        # Синхронизация модели через сигнал
        selected_model = new_config.get("active_model")
        if selected_model and hasattr(self, "lm_combo") and self.lm_combo:
            idx = self.lm_combo.findText(selected_model)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            else:
                self.lm_combo.addItem(selected_model)
                self.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(self.lm_combo.count() - 1)

    def _on_user_profiles_updated(self):
        self.app_config = ConfigManager.load_config()
        self._update_header_for_current_state()

        # 1. Мгновенно обновляем аватар пользователя во всех баблах активного чата
        new_user_avatar = self._get_user_avatar_path()
        for w in self._get_chat_message_widgets():
            if getattr(w, "is_user", False):
                w.update_avatar(new_user_avatar)

        # 2. Если ролевой чат на стадии завязки (нет ходов игрока) — реактивно обновляем {{user}} в приветствии
        if (
            self.current_mode == "roleplay"
            and self.active_character
            and self.current_session
            and len(self.current_session.get("messages", [])) == 1
            and not self.current_session["messages"][0].get("is_user")
        ):
            from services.macro_engine import MacroEngine
            u_name = self._get_active_user_name(is_roleplay=True)
            pool = self.active_character.get_greetings_pool()
            idx = self.current_session.get("active_greeting_idx", 0)
            if pool and 0 <= idx < len(pool):
                raw_eff = pool[idx]["effective"]
                raw_ru = pool[idx]["ru"]
            else:
                raw_eff = self.active_character.first_mes_ru or self.active_character.first_mes or ""
                raw_ru = self.active_character.first_mes_ru or ""

            if raw_eff:
                updated_greeting = MacroEngine.process(raw_eff, user_name=u_name, char_name=self.active_character.name)
                updated_ru = MacroEngine.process(raw_ru, user_name=u_name, char_name=self.active_character.name) if raw_ru else None
                widgets = self._get_chat_message_widgets()
                if widgets:
                    widgets[0].set_text(updated_greeting)
                    if updated_ru:
                        widgets[0].translated_text = updated_ru
                        if widgets[0].is_showing_translation:
                            widgets[0]._update_rendered_text()
                if self.chat_history:
                    self.chat_history[0]["content"] = updated_greeting
                self.current_session["messages"][0]["text"] = updated_greeting
                if updated_ru:
                    self.current_session["messages"][0]["translated_text"] = updated_ru
                self._save_current_session()

        self.statusBar().showMessage("Личные настройки профиля обновлены и применены к чату.", 3000)

    def _on_action_export_clicked(self):
        """Action for Export button: exports active session to exports folder and opens explorer."""
        try:
            self._save_current_session()
            if self.current_session and self.current_session.get("chat_history"):
                import json
                s_id = str(self.current_session.get("id", "session"))
                title = self.current_session.get("title", "chat")
                safe_title = re.sub(r'[\\/*?:"<>|]', "", title).strip() or "session"
                exp_json = EXPORTS_DIR / f"{safe_title}_{s_id[:8]}_{int(time.time())}.json"
                with open(exp_json, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    json.dump(self.current_session, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
                self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Сессия экспортирована: {exp_json.name}", 3000)
            os.startfile(str(EXPORTS_DIR))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error on export action: {e}")
            try:
                os.startfile(str(EXPORTS_DIR))
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _on_action_audio_clicked(self):
        """Action for Audio button: triggers TTS for last assistant message, or opens audio folder."""
        try:
            target_widget = None
            target_text = ""
            for i in reversed(range(self.chat_layout.count())):
                item = self.chat_layout.itemAt(i)
                w = item.widget() if item else None
                if w and isinstance(w, ChatMessageWidget) and not getattr(w, "is_user", True):
                    target_widget = w
                    target_text = getattr(w, "translated_text", None) or getattr(w, "raw_text", "")
                    break
            if target_widget and target_text:
                self._enqueue_tts_task(target_text, target_widget)
            else:
                os.startfile(str(AUDIO_DIR))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error on audio action: {e}")
            try:
                os.startfile(str(AUDIO_DIR))
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _open_background_settings_dialog(self):

        dialog.background_changed.connect(self._on_background_changed)

        dialog.background_reset.connect(self._on_background_reset)
        dialog.exec()

    def _on_background_changed(self, file_path: str):
        src_path = Path(file_path)
        if not src_path.exists():
            return

        BACKGROUNDS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest_filename = f"bg_{src_path.name}"
        dest_path = BACKGROUNDS_DIR / dest_filename
        try:
            if src_path.resolve() != dest_path.resolve():
                shutil.copy2(src_path, dest_path)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to copy background image: {e}")
            dest_path = src_path

        self.background_path = str(dest_path)
        self.background_pixmap = QPixmap(str(dest_path))
        self.app_config["background_path"] = self.background_path
        ConfigManager.save_config(self.app_config)

        if self.current_session:
            self.current_session["background_path"] = self.background_path
            self._save_current_session()

        self._update_background_cache()
        self.update()
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Фон окна успешно обновлен.", 3000)

    def _on_background_dimming_changed(self, alpha: int):
        self.background_dim_opacity = max(0, min(240, alpha))
        self.app_config["background_dim_opacity"] = self.background_dim_opacity
        ConfigManager.save_config(self.app_config)

        if self.current_session:
            self.current_session["bg_dim_alpha"] = self.background_dim_opacity
            self._save_current_session()

        self._update_background_cache()
        self.update()

    def _on_background_reset(self):
        """Resets background to default dark cyberpunk theme."""
        self.background_path = None
        self.background_pixmap = None
        self.app_config["background_path"] = None
        ConfigManager.save_config(self.app_config)

        if self.current_session:
            self.current_session["background_path"] = None
            self._save_current_session()

        self._bg_render_cache = None
        self.update()
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Фон окна сброшен к стандартной теме.", 3000)

    def _open_global_model_sampling_dialog(self):
        """Opens ModelSamplingDialog for setting persistent defaults in config.json."""
        from services.session_manager import get_default_sampling_params
        from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager

        is_eng = self.is_engineer_mode_active()
        active_mode = "engineer" if is_eng else self.current_mode
        current_defaults = get_default_sampling_params(active_mode)

        dlg = ModelSamplingDialog(
            current_params=current_defaults,
            mode=self.current_mode,
            is_engineer_mode=is_eng,
            is_global_defaults=True,
            parent=self
        )
        if dlg.exec():
            new_params = dlg.get_sampling_params()
            cfg_key = f"default_sampling_{active_mode}"
            if not hasattr(self, "app_config") or self.app_config is None:
                self.app_config = {}
            self.app_config[cfg_key] = new_params
            from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager
            ConfigManager.save_config(self.app_config)
            if hasattr(self, "chat_controller"):
                self.chat_controller.update_config(self.app_config)
            logger.info(
                f"[ConfigManager] [GLOBAL-DEFAULT] Обновлены дефолты для '{cfg_key}' в config.json: "
                f"temp={new_params.get('temperature')}, min_p={new_params.get('min_p')}, max_tok={new_params.get('max_tokens')}"
            )

            # Если у текущей открытой сессии того же режима is_custom_sampling равен False, сразу обновляем
            if self.current_session and not self.current_session.get("is_custom_sampling", False):
                sess_mode = self.current_session.get("mode", "assistant")
                sess_effective_mode = "engineer" if (sess_mode == "assistant" and is_eng) else sess_mode
                if sess_effective_mode == active_mode:
                    self.current_session["sampling_params"] = dict(new_params)
                    if "is_dm_mode" in new_params:
                        self.current_session["is_dm_mode"] = new_params["is_dm_mode"]
                    self._save_current_session()
                    logger.info(f"[SessionManager] Текущая сессия {self.current_session.get('id')} синхронизирована с новыми дефолтами {active_mode}.")

            self.statusBar().showMessage(
                f"Глобальные параметры для режима '{active_mode}' сохранены в config.json (MaxTok: {new_params['max_tokens']}).",
                4000
            )

    def _open_model_sampling_dialog(self):
        """Opens ModelSamplingDialog to adjust sampling strictly for the active session."""
        if not self.current_session:
            return
        current_params = dict(self.current_session.get("sampling_params") or {})
        if "is_dm_mode" in self.current_session:
            current_params["is_dm_mode"] = self.current_session.get("is_dm_mode", False)
        is_eng = self.is_engineer_mode_active()
        dlg = ModelSamplingDialog(
            current_params=current_params,
            mode=self.current_mode,
            is_engineer_mode=is_eng,
            is_global_defaults=False,
            parent=self
        )
        if dlg.exec():
            new_params = dlg.get_sampling_params()
            if self.current_session:
                self.current_session["sampling_params"] = new_params
                self.current_session["is_custom_sampling"] = not getattr(dlg, "was_reset_to_defaults", False)
                if "is_dm_mode" in new_params:
                    self.current_session["is_dm_mode"] = new_params["is_dm_mode"]
                self._save_current_session()
                logger.info(
                    f"[SessionManager] [CHAT-OVERRIDE] Установлены индивидуальные параметры для сессии "
                    f"'{self.current_session.get('id')}': temp={new_params.get('temperature')}, "
                    f"min_p={new_params.get('min_p')}, max_tok={new_params.get('max_tokens')} (is_custom={self.current_session['is_custom_sampling']})"
                )

            self.statusBar().showMessage(
                f"Параметры сессии сохранены (MaxTok: {new_params['max_tokens']}).",
                4000
            )

    def _rename_character_or_dialog(self):
        current_name = ""
        if self.current_mode == "roleplay" and self.active_character:
            current_name = self.active_character.name
        elif self.current_session:
            current_name = self.current_session.get("title", "")

        new_name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(
            self, "Переименовать", "Новое имя:", text=current_name
        )
        if ok and new_name.strip():
            new_name = new_name.strip()
            if self.current_mode == "roleplay" and self.active_character:
                self.active_character.name = new_name
                self.char_name_lbl.setText(new_name)
                if self.current_session and "character_data" in self.current_session and self.current_session["character_data"]:
                    self.current_session["character_data"]["name"] = new_name

            if self.current_session:
                self.current_session["title"] = new_name
                self._save_current_session()
                sess_id = self.current_session["id"]
                if sess_id in self._session_items:
                    _, w = self._session_items[sess_id]
                    w.title_lbl.setText(new_name)

            self._update_header_for_current_state()
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Имя изменено на '{new_name}'.", 4000)

    def _open_chat_media_gallery(self):
        # Агрегация всех сгенерированных артов из всех чатов
        all_images = []
        sessions_dir = OUTPUTS_DIR / "sessions"
        if sessions_dir.exists():
            for img_p in sessions_dir.rglob("*"):
                if img_p.is_file() and img_p.suffix.lower() in (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp"):
                    all_images.append(img_p)
        for img_p in OUTPUTS_DIR.glob("*"):
            if img_p.is_file() and img_p.suffix.lower() in (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp"):
                all_images.append(img_p)

        dlg = ChatMediaGalleryDialog(
            session_id="all_sessions",
            session_title="Общая галерея",
            image_paths=all_images,
            parent=self
        )
        dlg.exec()

DOC_TASK_MARKERS = (

)


class EngineerControllerMixin:
    """Миксин для MainWindow, изолирующий все инженерные функции."""

    def is_engineer_mode_active(self) -> bool:
        """Возвращает True, если активен автономный контур Инженера."""
        if getattr(self, "current_session", None) and isinstance(self.current_session, dict):
            raw_mode = str(self.current_session.get("mode") or "").lower()
            raw_type = str(self.current_session.get("type") or "").lower()
            return raw_mode in ("engineer", "engineering") or raw_type == "engineering"
        return bool(getattr(self, "_engineering_mode_active", False))

    def _activate_engineering_mode(self):
        self._engineering_mode_active = True
        if getattr(self, "current_session", None) and isinstance(self.current_session, dict):
            self.current_session["mode"] = "assistant"
            self.current_session["type"] = "engineering"
            if hasattr(self, "_save_current_session"):
                self._save_current_session()
        logger.info("[NeonRoute] >>> РЕЖИМ 'ИНЖЕНЕР' АКТИВИРОВАН (Память LanceDB изолирована, ядро Эларии включено) <<<")

    def _deactivate_engineering_mode(self):
        self._engineering_mode_active = False
        if getattr(self, "current_session", None) and isinstance(self.current_session, dict):
            self.current_session["mode"] = "assistant"
            self.current_session.pop("type", None)
            if hasattr(self, "_save_current_session"):
                self._save_current_session()
        logger.info("[NeonRoute] >>> РЕЖИМ 'ДИАЛОГ' АКТИВИРОВАН (Стандартный чат с памятью) <<<")

    def _create_engineering_chat(self):
        try:
            new_sess = SessionManager.create_session(
                mode="assistant",
                title="🛠️ Инженерная сессия"
            )
            new_sess["type"] = "engineering"
            SessionManager.save_session(new_sess)
            self._engineering_mode_active = True
            self._switch_to_session(new_sess["id"])
            logger.info(f"[NeonRoute] Создана инженерная сессия: {new_sess['id']}")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[NeonRoute] Ошибка создания инженерной сессии: {e}", exc_info=True)

    def _is_engineering_session(self) -> bool:
        return self.is_engineer_mode_active()

    def _open_mode_model_settings_dialog(self):
        from ui.dialogs.engineer_settings_dialog import ModeModelSettingsDialog
        dlg = ModeModelSettingsDialog(parent=self)
        dlg.exec()

    def _open_engineer_settings_dialog(self):
        """Алиас для сохранения обратной совместимости."""
        self._open_mode_model_settings_dialog()

    def _switch_to_engineer_model(self, model_name: Optional[str] = None):
        eng_model = (model_name or self.app_config.get("engineer_model", "")).strip()
        if not eng_model:
            return

        def _worker():
            # 1. Выгрузка чекпоинта Forge через VRAMArbiter
            from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
            VRAMArbiter.get_instance()._release_forge_vram()

            # 2. Чистая загрузка назначенной модели инженера (ensure_model_loaded проверяет под _reload_lock)
            if hasattr(self, "lm_client") and hasattr(self.lm_client, "ensure_model_loaded"):
                from services.subagent_engineer import SubagentEngineer
                try:
                    self.lm_client.ensure_model_loaded(
                        preferred_model=eng_model,
                        context_length=getattr(SubagentEngineer, "ENGINEER_CONTEXT_LENGTH", 28672),
                        gpu_ratio=getattr(SubagentEngineer, "ENGINEER_GPU_RATIO", "1.0")
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Ошибка загрузки модели инженера: {e}")

        import threading
        threading.Thread(target=_worker, daemon=True).start()

    def _apply_engine_mode_styling(self, checked: bool):
        """Чистая отрисовка стилей кнопки инженера без сайд-эффектов."""
        if hasattr(self, "input_box") and self.input_box:
            self.input_box.set_engineer_mode(checked)
        if not hasattr(self, "btn_engine_mode") or not self.btn_engine_mode:
            return
        if checked:
            self.btn_engine_mode.setText("⚡ Инженер")
            self.btn_engine_mode.setToolTip("Режим «⚡ Инженер»: температура 0.15, точечные патчи и песочница")
            self.btn_engine_mode.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton#EngineModeButton {
                    border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
                    background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
                    color: #00F0FF;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                    padding: 4px 10px;
                    font-size: 12px;
                    font-weight: 600;
                }
                QPushButton#EngineModeButton:hover {
                    background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25);
                    border: 1px solid #38BDF8;
                    color: #FFFFFF;
                }
            """)
        else:
            self.btn_engine_mode.setText("💬 Диалог")
            self.btn_engine_mode.setToolTip("Режим «💬 Диалог»: свободное общение с памятью")
            self.btn_engine_mode.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton#EngineModeButton {
                    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
                    color: #94A3B8;
                    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
                    border-radius: 8px;
                    padding: 4px 10px;
                    font-size: 12px;
                    font-weight: 500;
                }
                QPushButton#EngineModeButton:hover {
                    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
                    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
                    color: #E2E8F0;
                }
            """)

    def _on_engine_mode_toggled(self, checked: bool):
        if getattr(self, "is_busy", False):
            if hasattr(self, "btn_engine_mode") and self.btn_engine_mode:
                self.btn_engine_mode.blockSignals(True)
                self.btn_engine_mode.setChecked(not checked)
                self.btn_engine_mode.blockSignals(False)
            if hasattr(self, "statusBar") and self.statusBar():
                self.statusBar().showMessage("Дождитесь завершения текущего ответа перед сменой режима.", 3500)
            return

        from services.mode_coordinator import AppMode
        target = AppMode.ENGINEER if checked else AppMode.ASSISTANT
        if hasattr(self, "mode_coordinator"):
            self.mode_coordinator.transition_to(target)
        else:
            self._apply_engine_mode_styling(checked)

        if checked:
            eng_model = getattr(self, "app_config", {}).get("engineer_model", "").strip()
            if eng_model:
                if hasattr(self, "lm_combo") and self.lm_combo:
                    self.lm_combo.blockSignals(True)
                    idx = self.lm_combo.findText(eng_model)
                    if idx >= 0:
                        self.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
                    else:
                        self.lm_combo.addItem(eng_model)
                        self.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(self.lm_combo.count() - 1)
                    self.lm_combo.blockSignals(False)
                self.active_lms_model = eng_model
                if getattr(self, "current_session", None) and isinstance(self.current_session, dict):
                    self.current_session["model_id"] = eng_model
                    if hasattr(self, "_save_current_session"):
                        self._save_current_session()


    def _execute_workspace_script(self, script_path: str):
        inspector = getattr(self, "workspace_inspector", None)
        if inspector:
            inspector.mark_running(f"Запуск {Path(script_path).name}...")
        ok, msg = WorkspaceLauncher.execute_file(script_path)
        self.statusBar().showMessage(msg, 3500)
        if inspector:
            if ok:
                inspector.mark_success()
            else:
                line_num = 0
                m_line = re.search(r'line\s+(\d+)', msg, re.IGNORECASE)
                if m_line:
                    try:
                        line_num = int(m_line.group(1))
                    except ValueError:
                        line_num = 0
                inspector.show_error(Path(script_path).name, line_num, msg)

    def _is_ephemeral_doc_request(self, user_query: str, has_vision: bool = False) -> bool:
        if has_vision or getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant") == "roleplay":
            return False
        lower_t = (user_query or "").lower().strip()
        if lower_t.startswith(('!art', '!арт', '!img', '!картинка')):
            return False
        from services.subagent_engineer import SubagentEngineer
        if SubagentEngineer._is_document_task(lower_t):
            return True
        return any(m in lower_t for m in DOC_TASK_MARKERS)

    def _dispatch_ephemeral_doc_worker(
        self,
        task_prompt: str,
        attached_files: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        image_path: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> bool:
        from ui.controllers.chat_flow_controller import _resolve_target_image
        if not image_path:
            has_image_attached = bool(attached_files and any(Path(f).suffix.lower() in ('.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.webp') for f in attached_files))
            has_mockup_keyword = any(k in task_prompt.lower() for k in ("макет", "скриншот", "картинк", "рисунок", "по фото", "образц"))
            if has_image_attached or has_mockup_keyword:
                image_path = _resolve_target_image(task_prompt)

        context_hint = ""
        if attached_files:
            context_hint = Path(attached_files[-1]).name
        elif self.current_session and self.current_session.get("messages"):
            for m in reversed(self.current_session["messages"]):
                fps = m.get("file_paths", [])
                if fps:
                    context_hint = Path(fps[-1]).name
                    break

        if image_path and not context_hint:
            context_hint = f"Макет: {Path(image_path).name}"

        active_sid = self.current_session.get("id") if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else None
        # Не меняем глобальное состояние SandboxManager в UI-потоке до старта воркера
        ws_dir = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir()
        target_path = None
        doc_name = ""
        action_name = ""
        is_analysis = False

        from services.subagent_engineer import SubagentEngineer
        is_doc_task = SubagentEngineer._is_document_task(task_prompt)
        lower_prompt = task_prompt.lower()

        # 1. Поиск вложенного изображения (макета)
        if image_path:
            action_name = f"🎨 Создание по макету «{Path(image_path).name}»"
            context_hint = f"Макет: {Path(image_path).name}"

        # 2. Приоритетная обработка генерации таблиц, отчетов и офисных документов (без перезаписи намерений)
        elif is_doc_task:
            m_file = re.search(r'\b([a-zA-Z0-9_\-а-яА-ЯёЁ]+\.(?:xlsx|docx|doc|pdf|csv))\b', task_prompt, re.I)
            if m_file:
                doc_name = m_file.group(1)
                if (ws_dir / doc_name).is_file():
                    target_path = ws_dir / doc_name

            target_exists = target_path is not None and target_path.is_file()
            is_modifying = any(k in lower_prompt for k in ("обнови", "добавь в", "измени", "исправь", "дополни", "переделай"))

            if target_exists and is_modifying:
                ext = target_path.suffix.lower()
                if ext in ('.xlsx', '.xls', '.csv'):
                    action_name = f"📊 Обновление таблицы «{doc_name}»"
                else:
                    action_name = f"📝 Модификация документа «{doc_name}»"
                context_hint = doc_name
            elif doc_name:
                ext = Path(doc_name).suffix.lower()
                if ext in ('.xlsx', '.xls', '.csv'):
                    action_name = f"📊 Создание таблицы «{doc_name}»"
                else:
                    action_name = f"📝 Создание документа «{doc_name}»"
                context_hint = doc_name
            else:
                if any(k in lower_prompt for k in (".xlsx", ".xls", "эксель", "excel", "таблиц", "смет", "ведомост")):
                    action_name = "📊 Создание таблицы (Excel)"
                elif any(k in lower_prompt for k in (".docx", ".doc", "ворд", "word", "приказ", "договор")):
                    action_name = "📝 Создание документа (Word)"
                elif any(k in lower_prompt for k in ("отчет", "отчёт")):
                    action_name = "📊 Формирование отчета"
                else:
                    action_name = "📄 Генерация документа"
                context_hint = ""
            is_analysis = False

        # 3. Анализ Traceback и ошибок рантайма (Zero-Guesswork)
        elif any(k in lower_prompt for k in ("traceback", "exception")) or (
            any(k in lower_prompt for k in ("error", "ошибк")) and re.search(r'File\s+["\'][^"\']+["\'],\s+line\s+\d+', task_prompt, re.I)
        ):
            m_tb = re.search(r'File\s+["\']([^"\']+\.(?:pyw?|py))["\'],\s+line\s+(\d+)', task_prompt, re.I)
            m_err = re.search(r'\b([A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*(?:Error|Exception|Warning))\b', task_prompt)
            err_type = m_err.group(1) if m_err else "Сбой"
            tb_file = Path(m_tb.group(1)).name if m_tb else ""
            if not tb_file:
                m_f = re.search(r'\b([a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.(?:pyw?|py|xlsx|docx))\b', task_prompt, re.I)
                tb_file = m_f.group(1) if m_f else ""

            if tb_file and (ws_dir / tb_file).is_file():
                target_path = ws_dir / tb_file
                doc_name = tb_file
                action_name = f"🐞 Отладка: {err_type} в {tb_file}"
                context_hint = tb_file
            else:
                action_name = f"🐞 Отладка: {err_type}"
                context_hint = tb_file or context_hint or ""

        # 4. Поиск файлов по содержимому (Discovery)
        elif any(dm in lower_prompt for dm in ("найди файл", "в каком файле", "поищи файл", "где упомина", "в каких документах")):
            action_name = "🔍 Поиск файлов по содержимому"
            context_hint = "РЕЖИМ ПОИСКА: найди файлы и выведи краткие совпадения."
            is_analysis = True

        # 5. Анализ существующего файла (Read-Only)
        elif any(av in lower_prompt for av in ("что делает", "проанализируй", "разбери код", "прочитай файл", "покажи содержимое")) and not any(cg in lower_prompt for cg in ("создай", "сделай", "сформируй", "напиши", "построй")):
            m_file = re.search(r'\b([a-zA-Z0-9_\-а-яА-ЯёЁ]+\.(?:xlsx|docx|doc|pdf|csv|py|pyw))\b', task_prompt, re.I)
            doc_name = m_file.group(1) if m_file else ""
            if doc_name and (ws_dir / doc_name).is_file():
                target_path = ws_dir / doc_name
            action_name = f"📖 Анализ данных «{doc_name or 'файла'}»"
            context_hint = f"{doc_name} (РЕЖИМ ЧТЕНИЯ)" if doc_name else ""
            is_analysis = True

        # 6. Стандартная работа с файлом или новый проект
        else:
            m_file = re.search(r'\b([a-zA-Z0-9_\-а-яА-ЯёЁ]+\.(?:xlsx|docx|doc|pdf|csv|py|pyw))\b', task_prompt, re.I)
            if m_file:
                doc_name = m_file.group(1)
                if (ws_dir / doc_name).is_file():
                    target_path = ws_dir / doc_name

            # Проверка существующих файлов в workspace строго по границам слова
            if not target_path and ws_dir.exists():
                for f in ws_dir.iterdir():
                    if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in ('.docx', '.xlsx', '.py', '.pyw'):
                        if re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(f.name) + r'\b', task_prompt, re.I) or \
                           (len(f.stem) >= 4 and re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(f.stem) + r'\b', task_prompt, re.I)):
                            target_path = f
                            doc_name = f.name
                            break

            target_exists = target_path is not None and target_path.is_file()

            if target_exists:
                ext = target_path.suffix.lower()
                if ext in ('.py', '.pyw'):
                    action_name = f"⚡ Доработка: «{doc_name}»"
                elif ext == '.xlsx':
                    action_name = f"📊 Обновление таблицы «{doc_name}»"
                else:
                    action_name = f"📝 Модификация «{doc_name}»"
                context_hint = doc_name
            elif doc_name:
                ext = Path(doc_name).suffix.lower()
                if ext in ('.py', '.pyw'):
                    action_name = f"🛠️ Создание скрипта «{doc_name}»"
                elif ext == '.xlsx':
                    action_name = f"📊 Создание таблицы «{doc_name}»"
                else:
                    action_name = f"📝 Создание документа «{doc_name}»"
                context_hint = doc_name
            else:
                first_sentence = re.split(r'[.!?\n]', task_prompt.strip())[0].strip()
                first_clean = re.sub(r'^[#*_\-\s]+', '', first_sentence).strip()
                if len(first_clean) > 35:
                    short_subj = first_clean[:35].rsplit(' ', 1)[0].rstrip(' ,:.-') + "..."
                else:
                    short_subj = first_clean.rstrip(' ,:.-')
                action_name = f"🛠️ Задача: «{short_subj or 'Новый проект'}»"
                context_hint = ""

        session_history = []
        if self.current_session and self.current_session.get("messages"):
            raw_msgs = self.current_session["messages"][-6:]
            for m in raw_msgs:
                role = "user" if m.get("is_user") or m.get("role") == "user" else "assistant"
                txt = str(m.get("text") or m.get("content") or "").strip()
                if txt.startswith(("<<TOOL:", "[Tool", "[Системный", "[код]", "РЕКОМЕНДАЦИИ")):
                    continue
                txt_clean = re.sub(r'```[\s\S]*?```', '', txt).strip()
                if len(txt_clean) > 250:
                    txt_clean = txt_clean[:250] + "..."
                if txt_clean and txt_clean != task_prompt.strip():
                    session_history.append({"role": role, "content": txt_clean})

        def _worker_fn(
            prompt: str,
            hint: str,
            is_analysis: bool = False,
            image_path: Optional[str] = None,
            session_history: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]] = None,
            session_id: Optional[str] = None
        ) -> dict:
            from services.sandbox_manager import SandboxManager
            target_sid = session_id or (self.current_session.get("id") if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else None)
            try:
                on_msg_cb = lambda *args: getattr(self, "_sig_engineer_plan_card", None) and self._sig_engineer_plan_card.emit(args[-1])
                on_status_cb = lambda st, fn, ln, em: getattr(self, "_sig_inspector_status", None) and self._sig_inspector_status.emit(st, fn, ln, em)
                with SandboxManager.session_scope(target_sid):
                    sm = SessionManager(lm_client=getattr(self, "lm_client", None))
                    return sm.run_ephemeral_engineer_worker(
                        task_prompt=prompt,
                        context_hint=hint,
                        is_analysis=is_analysis,
                        image_path=image_path,
                        session_history=session_history,
                        on_message_callback=on_msg_cb,
                        on_status_callback=on_status_cb,
                        inspector=getattr(self, "workspace_inspector", None)
                    )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error in engineer worker: {e}", exc_info=True)
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "artifact_path": None,
                    "file_name": "",
                    "stdout": "",
                    "stderr": str(e),
                    "summary": f"Исключение при выполнении задачи: {e}"
                }

        abort_cb = getattr(self.lm_client, "abort", None) if hasattr(self, "lm_client") and self.lm_client else None

        task = InferenceTask(
            name=action_name,
            task_type="file",
            func=_worker_fn,
            kwargs={
                "prompt": task_prompt,
                "hint": context_hint,
                "is_analysis": is_analysis,
                "image_path": image_path,
                "session_history": session_history,
                "session_id": active_sid
            },
            abort_fn=abort_cb,
            metadata={
                "is_ephemeral_doc": True,
                "is_analysis": is_analysis,
                "bubble": None,
                "task_prompt": task_prompt,
                "context_hint": context_hint,
                "image_path": image_path
            }
        )
        if hasattr(self, "workspace_inspector") and self.workspace_inspector:
            self.workspace_inspector.mark_running()
        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)
        self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Элария выполняет: {action_name}...", 4000)
        return True

    def _handle_tool_call_flow(self, text: str):
        from ui.workers.tool_execution_worker import ToolExecutionWorker
        self._tool_executed_this_turn = True
        self._tool_loop_count = getattr(self, "_tool_loop_count", 0) + 1
        if self._tool_loop_count > 5:
            logger.warning("Tool loop recursion limit (5) reached.")
            self._tool_loop_count = 0
            return

        tool_calls = ToolEngine.parse_tool_calls(text)
        if not tool_calls:
            return

        sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
        if getattr(self, "_turn_bubble", None) is None:
            self._turn_bubble = self._append_message(sender_name, "", is_user=False)
        else:
            try:
                active_sid = self.current_session.get("id") if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else None
                bubble_sid = getattr(self._turn_bubble, "session_id", None)
                if bubble_sid and active_sid and bubble_sid != active_sid:
                    logger.info("[EngineerController] Смена сессии: подавление обновления виджета фоновой задачи")
                    return
                self._turn_bubble.set_text("")
            except RuntimeError:
                self._turn_bubble = self._append_message(sender_name, "", is_user=False)

        primary_file = None
        for call in tool_calls:
            call_name = getattr(call, "name", "").lower()
            params = getattr(call, "params", {})
            if call_name in ("write_file", "patch_file"):
                raw_fn = params.get("filename") or params.get("path") or params.get("file") or "script.py"
                clean_fn = SandboxManager.clean_workspace_filename(raw_fn)
                primary_file = clean_fn
                f_path = SandboxManager.get_workspace_dir() / clean_fn
                active_sid = self.current_session.get("id") if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else None
                bubble_sid = getattr(self._turn_bubble, "session_id", None)
                if bubble_sid and active_sid and bubble_sid != active_sid:
                    logger.info("[EngineerController] Смена сессии: подавление обновления виджета фоновой задачи")
                    return
                self._turn_bubble.add_workspace_file_card(f_path, on_run=self._execute_workspace_script)
                self._update_message_attachment(self._turn_bubble, f_path)

        curr_sid = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        self._tool_worker = ToolExecutionWorker(
            tool_calls=tool_calls,
            target_widget=self._turn_bubble,
            session_id=curr_sid
        )
        self._tool_worker.finished.connect(self._on_tool_execution_finished)
        self._tool_worker.start()

    def _on_tool_execution_finished(self, data: Any):
        if not data:
            logger.warning("[EngineerController] Получен пустой ответ от ToolExecutionWorker")
            if hasattr(self, "_force_reset_busy_state"):
                self._force_reset_busy_state()
            return

        # Универсальное извлечение статуса успеха и параметров
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            success = data.get("overall_success", data.get("success", False))
            results = data.get("results", [])
            error_msg = data.get("error", "")
            tool_name = data.get("tool_name", "")
            artifacts = data.get("artifacts", [])
        else:
            success = getattr(data, "success", getattr(data, "overall_success", False))
            results = getattr(data, "results", [])
            error_msg = getattr(data, "error", "")
            tool_name = getattr(data, "tool_name", "")
            artifacts = getattr(data, "artifacts", [])

        try:
            self._tool_executed_this_turn = True
            if hasattr(self, "_remove_typing_loader"):
                self._remove_typing_loader()

            # Если передан единичный результат через ToolResult без списка results
            if not results:
                raw_out = getattr(data, "output", "") if not isinstance(data, dict) else data.get("result", "")
                results = [{
                    "tool_name": tool_name,
                    "result": error_msg if not success and error_msg else raw_out,
                    "success": success
                }]

            active_sid = self.current_session.get("id") if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else None
            bubble_sid = getattr(self._turn_bubble, "session_id", None)
            if bubble_sid and active_sid and bubble_sid != active_sid:
                logger.info("[EngineerController] Смена сессии: подавление обновления виджета фоновой задачи")
                return

            # Отображение карточек файлов для артефактов при их наличии
            if artifacts:
                for art in artifacts:
                    art_path = Path(art) if not isinstance(art, Path) else art
                    if art_path.exists() and hasattr(self, "_turn_bubble") and self._turn_bubble is not None:
                        if hasattr(self._turn_bubble, "add_workspace_file_card"):
                            self._turn_bubble.add_workspace_file_card(art_path, on_run=self._execute_workspace_script)
                        if hasattr(self, "_update_message_attachment"):
                            self._update_message_attachment(self._turn_bubble, art_path)

            single_artifact = getattr(data, "artifact_path", None) if not isinstance(data, dict) else data.get("artifact_path")
            if single_artifact:
                single_path = Path(single_artifact) if not isinstance(single_artifact, Path) else single_artifact
                if single_path.exists() and hasattr(self, "_turn_bubble") and self._turn_bubble is not None:
                    if hasattr(self._turn_bubble, "add_workspace_file_card"):
                        self._turn_bubble.add_workspace_file_card(single_path, on_run=self._execute_workspace_script)
                    if hasattr(self, "_update_message_attachment"):
                        self._update_message_attachment(self._turn_bubble, single_path)

            obs_parts = []
            for item in results:
                if isinstance(item, dict):
                    t_name = item.get("tool_name", "")
                    t_res = item.get("result", item.get("output", ""))
                else:
                    t_name = getattr(item, "tool_name", "")
                    t_res = getattr(item, "output", getattr(item, "result", ""))
                obs_parts.append(f"[{t_name}]: {str(t_res)}")

            obs_payload = "[Tool Observation:\n" + "\n\n".join(obs_parts) + "\n]\n\n[Подтверди пользователю результат выполненных действий.]"
            if hasattr(self, "chat_history") and isinstance(self.chat_history, list):
                self.chat_history.append({"role": "user", "content": obs_payload})

            self._is_post_tool_synthesis = True
            self._synthesis_first_chunk = True
            if hasattr(self, "_enqueue_llm_task"):
                self._enqueue_llm_task(is_roleplay=False)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[EngineerController] Ошибка при обработке результатов инструмента: {e}", exc_info=True)
        finally:
            if hasattr(self, "_force_reset_busy_state"):
                self._force_reset_busy_state()

    def _display_engineer_plan_card(self, card_text: str):
        if getattr(self, "typing_loader", None) is not None:
            self._remove_typing_loader()
        avatar = self._get_current_avatar_path() if hasattr(self, "_get_current_avatar_path") else None
        bubble = self._append_message("Элария", card_text, is_user=False, avatar_path=avatar)
        if hasattr(self, "_active_tasks"):
            for t in self._active_tasks.values():
                if t.metadata and t.metadata.get("is_ephemeral_doc"):
                    t.metadata["bubble"] = bubble
                    break
        if hasattr(self, "_sync_turn"):
            self._sync_turn(role="assistant", content=card_text, replace_last=False)
        self._scroll_to_bottom()

    def _handle_engineer_task_finished(self, task: InferenceTask, result: Any):
        inspector = getattr(self, "workspace_inspector", None)
        bubble = task.metadata.get("bubble")
        res = result if isinstance(result, dict) else {}
        success = bool(res.get("success", False))
        artifact_path = res.get("artifact_path")
        file_name = res.get("file_name", "")
        stderr = res.get("stderr", "")
        summary = res.get("summary", "")
        is_analysis = bool(task.metadata.get("is_analysis", False) or res.get("is_analysis", False))

        if inspector:
            if success:
                inspector.mark_success()
            else:
                err_text = stderr or summary or "Скрипт завершился с ошибкой"
                line_num = 0
                m_line = re.search(r'line\s+(\d+)', err_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if m_line:
                    try:
                        line_num = int(m_line.group(1))
                    except ValueError:
                        line_num = 0
                inspector.show_error(file_name, line_num, err_text)

        if artifact_path:
            artifact_path = Path(artifact_path)
            file_name = file_name or artifact_path.name
            fin_text = f"✅ Файл `{file_name}` успешно сохранён и готов к работе."
            if bubble is not None:
                try:
                    active_sid = self.current_session.get("id") if getattr(self, "current_session", None) else None
                    bubble_sid = getattr(bubble, "session_id", None)
                    if bubble_sid and active_sid and bubble_sid != active_sid:
                        logger.info("[EngineerController] Смена сессии: подавление обновления виджета фоновой задачи")
                        return
                    if hasattr(bubble, "add_workspace_file_card"):
                        bubble.add_workspace_file_card(artifact_path, on_run=self._execute_workspace_script)
                    if hasattr(self, "_update_message_attachment"):
                        self._update_message_attachment(bubble, artifact_path)
                    if res.get("stdout") and str(res["stdout"]).strip() and hasattr(bubble, "add_console_spoiler"):
                        bubble.add_console_spoiler(title=f"Консоль: {file_name}", output=res["stdout"], is_error=False)
                    if hasattr(bubble, "set_text"):
                        bubble.set_text(fin_text)
                except RuntimeError:
                    bubble = None
            if bubble is None:
                avatar = self._get_current_avatar_path() if hasattr(self, "_get_current_avatar_path") else None
                bubble = self._append_message("Элария", fin_text, is_user=False, avatar_path=avatar)
                if hasattr(bubble, "add_workspace_file_card"):
                    bubble.add_workspace_file_card(artifact_path, on_run=self._execute_workspace_script)
                if hasattr(self, "_update_message_attachment"):
                    self._update_message_attachment(bubble, artifact_path)
                if res.get("stdout") and str(res["stdout"]).strip() and hasattr(bubble, "add_console_spoiler"):
                    bubble.add_console_spoiler(title=f"Консоль: {file_name}", output=res["stdout"], is_error=False)
            self._sync_turn(role="assistant", content=fin_text, replace_last=True)
        elif is_analysis:
            if not success and (stderr or "Ошибка" in summary):
                err_output = res.get("stderr") or stderr or ""
                err_msg = summary or err_output or "Неизвестная ошибка"
                fin_text = f"⚠️ Ошибка выполнения: {err_msg}"
                spoiler_title = f"Консоль: {file_name}" if file_name else "Ошибка анализа"
                avatar = self._get_current_avatar_path() if hasattr(self, "_get_current_avatar_path") else None
                b = self._append_message("Элария", fin_text, is_user=False, avatar_path=avatar)
                if err_output and hasattr(b, "add_console_spoiler"):
                    b.add_console_spoiler(title=spoiler_title, output=err_output, is_error=True)
                self._sync_turn(role="assistant", content=fin_text, replace_last=True)
            else:
                avatar = self._get_current_avatar_path() if hasattr(self, "_get_current_avatar_path") else None
                self._append_message("Элария", summary, is_user=False, avatar_path=avatar)
                self._sync_turn(role="assistant", content=summary, replace_last=True)
        else:
            err_output = res.get("stderr") or stderr or ""
            fin_text = f"⚠️ Не удалось выполнить задачу: {summary or err_output}"
            avatar = self._get_current_avatar_path() if hasattr(self, "_get_current_avatar_path") else None
            self._append_message("Элария", fin_text, is_user=False, avatar_path=avatar)
            self._sync_turn(role="assistant", content=fin_text, replace_last=True)

        self._scroll_to_bottom()

"""

Handles process lifecycles (LM Studio, SD WebUI Forge), health monitoring,

    @pyqtSlot(str, str)
    def _on_server_state_changed(self, old_state: str, new_state: str):
        logger.info(f"[ServerState] {old_state} -> {new_state}")
        norm = (new_state or "").lower()
        if norm == "ready":
            self.pill_lm.set_status(True, "llama-server Online")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setText("⚡ Стоп LLM")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setToolTip("Остановить локальный сервер llama-server.exe (порт 1234)")
        elif norm in ("starting", "restoring", "switching_model"):
            self.pill_lm.set_status(False, f"Запуск ({new_state})...")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setText("⚡ Стоп LLM")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setToolTip("Локальный сервер llama-server.exe запускается...")
        elif norm in ("stopped", "error"):
            self.pill_lm.set_status(False, "Offline")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setText("⚡ Старт LLM")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setToolTip("Запустить / остановить локальный сервер llama-server.exe (порт 1234)")
        elif norm == "evicted_for_forge":
            self.pill_lm.set_status(False, "Выгружен для Forge")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setText("⚡ Старт LLM")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setToolTip("LLM выгружен из VRAM для работы Forge. Нажмите для ручного возврата.")

    def _toggle_forge_server(self):
        if self.process_manager.is_forge_running() or self.pill_forge.is_online:
            self._forge_launching = False
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Остановка SD WebUI Forge и освобождение VRAM...")
            self.process_manager.stop_forge_async()
            self.btn_forge_toggle.setText("▶ Запустить Forge")
        else:
            self._forge_launching = True
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Запуск SD WebUI Forge (C:\\neyroGPD\\forge_launcher.bat)...")
            self.btn_forge_toggle.setText("⏳ Запуск Forge... (ожидание 7860)")
            self.btn_forge_toggle.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton {
                    background-color: #2D2311;
                    color: #FBBF24;
                    border: 1px solid #F59E0B;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    padding: 2px 9px;
                    font-size: 11px;
                    font-weight: bold;
                }
                QPushButton:hover {
                    background-color: #F59E0B;
                    color: #050B14;
                }
            """)
            self.process_manager.start_forge_async()

    def _toggle_lms_server(self):
        if self.process_manager.is_lm_studio_running() or self.pill_lm.is_online:
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Остановка LM Studio сервера...")
            if hasattr(self, "_cancel_lms_reload") and callable(self._cancel_lms_reload):
                self._cancel_lms_reload()
            if hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue:
                self.task_queue.abort_current()
                if hasattr(self.task_queue, "clear_queue") and callable(self.task_queue.clear_queue):
                    self.task_queue.clear_queue()
            if hasattr(self, "lm_client") and self.lm_client:
                self.lm_client.abort()
            self.process_manager.stop_lm_studio_async()
        else:
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Запуск LM Studio сервера (lms server start)...")
            self.process_manager.start_lm_studio_async()

    def _on_process_action_completed(self, action_name: str, success: bool, message: str):
        if "lms_load" in action_name:
            if not self.is_busy:
                self.btn_send.setEnabled(True)
            if success:
                # Синхронизация состояния синглтона LMStudioClient для исключения повторного сброса
                if hasattr(self, "lm_client") and self.lm_client and getattr(self, "active_lms_model", ""):
                    self.lm_client._last_loaded_model_id = self.active_lms_model
                    self.lm_client._is_model_unloaded = False
                    is_rp = (getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant") == "roleplay")
                    is_eng = getattr(self, "is_engineer_mode_active", lambda: False)()
                    m_key = "engineer" if is_eng else ("roleplay" if is_rp else "assistant")
                    def_ctx = 28672 if is_eng else (24576 if is_rp else 14336)
                    self.lm_client._current_loaded_ctx = self.app_config.get(f"context_length_{m_key}", def_ctx)
                self.statusBar().showMessage(f"✅ Модель '{self.active_lms_model}' готова к работе.", 5000)
            else:
                self.statusBar().showMessage(f"⚠️ {message}", 6000)
        elif action_name == "lms_load_fallback":
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"⚠️ {message}", 7000)
            self._append_message("Система", f"⚠️ **Внимание:** {message}", is_user=False, is_error=True)
            return
        elif action_name == "lms_stop":
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)
            self.pill_lm.set_status(False, "LM Studio Offline")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setText("⚡ Старт LLM")
            self.btn_lms_toggle.setStyleSheet("""
                QPushButton {
                    background-color: #111A28;
                    color: #00F0FF;
                    border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
                    border-radius: 4px;
                    padding: 2px 7px;
                    font-size: 11px;
                    font-weight: bold;
                }
                QPushButton:hover {
                    background-color: #00F0FF;
                    color: #050B14;
                }
            """)
        elif action_name == "lms_start" and success:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)
            QTimer.singleShot(1500, self._refresh_models)
        elif "lms" in action_name and success:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)
        elif "forge" in action_name:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)
            if not success:
                self._forge_launching = False
            else:
                QTimer.singleShot(3000, self._refresh_forge_models)
        else:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(message, 5000)

    def _on_hardware_stats(self, stats: dict):
        v_used = stats.get("vram_used_mb", 0)
        v_total = stats.get("vram_total_mb", 8192)
        v_pct = stats.get("vram_percent", 0.0)
        temp = stats.get("gpu_temp_c")
        temp_str = f" • {temp}°C" if temp else ""

        v_free = max(0, v_total - v_used)
        color = "#00FF66" if v_free >= 1200 else ("#FFE600" if v_free >= EMERGENCY_VRAM_THRESHOLD_MB else "#FF007F")
        self.lbl_vram.setText(f"VRAM: {v_used} / {v_total} MB ({v_pct}%){temp_str}")
        self.lbl_vram.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 15px;")

        r_used = stats.get("ram_used_gb", 0.0)
        r_total = stats.get("ram_total_gb", 16.0)
        r_pct = stats.get("ram_percent", 0.0)
        self.lbl_ram.setText(f"RAM: {r_used} / {r_total} GB ({r_pct}%)")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Обнаружение, выбор и настройка моделей
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _refresh_models(self):
        if getattr(self, "_discovery_worker", None) and self._discovery_worker.isRunning():
            return
        if hasattr(self, "btn_refresh_models") and self.btn_refresh_models:
            self.btn_refresh_models.setEnabled(False)
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Поиск доступных моделей в фоне...", 2000)
        self._discovery_worker = ModelDiscoveryWorker(self.process_manager, self.lm_client, self.forge_client)
        self._discovery_worker.lms_models_ready.connect(self._on_lms_models_discovered)
        self._discovery_worker.forge_models_ready.connect(self._on_forge_models_discovered)
        self._discovery_worker.start()

    def _on_lms_models_discovered(self, all_models: list):
        if hasattr(self, "btn_refresh_models") and self.btn_refresh_models:
            self.btn_refresh_models.setEnabled(True)
        self._is_refreshing_models = True
        try:
            if hasattr(self, "lm_combo") and self.lm_combo:
                current_choice = self.lm_combo.currentText().strip()
                self.lm_combo.blockSignals(True)
                self.lm_combo.clear()
                if all_models:
                    self.lm_combo.addItems(all_models)
                    target = current_choice or getattr(self, "active_lms_model", "") or all_models[0]
                    idx = self.lm_combo.findText(target)
                    if idx >= 0:
                        self.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
                    else:
                        self.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)
                else:
                    self.lm_combo.addItem("default (авто)")
                self.lm_combo.blockSignals(False)
            if all_models:
                self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Список моделей LM Studio обновлен ({len(all_models)} доступно).", 2500)
        finally:
            self._is_refreshing_models = False
            if hasattr(self, "models_refreshed"):
                self.models_refreshed.emit()

    def _on_lms_model_activated(self, index: int):
        if self._is_refreshing_models:
            return
        if not (hasattr(self, "lm_combo") and self.lm_combo):
            return
        model_name = self.lm_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not model_name or model_name.startswith("default"):
            return

        self.active_lms_model = model_name
        self.app_config["active_model"] = model_name
        ConfigManager.save_config(self.app_config)

        if self.current_session and not self.current_session.get("is_model_locked", False):
            self.current_session["model_id"] = model_name
            self._save_current_session()

        self.btn_send.setEnabled(False)
        self.statusBar().showMessage(f"⏳ Загрузка модели '{model_name}' в память...")
        device_mode = self.app_config.get("compute_device_mode", "Auto")
        self.process_manager.load_lms_model_async(model_name, device_mode=device_mode)

    def _refresh_forge_models(self):
        if getattr(self, "_discovery_worker", None) and self._discovery_worker.isRunning():
            return
        self._discovery_worker = ModelDiscoveryWorker(self.process_manager, self.lm_client, self.forge_client)
        self._discovery_worker.lms_models_ready.connect(self._on_lms_models_discovered)
        self._discovery_worker.forge_models_ready.connect(self._on_forge_models_discovered)
        self._discovery_worker.start()

    def _on_forge_model_changed(self, text: str):
        self.selected_forge_checkpoint = text
        if text.startswith("✨"):
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Режим генерации: ✨ Арт-директор (Авто)", 3000)
        else:
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Модель для генерации зафиксирована: {text}", 4000)

    def _on_forge_models_discovered(self, items: list):
        combined = ["✨ Арт-директор (Авто)"]
        profiles = []
        if hasattr(self, "art_director") and self.art_director and hasattr(self.art_director, "router") and self.art_director.router:
            profiles = getattr(self.art_director.router, "profiles", [])
        if not profiles:
            try:
                from services.art_director_config import load_art_director_models
                profiles = load_art_director_models()
            except Exception:
                profiles = []

        for prof in profiles:
            if isinstance(prof, dict) and prof.get("active", True) and prof.get("name"):
                name = prof["name"]
                if name not in combined:
                    combined.append(name)

        self.available_forge_checkpoints = combined
        if hasattr(self, "forge_combo"):
            cur = self.forge_combo.currentText()
            self.forge_combo.blockSignals(True)
            self.forge_combo.clear()
            self.forge_combo.addItems(combined)
            idx = self.forge_combo.findText(cur)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.forge_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            self.forge_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _select_forge_model_dialog(self):
        items = list(getattr(self, "available_forge_checkpoints", ["✨ Арт-директор (Авто)"]))
        if "✨ Арт-директор (Авто)" not in items:
            items.insert(0, "✨ Арт-директор (Авто)")

        current_idx = 0
        if hasattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint") and self.selected_forge_checkpoint in items:
            current_idx = items.index(self.selected_forge_checkpoint)

        chosen, ok = QInputDialog.getItem(
            self,
            "Выбор чекпоинта SD WebUI Forge",
            "Выберите модель Forge (или оставьте Авто для Арт-директора):",
            items,
            current_idx,
            False
        )
        if ok and chosen:
            self.selected_forge_checkpoint = chosen
            if hasattr(self, "forge_combo"):
                self.forge_combo.blockSignals(True)
                idx = self.forge_combo.findText(chosen)
                if idx >= 0:
                    self.forge_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
                self.forge_combo.blockSignals(False)
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Выбрана модель Forge: {chosen}", 5000)


    def _open_models_manager_dialog(self):
        dialog = ModelsManagerDialog(self.forge_client, self)
        if hasattr(dialog, "models_updated"):
            dialog.models_updated.connect(self._refresh_forge_models)
        dialog.exec()
        self.art_director.reload_models()
        self._refresh_forge_models()
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Конфигурация моделей Арт-директора обновлена.", 4000)

    def _open_llm_engine_settings_dialog(self):

        from ui.dialogs.llm_engine_settings_dialog import LLMEngineSettingsDialog
        dlg = LLMEngineSettingsDialog(self)
        dlg.exec()

    def _perform_hardware_kv_autotune(self):
        """
        Однократный аппаратный автотюн KV-кэша и Flash Attention при первом старте.
        """
        try:
            from services.layer_budgeter import LayerBudgeter
            from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager
            from qfluentwidgets import InfoBar

            cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
            if cfg.get("hardware_autotune_done", False):
                return

            profile = LayerBudgeter.detect_hardware_kv_profile()
            cfg["kv_cache_type"] = profile.get("recommended_kv", "q8_0")
            cfg["flash_attention_enabled"] = profile.get("recommended_fa", True)
            cfg["hardware_autotune_done"] = True
            ConfigManager.save_config(cfg)
            self.app_config = cfg

            if profile.get("supported", False):
                InfoBar.success(
                    title="Аппаратный автотюн GPU",
                    content=f"Обнаружена {profile['gpu_name']} (CC {profile['compute_cap']}). Активирован скоростной буфер Q8_0 и Flash Attention (экономия 50% VRAM).",
                    duration=6000,
                    parent=self
                )
            else:
                InfoBar.info(
                    title="Аппаратный автотюн GPU",
                    content=f"Видеокарта {profile['gpu_name']} не поддерживает Flash Attention. Выставлен стандартный режим FP16.",
                    duration=6000,
                    parent=self
                )
            logger.info(f"[HardwareEngine] Аппаратный автотюн выполнен: {profile}")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[HardwareEngine] Ошибка выполнения аппаратного автотюна: {e}")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Генерация арта и жонглинг 8GB VRAM
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_action_art_clicked(self):
        try:
            target_widget = None
            for i in reversed(range(self.chat_layout.count())):
                item = self.chat_layout.itemAt(i)
                w = item.widget() if item else None
                if w and isinstance(w, ChatMessageWidget) and not getattr(w, "is_user", True):
                    target_widget = w
                    break
            if target_widget:
                v_intent = getattr(target_widget, "visual_intent", None)
                target_text = getattr(target_widget, "translated_text", None) or getattr(target_widget, "raw_text", "")
                if v_intent:
                    self._on_scene_art_requested(widget=target_widget, visual_intent=v_intent)
                elif target_text:
                    self._on_scene_art_requested(text=target_text, widget=target_widget)
                else:
                    os.startfile(str(OUTPUTS_DIR))
            else:
                os.startfile(str(OUTPUTS_DIR))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error on art action: {e}")

    def _on_forge_generation_progress(self, stage_name: str, percent: int):
        if hasattr(self, "header_controller"):
            self.header_controller.set_forge_progress(stage_name, percent)


    def _on_scene_art_requested(
        self,
        text: Optional[str] = None,
        widget: Optional[ChatMessageWidget] = None,
        preferred_style: Optional[str] = None,
        character_name: Optional[str] = None,
        visual_intent: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    ):
        if not self.pill_forge.is_online:
            if widget and hasattr(widget, "set_scene_art_busy"):
                widget.set_scene_art_busy(False)
            logger.warning("[SD Forge] Отклонен запрос иллюстрации сцены: сервер Forge офлайн (порт 7860 недоступен).")
            user_msg = (
                "⚠️ **SD WebUI Forge не запущен или еще загружается.**\n\n"
                "Запустите Forge через кнопку в нижней панели и дождитесь зеленого индикатора."
            )
            sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
            self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("SD WebUI Forge недоступен. Запустите Forge в нижней панели.", 6000)
            return

        self._cancel_lms_reload()
        if hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue:
            self.task_queue.abort_tasks_by_type("memory")

        v_intent = visual_intent or (getattr(widget, "visual_intent", None) if widget is not None else None)

        norm_combo = normalize_model_choice(getattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint", None))
        norm_pref = normalize_model_choice(preferred_style)
        active_pref_style = norm_combo or norm_pref

        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        sess_images_dir = SessionManager.get_session_images_dir(sess_id) if sess_id else None

        captured_mode = self.get_effective_mode() if hasattr(self, "get_effective_mode") else getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant")
        captured_char = self.active_character if (captured_mode == "roleplay" and hasattr(self, "active_character")) else None
        active_char_name = character_name
        if not active_char_name and captured_mode == "roleplay" and captured_char:
            active_char_name = getattr(captured_char, "name", None)

        raw_scene_text = (text or "").strip()
        needs_llm_gen = bool((captured_mode in ("roleplay", "rp") and not v_intent) or (not v_intent and re.search(r"[а-яА-ЯёЁ]", raw_scene_text)))

        def _scene_art_pipeline(v_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, scene_text: Optional[str] = None, ckpt: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            self._cancel_lms_reload()
            available_models = self.forge_client.get_models()
            if captured_mode in ("roleplay", "rp") and not v_payload:
                english_prompt = self._generate_ephemeral_rp_art_prompt(
                    sess_id=sess_id,
                    last_assistant_message=scene_text or "",
                    target_model_id=ckpt or "realistic"
                )
                from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
                VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()
                plan = self.art_director.plan_generation(
                    raw_prompt=english_prompt,
                    preferred_style=ckpt,
                    available_models=available_models,
                    session_id=sess_id,
                    mode=captured_mode
                )
            elif v_payload:
                plan = self.art_director.plan_from_visual_intent(
                    visual_intent=v_payload,
                    preferred_style=ckpt,
                    available_models=available_models,
                    character_name=active_char_name,
                    character=None,
                    session_id=sess_id,
                    mode=captured_mode
                )
            else:
                plan = self.art_director.plan_generation(
                    raw_prompt=scene_text or "",
                    preferred_style=ckpt,
                    lm_client=self.lm_client,
                    character=None,
                    available_models=available_models,
                    character_name=active_char_name,
                    session_id=sess_id,
                    mode=captured_mode
                )
                if plan.is_ambiguous:
                    return {"image_path": None, "plan": plan, "checkpoint": None, "is_ambiguous": True}
                from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
                VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()

            logger.info(f"Scene Art selected checkpoint: '{plan.target_checkpoint}'")

            kwargs = plan.to_forge_kwargs(output_dir=sess_images_dir, session_id=sess_id)
            img_path = None
            try:
                img_path = self.forge_client.text_to_image(**kwargs)
            finally:
                try:
                    self.forge_client.unload_checkpoint()
                    self.forge_client.free_vram()
                except Exception as _e_unl:
                    logger.debug(f"[ForgeClient] Ошибка выгрузки чекпоинта: {_e_unl}")
                self._reload_active_lms_model_async(delay=1.2)
            return {"image_path": img_path, "plan": plan, "checkpoint": plan.target_checkpoint}

        if widget and hasattr(widget, "set_scene_art_busy"):
            widget.set_scene_art_busy(True, "⏳ Генерация...")

        task = InferenceTask(
            name="🎨 Иллюстрация сцены",
            task_type="scene_art",
            func=_scene_art_pipeline,
            kwargs={
                "v_payload": v_intent,
                "scene_text": raw_scene_text,
                "ckpt": active_pref_style
            },
            abort_fn=self.forge_client.interrupt,
            metadata={
                "is_scene_art": True,
                "session_id": sess_id,
                "target_widget": widget,
                "preferred_style": active_pref_style,
                "visual_intent": v_intent,
                "needs_llm_prompt_gen": needs_llm_gen
            }
        )
        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _enqueue_image_task(self, prompt: str):
        if not self.pill_forge.is_online:
            user_msg = (
                "⚠️ **SD WebUI Forge не запущен или еще загружается.**\n\n"
                "Запустите Forge через кнопку в нижней панели и дождитесь зеленого индикатора."
            )
            sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
            self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Forge офлайн. Запустите сервер в нижней панели.", 6000)
            return

        checkpoint = normalize_model_choice(getattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint", None))
        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        sess_images_dir = SessionManager.get_session_images_dir(sess_id) if sess_id else None

        captured_mode = self.get_effective_mode() if hasattr(self, "get_effective_mode") else getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant")
        captured_char = self.active_character if (captured_mode == "roleplay" and hasattr(self, "active_character")) else None
        active_char_name = None
        if captured_mode == "roleplay" and captured_char:
            active_char_name = getattr(captured_char, "name", None)

        def _image_worker(raw_prompt: str, ckpt: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            self._cancel_lms_reload()
            available_models = self.forge_client.get_models()
            plan = self.art_director.plan_generation(
                raw_prompt=raw_prompt,
                preferred_style=ckpt,
                lm_client=self.lm_client,
                character=captured_char if captured_mode == "roleplay" else None,
                available_models=available_models,
                character_name=active_char_name,
                session_id=sess_id,
                mode=captured_mode
            )
            if plan.is_ambiguous:
                return {"image_path": None, "plan": plan, "checkpoint": None, "is_ambiguous": True}

            from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
            VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()

            logger.info(
                f"Art Director Plan: style={plan.style}, target='{plan.model_title}', "
                f"size={plan.width}x{plan.height}, prompt='{plan.positive_prompt[:60]}...'"
            )

            kwargs = plan.to_forge_kwargs(output_dir=sess_images_dir, session_id=sess_id)
            img_path = self.forge_client.text_to_image(**kwargs)

            # text_to_image() guarantees cleanup in finally. Idempotent guard prevents duplicate requests.
            try:
                self.forge_client.unload_checkpoint()
                self.forge_client.free_vram()
            except Exception as _e_unl:
                logger.debug(f"[ForgeClient] Ошибка выгрузки чекпоинта: {_e_unl}")

            # Быстрый тихий возврат активной модели режима в VRAM
            self._reload_active_lms_model_async(delay=1.2)
            return {
                "image_path": img_path,
                "plan": plan,
                "checkpoint": plan.target_checkpoint
            }

        has_cyrillic = bool(re.search(r"[а-яА-ЯёЁ]", prompt))
        task = InferenceTask(
            name=f"🎨 Арт: {prompt[:25]}...",
            task_type="image",
            func=_image_worker,
            kwargs={"raw_prompt": prompt, "ckpt": checkpoint},
            abort_fn=self.forge_client.interrupt,
            metadata={"prompt": prompt, "needs_llm_prompt_gen": has_cyrillic}
        )
        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)
