    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Координация таймеров возврата LLM
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _reload_active_lms_model_async(self, delay: float = 3.0):
        self._sig_reload_lms.emit(delay)

    def _cancel_lms_reload(self):
        self._sig_cancel_lms.emit()

    @pyqtSlot(float)
    def _do_reload_active_lms_timer(self, delay: float):
        self._do_cancel_lms_reload()

        has_pending_art = self.task_queue.has_pending_tasks(("scene_art", "image", "scene_background")) if hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue else False
        if has_pending_art:
            logger.info("[MainWindow] Возврат LLM отменён: в очереди ожидают задачи Forge.")
            return

        self._lms_reload_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._lms_reload_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._lms_reload_timer.timeout.connect(self._execute_lms_reload)
        self._lms_reload_timer.start(int(delay * 1000))

    @pyqtSlot()
    def _do_cancel_lms_reload(self):
        if hasattr(self, "_lms_reload_timer") and self._lms_reload_timer and self._lms_reload_timer.isActive():
            self._lms_reload_timer.stop()
            logger.info("[MainWindow] Отложенная загрузка LLM успешно отменена до выгрузки.")

    def _execute_lms_reload(self):
        if getattr(self, "is_busy", False):
            return

        if hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue:
            if self.task_queue.current_task is not None:
                return
            if self.task_queue.has_pending_tasks(("scene_art", "image", "scene_background")):
                return

        is_rp = (getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant") == "roleplay")
        is_eng = (not is_rp) and (self.is_engineer_mode_active() if hasattr(self, "is_engineer_mode_active") else False)

        # Точное определение целевой модели под текущий режим
        if is_eng:
            target_model = self.app_config.get("engineer_model_name") or self.app_config.get("engineer_model")
        elif is_rp:
            char_data = (self.current_session.get("character_data") or {}) if self.current_session else {}
            target_model = (
                char_data.get("character_model")
                or self.app_config.get("rp_model_name")
                or (self.current_session.get("model_id") if self.current_session else None)
                or self.app_config.get("active_model")
            )
        else:
            target_model = (
                self.app_config.get("assistant_model_name")
                or (self.current_session.get("model_id") if self.current_session else None)
                or self.app_config.get("active_model")
            )

        target_model = (target_model or "").strip()
        if not target_model or target_model.startswith("default"):
            target_model = getattr(self, "active_lms_model", "")

        if not target_model or target_model.startswith("default"):
            return

        # Определение целевого контекста: 28K для Инженера, 24K для РП, 14K для Ассистента
        if is_eng:
            ctx_len = self.app_config.get("context_length_engineer", 28672)
        elif is_rp:
            ctx_len = self.app_config.get("context_length_roleplay", 24576)
        else:
            ctx_len = self.app_config.get("context_length_assistant", 14336)

        if hasattr(self, "lm_client") and self.lm_client and hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue:
            from services.task_queue import PRIORITY_LOW
            task = InferenceTask(
                name="Возврат LLM в VRAM",
                task_type="llm",
                func=self.lm_client.ensure_model_loaded,
                kwargs={
                    "preferred_model": target_model,
                    "context_length": ctx_len,
                    "is_engineer": is_eng,
                    "is_roleplay": is_rp
                },
                priority=PRIORITY_LOW,
                metadata={"silent": True}
            )
            self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
            self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

import logging
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any
from pathlib import Path
from PyQt6.QtCore import QObject, pyqtSignal

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.HeaderController")


class HeaderStateController(QObject):
    """
    Управляет состоянием шапки чата (конечный автомат: имя, статус, неоновый цвет, аватар).
    Изолирует логику представления от главного окна MainWindow.
    """
    # title, status_text, status_color_hex, avatar_path
    state_updated = pyqtSignal(str, str, str, object)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._current_mode = "assistant"
        self._active_character: Optional[Any] = None
        self._current_session: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
        self._active_task_status: Optional[str] = None
        self._active_task_color: str = "#00F0FF"

    def sync_context(
        self,
        mode: str,
        character: Optional[Any],
        session: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    ):
        """Синхронизирует базовый контекст диалога (режим, персонаж, сессия)."""
        self._current_mode = mode
        self._active_character = character
        self._current_session = session
        self.refresh()

    def set_forge_progress(self, stage_name: str, percent: int):
        """Обновляет статус выполнения этапов SD WebUI Forge."""
        if percent > 0:
            self._active_task_status = f"{stage_name}: {percent}%"
        else:
            self._active_task_status = f"{stage_name}..."
        self._active_task_color = "#00F0FF"
        self.refresh()

    def set_task_state(self, task_type: str, action_text: str):
        """Устанавливает статус выполнения фоновой задачи."""
        self._active_task_status = f"{action_text}..."
        if task_type in ("scene_art", "image"):
            self._active_task_color = "#00F0FF"
        elif task_type == "llm":
            self._active_task_color = "#00F0FF"
        elif task_type == "file":
            self._active_task_color = "#FBBF24"
        elif task_type == "translation":
            self._active_task_color = "#38BDF8"
        else:
            self._active_task_color = "#00F0FF"
        self.refresh()

    def clear_active_task(self):
        """Сбрасывает состояние активной задачи при завершении или отмене."""
        self._active_task_status = None
        self.refresh()

    def refresh(self):
        """Вычисляет результирующее состояние и передает его в UI."""
        if self._active_task_status:
            title = self._get_base_title()
            avatar_path = self._get_avatar_path()
            self.state_updated.emit(title, self._active_task_status, self._active_task_color, avatar_path)
            return

        if self._current_mode == "roleplay":
            if self._active_character and getattr(self._active_character, "name", None):
                char_name = self._active_character.name
                user_name = "Игрок"
                if self._current_session:
                    from services.session_manager import SessionManager
                    sess_persona_id = self._current_session.get("user_persona_id")
                    persona = SessionManager.get_active_user_persona(is_roleplay=True, session_persona_id=sess_persona_id)
                    user_name = persona.get("name", "Игрок")

                status = f"🎭 {char_name} • Вы: {user_name}"
                color = "#A78BFA"
                # ВАЖНО: берем аватар через _get_avatar_path(), который учитывает сессионный оверрайд!
                avatar_path = self._get_avatar_path()
                self.state_updated.emit(char_name, status, color, avatar_path)
            else:
                self.state_updated.emit(
                    "Ролевой чат (Персонаж не выбран)",
                    "Загрузите карточку (.json)",
                    "#94A3B8",
                    None
                )
        else:
            # Ассистент: отображает аватар текущей сессии (или None для стандартного бейджа)
            self.state_updated.emit(
                "Элария",
                "Элария • В сети",
                "#38BDF8",
                self._get_avatar_path()
            )

    def _get_base_title(self) -> str:
        if self._current_mode == "roleplay" and self._active_character:
            return getattr(self._active_character, "name", "Персонаж")
        return "Элария"

    def _get_avatar_path(self) -> Optional[Any]:
        if self._current_mode == "roleplay":
            # 1. Индивидуальный аватар конкретного чата
            if self._current_session and self._current_session.get("character_data"):
                sess_av = self._current_session["character_data"].get("avatar_path")
                if sess_av and Path(sess_av).exists():
                    return Path(sess_av)
            # 2. Исходный аватар карточки персонажа из галереи
            if self._active_character and getattr(self._active_character, "avatar_path", None):
                p = Path(self._active_character.avatar_path)
                if p.exists():
                    return p
            return None

        # Режим ассистента: СТРОГО аватар текущей сессии. Если не задан — None (чистый бейдж)
        if self._current_session:
            sess_av = self._current_session.get("assistant_avatar_path")
            if sess_av and Path(sess_av).exists():
                return Path(sess_av)
        return None

"""
Reminder Controller for NeonRoute.
Periodically polls SQLite for due reminders and dispatches Windows Tray,
PowerShell Toasts, and in-app neon Toast widgets.
"""

import subprocess
import logging
from typing import List, Optional
from PyQt6.QtCore import QObject, QTimer, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QSystemTrayIcon, QStyle, QWidget
from ui.components.reminder_toast import ReminderToastWidget

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.ReminderController")


class ReminderController(QObject):
    reminder_triggered = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, parent_window: QWidget):
        super().__init__(parent_window)
        self.window = parent_window
        self._active_toasts: List[ReminderToastWidget] = []

        # System Tray Icon
        self.tray_icon = QSystemTrayIcon(self.window)
        app_icon = self.window.windowIcon()
        if not app_icon.isNull():
            self.tray_icon.setIcon(app_icon)
        else:
            self.tray_icon.setIcon(self.window.style().standardIcon(QStyle.StandardPixmap.SP_MessageBoxInformation))
        self.tray_icon.show()

        # Heartbeat timer (every 4 seconds)
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._check_reminders)
        self._timer.start(4000)

    def _check_reminders(self):
        try:
            from services.memory_db import memory_db
            due_list = memory_db.get_due_reminders()
            for item in due_list:
                r_id = item["id"]
                r_text = item["text"]
                r_time = item["remind_at"]
                memory_db.mark_reminder_done(r_id)

                self._dispatch_toast(r_text, r_time)
                self.reminder_triggered.emit(r_text)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"[ReminderController] Heartbeat error: {e}")

    def _dispatch_toast(self, text: str, remind_at: str):
        # 1. Native Windows Tray
        try:
            self.tray_icon.showMessage(
                "Элария • Напоминание",
                f"{text}\n({remind_at})",
                QSystemTrayIcon.MessageIcon.Information,
                12000
            )
        except Exception as te:
            logger.debug(f"[ReminderController] Tray error: {te}")

        # 2. PowerShell Toast Notification
        try:
            ps_cmd = (
                f'[Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] > $null; '
                f'$template = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::GetTemplateContent([Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastTemplateType]::ToastText02); '
                f'$textNodes = $template.GetElementsByTagName("text"); '
                f'$textNodes.Item(0).AppendChild($template.CreateTextNode("Элария • Напоминание")) > $null; '
                f'$textNodes.Item(1).AppendChild($template.CreateTextNode("{text}")) > $null; '
                f'$toast = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new($template); '
                f'[Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::CreateToastNotifier("NeonRoute").Show($toast);'
            )
            subprocess.Popen(["powershell", "-WindowStyle", "Hidden", "-Command", ps_cmd], creationflags=0x08000000)
        except Exception:
            pass

        # 3. In-App Neon Toast Widget
        toast = ReminderToastWidget(text, remind_at, self.window)
        toast.adjustSize()
        toast.setFixedWidth(320)

        margin_x = 24
        margin_y = 48
        x = self.window.width() - toast.width() - margin_x
        y = self.window.height() - toast.height() - margin_y

        active = [t for t in self._active_toasts if t.isVisible()]
        if active:
            y -= len(active) * (toast.height() + 10)

        toast.move(max(10, x), max(10, y))
        toast.show()
        toast.raise_()
        self._active_toasts.append(toast)

"""
Roleplay & Companion Controller (Mixin) for NeonRoute MainWindow.
Handles companions, scene backgrounds, characters gallery, campaign info dialogs,
character localization (_ru fields), and character state hydration.
"""

import logging
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional, Dict, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QFileDialog, QMessageBox
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPixmap

from services.tavern_parser import CharacterCard, TavernParser
from services.session_manager import SessionManager
from services.task_queue import InferenceTask
from ui.components.step_progress_button import CardProgressBridge
from services.card_translator import translate_card_slots_sequential

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.RoleplayController")


class RoleplayControllerMixin:
    """
    Миксин управления ролевым режимом (RP), компаньонами и сценой для MainWindow.
    """

    def _apply_chat_background(self):
        """Применяет персональный фон сцены для текущего диалога с затемнением."""
        bg_path = None
        if self.current_session:
            bg_path = self.current_session.get("background_image")

        applied = False
        if bg_path:
            p = Path(bg_path).resolve()
            if p.exists() and p.is_file():
                pix = QPixmap(str(p))
                if not pix.isNull():
                    dim_alpha = int(255 * 0.70)
                    if hasattr(self, "chat_viewport") and self.chat_viewport:
                        self.chat_viewport.set_background(pix, alpha=dim_alpha)
                        applied = True

        if not applied:
            if hasattr(self, "chat_viewport") and self.chat_viewport:
                if hasattr(self, "background_pixmap") and self.background_pixmap and not self.background_pixmap.isNull():
                    self.chat_viewport.set_background(self.background_pixmap, alpha=self.background_dim_opacity)
                else:
                    self.chat_viewport.set_background(None)

        if hasattr(self, "chat_viewport") and self.chat_viewport:
            self.chat_viewport.update()
        if hasattr(self, "scroll_area") and self.scroll_area:
            self.scroll_area.update()

    def _on_choose_background_clicked(self):
        file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Выберите фоновое изображение для сцены",
            "",
            "Images (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.webp)"
        )
        if not file_path:
            return
        norm_path = str(Path(file_path).resolve())
        if self.current_session:
            self.current_session["background_image"] = norm_path
            self._save_current_session()
        self._apply_chat_background()
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Фон сцены обновлен.", 3000)

    def _on_reset_background_clicked(self):
        if self.current_session:
            self.current_session["background_image"] = None
            self._save_current_session()
        self._apply_chat_background()
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Фон сцены сброшен.", 3000)

    def _on_generate_background_clicked(self):
        """Generates scene environment background without people using SD WebUI Forge pipeline."""
        sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
        if not self.pill_forge.is_online:
            logger.warning("[SD Forge] Отклонен запрос генерации фона сцены: сервер Forge офлайн.")
            user_msg = (
                "⚠️ **SD WebUI Forge не запущен или еще загружается.**\n\n"
                "Запустите Forge через кнопку в нижней панели и дождитесь зеленого индикатора."
            )
            self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Forge офлайн. Запустите сервер в нижней панели.", 6000)
            return

        checkpoint = getattr(self, "selected_forge_checkpoint", "✨ Арт-директор (Авто)")
        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        sess_images_dir = SessionManager.get_session_images_dir(sess_id) if sess_id else None

        loc_dna = ""
        if sess_id:
            from services.rp_cast_manager import RPCastManager
            cast_data = RPCastManager.load_cast(sess_id)
            loc_dna = (cast_data.get("environment") or {}).get("location_dna", "").strip()

        if loc_dna:
            prompt_seed = f"scenery, empty environment, {loc_dna}, masterpiece, detailed background, no humans"
        else:
            scene_desc = ""
            if self.active_character:
                scene_desc = self.active_character.scenario or self.active_character.description or self.active_character.name
            prompt_seed = f"scenery, empty environment, {scene_desc.strip()[:260]}, atmospheric lighting, no humans"

        def _bg_pipeline(raw_prompt: str, ckpt: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            self._cancel_lms_reload()
            available_models = self.forge_client.get_models()
            plan = self.art_director.plan_generation(
                raw_prompt=raw_prompt,
                preferred_style=ckpt,
                lm_client=self.lm_client,
                character=None,
                available_models=available_models
            )
            plan.positive_prompt = f"scenery, empty landscape, atmospheric lighting, no humans, {plan.positive_prompt}"
            human_neg = "human, person, 1girl, 1boy, woman, man, character, people, crowd, face, hands, body, portrait, "
            plan.negative_prompt = human_neg + (plan.negative_prompt or "")
            plan.width = 768
            plan.height = 512
            plan.enable_adetailer = False

            from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
            VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()

            kwargs = plan.to_forge_kwargs(output_dir=sess_images_dir, session_id=sess_id)
            img_path = self.forge_client.text_to_image(**kwargs)

            # Быстрый тихий возврат активной модели режима в VRAM
            if hasattr(self, "_reload_active_lms_model_async"):
                self._reload_active_lms_model_async(delay=1.2)

            if img_path and Path(img_path).resolve().exists():
                if self.current_session:
                    self.current_session["background_image"] = str(Path(img_path).resolve())
                    self._save_current_session()
                QTimer.singleShot(0, self, self._apply_chat_background)
            return {"image_path": img_path, "plan": plan, "checkpoint": plan.target_checkpoint, "is_scene_background": True}

        needs_llm_gen = bool(not loc_dna and re.search(r"[а-яА-ЯёЁ]", prompt_seed))
        task = InferenceTask(
            name="🖼️ Фон сцены",
            task_type="scene_background",
            func=_bg_pipeline,
            kwargs={"raw_prompt": prompt_seed, "ckpt": checkpoint},
            abort_fn=self.forge_client.interrupt,
            metadata={"is_scene_background": True, "needs_llm_prompt_gen": needs_llm_gen}
        )
        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Генерация фона сцены запущена в Forge...", 5000)

    def _open_campaign_info_dialog(self):
        """Открывает интерактивное окно сводки кампании, правил мира и памяти ИИ."""
        if not self.active_character:
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Сначала загрузите карточку персонажа или ДМ.", 3000)
            return
        try:
            from ui.dialogs.campaign_info_dialog import CampaignInfoDialog
            dlg = CampaignInfoDialog(
                character_card=self.active_character,
                current_session=self.current_session,
                parent=self
            )
            dlg.exec()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Ошибка открытия сводки кампании: {e}", exc_info=True)

    def _open_characters_gallery_dialog(self):
        """Открытие галереи персонажей с защитой от повторного открытия экземпляров."""
        if hasattr(self, "_active_gallery_dialog") and self._active_gallery_dialog is not None:
            try:
                if self._active_gallery_dialog.isVisible():
                    self._active_gallery_dialog.activateWindow()
                    self._active_gallery_dialog.raise_()
                    return
            except (RuntimeError, ReferenceError):
                self._active_gallery_dialog = None

        from ui.dialogs.characters_gallery_dialog import CharactersGalleryDialog
        dialog = CharactersGalleryDialog(parent=self)
        self._active_gallery_dialog = dialog

        # Гарантируем пересчет геометрии сплиттера после закрытия диалога
        def _on_dialog_closed():
            self._active_gallery_dialog = None
            if hasattr(self, "_sync_splitter_layout"):
                QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self._sync_splitter_layout(self.is_engineer_mode_active()))

        dialog.finished.connect(_on_dialog_closed)
        dialog.card_saved.connect(self._on_character_card_updated)
        res = dialog.exec()
        if res:
            card = getattr(dialog, "selected_card", None)
            if card:
                self._create_new_session(mode="roleplay", character_card=card)

    def _on_character_card_updated(self, card: CharacterCard):
        """Синхронизирует данные идентичности персонажа, локализацию и visual_dna в сессии и live-объекте."""
        if not card:
            return
        if hasattr(self, "current_session") and self.current_session:
            cd = self.current_session.get("character_data")
            card_id = getattr(card, "id", None)
            card_name = getattr(card, "name", None)
            if isinstance(cd, dict) and ((card_id and cd.get("id") == card_id) or (not cd.get("id") and card_name and cd.get("name") == card_name)):
                cd["name"] = card_name
                cd["visual_dna"] = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")

                identity_fields = (
                    "description",
                    "personality",
                    "scenario",
                    "system_prompt",
                    "mes_example",
                    "first_mes",
                    "description_ru",
                    "personality_ru",
                    "scenario_ru",
                    "system_prompt_ru",
                    "mes_example_ru",
                    "first_mes_ru",
                )
                for field in identity_fields:
                    if hasattr(card, field):
                        cd[field] = getattr(card, field)
                    elif field == "system_prompt_ru":
                        cd[field] = getattr(card, field, "")

                if hasattr(card, "avatar_path") and getattr(card, "avatar_path", None) is not None:
                    cd["avatar_path"] = str(card.avatar_path) if card.avatar_path else ""

                for greet_field in ("alternate_greetings", "alternate_greetings_ru"):
                    if hasattr(card, greet_field) and getattr(card, greet_field) is not None:
                        cd[greet_field] = getattr(card, greet_field)

                if hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character:
                    if (card_id and getattr(self.active_character, "id", None) == card_id) or (card_name and getattr(self.active_character, "name", None) == card_name):
                        self.active_character.name = card_name
                        self.active_character.visual_dna = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
                        for field in identity_fields:
                            if hasattr(card, field):
                                setattr(self.active_character, field, getattr(card, field))
                            elif field == "system_prompt_ru":
                                setattr(self.active_character, field, getattr(card, field, ""))

                        if hasattr(card, "avatar_path") and getattr(card, "avatar_path", None) is not None:
                            self.active_character.avatar_path = card.avatar_path

                        for greet_field in ("alternate_greetings", "alternate_greetings_ru"):
                            if hasattr(card, greet_field) and getattr(card, greet_field) is not None:
                                setattr(self.active_character, greet_field, getattr(card, greet_field))

                        if hasattr(self, "char_name_lbl") and self.char_name_lbl:
                            self.char_name_lbl.setText(f"🎭 {card_name}")
                if hasattr(self, "_save_current_session"):
                    self._save_current_session()
                try:
                    from services.rp_cast_manager import RPCastManager
                    sess_id = self.current_session.get("id")
                    if sess_id:
                        cast_data = RPCastManager.load_cast(sess_id)
                        if isinstance(cast_data, dict) and "companion_state" in cast_data:
                            cast_data["companion_state"]["visual_dna"] = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
                            RPCastManager.save_cast(sess_id, cast_data)
                except Exception as e_cast:
                    logger.debug(f"Could not update cast visual_dna on card save: {e_cast}")

    def _import_character(self):
        """Opens Characters Gallery dialog for companion selection."""
        self._open_characters_gallery_dialog()

    def _translate_character_card_task(self, card: CharacterCard, on_complete=None, on_progress=None):
        """Пайплайн асинхронной локализации карточки персонажа на русский язык."""
        sections = []
        if getattr(card, "description", None) and card.description.strip():
            sections.append(f"===DESCRIPTION===\n{card.description.strip()}")
        if getattr(card, "personality", None) and card.personality.strip():
            sections.append(f"===PERSONALITY===\n{card.personality.strip()}")
        if getattr(card, "scenario", None) and card.scenario.strip():
            sections.append(f"===SCENARIO===\n{card.scenario.strip()}")
        if getattr(card, "mes_example", None) and card.mes_example.strip():
            sections.append(f"===MES_EXAMPLE===\n{card.mes_example.strip()}")
        if getattr(card, "first_mes", None) and card.first_mes.strip():
            sections.append(f"===FIRST_MES===\n{card.first_mes.strip()}")

        if hasattr(card, "alternate_greetings") and card.alternate_greetings:
            for idx, alt_greet in enumerate(card.alternate_greetings):
                if alt_greet and alt_greet.strip():
                    sections.append(f"===ALT_GREETING_{idx+1}===\n{alt_greet.strip()}")

        if not sections:
            if on_complete:
                try:
                    on_complete(False, {})
                except TypeError:
                    on_complete(False)
            return

        raw_payload = "\n".join(sections)
        bridge = CardProgressBridge()
        if on_progress:
            bridge.progress_changed.connect(on_progress)

        sys_prompt = (
            "Ты — профессиональный художественный переводчик литературной прозы и ролевых игр на русский язык.\n"
            "Переведи каждую секцию карточки персонажа на богатый, атмосферный русский язык, сохраняя стиль и характер.\n"
            "СТРОГО СОХРАНЯЙ ВСЕ РАЗДЕЛИТЕЛИ ===SECTION=== В СВОЕМ ОТВЕТЕ! Переведи все приветствия ===FIRST_MES=== и ===ALT_GREETING_X=== без исключений."
        )

        def _worker_fn(text: str = None, task_card: CharacterCard = None) -> dict:
            # 1. Если задан коллбэк прогресса — используем слот-конвейер
            if on_progress:
                target_card = task_card or card
                def _slot_cb(cur: int, tot: int, slot_key: str):
                    bridge.progress_changed.emit(cur, tot, slot_key)

                return translate_card_slots_sequential(
                    card=target_card,
                    lm_client=self.lm_client,
                    on_progress=_slot_cb
                )

            # 2. Монолитный вызов для тестов и обратной совместимости
            payload_text = text if text is not None else raw_payload
            resp = self.lm_client.chat_completion(
                messages=[{"role": "system", "content": sys_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": payload_text}],
                temperature=0.25,
                max_tokens=8192,
                emit_signal=False,
                is_roleplay=False
            )
            return {"raw_reply": resp}

        def _on_done(task_id, result):
            if isinstance(result, dict) and "raw_reply" not in result:
                res_dict = result
            else:
                reply = result.get("raw_reply", "") if isinstance(result, dict) else str(result)
                parts = re.split(r'===+\s*([A-Za-z0-9_А-Яа-яЁё\s]+)\s*===+', reply, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
                res_dict = {}
                key_aliases = {
                    "DESCRIPTION": "DESCRIPTION", "ОПИСАНИЕ": "DESCRIPTION",
                    "PERSONALITY": "PERSONALITY", "ХАРАКТЕР": "PERSONALITY", "ЛИЧНОСТЬ": "PERSONALITY",
                    "SCENARIO": "SCENARIO", "СЦЕНАРИЙ": "SCENARIO", "ОКРУЖЕНИЕ": "SCENARIO",
                    "MES_EXAMPLE": "MES_EXAMPLE", "ПРИМЕРЫ": "MES_EXAMPLE", "ПРИМЕРЫ ДИАЛОГОВ": "MES_EXAMPLE", "ДИАЛОГИ": "MES_EXAMPLE",
                    "FIRST_MES": "FIRST_MES", "FIRST_MESSAGE": "FIRST_MES", "FIRST MESSAGE": "FIRST_MES",
                    "GREETING": "FIRST_MES", "ПЕРВОЕ СООБЩЕНИЕ": "FIRST_MES", "ПРИВЕТСТВИЕ": "FIRST_MES", "ВСТУПЛЕНИЕ": "FIRST_MES"
                }
                if len(parts) >= 3:
                    for i in range(1, len(parts), 2):
                        raw_header = parts[i].upper().strip()
                        clean_header = re.sub(r'[\s_]+', ' ', raw_header).strip()
                        underscore_header = re.sub(r'\s+', '_', clean_header)

                        canonical_key = (
                            key_aliases.get(raw_header)
                            or key_aliases.get(clean_header)
                            or key_aliases.get(underscore_header)
                        )
                        if not canonical_key:
                            alt_match = re.match(r'^(?:ALT[_\s]*GREETING|АЛЬТ(?:ЕРНАТИВНОЕ)?[_\s]*ПРИВЕТСТВИЕ)[_\s]*(\d+)$', raw_header, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
                            if alt_match:
                                canonical_key = f"ALT_GREETING_{alt_match.group(1)}"
                            else:
                                canonical_key = raw_header

                        val = parts[i+1].strip()
                        val = re.sub(r'^[\*\s`#_]+(?:\r?\n|$)', '', val)
                        val = re.sub(r'(?:\r?\n|^)[\*\s`#_]+$', '', val).strip()
                        if val and canonical_key:
                            res_dict[canonical_key] = val

            if not res_dict:
                self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Не удалось распознать перевод для карточки '{card.name}'.", 5000)
                if on_complete:
                    try:
                        on_complete(False, {})
                    except TypeError:
                        on_complete(False)
                return

            if res_dict.get("DESCRIPTION"): card.description_ru = res_dict["DESCRIPTION"]
            if res_dict.get("PERSONALITY"): card.personality_ru = res_dict["PERSONALITY"]
            if res_dict.get("SCENARIO"): card.scenario_ru = res_dict["SCENARIO"]
            if res_dict.get("MES_EXAMPLE"): card.mes_example_ru = res_dict["MES_EXAMPLE"]
            if res_dict.get("FIRST_MES"): card.first_mes_ru = res_dict["FIRST_MES"]

            if hasattr(card, "alternate_greetings") and card.alternate_greetings:
                alt_ru = list(getattr(card, "alternate_greetings_ru", []) or [])
                while len(alt_ru) < len(card.alternate_greetings):
                    alt_ru.append("")
                for idx in range(len(card.alternate_greetings)):
                    key = f"ALT_GREETING_{idx+1}"
                    if res_dict.get(key):
                        alt_ru[idx] = res_dict[key]
                card.alternate_greetings_ru = alt_ru

            TavernParser.save_card_translations(card)
            if self.current_session:
                cd = self.current_session.get("character_data")
                if isinstance(cd, dict):
                    if cd.get("name") == card.name or cd.get("id") == getattr(card, "id", None):
                        cd["description_ru"] = card.description_ru
                        cd["personality_ru"] = card.personality_ru
                        cd["scenario_ru"] = card.scenario_ru
                        cd["mes_example_ru"] = card.mes_example_ru
                        cd["first_mes_ru"] = card.first_mes_ru
                        cd["alternate_greetings_ru"] = card.alternate_greetings_ru or []
                        if getattr(card, "visual_dna", ""):
                            cd["visual_dna"] = card.visual_dna
                        self._save_current_session()

            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Карточка персонажа '{card.name}' успешно переведена на русский язык!", 5000)
            if on_complete:
                try:
                    on_complete(True, res_dict)
                except TypeError:
                    on_complete(True)

        task = InferenceTask(
            name=f"🌐 Локализация карточки: {card.name}",
            task_type="translation",
            func=_worker_fn,
            kwargs={"text": raw_payload, "task_card": card},
            abort_fn=self.lm_client.abort
        )
        if hasattr(self, "_active_tasks"):
            self._active_tasks[task.id] = task

        def _disconnect_handlers():
            try:
                self.task_queue.task_finished.disconnect(_on_done_wrapper)
            except (TypeError, RuntimeError):
                pass
            try:
                self.task_queue.task_failed.disconnect(_on_fail_wrapper)
            except (TypeError, RuntimeError):
                pass

        def _on_done_wrapper(tid: str, res: Any):
            if tid != task.id:
                return
            _disconnect_handlers()
            if hasattr(self, "_active_tasks"):
                self._active_tasks.pop(task.id, None)
            _on_done(tid, res)

        def _on_fail_wrapper(tid: str, err: str):
            if tid != task.id:
                return
            _disconnect_handlers()
            if hasattr(self, "_active_tasks"):
                self._active_tasks.pop(task.id, None)
            if on_complete:
                try:
                    on_complete(False, {})
                except TypeError:
                    on_complete(False)

        self.task_queue.task_finished.connect(_on_done_wrapper)
        self.task_queue.task_failed.connect(_on_fail_wrapper)
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _restore_roleplay_character_from_session(self, char_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Optional[CharacterCard]:
        """Восстанавливает объект CharacterCard через канонический from_dict()."""
        if not char_data or not isinstance(char_data, dict):
            return None

        card = CharacterCard.from_dict(char_data)

        # Защитная гидратация visual_dna из каста сессии, если поле пустое
        sess_id = self.current_session.get("id") if self.current_session else None
        if not card.visual_dna and sess_id:
            try:
                from services.rp_cast_manager import RPCastManager
                cast_data = RPCastManager.load_cast(sess_id)
                card.visual_dna = (cast_data.get("companion_state") or {}).get("visual_dna", "")
            except Exception:
                pass

        return card

"""
Chat Search Controller (Mixin) for NeonRoute MainWindow.
Manages in-chat text query search, occurrence counting, match highlighting,
and smooth auto-scrolling between matches.
"""

import re
import logging
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, List, Optional, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QLabel, QLineEdit, QScrollArea, QPushButton
from PyQt6.QtGui import QTextCursor, QTextDocument, QColor

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.ChatSearch")


class ChatSearchMixin:
    """
    Миксин внутричатового поиска для MainWindow.
    Изолирует всю механику поиска, подсветки совпадений и навигации.
    """

    def _on_search_clicked(self):
        try:
            self._toggle_search_bar()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error in _on_search_clicked: {e}", exc_info=True)

    def _show_search_bar(self):
        self.search_bar_widget.show_and_focus()

    def _toggle_search_bar(self):
        if self.search_bar_widget.isVisible():
            self._close_search_bar()
        else:
            self._show_search_bar()

    def _close_search_bar(self):
        self.search_bar_widget.setVisible(False)
        self._clear_search_highlight()
        self.input_box.setFocus()

    def _on_search_query_changed(self, query: str):
        query = query.strip()
        self._search_matching_widgets.clear()
        self._current_search_idx = -1

        if not query:
            self.search_bar_widget.set_match_info(0, 0)
            return

        q_lower = query.lower()
        for w in self._get_chat_message_widgets():
            txt = ""
            if hasattr(w, "text_browser") and w.text_browser:
                txt = w.text_browser.toPlainText()
            elif hasattr(w, "raw_text"):
                txt = w.raw_text or ""
            if q_lower in txt.lower():
                self._search_matching_widgets.append(w)

        total = len(self._search_matching_widgets)
        if total > 0:
            self._current_search_idx = 0
            self.search_bar_widget.set_match_info(1, total)
            self._navigate_search_match(0)
        else:
            self.search_bar_widget.set_match_info(0, 0)

    def _clear_search_highlight(self):
        self._search_matching_widgets.clear()
        self._current_search_idx = -1

"""
Session & History Controller (Mixin) for NeonRoute MainWindow.
Handles session creation, switching, persistence, sidebar list updates,
and chat message serialization.
"""

import time
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional, List, Dict, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, QPoint, QSize
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QMessageBox, QInputDialog, QListWidgetItem,
    QMenu, QApplication, QFileDialog
)
from PyQt6.QtGui import QIcon, QAction
from services.session_manager import SessionManager


if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ui.main_window import MainWindow

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.SessionController")


class SessionControllerMixin:
    """
    Миксин управления сессиями и историей диалогов для MainWindow.
    """

    def _on_new_chat_clicked(self):
        """Handler for '+ Новый' button in sidebar."""
        self._create_new_session(
            mode=self.current_mode,
            character_card=self.active_character if self.current_mode == "roleplay" else None,
            title=None
        )
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Создан новый диалог.", 4000)

    def _save_current_session(self, trigger_memory: bool = False):
        """Persists active session to disk."""
        if not self.current_session:
            return
        self.current_session["chat_history"] = list(self.chat_history)
        self.current_session["mode"] = self.current_mode
        if hasattr(self, "is_engineer_mode_active") and self.is_engineer_mode_active():
            self.current_session["type"] = "engineering"
        else:
            self.current_session.pop("type", None)
        SessionManager.save_session(self.current_session, trigger_memory=trigger_memory)

    def _on_rename_session_requested(self, session_id: str):
        """Opens rename dialog for the session."""
        current_title = "Диалог"
        if self.current_session and self.current_session.get("id") == session_id:
            current_title = self.current_session.get("title", current_title)
        elif session_id in self._session_items:
            _, w = self._session_items[session_id]
            current_title = w.title_lbl.text()

        new_title, ok = QInputDialog.getText(
            self,
            "Переименование диалога",
            "Введите новое название диалога:",
            text=current_title
        )
        if ok and new_title.strip():
            clean_title = new_title.strip()
            SessionManager.rename_session(session_id, clean_title)
            if self.current_session and self.current_session.get("id") == session_id:
                self.current_session["title"] = clean_title
            if session_id in self._session_items:
                _, w = self._session_items[session_id]
                w.update_title(clean_title)
            if hasattr(self, "workspace_inspector"):
                self.workspace_inspector.update_title(clean_title)
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Диалог переименован: '{clean_title}'", 3000)

    def _on_delete_session_requested(self, session_id: str):
        """Deletes a session from history and removes from sidebar with WinError 32 guard."""
        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Удаление диалога",
            "Вы действительно хотите удалить этот диалог из истории?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return

        # 1. Если удаляется активная сессия, останавливаем активные задачи очереди и переключаем UI
        is_active_session = bool(self.current_session and self.current_session.get("id") == session_id)
        if is_active_session:
            if getattr(self, "is_busy", False):
                self.task_queue.abort_current()

            # Освобождаем виджеты текущего чата и дескрипторы аудио/изображений
            self._clear_chat_widgets()

            next_id = None
            # Сначала ищем сессию того же режима (self.current_mode)
            target_m = getattr(self, "current_mode", "assistant")
            for i in range(self.chat_list_widget.count()):
                cand_item = self.chat_list_widget.item(i)
                cid = cand_item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                if cid and cid != session_id:
                    cand_w = self.chat_list_widget.itemWidget(cand_item)
                    cand_mode = getattr(cand_w, "mode", None) if cand_w else None
                    if cand_mode == target_m:
                        next_id = cid
                        break

            # Если сессии того же режима нет, ищем любую доступную
            if not next_id:
                for i in range(self.chat_list_widget.count()):
                    cand_item = self.chat_list_widget.item(i)
                    cid = cand_item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                    if cid and cid != session_id:
                        next_id = cid
                        break

            self.current_session = None
            if next_id:
                self._switch_to_session(next_id)
            else:
                self._create_new_session(self.current_mode or "assistant")

        # 2. Удаляем сессию из списка UI
        if session_id in self._session_items:
            item, _ = self._session_items.pop(session_id)
            row = self.chat_list_widget.row(item)
            if row >= 0:
                self.chat_list_widget.takeItem(row)

        # 3. Полное удаление истории чата и папки outputs/sessions/<session_id>/
        SessionManager.delete_session(session_id)

import os
import re
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget

from services.task_queue import InferenceTask
from services.session_manager import SessionManager
from services.memory_db import handle_memory_command
from services.tool_engine import ToolEngine
from ui.components.typing_loader import TypingLoaderWidget
from ui.components.chat_bubble import ChatMessageWidget

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.TaskLifecycle")


class TaskLifecycleMixin:
    """Миксин для управления жизненным циклом и диспатчингом задач очереди TaskQueue."""

    def _enqueue_translation_task(self, text: str, target_message: ChatMessageWidget, is_greeting: bool = False):
        def _rollback_btn():
            if target_message and getattr(target_message, "btn_translate", None):
                target_message.btn_translate.setText("🌐 Перевести")

        if not text or not str(text).strip():
            _rollback_btn()
            return

        # Check if greeting translation is already cached: if present, use directly and skip queue
        char_data = self.current_session.get("character_data") if self.current_session else None
        char_first_mes = char_data.get("first_mes") if char_data else None
        if not is_greeting and char_first_mes and text == char_first_mes:
            is_greeting = True

        if is_greeting and char_data:
            cached_ru = char_data.get("first_mes_ru") or SessionManager.get_cached_greeting_ru(char_data.get("id"), char_data.get("name"))
            if cached_ru:
                char_data["first_mes_ru"] = cached_ru
                if target_message:
                    target_message.set_translation(cached_ru)
                    self._update_message_translation_in_session(target_message, cached_ru)
                logger.info("Using cached character greeting translation; skipped translation queue.")
                return

        # Code/scripts, system observations, tool outputs, and operational reports MUST NEVER be sent to translation
        has_code_markers = any(k in text for k in ("```", "def ", "class ", "import ", "print(", "return ", "<<TOOL:"))
        if has_code_markers:
            _rollback_btn()
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Код и служебные блоки не подлежат переводу.", 3000)
            return

        system_markers = [
            "[Системный результат",
            "[IMAGE_PROMPT",
            "[строки ",
            "[Код возврата:",
            "[Успешно]:",
            "STDERR:",
            "📖 Читаю файл",
            "📋 Копирую файл",
            "🔍 Ищу файлы",
            "⚡ Запуск скрипта",
            "🔧 Выполняю",
            "Консоль:"
        ]
        if ToolEngine.has_tool_call(text) or any(m in text for m in system_markers):
            _rollback_btn()
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Системные логи не подлежат переводу.", 3000)
            return

        latin_count = sum(1 for c in text if 'a' <= c.lower() <= 'z')
        cyrillic_count = sum(1 for c in text if 'а' <= c.lower() <= 'я')

        if cyrillic_count >= latin_count:
            task_title = "Перевод на английский"
            sys_prompt = (
                "You are a professional literary translator. Translate the text into natural English faithfully, "
                "preserving character voice, tone, formatting, and markdown. Respond ONLY with the translation."
            )
            user_prompt = f"Translate this text into natural English:\n\n{text}"
        else:
            task_title = "Перевод на русский"
            sys_prompt = (
                "Ты — профессиональный писатель и литературный переводчик художественной прозы на русский язык.\n\n"
                "Правила перевода:\n"
                "1. Полнота: переведи весь предоставленный текст полностью от первого до последнего предложения, без сокращений и пересказов.\n"
                "2. Грамматика и род: строго сохраняй грамматический род участников сцены и персонажей по контексту повествования (не подменяй мужской род на женский и наоборот).\n"
                "3. Литературный слог: переводи выразительно и естественно, избегая калек машинного перевода.\n"
                "4. Форматирование: сохраняй исходные абзацы, кавычки, реплики и *курсив*. Выводи только готовый перевод без предисловий и комментариев."
            )
            user_prompt = f"Переведи следующий художественный текст на красивый русский литературный язык целиком без сокращений:\n\n{text}"

        messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": sys_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
        ]

        model_name = (
            getattr(self.lm_client, "_last_loaded_model_id", None)
            or (self.lm_combo.currentText().strip() if hasattr(self, "lm_combo") and self.lm_combo else "")
            or getattr(self, "active_lms_model", "")
        )
        if model_name and model_name.startswith("default"):
            model_name = None

        from services.session_manager import get_mode_profile
        active_loaded_ctx = getattr(self.lm_client, "_current_loaded_ctx", None)
        if not active_loaded_ctx:
            active_loaded_ctx = get_mode_profile(self.current_mode).get("context_length", 24576)

        tr_cfg = self.app_config.get("translation_settings", {})
        tr_temp = float(tr_cfg.get("temperature", 0.20))
        max_limit = int(tr_cfg.get("max_tokens_limit", 4096))
        tr_budget = SessionManager.calculate_translation_budget(text, max_limit=max_limit)

        task = InferenceTask(
            name=task_title,
            task_type="translation",
            func=self.lm_client.chat_completion,
            kwargs={
                "messages": messages,
                "model": model_name,
                "temperature": tr_temp,
                "max_tokens": tr_budget,
                "context_length": int(active_loaded_ctx),
                "stream": False,
                "emit_signal": False,
                "is_roleplay": (self.current_mode == "roleplay")
            },
            abort_fn=self.lm_client.abort,
            metadata={
                "target_widget": target_message,
                "is_translation": True,
                "original_text": text,
                "is_greeting": is_greeting,
                "char_id": char_data.get("id") if char_data else None
            }
        )

        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _route_and_enqueue(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        attached_files: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        vision_content: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        user_query: Optional[str] = None,
        art_guidance: Optional[str] = None
    ):
        """Analyzes intent and enqueues sequential task."""
        # 0. Intercept Long-Term User Memory Commands (View, Delete by ID/Keyword, Clear All, Save)
        is_memory_cmd, reply_text = handle_memory_command(prompt)
        if is_memory_cmd:
            sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
            avatar = self.active_character.avatar_path if (self.current_mode == "roleplay" and self.active_character) else None

            self._append_message(sender_name, reply_text, is_user=False, avatar_path=avatar)
            self._sync_turn(role="assistant", content=reply_text, replace_last=False, trigger_memory=False)
            return

        # Интенты картинок проверяются СТРОГО по запросу пользователя, а не по телу файла
        query_text = user_query if user_query is not None else prompt
        lower = query_text.lower() if query_text else ""

        # If vision content is present, route to vision LLM
        if vision_content:
            self._enqueue_llm_task(is_roleplay=(self.current_mode == "roleplay"), vision_content=vision_content, art_guidance=art_guidance)
            return

        # Direct art trigger check (strictly for roleplay or assistant with engineer mode OFF)
        is_eng = self.is_engineer_mode_active()
        if not is_eng and self.current_mode in ("roleplay", "assistant"):
            direct_prefixes = ("!art ", "!арт ", "!img ", "!картинка ", "!art", "!арт", "!img", "!картинка")
            is_direct = lower.startswith(direct_prefixes)
            if is_direct:
                logger.info(f"[Арт-команда] Получен запрос прямого рендера: '{prompt.strip()}'")
                # 1. Strip trigger prefix from prompt
                trimmed_prompt = prompt
                for pfx in sorted(direct_prefixes, key=len, reverse=True):
                    if lower.startswith(pfx):
                        trimmed_prompt = prompt[len(pfx):].strip()
                        break

                if not trimmed_prompt:
                    user_msg = "⚠️ **Укажите описание изображения после триггера прямого рендера** (например: `!art киберпанк девушка` или `!img neon street`)."
                    sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
                    self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
                    return

                # 2. Check Forge status
                if not self.pill_forge.is_online:
                    logger.warning(f"[SD Forge] Отклонен прямой рендер '{trimmed_prompt}': сервер Forge офлайн (порт 7860 недоступен).")
                    user_msg = (
                        "⚠️ **SD WebUI Forge не запущен или еще загружается.**\n\n"
                        "Запустите Forge через кнопку в нижней панели и дождитесь зеленого индикатора."
                    )
                    sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
                    self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
                    self.statusBar().showMessage("Forge офлайн. Запустите сервер в нижней панели.", 6000)
                    return

                # 3 & 4. Build direct plan and directly enqueue task to TaskQueue
                self._enqueue_direct_image_task(trimmed_prompt)
                # 5. Return
                return

        # 1. Roleplay Mode: Изолированный контроллер ролевого режима
        if self.current_mode == "roleplay":
            if hasattr(self, "_enqueue_roleplay_llm_task"):
                self._enqueue_roleplay_llm_task(vision_content=vision_content, art_guidance=art_guidance)
            else:
                self._enqueue_llm_task(is_roleplay=True, vision_content=vision_content, art_guidance=art_guidance)
            return

        # 2. Engineer Mode: Приоритетный перехват активного инженерного контура
        is_eng = self.is_engineer_mode_active()
        if is_eng:
            if hasattr(self, "_dispatch_ephemeral_doc_worker"):
                if self._dispatch_ephemeral_doc_worker(task_prompt=prompt, attached_files=attached_files):
                    return

        # 3. Assistant Mode: Изолированный контроллер Ассистента (Элария)
        is_excel = any(k in lower for k in ["excel", "эксель", "таблиц", "смет", "xlsx", "расчет"])
        is_word = any(k in lower for k in ["word", "ворд", "docx", "документ", "отчет", "реферат", "стать"])

        if hasattr(self, "_enqueue_assistant_llm_task"):
            self._enqueue_assistant_llm_task(is_excel=is_excel, is_word=is_word, vision_content=vision_content, art_guidance=art_guidance)
        else:
            self._enqueue_llm_task(is_roleplay=False, is_excel=is_excel, is_word=is_word, vision_content=vision_content, art_guidance=art_guidance)

    def _enqueue_tts_task(self, text: str, target_message: ChatMessageWidget):
        task = InferenceTask(
            name="F5-TTS Озвучка",
            task_type="tts",
            func=self.tts_service.synthesize,
            kwargs={"text": text},
            abort_fn=self.tts_service.abort,
            metadata={"target_widget": target_message}
        )
        self._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _on_task_started(self, task_id: str, name: str, task_type: str):
        task = self._active_tasks.get(task_id) if hasattr(self, "_active_tasks") else None
        is_silent = bool(task and (task.metadata.get("silent", False) or getattr(task, "task_type", None) == "memory"))
        if is_silent or name == "Возврат LLM в VRAM" or task_type == "memory":
            return
        self.is_busy = True
        self.input_box.set_busy(True)
        self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Выполняется: {name}...")

        # Remove any existing typing loader
        self._remove_typing_loader()

        # Determine adaptive roleplay / assistant name
        if self.current_mode == "roleplay":
            if self.active_character:
                sender_name = self.active_character.name
                avatar_path = self.active_character.avatar_path
            else:
                sender_name = self.current_session.get("title") if self.current_session else "Персонаж"
                avatar_path = None
        else:
            sender_name = "Элария"
            avatar_path = self._get_current_avatar_path()

        if task_type == "translation":
            icon = "🌐"
            action_text = "Выполняется перевод"
        elif task_type in ("scene_art", "image"):
            icon = "🎨"
            action_text = "Генерация иллюстрации"
        elif task_type == "tts":
            icon = "🔊"
            action_text = "Озвучивание сообщения"
        elif task_type == "file":
            icon = "⏳"
            action_text = name
        else:
            if self.current_mode == "roleplay":
                icon = "💭"
                action_text = f"{sender_name} печатает"
            else:
                icon = "⚡"
                action_text = "Элария думает"

        # Update dynamic header typing status
        if hasattr(self, "header_controller"):
            self.header_controller.set_task_state(task_type, action_text)

        task = self._active_tasks.get(task_id)
        is_attached_to_widget = bool(task and task.metadata and task.metadata.get("target_widget"))
        if task_type in ("scene_art", "image") and is_attached_to_widget:
            # Не создаем TypingLoaderWidget внизу ленты, так как статус отображается прямо на кнопке-чипе сообщения!
            return

        self.typing_loader = TypingLoaderWidget(
            sender_name=sender_name,
            action_text=action_text,
            avatar_path=avatar_path,
            icon=icon,
            parent=self.chat_container
        )
        self.chat_layout.insertWidget(self.chat_layout.count() - 1, self.typing_loader, alignment=Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        self._scroll_to_bottom()

    def _remove_typing_loader(self):
        if self.typing_loader is not None:
            try:
                self.chat_layout.removeWidget(self.typing_loader)
                self.typing_loader.stop_animation()
                self.typing_loader.deleteLater()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(f"Error removing typing loader: {e}")
            finally:
                self.typing_loader = None

    def _on_task_finished(self, task_id: str, result: any):
        """Делегирует завершение задачи в единый диспетчер ChatFlowControllerMixin."""
        super()._on_task_finished(task_id, result)
        if hasattr(self, "header_controller"):
            self.header_controller.clear_active_task()

    def _refresh_lm_models(self):
        """Обновляет список моделей LM Studio из CLI."""
        if hasattr(self, "_refresh_models"):
            self._refresh_models()

    def _on_task_failed(self, task_id: str, error: str):
        task = self._active_tasks.get(task_id)
        self._force_reset_busy_state(task_id)
        if hasattr(self, "header_controller"):
            self.header_controller.clear_active_task()
        self._update_header_for_current_state()

        # Откат состояния кнопки арт-сцены при сбое Forge
        if task and task.metadata and task.metadata.get("is_scene_art"):
            target_widget = task.metadata.get("target_widget")
            if target_widget and hasattr(target_widget, "set_scene_art_busy"):
                target_widget.set_scene_art_busy(False)

        # Откат состояния кнопки бабла при ошибке перевода
        if task and task.metadata and task.metadata.get("is_translation"):
            target_widget = task.metadata.get("target_widget")
            if target_widget and getattr(target_widget, "btn_translate", None):
                target_widget.btn_translate.setText("🌐 Перевести")
            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Ошибка перевода: {error}", 4000)
            return

        error_msg = str(error)

        # Проверка на удаленную/отсутствующую модель
        is_model_missing = (
            "не найдена в хранилище" in error_msg
            or "No models loaded" in error_msg
            or "Model not found" in error_msg
            or "ModelNotFoundError" in error_msg
            or "не найдена на диске" in error_msg
        )

        if is_model_missing:
            # 1. Извлекаем имя сбойной модели
            missing_name = getattr(self.lm_combo, "currentText", lambda: "выбранная")().strip()
            if (not missing_name or missing_name.startswith("default")) and "Модель '" in error_msg:
                try:
                    import re
                    m = re.search(r"Модель '([^']+)' не найдена", error_msg)
                    if m:
                        missing_name = m.group(1)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            # 2. Разблокируем выбор модели для пользователя
            if hasattr(self, "lm_combo") and self.lm_combo:
                self.lm_combo.setEnabled(True)
                self.lm_combo.setToolTip("Выберите другую доступную модель")
            if getattr(self, "current_session", None):
                self.current_session["is_model_locked"] = False
                if hasattr(self, "_save_current_session"):
                    self._save_current_session()

            # 3. Обновляем список моделей из CLI
            if hasattr(self, "_refresh_lm_models"):
                self._refresh_lm_models()
            elif hasattr(self, "_refresh_models"):
                self._refresh_models()

            # 4. Выводим аккуратное сообщение пользователю в чат вместо модального креста
            friendly_text = f"⚠️ Модель «{missing_name}» не найдена на диске или была удалена.\nПожалуйста, выберите доступную модель в списке выше."
            sender_name = getattr(self.active_character, "name", "Элария") if hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character else "Элария"

            if getattr(self, "_turn_bubble", None) is not None:
                try:
                    self._turn_bubble.set_text(friendly_text)
                except Exception:
                    self._append_message(sender_name, friendly_text, is_user=False)
                self._turn_bubble = None
            else:
                self._append_message(sender_name, friendly_text, is_user=False)

            self.statusBar().showMessage(f"Модель «{missing_name}» не найдена.", 5000)
            return

        # Для всех остальных непредвиденных ошибок сохраняется стандартный лог:
        logger.error(f"[NeonRoute.TaskQueue] Task failed: {task_id} - {error_msg}")
        if "ForgeOfflineError" in error_msg or "SD WebUI Forge не запущен" in error_msg:
            logger.warning(f"[SD Forge] Ошибка выполнения задачи (Forge офлайн): {error_msg}")
            user_msg = (
                "⚠️ **SD WebUI Forge не запущен или еще загружается.**\n\n"
                "Запустите Forge через кнопку в нижней панели и дождитесь зеленого индикатора."
            )
            sender_name = self.active_character.name if (hasattr(self, "active_character") and self.active_character) else "Элария"
            self._append_message(sender_name, user_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("SD WebUI Forge недоступен. Запустите Forge в нижней панели.", 6000)
        elif "не поддерживает распознавание изображений" in error_msg or "Vision-модель" in error_msg:
            self._append_message("Система (Vision)", error_msg, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Выберите Vision-модель для анализа картинок.", 6000)
        else:
            err_display = f"❌ **Ошибка выполнения задачи:**\n\n```text\n{error_msg}\n```"
            self._append_message("Система (Ошибка)", err_display, is_user=False, is_error=True)
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Ошибка выполнения задачи.", 6000)

    def _on_task_aborted(self, task_id: str):
        task = self._active_tasks.get(task_id)
        self._force_reset_busy_state(task_id)
        if hasattr(self, "header_controller"):
            self.header_controller.clear_active_task()
        self._update_header_for_current_state()

        if task and task.metadata and task.metadata.get("is_scene_art"):
            target_widget = task.metadata.get("target_widget")
            if target_widget and hasattr(target_widget, "set_scene_art_busy"):
                target_widget.set_scene_art_busy(False)

        if task and task.metadata and task.metadata.get("is_translation"):
            target_widget = task.metadata.get("target_widget")
            if target_widget and getattr(target_widget, "btn_translate", None):
                target_widget.btn_translate.setText("🌐 Перевести")

        if getattr(self, "_antiloop_aborted", False):
            self._antiloop_aborted = False
            self.statusBar().showMessage("Генерация завершена (срез зацикливания текста).", 4000)
            return

        self._append_message("Система", "⏹️ Операция остановлена пользователем.", is_user=False)
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Операция прервана.", 4000)

    def _on_queue_empty(self):
        self._force_reset_busy_state()
        if hasattr(self, "header_controller"):
            self.header_controller.clear_active_task()
        self._update_header_for_current_state()

    def _on_stop_clicked(self):
        self.statusBar().showMessage("Остановка активной задачи...")
        if hasattr(self, "task_queue") and self.task_queue:
            self.task_queue.abort_current()
        if hasattr(self, "abort_generation"):
            self.abort_generation()
        self._force_reset_busy_state()


__all__ = ["TaskLifecycleMixin"]

import logging
from typing import Optional

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QEvent
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPainter, QColor, QPixmap
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QMainWindow

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.WindowState")


class WindowStateMixin:
    """Миксин для отрисовки фона окна, переключения полноэкранного режима и обработки геометрии."""

    def _update_background_cache(self):
        if hasattr(self, 'background_pixmap') and self.background_pixmap and not self.background_pixmap.isNull():
            w, h = max(1, self.width()), max(1, self.height())
            buffer = QPixmap(w, h)
            buffer.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)

            p = QPainter(buffer)
            p.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)

            scaled = self.background_pixmap.scaled(
                self.size(),
                Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatioByExpanding,
                Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
            )
            x = (w - scaled.width()) // 2
            y = (h - scaled.height()) // 2
            p.drawPixmap(x, y, scaled)

            dim_alpha = getattr(self, 'background_dim_opacity', 140)
            p.fillRect(buffer.rect(), QColor(0, 0, 0, dim_alpha))
            p.end()

            self._bg_render_cache = buffer
        else:
            self._bg_render_cache = None

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        if hasattr(super(), "paintEvent"):
            try:
                super().paintEvent(event)
            except Exception:
                pass
        painter = QPainter(self)
        if getattr(self, '_bg_render_cache', None) and not self._bg_render_cache.isNull():
            painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, self._bg_render_cache)
        else:
            painter.fillRect(self.rect(), QColor(18, 18, 20))
        painter.end()

    def _toggle_fullscreen(self):
        if self.isFullScreen():
            self.showNormal()
            if hasattr(self, "sidebar"):
                self.sidebar.setVisible(True)
            if self.statusBar():
                self.statusBar().setVisible(True)
            if self.menuBar():
                self.menuBar().setVisible(True)
            if hasattr(self, "floating_close_btn"):
                self.floating_close_btn.setVisible(False)
            if hasattr(self, "btn_fullscreen"):
                self.btn_fullscreen.setText("⛶")
        else:
            if hasattr(self, "sidebar"):
                self.sidebar.setVisible(False)
            if self.statusBar():
                self.statusBar().setVisible(False)
            if self.menuBar():
                self.menuBar().setVisible(False)
            self.showFullScreen()
            if hasattr(self, "floating_close_btn"):
                self.floating_close_btn.setVisible(True)
                self._position_floating_close_btn()
            if hasattr(self, "btn_fullscreen"):
                self.btn_fullscreen.setText("🗗")

    def _position_floating_close_btn(self):
        if hasattr(self, "floating_close_btn"):
            self.floating_close_btn.move(self.width() - 48, 12)
            self.floating_close_btn.raise_()

    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_F11:
            self._toggle_fullscreen()
            event.accept()
            return
        elif event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Escape:
            if self.isFullScreen():
                self._toggle_fullscreen()
                event.accept()
                return
        if isinstance(self, QMainWindow):
            QMainWindow.keyPressEvent(self, event)

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        if hasattr(super(), "resizeEvent"):
            try:
                super().resizeEvent(event)
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._update_background_cache()
        if self.isFullScreen() and hasattr(self, "floating_close_btn") and self.floating_close_btn.isVisible():
            self._position_floating_close_btn()

    def changeEvent(self, event):
        if hasattr(super(), "changeEvent"):
            try:
                super().changeEvent(event)
            except Exception:
                pass
        if event.type() == QEvent.Type.WindowStateChange:
            if self.isFullScreen():
                if hasattr(self, "sidebar"):
                    self.sidebar.setVisible(False)
                if self.statusBar():
                    self.statusBar().setVisible(False)
                if self.menuBar():
                    self.menuBar().setVisible(False)
                if hasattr(self, "floating_close_btn"):
                    self.floating_close_btn.setVisible(True)
                    self._position_floating_close_btn()
                if hasattr(self, "btn_fullscreen"):
                    self.btn_fullscreen.setText("🗗")
                    self.btn_fullscreen.setToolTip("Выйти из полноэкранного режима (Esc / F11)")
            else:
                if hasattr(self, "sidebar"):
                    self.sidebar.setVisible(True)
                if self.statusBar():
                    self.statusBar().setVisible(True)
                if self.menuBar():
                    self.menuBar().setVisible(True)
                if hasattr(self, "floating_close_btn"):
                    self.floating_close_btn.setVisible(False)
                if hasattr(self, "btn_fullscreen"):
                    self.btn_fullscreen.setText("⛶")
                    self.btn_fullscreen.setToolTip("Полноэкранный режим чата (F11)")

    def nativeEvent(self, eventType, message):
        if hasattr(super(), "nativeEvent"):
            try:
                return super().nativeEvent(eventType, message)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return False, 0


__all__ = ["WindowStateMixin"]

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from typing import Optional
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtGui import QGuiApplication
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel
from qfluentwidgets import (
    MessageBoxBase,
    SubtitleLabel,
    BodyLabel,
    CaptionLabel,
    PlainTextEdit,
    PushButton,
    PrimaryPushButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    InfoBar,
    InfoBarPosition
)
from services.roleplay_prompt_builder import RoleplayPromptBuilder
from services.tavern_parser import TavernParser


class AnchorViewerDialog(MessageBoxBase):
    """
    Диалог просмотра и редактирования Depth-0 якоря сцены.
    Выполнен на компонентах QFluentWidgets в темной стилистике NeonRoute.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget, character_card, user_name: str, current_anchor: Optional[str] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.character_card = character_card
        self.user_name = user_name or "Игрок"
        self.char_name = getattr(character_card, "name", "Собеседник") if character_card else "Собеседник"
        self.archetype = getattr(character_card, "archetype", None) or TavernParser.detect_card_archetype(character_card)
        self.default_anchor = RoleplayPromptBuilder.get_default_depth_anchor(self.character_card, self.user_name).strip()
        self.initial_anchor = (current_anchor.strip() if current_anchor and current_anchor.strip() else self.default_anchor)

        self._init_widget()

    def _init_widget(self):
        # Настройка габаритов
        self.widget.setMinimumWidth(620)
        self.widget.setMaximumWidth(700)

        # Кастомный заголовок
        self.title_lbl = SubtitleLabel("⚓ Якорь сцены (Depth-0 Директива)", self)
        self.viewLayout.addWidget(self.title_lbl)

        # Метаданные сцены
        meta_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        meta_layout.setSpacing(16)

        self.btn_copy.clicked.connect(self._on_copy_clicked)

        actions_layout.addWidget(self.btn_copy)
        actions_layout.addStretch()

        self.yesButton.setText("Применить")
        self.cancelButton.setText("Отмена")

    def _on_reset_to_default(self):
        self.anchor_edit.setPlainText(self.default_anchor)
        InfoBar.info(
            title="Сброс",
            content="Восстановлен эталонный абстрактный якорь по умолчанию",
            parent=self.widget,
            position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
            duration=2000
        )

    def _on_copy_clicked(self):
        text = self.anchor_edit.toPlainText().strip()
        if text:
            QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
            InfoBar.success(
                title="Скопировано",
                content="Текст якоря помещен в буфер обмена",
                parent=self.widget,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                duration=2000
            )

    def get_configured_anchor(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Возвращает настроенный текст:
        - None, если текст совпадает с дефолтным (чистый сброс ключа в сессии).
        - Отредактированную строку, если пользователь задал кастомный текст.
        """
        current_text = self.anchor_edit.toPlainText().strip()
        if not current_text or current_text == self.default_anchor:
            return None
        return current_text
