    def _on_search_clicked(self, reset_page: bool = True):
        if reset_page:
            self.current_page = 1
            self.current_cursor = None
            self.next_cursor = None
            self.cursor_stack.clear()

        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        m_type = self.combo_type.currentData()
        base_arch = self.combo_arch.currentData()
        sort = self.combo_sort.currentData()
        nsfw = self.chk_nsfw.isChecked()

        self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(False)

        if self._search_worker and self._search_worker.isRunning():
            try:
                self._search_worker.results_ready.disconnect()
                self._search_worker.error_occurred.disconnect()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._search_worker.abort()
            self._search_worker.quit()
            self._search_worker.wait(300)
            if self._search_worker.isRunning():
                try:
                    self._search_worker.setParent(None)
                    _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS.append(self._search_worker)
                    self._search_worker.finished.connect(
                        lambda w=self._search_worker: _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS.remove(w) if w in _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS else None
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass

        self._search_worker = CivitaiSearchWorker(
            query=query,
            model_type=m_type,
            base_model=base_arch,
            sort=sort,
            nsfw=nsfw,
            page=self.current_page,
            cursor=self.current_cursor,
            parent=self
        )
        self._search_worker.results_ready.connect(self._on_results_ready)
        self._search_worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_search_error)
        self._search_worker.start()

    def _on_prev_page_clicked(self):
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        if query:
            if self.cursor_stack:
                self.current_cursor = self.cursor_stack.pop()
                self.current_page = max(1, self.current_page - 1)
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)
        else:
            if self.current_page > 1:
                self.current_page -= 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_next_page_clicked(self):
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        if query:
            if self.next_cursor is not None:
                self.cursor_stack.append(self.current_cursor)
                self.current_cursor = self.next_cursor
                self.current_page += 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)
        else:
            if self.current_page < self.total_pages:
                self.current_page += 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_results_ready(self, cards: list, total_pages: int, total_items: int, next_cursor: Optional[Any]):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.cards_data = cards
        self.list_results.clear()
        self._cached_thumb_paths.clear()

        self.next_cursor = next_cursor
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()

        if query:
            self.lbl_page_info.setText(f"Стр. {self.current_page}")
            self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(len(self.cursor_stack) > 0)
            self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(bool(self.next_cursor))
        else:
            self.total_pages = max(1, total_pages)
            self.lbl_page_info.setText(f"Стр. {self.current_page} из {self.total_pages} (найдено: {total_items})")
            self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(self.current_page > 1)
            self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(self.current_page < self.total_pages or bool(self.next_cursor))

        if self._thumb_worker and self._thumb_worker.isRunning():
            try:
                self._thumb_worker.thumb_loaded.disconnect()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._thumb_worker.abort()
            self._thumb_worker.quit()
            self._thumb_worker.wait(300)
            if self._thumb_worker.isRunning():
                try:
                    self._thumb_worker.setParent(None)
                    _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS.append(self._thumb_worker)
                    self._thumb_worker.finished.connect(
                        lambda w=self._thumb_worker: _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS.remove(w) if w in _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS else None
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass

        for c in cards:
            c_name = c["name"]
            short_name = c_name[:15] + ("…" if len(c_name) > 15 else "")
            sz_str = f"{c['size_mb'] / 1024.0:.1f} GB" if c['size_mb'] > 1024 else f"{c['size_mb']:.0f} MB"
            type_tag = "📦" if c["type"] == "Checkpoint" else "⚡"

            item_text = f"{short_name}\n{type_tag} {c['base_model']} • {sz_str}"
            placeholder = render_civitai_poster(None, name=c_name, width=130, height=150)
            item = QListWidgetItem(QIcon(placeholder), item_text)
            self.list_results.addItem(item)

        if cards:
            self._thumb_worker = CivitaiThumbnailsBatchWorker(cards, parent=self)
            self._thumb_worker.thumb_loaded.connect(self._on_thumb_loaded)
            self._thumb_worker.start()

            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.list_results.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            self.lbl_title.setText("Ничего не найдено")
            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.lbl_meta.setText("Попробуйте изменить запрос или фильтры архитектуры.")
            self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(render_civitai_poster(None, name="?", width=90, height=110))
            self.text_preview.clear()
            self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_thumb_loaded(self, row_idx: int, img_path: str):
        self._cached_thumb_paths[row_idx] = img_path
        item = self.list_results.item(row_idx)
        if item and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            poster = render_civitai_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=130, height=150)
            item.setIcon(QIcon(poster))

        if self.list_results.currentRow() == row_idx and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            preview_pix = render_civitai_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=90, height=110)
            self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(preview_pix)

    def _on_search_error(self, err: str):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.list_results.clear()
        self.lbl_title.setText("🔌 Ошибка загрузки каталога")
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #FF007F; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
        self.lbl_meta.setText("Сбой запроса")
        self.text_preview.setPlainText(f"Не удалось получить данные с Civitai:\n{err}")
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_card_selected(self, current: Optional[QListWidgetItem]):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        self.lbl_title.setText(f"{c['name']} ({c['version_name']})")
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")

        sz_str = f"{c['size_mb'] / 1024.0:.2f} GB" if c['size_mb'] > 1024 else f"{c['size_mb']:.0f} MB"
        self.lbl_meta.setText(f"Тип: {c['type']} | Архитектура: {c['base_model']} | Размер: {sz_str}")

        triggers = c.get("trained_words") or []
        if triggers:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText(f"🏷️ Триггер-слова: {', '.join(triggers[:6])}")
        else:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText("🏷️ Триггер-слова: не требуются (стандартный чекпоинт)")

        # Рекомендованные параметры из метаданных превью
        meta = c.get("meta") or {}
        sampler = meta.get("sampler") or "DPM++ 2M Karras"
        steps = meta.get("steps") or 25
        cfg = meta.get("cfgScale") or 6.0

        desc_parts = [
            f"⚙️ Рекомендованные автором параметры:\n• Сэмплер: {sampler}\n• Шаги: {steps}\n• CFG Scale: {cfg}",
            f"📄 Имя файла: {c['filename']}",
            f"📖 Описание:\n{c.get('description', '')}"
        ]
        self.text_preview.setPlainText("\n\n".join(desc_parts).strip())

        cached_path = self._cached_thumb_paths.get(row)
        pix = render_civitai_poster(cached_path, name=c["name"], width=90, height=110)
        self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(pix)

        self.btn_download.setEnabled(bool(c.get("download_url")))
        self.btn_download.setText(f"📥 Скачать {c['type']} ({sz_str})")

    def _on_download_clicked(self):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        filename = c["filename"]

        # Папка назначения: checkpoints или lora
        if c["type"] == "LORA":
            save_dir = self.target_dir.parent / "Lora" if self.target_dir else Path(r"C:\neyroGPD\models\Lora")
        else:
            save_dir = self.target_dir

        dest_file = save_dir / filename

        if dest_file.suffix.lower() != ".safetensors":
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Запрещенный формат модели",
                f"Загрузка файлов с расширением '{dest_file.suffix}' заблокирована в целях безопасности.\n\n"
                f"Разрешены строго безопасные веса в формате .safetensors. Файлы .ckpt и .pt запрещены."
            )
            return

        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_cancel_dl.setVisible(True)
        self.download_box.setVisible(True)
        self.dl_status_lbl.setText("Подключение к серверу загрузки...")
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(0)

        self._download_worker = CivitaiDownloadWorker(
            download_url=c["download_url"],
            dest_path=dest_file,
            expected_sha256=c.get("sha256"),
            parent=self
        )
        self._download_worker.progress_updated.connect(self._on_download_progress)
        self._download_worker.finished_successfully.connect(self._on_download_success)
        self._download_worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_download_error)
        self._download_worker.start()

    def _on_download_progress(self, percent: int, downloaded_mb: float, speed_mbps: float):
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(percent)
        self.dl_status_lbl.setText(f"Загрузка: {percent}% • {downloaded_mb:.1f} MB ({speed_mbps:.1f} MB/s)")

    def _on_cancel_download_clicked(self):
        if self._download_worker and self._download_worker.isRunning():
            try:
                self._download_worker.progress_updated.disconnect()
                self._download_worker.finished_successfully.disconnect()
                self._download_worker.error_occurred.disconnect()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._download_worker.abort()
            self._download_worker.quit()
            self._download_worker.wait(300)
            if self._download_worker.isRunning():
                try:
                    self._download_worker.setParent(None)
                    _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS.append(self._download_worker)
                    self._download_worker.finished.connect(
                        lambda w=self._download_worker: _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS.remove(w) if w in _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS else None
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self._download_worker = None
            self._reset_dl_ui()

    def _on_download_success(self, saved_path: Path):
        self._reset_dl_ui()
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        c = self.cards_data[row] if (0 <= row < len(self.cards_data)) else {}

        meta = c.get("meta") or {}
        triggers = c.get("trained_words") or []
        desc_text = f"{c.get('name', '')}. Теги: {', '.join(triggers[:8])}" if triggers else c.get('name', '')

        model_payload = {
            "id": c.get("id"),
            "name": c.get("name"),
            "filename": saved_path.name,
            "path": str(saved_path),
            "type": c.get("type"),
            "triggers": triggers,
            "description": desc_text,
            "guidance": f"Trigger words: {', '.join(triggers[:5])}" if triggers else "",
            "sampler": meta.get("sampler", "DPM++ 2M Karras"),
            "steps": int(meta.get("steps", 25)),
            "cfg_scale": float(meta.get("cfgScale", 6.0))
        }

        self.model_installed.emit(model_payload)
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Загрузка завершена",
            f"Модель успешно сохранена в папку Forge:\n{saved_path.name}\n\nОна автоматически зарегистрирована в роутере!"
        )
        self.accept()

    def _on_download_error(self, err: str):
        self._reset_dl_ui()
        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Ошибка загрузки", f"Не удалось завершить загрузку файла:\n{err}")

    def _reset_dl_ui(self):
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_cancel_dl.setVisible(False)
        self.download_box.setVisible(False)
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(0)

    def _stop_all_workers(self):
        """Безопасная остановка всех рабочих потоков диалога Civitai."""
        workers = [self._search_worker, self._thumb_worker, self._download_worker]
        for worker in workers:
            if worker is None:
                continue

            # 1) Отключение сигналов от UI
            for sig_name in (
                "results_ready", "error_occurred",
                "thumb_loaded",
                "progress_updated", "finished_successfully"
            ):
                sig = getattr(worker, sig_name, None)
                if sig is not None:
                    try:
                        sig.disconnect()
                    except Exception:
                        pass

            # 2) Вызов abort() и quit()
            if hasattr(worker, "abort"):
                try:
                    worker.abort()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            try:
                worker.requestInterruption()
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                worker.quit()
            except Exception:
                pass

            # 3) Если поток все еще isRunning(), wait(300). Если не успел — отвязать parent (setParent(None))
            try:
                if worker.isRunning():
                    worker.wait(300)
            except Exception:
                pass

            try:
                if worker.isRunning():
                    worker.setParent(None)
                    _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS.append(worker)
                    worker.finished.connect(
                        lambda w=worker: _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS.remove(w) if w in _CIVITAI_ORPHANED_WORKERS else None
                    )
            except Exception:
                pass

        self._search_worker = None
        self._thumb_worker = None
        self._download_worker = None

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        self._stop_all_workers()
        super().closeEvent(event)

    def reject(self):
        self._stop_all_workers()
        super().reject()

    def accept(self):
        self._stop_all_workers()
        super().accept()

Provides dedicated character LoRA discovery, SD 1.5 / SDXL / Pony compatibility evaluation,
and streaming downloads directly to Forge LoRA storage with automatic registry updates.

class CivitaiLoraDialog(QDialog):
    """
    Модальный диалог поиска и установки персонажных LoRA с Civitai
    с проверкой совместимости архитектур.
    """
    lora_installed = pyqtSignal(str, str, list)  # file_stem, character_name, trained_words

    @staticmethod
    def evaluate_compatibility(lora_base_model: str, active_forge_arch: str = "SD 1.5") -> dict:
        """
        Сравнивает семейство базовой модели LoRA с текущим активным чекпоинтом Forge.
        Возвращает словарь с флагом is_compatible, стилем бейджа и поясняющим текстом.
        """
        l_base = (lora_base_model or "").lower()
        a_base = (active_forge_arch or "").lower()

        is_sd15_lora = any(k in l_base for k in ["sd 1.5", "sd 1.4", "sd15"])
        is_sdxl_lora = any(k in l_base for k in ["sdxl", "pony", "illustrious"])

        is_current_sd15 = "1.5" in a_base
        is_current_sdxl = "xl" in a_base or "pony" in a_base

        if (is_sd15_lora and is_current_sd15) or (is_sdxl_lora and is_current_sdxl):
            return {
                "compatible": True,
                "badge": f"✅ {lora_base_model} (Совместимо)",
                "color": "#10B981",
                "warn_text": ""
            }
        else:
            return {
                "compatible": False,
                "badge": f"⚠️ {lora_base_model} (Несовместимо)",
                "color": "#F59E0B",
                "warn_text": (
                    f"Внимание: данная LoRA создана для архитектуры {lora_base_model}, "
                    f"в то время как ваш активный чекпоинт в Forge работает на {active_forge_arch}.\n"
                    f"Генерация артов с этой LoRA в текущем режиме вызовет визуальные артефакты или сбой."
                )
            }

    def _on_search_clicked(self, reset_page: bool = True):
        if reset_page:
            self.current_page = 1
            self.current_cursor = None
            self.next_cursor = None
            self.cursor_stack.clear()

        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        base_arch = self.combo_arch.currentData()
        sort = self.combo_sort.currentData()
        nsfw = self.chk_nsfw.isChecked()

        self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(False)

        self._search_worker = CivitaiSearchWorker(
            query=query,
            model_type="LORA",
            base_model=base_arch,
            sort=sort,
            nsfw=nsfw,
            page=self.current_page,
            cursor=self.current_cursor
        )
        self._search_worker.results_ready.connect(self._on_results_ready)
        self._search_worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_search_error)
        self._search_worker.start()

    def _on_prev_page_clicked(self):
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        if query:
            if self.cursor_stack:
                self.current_cursor = self.cursor_stack.pop()
                self.current_page = max(1, self.current_page - 1)
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)
        else:
            if self.current_page > 1:
                self.current_page -= 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_next_page_clicked(self):
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()
        if query:
            if self.next_cursor is not None:
                self.cursor_stack.append(self.current_cursor)
                self.current_cursor = self.next_cursor
                self.current_page += 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)
        else:
            if self.current_page < self.total_pages:
                self.current_page += 1
                self._on_search_clicked(reset_page=False)

    def _on_results_ready(self, cards: list, total_pages: int, total_items: int, next_cursor: Optional[Any]):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.cards_data = cards
        self.list_results.clear()
        self._cached_thumb_paths.clear()

        self.next_cursor = next_cursor
        query = self.input_search.text().strip()

        if query:
            self.lbl_page_info.setText(f"Стр. {self.current_page}")
            self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(len(self.cursor_stack) > 0)
            self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(bool(self.next_cursor))
        else:
            self.total_pages = max(1, total_pages)
            self.lbl_page_info.setText(f"Стр. {self.current_page} из {self.total_pages} (найдено: {total_items})")
            self.btn_prev_page.setEnabled(self.current_page > 1)
            self.btn_next_page.setEnabled(self.current_page < self.total_pages or bool(self.next_cursor))

        if self._thumb_worker and self._thumb_worker.isRunning():
            self._thumb_worker.abort()
            self._thumb_worker.wait(150)

        for c in cards:
            c_name = c["name"]
            short_name = c_name[:15] + ("…" if len(c_name) > 15 else "")
            sz_str = f"{c['size_mb'] / 1024.0:.1f} GB" if c['size_mb'] > 1024 else f"{c['size_mb']:.0f} MB"
            comp_info = self.evaluate_compatibility(c.get("base_model", ""), self.active_architecture)

            item_text = f"{short_name}\n{comp_info['badge']} • {sz_str}"
            placeholder = render_civitai_poster(None, name=c_name, width=130, height=150)
            item = QListWidgetItem(QIcon(placeholder), item_text)
            item.setToolTip(f"{c_name}\nАрхитектура: {c.get('base_model', '')}\n{comp_info['badge']}\nРазмер: {sz_str}")
            self.list_results.addItem(item)

        if cards:
            self._thumb_worker = CivitaiThumbnailsBatchWorker(cards)
            self._thumb_worker.thumb_loaded.connect(self._on_thumb_loaded)
            self._thumb_worker.start()

            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.list_results.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            self.lbl_title.setText("LoRA не найдены")
            self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
            self.lbl_compat_badge.setText("Совместимость: --")
            self.lbl_compat_badge.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 11px;")
            self.lbl_meta.setText("Попробуйте изменить поисковый запрос или фильтр архитектур.")
            self.lbl_warn_box.setVisible(False)
            self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(render_civitai_poster(None, name="?", width=90, height=110))
            self.text_preview.clear()
            self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_thumb_loaded(self, row_idx: int, img_path: str):
        self._cached_thumb_paths[row_idx] = img_path
        item = self.list_results.item(row_idx)
        if item and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            poster = render_civitai_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=130, height=150)
            item.setIcon(QIcon(poster))

        if self.list_results.currentRow() == row_idx and row_idx < len(self.cards_data):
            c_name = self.cards_data[row_idx]["name"]
            preview_pix = render_civitai_poster(img_path, name=c_name, width=90, height=110)
            self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(preview_pix)

    def _on_search_error(self, err: str):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.btn_search.setEnabled(True)
        self.list_results.clear()
        self.lbl_title.setText("🔌 Ошибка каталога Civitai")
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #FF007F; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")
        self.lbl_compat_badge.setText("")
        self.lbl_meta.setText("Сбой запроса")
        self.lbl_warn_box.setVisible(False)
        self.text_preview.setPlainText(f"Не удалось получить список LoRA с Civitai:\n{err}")
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_card_selected(self, current: Optional[QListWidgetItem]):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        self.lbl_title.setText(f"{c['name']} ({c['version_name']})")
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;")

        sz_str = f"{c['size_mb'] / 1024.0:.2f} GB" if c['size_mb'] > 1024 else f"{c['size_mb']:.0f} MB"
        self.lbl_meta.setText(f"Архитектура: {c['base_model']} | Размер: {sz_str}")

        # Бейдж совместимости
        comp_info = self.evaluate_compatibility(c.get("base_model", ""), self.active_architecture)
        self.lbl_compat_badge.setText(comp_info["badge"])
        self.lbl_compat_badge.setStyleSheet(f"color: {comp_info['color']}; font-weight: bold; font-size: 11px;")

        if not comp_info["compatible"]:
            self.lbl_warn_box.setText(comp_info["warn_text"])
            self.lbl_warn_box.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.lbl_warn_box.setVisible(False)

        triggers = c.get("trained_words") or []
        if triggers:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText(f"🏷️ Триггер-слова: {', '.join(triggers[:6])}")
        else:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText("🏷️ Триггер-слова: не указаны автором")

        meta = c.get("meta") or {}
        sampler = meta.get("sampler") or "DPM++ 2M Karras"
        steps = meta.get("steps") or 25
        cfg = meta.get("cfgScale") or 6.0

        desc_parts = [
            f"⚙️ Рекомендованные автором параметры:\n• Сэмплер: {sampler}\n• Шаги: {steps}\n• CFG Scale: {cfg}",
            f"📄 Имя файла: {c['filename']}",
            f"📖 Описание:\n{c.get('description', '')}"
        ]
        self.text_preview.setPlainText("\n\n".join(desc_parts).strip())

        cached_path = self._cached_thumb_paths.get(row)
        pix = render_civitai_poster(cached_path, name=c["name"], width=90, height=110)
        self.poster_preview_lbl.setPixmap(pix)

        self.btn_download.setEnabled(bool(c.get("download_url")))
        self.btn_download.setText(f"📥 Скачать LoRA ({sz_str})")

    def _on_download_clicked(self):
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self.cards_data):
            return

        c = self.cards_data[row]
        comp_info = self.evaluate_compatibility(c.get("base_model", ""), self.active_architecture)

        if not comp_info["compatible"]:
            resp = QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Несовпадение архитектуры",
                f"{comp_info['warn_text']}\n\nВы действительно хотите скачать этот файл?",
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
            )
            if resp != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
                return

        filename = c["filename"]
        dest_file = DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR / filename
        DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.btn_download.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_cancel_dl.setVisible(True)
        self.download_box.setVisible(True)
        self.dl_status_lbl.setText("Подключение к серверу загрузки...")
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(0)

        self._download_worker = CivitaiDownloadWorker(
            download_url=c["download_url"],
            dest_path=dest_file
        )
        self._download_worker.progress_updated.connect(self._on_download_progress)
        self._download_worker.finished_successfully.connect(self._on_download_success)
        self._download_worker.error_occurred.connect(self._on_download_error)
        self._download_worker.start()

    def _on_download_progress(self, percent: int, downloaded_mb: float, speed_mbps: float):
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(percent)
        self.dl_status_lbl.setText(f"Загрузка LoRA: {percent}% • {downloaded_mb:.1f} MB ({speed_mbps:.1f} MB/s)")

    def _on_cancel_download_clicked(self):
        if self._download_worker and self._download_worker.isRunning():
            self._download_worker.abort()
            self._download_worker.wait(300)
            self._reset_dl_ui()

    def _on_download_success(self, saved_path: Path):
        self._reset_dl_ui()
        row = self.list_results.currentRow()
        c = self.cards_data[row] if (0 <= row < len(self.cards_data)) else {}

        trained_words = c.get("trained_words") or []
        file_stem = saved_path.stem
        char_name = self.character_name or file_stem

        # Регистрация LoRA в lora_registry.json
        LoraManager.register_character_lora(char_name, file_stem, trained_words)
        self.lora_installed.emit(file_stem, char_name, trained_words)
        self.accept()

    def _on_download_error(self, err: str):
        self._reset_dl_ui()
        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Ошибка загрузки", f"Не удалось завершить загрузку LoRA:\n{err}")

    def _reset_dl_ui(self):
        self.btn_download.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_cancel_dl.setVisible(False)
        self.download_box.setVisible(False)
        self.dl_progress_bar.setValue(0)

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        if self._thumb_worker and self._thumb_worker.isRunning():
            self._thumb_worker.abort()
            self._thumb_worker.wait(150)
        if self._download_worker and self._download_worker.isRunning():
            self._download_worker.abort()
            self._download_worker.wait(200)
        super().closeEvent(event)

"""
Clean Cache and Temporary Files Dialog for NeonRoute
Calculates disk usage and safely cleans Forge/Gradio cache, app logs, and generated outputs
using background QThreads without blocking the PyQt6 GUI event loop.
"""

import os
import shutil
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QThread, pyqtSignal
from PyQt6.QtGui import QCursor
import json
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QCheckBox,
    QPushButton, QProgressBar, QMessageBox, QFrame, QWidget
)

from config import FORGE_ROOT_DIR, HISTORY_DIR, BASE_DIR, LOGS_DIR, DATA_DIR, OUTPUTS_DIR, BACKGROUNDS_DIR, CONFIG_PATH, WORKSPACE_DIR

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.CleanCacheDialog")


def get_protected_background_paths() -> set[Path]:
    """
    Returns a set of resolved absolute Paths for backgrounds that must not be deleted:
    - Active background from config.json ('background_path')
    - Any background_image or background_path referenced in any chat history JSON
    """
    protected = set()
    try:
        if CONFIG_PATH.exists():
            with open(CONFIG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                cfg = json.load(f)
                bg_cfg = cfg.get("background_path")
                if bg_cfg:
                    p = Path(bg_cfg)
                    if not p.is_absolute():
                        p = BASE_DIR / p
                    if p.exists():
                        protected.add(p.resolve())
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Error reading config.json for protected backgrounds: {e}")

    try:
        if HISTORY_DIR.exists():
            for chat_file in HISTORY_DIR.glob("chat_*.json"):
                try:
                    with open(chat_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        session_data = json.load(f)
                    for key in ("background_path", "background_image"):
                        bg_val = session_data.get(key)
                        if bg_val:
                            p = Path(bg_val)
                            if not p.is_absolute():
                                p = BASE_DIR / p
                            if p.exists():
                                protected.add(p.resolve())
                except Exception:
                    pass
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Error scanning history for protected backgrounds: {e}")

    return protected


def _get_orphan_cast_files() -> List[Path]:
    """Finds cast_*.json files in history/ that do not have a matching chat_*.json."""
    orphans = []
    try:
        if HISTORY_DIR.exists():
            for cast_file in HISTORY_DIR.glob("cast_*.json"):
                stem = cast_file.stem
                s_id = stem[5:] if stem.startswith("cast_") else ""
                if s_id and not (HISTORY_DIR / f"chat_{s_id}.json").exists():
                    orphans.append(cast_file)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Error finding orphan cast files: {e}")
    return orphans


def _get_orphan_workspace_project_dirs() -> List[Path]:
    """Finds project folders in WORKSPACE_DIR / 'projects' without matching chat_<id>.json in HISTORY_DIR."""
    orphans = []
    try:
        projects_dir = WORKSPACE_DIR / "projects"
        if projects_dir.exists() and projects_dir.is_dir():
            for p in projects_dir.iterdir():
                if p.is_dir():
                    s_id = p.name
                    if not (HISTORY_DIR / f"chat_{s_id}.json").exists():
                        orphans.append(p)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Error finding orphan workspace projects: {e}")
    return orphans


def format_size(size_bytes: int) -> str:
    """Formats bytes into human-readable B, KB, MB, GB."""
    if size_bytes <= 0:
        return "0 MB"
    val = float(size_bytes)
    for unit in ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB']:
        if val < 1024.0 or unit == 'TB':
            return f"{val:.1f} {unit}"
        val /= 1024.0
    return f"{val:.1f} GB"


def get_dir_size(path: Path) -> int:
    """Calculates total size in bytes of a directory recursively."""
    total = 0
    if not path.exists():
        return 0
    try:
        if path.is_file():
            return path.stat().st_size
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(str(path)):
            for f in files:
                try:
                    fp = os.path.join(root, f)
                    total += os.path.getsize(fp)
                except (OSError, PermissionError):
                    pass
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug(f"Error calculating size for {path}: {e}")
    return total


class CacheScanWorker(QThread):
    """Calculates disk sizes for cache categories in background."""
    scan_completed = pyqtSignal(dict)  # category_key -> size_in_bytes

    def __init__(self, targets: Dict[str, List[Path]], parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.targets = targets

    def run(self):
        try:
            results = {}
            protected_bgs = get_protected_background_paths()
            for key, paths in self.targets.items():
                total = 0
                if key == "backgrounds":
                    for p in paths:
                        if p.is_file() and p.resolve() not in protected_bgs:
                            total += get_dir_size(p)
                        elif p.is_dir():
                            for f in p.rglob("*"):
                                if f.is_file() and f.resolve() not in protected_bgs:
                                    total += get_dir_size(f)
                else:
                    for p in paths:
                        total += get_dir_size(p)
                results[key] = total
            self.scan_completed.emit(results)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error in CacheScanWorker: {e}", exc_info=True)
            self.scan_completed.emit({})



class CacheCleanWorker(QThread):
    """Deletes selected cache files and directories in background."""
    progress_updated = pyqtSignal(str)
    clean_completed = pyqtSignal(int, list)  # freed_bytes, list of cleared description strings

    def __init__(self, selected_targets: Dict[str, List[Path]], parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.selected_targets = selected_targets

    def run(self):
        total_freed = 0
        cleared_summary = []
        protected_bgs = get_protected_background_paths()

        for category, paths in self.selected_targets.items():
            self.progress_updated.emit(f"Очистка: {category}...")
            cat_freed = 0

            if "backgrounds" in category.lower() or "обои" in category.lower():
                for p in paths:
                    if not p.exists():
                        continue
                    files_to_check = [p] if p.is_file() else list(p.rglob("*"))
                    for f in files_to_check:
                        if f.is_file() and f.resolve() not in protected_bgs:
                            try:
                                sz = f.stat().st_size
                                f.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                                cat_freed += sz
                            except Exception as e:
                                logger.warning(f"Failed to delete background {f}: {e}")
                total_freed += cat_freed
                cleared_summary.append(f"{category} ({format_size(cat_freed)})")
                continue

            for p in paths:
                if not p.exists():
                    continue

                cat_freed += get_dir_size(p)

                try:
                    if p.is_file():
                        p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    elif p.is_dir():
                        # Delete contents or entire dir and recreate empty
                        current_active_log = (LOGS_DIR / "neonroute.log").resolve()
                        for item in p.iterdir():
                            if item.resolve() == current_active_log:
                                try:
                                    with open(item, "r+", encoding="utf-8") as f_trunc:
                                        f_trunc.truncate(0)
                                except (PermissionError, OSError):
                                    pass
                                continue
                            try:
                                if item.is_file() or item.is_symlink():
                                    item.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                                elif item.is_dir():
                                    shutil.rmtree(item, ignore_errors=True)
                            except (PermissionError, OSError) as e:
                                logger.warning(f"Файл заблокирован процессом Windows, пропуск: {item} ({e})")
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.error(f"Error cleaning {p}: {e}")

            total_freed += cat_freed
            cleared_summary.append(f"{category} ({format_size(cat_freed)})")

        # Компактная очистка и оптимизация версий LanceDB
        try:
            self.progress_updated.emit("Оптимизация базы векторов LanceDB...")
            from services.memory_db import _get_embedding_engine, _LANCE_LOCK
            embed_model, facts_t, rp_t = _get_embedding_engine()
            for tbl in (facts_t, rp_t):
                if tbl:
                    with _LANCE_LOCK:
                        try:
                            if hasattr(tbl, "compact_files"):
                                tbl.compact_files()
                        except Exception as e:
                            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] compact_files error: {e}")
                        try:
                            if hasattr(tbl, "cleanup_old_versions"):
                                tbl.cleanup_old_versions()
                        except Exception as e:
                            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] cleanup_old_versions error: {e}")

            # Если в HISTORY_DIR нет ни одного РП-чата — полная очистка таблицы rp_memories
            has_rp_chats = False
            if HISTORY_DIR.exists():
                for cf in HISTORY_DIR.glob("chat_*.json"):
                    try:
                        with open(cf, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f_chat:
                            c_data = json.load(f_chat)
                            if c_data.get("mode") == "roleplay":
                                has_rp_chats = True
                                break
                    except Exception:
                        pass

            if not has_rp_chats:
                import lancedb
                from config import DATA_DIR
                lance_path = DATA_DIR / "vector_memory"
                with _LANCE_LOCK:
                    db = lancedb.connect(str(lance_path))
                    tables = db.list_tables() if hasattr(db, "list_tables") else db.table_names()
                    if "rp_memories" in tables:
                        try:
                            # Удаление директории таблицы или drop_table
                            rp_dir = lance_path / "rp_memories.lance"
                            if rp_dir.exists():
                                shutil.rmtree(rp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
                            else:
                                db.drop_table("rp_memories")
                        except Exception as e_drop:
                            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] Drop table error: {e_drop}")

                    if embed_model:
                        try:
                            dummy_vec = list(embed_model.embed(["init"]))[0].tolist()
                            db.create_table(
                                "rp_memories",
                                data=[{
                                    "id": "init_id",
                                    "session_id": "init_sess",
                                    "text": "init",
                                    "vector": dummy_vec,
                                    "timestamp": "0"
                                }]
                            )
                        except Exception as e_cr:
                            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] Recreate table error: {e_cr}")

                cleared_summary.append("Векторная память РП (LanceDB сброшена)")
        except Exception as e_lance:
            logger.debug(f"[CleanCache] Ошибка очистки LanceDB: {e_lance}")

        from ui.components.chat_bubble import _IMAGE_CACHE_LOCK, _IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE
        from PyQt6.QtGui import QPixmapCache
        with _IMAGE_CACHE_LOCK:
            _IMAGE_PREVIEW_CACHE.clear()
        QPixmapCache.clear()

        self.clean_completed.emit(total_freed, cleared_summary)

        self.btn_clean.setObjectName("BtnClean")
        self.btn_clean.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.btn_clean.clicked.connect(self._on_clean_clicked)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_clean)

        main_layout.addLayout(btn_layout)

    def _start_size_scan(self):
        """Launches non-blocking size calculation."""
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.scan_worker = CacheScanWorker(self.target_paths, self)
        self.scan_worker.scan_completed.connect(self._on_scan_completed)
        self.scan_worker.start()

    def _on_scan_completed(self, sizes: dict):
        self.category_sizes = sizes
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.lbl_status.setText("Подсчет завершен. Выберите элементы и нажмите 'Очистить'.")

        self.lbl_size_forge.setText(format_size(sizes.get("forge_cache", 0)))
        self.lbl_size_logs.setText(format_size(sizes.get("app_logs", 0)))
        self.lbl_size_chub.setText(format_size(sizes.get("chub_cache", 0)))
        self.lbl_size_backgrounds.setText(format_size(sizes.get("backgrounds", 0)))
        self.lbl_size_outputs.setText(format_size(sizes.get("outputs", 0)))

    def _on_clean_clicked(self):
        # Prepare selected targets
        selected: Dict[str, List[Path]] = {}
        if self.chk_forge.isChecked():
            selected["Кэш Forge/Gradio"] = self.target_paths["forge_cache"]
        if self.chk_logs.isChecked():
            # For history dir, only clean temporary .tmp and .bak files and orphan cast files, never chat_*.json
            paths_to_clean = [
                LOGS_DIR,
                BASE_DIR / "neonroute.log",
                *list(HISTORY_DIR.glob("*.tmp")),
                *list(HISTORY_DIR.glob("*.bak")),
                *_get_orphan_cast_files()
            ]
            selected["Логи и временные файлы"] = paths_to_clean
        if self.chk_chub.isChecked():
            selected["Кэш каталога Chub.ai"] = self.target_paths["chub_cache"]
        if self.chk_backgrounds.isChecked():
            selected["Неиспользуемые обои рабочего пространства"] = self.target_paths["backgrounds"]
        if self.chk_outputs.isChecked():
            # Extra confirmation if deleting user generated images
            reply = QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Подтверждение удаления изображений",
                "Вы выбрали удаление всех сгенерированных изображений из C:\\NeonRoute\\outputs\\.\n\n"
                "Вы уверены, что хотите удалить их?",
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.No
            )
            if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
                return
            selected["Сгенерированные изображения"] = self.target_paths["outputs"]

        if not selected:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Очистка", "Не выбрано ни одной категории для очистки.")
            return

        # Disable buttons and start progress
        self.btn_clean.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_cancel.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_forge.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_logs.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_chub.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_backgrounds.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_outputs.setEnabled(False)

        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.lbl_status.setText("Выполняется безопасное удаление файлов...")

        self.clean_worker = CacheCleanWorker(selected, self)
        self.clean_worker.progress_updated.connect(lambda msg: self.lbl_status.setText(msg))
        self.clean_worker.clean_completed.connect(self._on_clean_completed)
        self.clean_worker.start()

    def _on_clean_completed(self, freed_bytes: int, summary: list):
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.lbl_status.setText("Очистка успешно завершена.")

        freed_str = format_size(freed_bytes)
        summary_text = "\n• " + "\n• ".join(summary) if summary else ""

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Очистка завершена",
            f"Очистка успешно выполнена!\nОсвобождено дискового пространства: {freed_str}{summary_text}"
        )
        self.accept()

from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton,
    QCheckBox, QScrollArea, QWidget, QFrame, QMessageBox, QProgressBar
)
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from services.environment_doctor import EnvironmentDoctor, PipInstallWorker
from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager

class DependencyDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Проверка компонентов NeonRoute")
        self.resize(640, 520)
        self.setModal(True)
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QDialog { background-color: #1a1a1f; color: #ffffff; }
            QLabel { color: #ffffff; }
            QScrollArea { border: 1px solid #2d2d38; background: transparent; }
            QScrollBar:vertical { border: none; background: #1a1a1f; width: 8px; }
            QScrollBar::handle:vertical { background: #3d3d4d; border-radius: 4px; }
        """)

        self.missing_items = EnvironmentDoctor.check_missing()
        self.checkboxes = {}
        self.worker = None

        self._init_ui()

    def _init_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setSpacing(14)
        layout.setContentsMargins(20, 20, 20, 20)

        h_lbl = QLabel("Дополнительные компоненты для режима Инженер")
        h_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #00e5ff;")
        layout.addWidget(h_lbl)

        sub_lbl = QLabel("Для полной автономной работы модулей Инженера рекомендуются следующие библиотеки:")
        sub_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 13px; color: #a0a0b0;")
        sub_lbl.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(sub_lbl)

        scroll = QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        container = QWidget()
        c_layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        c_layout.setSpacing(10)
        c_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)

        if not self.missing_items:
            all_ok_lbl = QLabel("✅ Все необходимые компоненты и библиотеки уже установлены!")
            all_ok_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 14px; color: #00e676; padding: 20px;")
            c_layout.addWidget(all_ok_lbl)
        else:
            for item in self.missing_items:
                card = QFrame()
                card.setStyleSheet("background-color: #22222c; border: 1px solid #323242; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px;")
                card_l = QVBoxLayout(card)

                cb = QCheckBox(item["name"])
                cb.setStyleSheet("font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff;")
                if item["type"] == "python":
                    cb.setChecked(True)
                    self.checkboxes[item["package"]] = cb
                else:
                    cb.setChecked(False)
                    cb.setEnabled(False)

                desc = QLabel(item["description"])
                desc.setStyleSheet("font-size: 12px; color: #c0c0d0; margin-left: 20px;")
                desc.setWordWrap(True)

                conseq = QLabel(f"Если не ставить: {item['consequence']}")
                conseq.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #ffb74d; margin-left: 20px;")
                conseq.setWordWrap(True)

                card_l.addWidget(cb)
                card_l.addWidget(desc)
                card_l.addWidget(conseq)

                if item["type"] == "binary" and "install_guide" in item:
                    guide = QLabel(f"Подсказка: {item['install_guide']}")
                    guide.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #80cbc4; margin-left: 20px;")
                    guide.setWordWrap(True)
                    card_l.addWidget(guide)

                c_layout.addWidget(card)

        c_layout.addStretch()
        scroll.setWidget(container)
        layout.addWidget(scroll)

        # Прогресс-бар
        self.progress_bar = QProgressBar()
        self.progress_bar.setStyleSheet("""
            QProgressBar { border: 1px solid #3d3d4d; border-radius: 4px; text-align: center; color: white; background: #15151a; height: 18px; }
            QProgressBar::chunk { background-color: #00e5ff; }
        """)
        self.progress_bar.setRange(0, 0)
        self.progress_bar.hide()
        layout.addWidget(self.progress_bar)

        self.status_lbl = QLabel("")
        self.status_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-size: 12px; color: #00e5ff;")
        self.status_lbl.hide()
        layout.addWidget(self.status_lbl)

        # Чекбокс «Больше не показывать»
        self.cb_dont_show = QCheckBox("Больше не показывать это окно при запуске")
        self.cb_dont_show.setStyleSheet("color: #a0a0b0; font-size: 12px;")
        layout.addWidget(self.cb_dont_show)

        # Кнопки
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_layout.addStretch()

        self.btn_skip = QPushButton("Пропустить")
        self.btn_skip.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton { background-color: #2d2d38; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; }
            QPushButton:hover { background-color: #3d3d4d; }
        """)
        self.btn_skip.clicked.connect(self._on_skip)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_skip)

        self.btn_install = QPushButton("Установить выбранное")
        self.btn_install.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton { background-color: #00b0ff; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 13px; }
            QPushButton:hover { background-color: #40c4ff; }
            QPushButton:disabled { background-color: #555566; color: #888888; }
        """)
        self.btn_install.setEnabled(bool(self.checkboxes))
        self.btn_install.clicked.connect(self._on_install)
        btn_layout.addWidget(self.btn_install)

        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)

    def _on_skip(self):
        if self.cb_dont_show.isChecked():
            cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
            cfg["check_dependencies_on_startup"] = False
            ConfigManager.save_config(cfg)

            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Проверка компонентов",
                "Договорились, больше не буду беспокоить при старте!\n\n"
                "Если компоненты понадобятся позже — вы всегда можете запустить эту проверку вручную через верхнее меню:\n"
                "«Справка» → «Проверка компонентов...»."
            )
        self.reject()

    def _on_install(self):
        to_install = [pkg for pkg, cb in self.checkboxes.items() if cb.isChecked()]
        if not to_install:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Внимание", "Не выбран ни один компонент для установки.")
            return

        self.btn_install.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_skip.setEnabled(False)
        self.progress_bar.show()
        self.status_lbl.show()

        self.worker = PipInstallWorker(to_install)
        self.worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        self.worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        self.worker.start()

    def _on_progress(self, msg: str):
        self.status_lbl.setText(msg)

    def _on_finished(self, success: bool, msg: str):
        self.progress_bar.hide()
        self.status_lbl.hide()
        self.btn_skip.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_install.setEnabled(True)

        if success:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Успех", msg)
            self.accept()
        else:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Ошибка установки", msg)

    def _get_available_models(self) -> List[str]:
        """Получает список доступных .gguf моделей через ServerConfigResolver и lm_client."""
        models: List[str] = []
        try:
            from services.server_config import ServerConfigResolver
            discovered = ServerConfigResolver.discover_gguf_models()
            if discovered:
                models.extend(list(discovered.keys()))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Ошибка ServerConfigResolver.discover_gguf_models: {e}")

        parent_win = getattr(self, "_parent_ref", None) or self.parent()
        if parent_win and hasattr(parent_win, "lm_client") and parent_win.lm_client:
            try:
                client_models = parent_win.lm_client.get_models() or []
                for m in client_models:
                    if m not in models:
                        models.append(m)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(f"Ошибка получения моделей от lm_client: {e}")

        if not models and parent_win and hasattr(parent_win, "lm_combo"):
            combo = parent_win.lm_combo
            if hasattr(combo, "count"):
                for i in range(combo.count()):
                    txt = combo.itemText(i).strip()
                    if txt and not txt.startswith("default") and txt not in models:
                        models.append(txt)

        return models

    def _populate_combo(self, combo: QComboBox, current_val: str, models: List[str]) -> None:
        combo.blockSignals(True)
        combo.clear()
        for m in models:
            combo.addItem(m)
        if current_val:
            idx = combo.findText(current_val)
            if idx >= 0:
                combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            else:
                combo.addItem(current_val)
                combo.setCurrentIndex(combo.count() - 1)
        elif combo.count() > 0:
            combo.setCurrentIndex(0)
        combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _load_models_and_settings(self) -> None:
        """Считывает сохранённые модели из config.json и заполняет комбобоксы."""
        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        asst_model = (cfg.get("assistant_model_name") or cfg.get("active_model", "")).strip()
        rp_model = (cfg.get("rp_model_name") or cfg.get("active_model", "")).strip()
        eng_model = (cfg.get("engineer_model_name") or cfg.get("engineer_model", "")).strip()

        models = self._get_available_models()

        self._populate_combo(self.combo_assistant, asst_model, models)
        self._populate_combo(self.combo_rp, rp_model, models)
        self._populate_combo(self.combo_engineer, eng_model, models)

    def _on_refresh_clicked(self) -> None:
        """Обновляет список моделей при нажатии на кнопку обновления."""
        asst_sel = self.combo_assistant.currentText().strip()
        rp_sel = self.combo_rp.currentText().strip()
        eng_sel = self.combo_engineer.currentText().strip()

        models = self._get_available_models()

        self._populate_combo(self.combo_assistant, asst_sel, models)
        self._populate_combo(self.combo_rp, rp_sel, models)
        self._populate_combo(self.combo_engineer, eng_sel, models)

    def _on_save_clicked(self) -> None:
        """
        Сохраняет выбранные модели для всех трех режимов в config.json.
        При необходимости инициирует фоновый hot-swap активной модели.
        """
        asst_model = self.combo_assistant.currentText().strip()
        rp_model = self.combo_rp.currentText().strip()
        eng_model = self.combo_engineer.currentText().strip()

        # 1. Запись в config.json
        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        cfg["assistant_model_name"] = asst_model
        cfg["rp_model_name"] = rp_model
        cfg["engineer_model_name"] = eng_model
        cfg["engineer_model"] = eng_model
        ConfigManager.save_config(cfg)

        parent_win = getattr(self, "_parent_ref", None) or self.parent()
        if parent_win:
            if hasattr(parent_win, "app_config") and isinstance(parent_win.app_config, dict):
                parent_win.app_config["assistant_model_name"] = asst_model
                parent_win.app_config["rp_model_name"] = rp_model
                parent_win.app_config["engineer_model_name"] = eng_model
                parent_win.app_config["engineer_model"] = eng_model

            # Определение активного режима текущей сессии
            current_sess = getattr(parent_win, "current_session", None)
            active_mode = "assistant"
            if current_sess and isinstance(current_sess, dict):
                raw_mode = str(current_sess.get("mode") or "assistant").lower()
                raw_type = str(current_sess.get("type") or "").lower()
                if raw_type == "engineering" or raw_mode in ("engineer", "engineering"):
                    active_mode = "engineer"
                elif raw_mode in ("rp", "roleplay"):
                    active_mode = "rp"
                else:
                    active_mode = "assistant"
            elif hasattr(parent_win, "is_engineer_mode_active") and parent_win.is_engineer_mode_active():
                active_mode = "engineer"

            if active_mode == "engineer":
                target_model = eng_model
            elif active_mode == "rp":
                target_model = rp_model
            else:
                target_model = asst_model

            current_loaded = getattr(getattr(parent_win, "lm_client", None), "_last_loaded_model_id", None) or getattr(parent_win, "active_lms_model", "")
            if target_model:
                parent_win.active_lms_model = target_model
                if current_sess and isinstance(current_sess, dict) and not current_sess.get("is_model_locked", False):
                    current_sess["model_id"] = target_model
                    if hasattr(parent_win, "_save_current_session"):
                        try:
                            parent_win._save_current_session()
                        except Exception as e:
                            logger.warning(f"Ошибка сохранения сессии при смене модели: {e}")

                if hasattr(parent_win, "lm_combo") and parent_win.lm_combo:
                    idx = parent_win.lm_combo.findText(target_model)
                    if idx >= 0:
                        parent_win.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
                    else:
                        parent_win.lm_combo.addItem(target_model)
                        parent_win.lm_combo.setCurrentIndex(parent_win.lm_combo.count() - 1)

                if current_loaded != target_model and hasattr(parent_win, "lm_client") and hasattr(parent_win.lm_client, "ensure_model_loaded"):
                    import threading
                    def _hot_swap():
                        try:
                            parent_win.lm_client.ensure_model_loaded(preferred_model=target_model)
                        except Exception as err:
                            logger.warning(f"[ModeModelSettingsDialog] Ошибка подгрузки модели: {err}")
                    threading.Thread(target=_hot_swap, daemon=True).start()

        self.accept()


ModeModelSettingsDialog = EngineerSettingsDialog

"""

class DocumentCardWidget(SimpleCardWidget):
    """
    Карточка документа базы знаний на базе SimpleCardWidget qfluentwidgets.
    Отображает иконку типа, имя файла, метаданные, чипы извлеченных триггеров и кнопку удаления.
    """

    def __init__(self, doc: Dict[str, Any], on_delete: Callable[[str], None], parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.doc = doc
        self.filename = doc.get("filename", "")
        self.on_delete = on_delete

        self.setObjectName("DocumentCardWidget")
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            SimpleCardWidget#DocumentCardWidget {
                background-color: rgba(18, 24, 38, 0.85);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.18);
                border-radius: 10px;
                padding: 10px;
            }
            SimpleCardWidget#DocumentCardWidget:hover {
                border-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.40);
                background-color: rgba(22, 30, 48, 0.95);
            }
        """)

        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        root_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 10, 12, 10)
        root_layout.setSpacing(8)

        # 1. Верхняя строка: Иконка + Имя и метаданные + Кнопка удаления
        header_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        header_layout.setSpacing(10)

        # Определение иконки файла
        ext = Path(self.filename).suffix.lower()
        ICON_MAP = {
            ".pdf": getattr(FIF, "DOCUMENT", FIF.DOCUMENT),
            ".txt": getattr(FIF, "DOCUMENT", FIF.DOCUMENT),
            ".md": getattr(FIF, "DOCUMENT", FIF.DOCUMENT),
            ".json": getattr(FIF, "CODE", FIF.DOCUMENT),
        }
        icon = ICON_MAP.get(ext.lower(), FIF.DOCUMENT)
        icon_widget = IconWidget(icon, self)
        icon_widget.setFixedSize(24, 24)
        header_layout.addWidget(icon_widget, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)

        # Текстовые метаданные
        title_meta_layout = QVBoxLayout()
        title_meta_layout.setSpacing(2)

        name_lbl = StrongBodyLabel(self.filename, self)
        name_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #F8FAFC; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px;")
        title_meta_layout.addWidget(name_lbl)

        size_kb = self.doc.get("size_kb", 0.0)
        lines = self.doc.get("line_count", 0)
        pages = self.doc.get("page_count")
        updated = self.doc.get("updated_at", "")
        date_str = updated[:10] if updated else ""

        if pages is not None:
            count_str = f"{pages} стр."
        else:
            count_str = f"{lines} строк"

        meta_text = f"{size_kb:.1f} КБ • {count_str}"
        if date_str:
            meta_text += f" • {date_str}"

        meta_lbl = CaptionLabel(meta_text, self)
        meta_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 11px;")
        title_meta_layout.addWidget(meta_lbl)

        header_layout.addLayout(title_meta_layout, 1)

        # Кнопка удаления
        btn_delete = TransparentToolButton(FIF.DELETE, self)
        btn_delete.setToolTip("Удалить документ")
        btn_delete.clicked.connect(lambda: self.on_delete(self.filename))
        header_layout.addWidget(btn_delete, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)

        root_layout.addLayout(header_layout)

        # 2. Нижняя строка: Контейнер триггеров
        triggers: List[str] = self.doc.get("triggers", [])
        if triggers:
            triggers_frame = QWidget(self)
            triggers_layout = FlowLayout(triggers_frame, needAni=False)
            triggers_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 2, 0, 0)
            triggers_layout.setSpacing(6)

            for trig in triggers:
                chip = PillPushButton(trig, triggers_frame)
                chip.setEnabled(False)  # Чип только для отображения
                chip.setFixedHeight(22)
                chip.setStyleSheet("""
                    PillPushButton {
                        background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08);
                        color: #00F0FF;
                        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.28);
                        border-radius: 11px;
                        padding: 1px 10px;
                        font-size: 11px;
                        font-weight: 500;
                    }
                    PillPushButton:disabled {
                        background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08);
                        color: #00F0FF;
                        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.28);
                    }
                """)
                triggers_layout.addWidget(chip)

            root_layout.addWidget(triggers_frame)
        else:
            no_trig = CaptionLabel("Триггеры не извлечены (документ пуст или содержит только код/разметку)", self)
            no_trig.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-style: italic; font-size: 11px;")
            root_layout.addWidget(no_trig)

        self.stack = QStackedWidget(self)
        root_layout.addWidget(self.stack, 1)

        # ── Вкладка 1: «📚 База знаний» ──
        self.docs_page = QWidget(self)
        docs_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.docs_page)
        docs_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 6, 0, 0)
        docs_layout.setSpacing(10)

        toolbar_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        toolbar_layout.setSpacing(10)

        self.btn_add = PrimaryPushButton(FIF.ADD, "Добавить документ", self.docs_page)
        self.btn_add.setToolTip("Импортировать файл в базу знаний")
        self.btn_add.clicked.connect(self._on_add_document_clicked)
        toolbar_layout.addWidget(self.btn_add)

        self.btn_open_folder = PushButton(FIF.FOLDER, "Открыть папку", self.docs_page)
        self.btn_open_folder.setToolTip("Открыть проводник с папкой knowledge_base/")
        self.btn_open_folder.clicked.connect(self._on_open_folder_clicked)
        toolbar_layout.addWidget(self.btn_open_folder)

        self.btn_sync = TransparentToolButton(FIF.SYNC, self.docs_page)
        self.btn_sync.setToolTip("Синхронизировать")
        self.btn_sync.clicked.connect(self._on_sync_clicked)
        toolbar_layout.addWidget(self.btn_sync)

        toolbar_layout.addStretch(1)
        docs_layout.addLayout(toolbar_layout)

        self.scroll_area = SingleDirectionScrollArea(self.docs_page)
        self.scroll_area.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self.scroll_area.setStyleSheet("""
            QScrollArea {
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
                border-radius: 8px;
                background-color: rgba(14, 19, 31, 0.6);
            }
        """)

        self.cards_container = QWidget()
        self.cards_container.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
        self.cards_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.cards_container)
        self.cards_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)
        self.cards_layout.setSpacing(10)
        self.cards_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)

        self.scroll_area.setWidget(self.cards_container)
        docs_layout.addWidget(self.scroll_area, 1)

        self.stack.addWidget(self.docs_page)

        # ── Вкладка 2: «⚡ Скиллы Эларии» ──
        self.skills_page = QWidget(self)
        self._setup_skills_ui()
        self.stack.addWidget(self.skills_page)

        # ── Вкладка 3: «⚙️ Системный промпт» ──
        self.prompt_page = QWidget(self)
        self._setup_prompt_ui()
        self.stack.addWidget(self.prompt_page)

        def _on_tab_changed(key: str):
            idx_map = {"tab_docs": 0, "tab_skills": 1, "tab_prompt": 2}
            idx = idx_map.get(key, 0)
            self.stack.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            if idx == 0:
                self.reload_documents()
            elif idx == 1:
                self._load_skills_list()
            elif idx == 2:
                self._load_system_prompt()

        self.tab_bar.currentItemChanged.connect(_on_tab_changed)
        self.tab_bar.setCurrentItem("tab_docs")
