    def _load_system_prompt(self):
        """Загрузка системного промпта из конфига или заводского шаблона."""
        from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager
        from services.assistant_prompt_builder import AssistantPromptBuilder
        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        custom_tmpl = cfg.get("assistant_custom_prompt_template", "")
        if custom_tmpl and custom_tmpl.strip():
            self.prompt_editor.setPlainText(custom_tmpl.strip())
        else:
            self.prompt_editor.setPlainText(AssistantPromptBuilder.SYSTEM_PERSONA_TEMPLATE.strip())

    def _on_save_prompt_clicked(self):
        """Сохранение отредактированного системного промпта для новых сессий."""
        from utils.config_manager import ConfigManager
        new_text = self.prompt_editor.toPlainText().strip()
        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        cfg["assistant_custom_prompt_template"] = new_text
        ConfigManager.save_config(cfg)

        # Обновляем память окна, если доступно
        parent_win = self.parent()
        if parent_win and hasattr(parent_win, "app_config") and isinstance(parent_win.app_config, dict):
            parent_win.app_config["assistant_custom_prompt_template"] = new_text

        InfoBar.success(
            title="Сохранено",
            content="Системный промпт обновлен. Он будет применяться ко всем вновь создаваемым диалогам.",
            orient=Qt.Orientation.Horizontal,
            isClosable=True,
            position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
            duration=3000,
            parent=self
        )

    def _on_reset_prompt_clicked(self):
        """Сброс системного промпта в редакторе к заводскому шаблону."""
        from services.assistant_prompt_builder import AssistantPromptBuilder
        self.prompt_editor.setPlainText(AssistantPromptBuilder.SYSTEM_PERSONA_TEMPLATE.strip())
        InfoBar.info(
            title="Восстановлен шаблон",
            content="Отображен заводской промпт. Нажмите «Сохранить для новых сессий», чтобы применить.",
            orient=Qt.Orientation.Horizontal,
            isClosable=True,
            position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
            duration=2500,
            parent=self
        )

    def _get_router(self):
        """Получает активный экземпляр роутера скиллов Ассистента."""
        try:
            from services.assistant_prompt_builder import AssistantPromptBuilder
            builder = AssistantPromptBuilder.get_instance()
            if hasattr(builder, "router") and builder.router:
                return builder.router
        except Exception:
            pass
        from services.skill_router import SkillRouter
        return SkillRouter.get_instance()

    def _load_skills_list(self, select_skill_id: Optional[str] = None):
        """Наполняет список скиллами из SkillRouter.get_all_skills()."""
        self.list_skills.clear()
        router = self._get_router()
        all_skills = router.get_all_skills() if hasattr(router, "get_all_skills") else {}

        target_row = -1
        row_idx = 0
        for sid, sdata in all_skills.items():
            title = sdata.get("title", sid)
            is_builtin = sdata.get("is_builtin", False)
            first_token = title.split()[0] if title and title.split() else ""
            icon_char = first_token if len(first_token) <= 2 else ("⚡" if is_builtin else "✨")

            item = QListWidgetItem(self.list_skills)
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, sid)
            item_widget = SkillListItemWidget(title, is_builtin, icon_char)
            item.setSizeHint(item_widget.sizeHint())
            self.list_skills.addItem(item)
            self.list_skills.setItemWidget(item, item_widget)

            if select_skill_id and sid == select_skill_id:
                target_row = row_idx
            row_idx += 1

        if target_row >= 0:
            self.list_skills.setCurrentRow(target_row)
        elif self.list_skills.count() > 0:
            self.list_skills.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _on_skill_row_changed(self, row: int):
        if row < 0:
            return
        item = self.list_skills.item(row)
        if not item:
            return
        sid = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        self._on_skill_selected(sid)

    def _on_skill_selected(self, skill_id: str):
        """Заполняет поля данными выбранного скилла."""
        router = self._get_router()
        all_skills = router.get_all_skills() if hasattr(router, "get_all_skills") else {}
        skill = all_skills.get(skill_id)
        if not skill:
            return

        self._current_selected_skill_id = skill_id
        is_builtin = skill.get("is_builtin", False)

        self.line_skill_id.setText(skill_id)
        self.line_skill_id.setEnabled(False)

        self.line_skill_title.setText(skill.get("title", ""))
        self.line_skill_title.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.text_human_desc.setPlainText(skill.get("human_description", ""))
        self.text_human_desc.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.text_triggers.setPlainText(skill.get("triggers", ""))
        self.text_triggers.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.text_system_prompt.setPlainText(skill.get("system_prompt", ""))
        self.text_system_prompt.setEnabled(not is_builtin)

        self.btn_save_skill.setEnabled(not is_builtin)
        self.btn_delete_skill.setEnabled(not is_builtin)
        if is_builtin:
            self.btn_delete_skill.setToolTip("Базовые скиллы защищены от удаления")
            self.btn_save_skill.setToolTip("Базовые скиллы защищены от изменений")
        else:
            self.btn_delete_skill.setToolTip("Удалить пользовательский скилл")
            self.btn_save_skill.setToolTip("Сохранить изменения скилла")

    def _on_add_skill_clicked(self):
        """Подготавливает форму для создания нового кастомного скилла."""
        self._current_selected_skill_id = None
        self.list_skills.setCurrentRow(-1)

        self.line_skill_id.clear()
        self.line_skill_id.setEnabled(True)

        self.line_skill_title.clear()
        self.line_skill_title.setEnabled(True)

        self.text_human_desc.clear()
        self.text_human_desc.setEnabled(True)

        self.text_triggers.clear()
        self.text_triggers.setEnabled(True)

        self.text_system_prompt.clear()
        self.text_system_prompt.setEnabled(True)

        self.btn_save_skill.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_save_skill.setToolTip("Сохранить новый скилл")
        self.btn_delete_skill.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_delete_skill.setToolTip("")

        self.line_skill_id.setFocus()

    def _on_save_skill_clicked(self):
        """Сохраняет кастомный скилл через роутер."""
        s_id = self.line_skill_id.text().strip()
        title = self.line_skill_title.text().strip()
        desc = self.text_human_desc.toPlainText().strip()
        triggers = self.text_triggers.toPlainText().strip()
        sys_prompt = self.text_system_prompt.toPlainText().strip()

        if not s_id:
            InfoBar.warning(
                title="Заполните ID",
                content="Идентификатор скилла (ID) не может быть пустым.",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=3000
            )
            self.line_skill_id.setFocus()
            return

        from services.skill_router import ASSISTANT_SKILLS
        if s_id in ASSISTANT_SKILLS:
            InfoBar.error(
                title="Запрещено",
                content=f"Нельзя перезаписать базовый скилл «{s_id}».",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=3000
            )
            return

        if not title:
            InfoBar.warning(
                title="Заполните название",
                content="Название скилла не может быть пустым.",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=3000
            )
            self.line_skill_title.setFocus()
            return

        skill_dict = {
            "skill_id": s_id,
            "title": title,
            "human_description": desc,
            "triggers": triggers,
            "system_prompt": sys_prompt,
            "is_builtin": False
        }

        router = self._get_router()
        ok = router.save_custom_skill(skill_dict)
        if ok:
            InfoBar.success(
                title="Скилл сохранен",
                content=f"Скилл «{title}» успешно сохранен в базе.",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=3000
            )
            self._load_skills_list(select_skill_id=s_id)
        else:
            InfoBar.error(
                title="Ошибка сохранения",
                content="Не удалось сохранить скилл. Проверьте правильность данных.",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=3500
            )

    def _on_delete_skill_clicked(self):
        """Удаляет выбранный кастомный скилл с подтверждением."""
        s_id = self.line_skill_id.text().strip()
        title = self.line_skill_title.text().strip() or s_id
        if not s_id:
            return

        from services.skill_router import ASSISTANT_SKILLS
        if s_id in ASSISTANT_SKILLS:
            InfoBar.error(
                title="Запрещено",
                content="Нельзя удалять базовые скиллы.",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=3000
            )
            return

        box = MessageBox(
            "Удаление скилла",
            f"Вы действительно хотите удалить скилл «{title}»?",
            self
        )
        box.yesButton.setText("Удалить")
        box.cancelButton.setText("Отмена")

        if box.exec():
            router = self._get_router()
            ok = router.delete_custom_skill(s_id)
            if ok:
                InfoBar.success(
                    title="Скилл удален",
                    content=f"Скилл «{title}» успешно удален.",
                    parent=self,
                    position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                    duration=2500
                )
                self._load_skills_list()
                self._on_add_skill_clicked()
            else:
                InfoBar.error(
                    title="Ошибка удаления",
                    content=f"Не удалось удалить скилл «{s_id}».",
                    parent=self,
                    position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                    duration=3000
                )

    def reload_documents(self):
        """Перезагружает и отображает список карточек документов из реестра."""
        # Очистка существующих карточек
        while self.cards_layout.count() > 0:
            child = self.cards_layout.takeAt(0)
            if child.widget():
                child.widget().deleteLater()

        documents = KnowledgeManager.get_documents()
        total_triggers = sum(len(d.get("triggers", [])) for d in documents)

        self.caption_label.setText(
            f"Проиндексировано документов: {len(documents)} • Ключевых триггеров: {total_triggers}"
        )

        if not documents:
            empty_frame = QWidget(self.cards_container)
            empty_layout = QVBoxLayout(empty_frame)
            empty_layout.setContentsMargins(20, 60, 20, 60)
            empty_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            empty_icon = IconWidget(SafeFIF.BOOK_SHELF, empty_frame)
            empty_icon.setFixedSize(48, 48)
            empty_layout.addWidget(empty_icon, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            empty_lbl = CaptionLabel("База знаний пуста.", empty_frame)
            empty_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #CBD5E1; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 8px;")
            empty_layout.addWidget(empty_lbl, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            sub_lbl = CaptionLabel("Нажмите «Добавить документ» или скопируйте файлы в папку knowledge_base/", empty_frame)
            sub_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 11px;")
            empty_layout.addWidget(sub_lbl, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)

            self.cards_layout.addWidget(empty_frame)
            return

        # Добавляем карточки документов
        for doc in documents:
            card = DocumentCardWidget(doc, on_delete=self._on_delete_document, parent=self.cards_container)
            self.cards_layout.addWidget(card)

    def _on_add_document_clicked(self):
        """Открытие диалога выбора файлов для добавления в базу знаний."""
        file_paths, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames(
            self,
            "Выберите документы для базы знаний Эларии",
            "",
            "Все поддерживаемые документы (*.pdf *.docx *.xlsx *.txt *.md *.json *.yaml *.yml *.toml *.csv *.py *.js *.ts *.cpp *.cs *.rs *.sql *.sh *.bat *.fb2);;Документы Office (*.pdf *.docx *.xlsx);;Исходный код и конфиги (*.py *.js *.ts *.cpp *.cs *.rs *.sql *.json *.yaml *.toml);;Все файлы (*.*)"
        )
        if not file_paths:
            return

        added_count = 0
        for f_path in file_paths:
            if KnowledgeManager.import_file(f_path):
                added_count += 1

        self.reload_documents()

        if added_count > 0:
            InfoBar.success(
                title="Документы добавлены",
                content=f"Успешно импортировано и проиндексировано файлов: {added_count}",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=3000
            )
        else:
            InfoBar.error(
                title="Ошибка импорта",
                content="Не удалось импортировать выбранные файлы.",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=3000
            )

    def _on_open_folder_clicked(self):
        """Открывает системную папку knowledge_base/."""
        k_dir = KnowledgeManager.get_knowledge_dir()
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(k_dir)))

    def _on_sync_clicked(self):
        """Ручной запуск сканирования и синхронизации реестра."""
        try:
            reg = KnowledgeManager.scan_and_sync()
            self.reload_documents()
            doc_count = reg.get("total_documents", len(reg.get("documents", {})))
            InfoBar.success(
                title="Синхронизация завершена",
                content=f"База знаний актуализирована. Документов в реестре: {doc_count}",
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=2500
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[KnowledgeManagerDialog] Ошибка синхронизации: {e}", exc_info=True)
            InfoBar.error(
                title="Ошибка синхронизации",
                content=str(e),
                parent=self,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                duration=3500
            )

    def _on_delete_document(self, filename: str):
        """Удаление документа с подтверждением пользователя."""
        box = MessageBox(
            "Удаление документа",
            f"Вы действительно хотите удалить документ «{filename}» из базы знаний?",
            self
        )
        box.yesButton.setText("Удалить")
        box.cancelButton.setText("Отмена")

        if box.exec():
            success = KnowledgeManager.delete_file(filename)
            self.reload_documents()
            if success:
                InfoBar.success(
                    title="Удалено",
                    content=f"Документ «{filename}» удален из базы знаний.",
                    parent=self,
                    position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                    duration=2500
                )
            else:
                InfoBar.error(
                    title="Ошибка удаления",
                    content=f"Не удалось удалить документ «{filename}».",
                    parent=self,
                    position=InfoBarPosition.TOP_RIGHT,
                    duration=3000
                )

        self.setStyleSheet("""

    def _sync_with_current_config(self):
        """Устанавливает текущие значения из конфига в элементы управления."""
        # KV Combo
        matched_idx = 0
        for i, (k, _) in enumerate(self.KV_OPTIONS):
            if k == self.current_kv:
                matched_idx = i
                break
        self.kv_combo.setCurrentIndex(matched_idx)
        self._update_hint_card(self.current_kv)

        # Flash Attention Switch
        self.switch_fa.setChecked(self.current_fa)

    def _on_kv_selection_changed(self, index: int):
        """Слот изменения выбранного типа KV-кэша."""
        if 0 <= index < len(self.KV_OPTIONS):
            kv_key = self.KV_OPTIONS[index][0]
            self._update_hint_card(kv_key)

    def _update_hint_card(self, kv_key: str):
        """Реактивное обновление текстов и цветов карточки-подсказки."""
        data = self.HINTS_DATA.get(kv_key, self.HINTS_DATA["q8_0"])

        self.hint_title_lbl.setText(data["title"])
        self.hint_title_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px; color: {data['title_color']};")

        self.hint_budget_lbl.setText(data["budget"])

        self.hint_effect_lbl.setText(data["effect"])

        self.hint_side_lbl.setText(data["side_effect"])
        self.hint_side_lbl.setStyleSheet(f"font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; color: {data['side_color']};")

        # Плавное обновление карточки
        self.hint_card.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame#hintCard {{
                background-color: {data['bg_color']};
                border: 1px solid {data['border_color']};
                border-radius: 8px;
            }}
        """)

    def _on_save_clicked(self):
        """Сохранение выбранных параметров и мягкий перезапуск llama-server."""
        selected_idx = self.kv_combo.currentIndex()
        selected_kv = self.KV_OPTIONS[selected_idx][0] if 0 <= selected_idx < len(self.KV_OPTIONS) else "q8_0"
        fa_enabled = self.switch_fa.isChecked()

        try:
            cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
            cfg["kv_cache_type"] = selected_kv
            cfg["flash_attention_enabled"] = fa_enabled
            ConfigManager.save_config(cfg)
            logger.info(f"[LLMEngineSettingsDialog] Сохранено: kv_cache_type={selected_kv}, flash_attention={fa_enabled}")

            # Инициируем мягкий перезапуск сервера, если он активен
            parent_win = self._parent_ref or self.parent()
            pm = getattr(parent_win, "process_manager", None)
            if pm and hasattr(pm, "restart_llama_server_async"):
                if pm.is_lm_studio_running():
                    pm.restart_llama_server_async()
                    logger.info("[LLMEngineSettingsDialog] Отправлена команда перезапуска llama-server.")

            self.accept()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[LLMEngineSettingsDialog] Ошибка сохранения параметров: {e}")
            self.reject()

"""

Scans SD WebUI Forge models/Lora directory, provides quick filtering,
weight tuning, and trigger tags injection.

import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any, Tuple

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QSize
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QLineEdit,
    QListWidget, QListWidgetItem, QPushButton, QDoubleSpinBox,
    QFileDialog, QMessageBox, QFrame
)

from config import DATA_DIR, BASE_DIR, FORGE_LORA_DIRS, DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR, LORA_REGISTRY_PATH

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.LocalLoraDialog")


def get_forge_lora_dirs() -> List[Path]:
    """Возвращает список существующих путей поиска моделей LoRA в Forge."""
    existing = [p.resolve() for p in FORGE_LORA_DIRS if p.exists() and p.is_dir()]
    if not existing:
        DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        existing.append(DEFAULT_FORGE_LORA_DIR.resolve())
    return existing

                background-color: #00737D;

    def _load_registry(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        reg_path = LORA_REGISTRY_PATH
        if reg_path.exists():
            try:
                with open(reg_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    return json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(f"Failed to read lora_registry: {e}")
        return {}

    def _scan_loras(self):
        self._all_lora_files.clear()
        dirs = get_forge_lora_dirs()
        for d in dirs:
            for f in d.rglob("*.safetensors"):
                if f.is_file() and f not in self._all_lora_files:
                    self._all_lora_files.append(f)

        # Сортировка: подходящие под имя персонажа — наверх
        name_clean = "".join(c for c in self.character_name.lower() if c.isalnum())
        def _sort_key(p: Path):
            stem = p.stem.lower()
            is_match = bool(name_clean and name_clean in "".join(c for c in stem if c.isalnum()))
            return (0 if is_match else 1, stem)

        self._all_lora_files.sort(key=_sort_key)
        self._filter_list(self.search_input.text())

    def _filter_list(self, query: str):
        self.list_widget.clear()
        q = query.strip().lower()
        name_clean = "".join(c for c in self.character_name.lower() if c.isalnum())

        for p in self._all_lora_files:
            stem = p.stem
            if q and q not in stem.lower():
                continue

            size_mb = p.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024)
            is_match = bool(name_clean and name_clean in "".join(c for c in stem.lower() if c.isalnum()))

            prefix = "⭐ [Рекомендуется] " if is_match else "📦 "
            item = QListWidgetItem(f"{prefix}{stem}  ({size_mb:.1f} MB)")
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, str(p))
            if is_match:
                item.setForeground(Qt.GlobalColor.cyan)
            self.list_widget.addItem(item)

        if self.list_widget.count() > 0:
            self.list_widget.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _on_item_changed(self, current: Optional[QListWidgetItem], previous=None):
        if not current:
            self.btn_apply.setEnabled(False)
            self.lbl_triggers.setText("Активационные слова: (не заданы)")
            return

        p_str = current.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        p = Path(p_str)
        self.selected_lora_stem = p.stem
        self.btn_apply.setEnabled(True)

        # Поиск триггеров в реестре
        reg_info = self._lora_registry.get(p.stem, {})
        triggers = reg_info.get("trained_words", []) or reg_info.get("activation_tags", [])
        self.selected_triggers = list(triggers)

        if triggers:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText(f"Активационные слова: {', '.join(triggers[:5])}")
        else:
            self.lbl_triggers.setText("Активационные слова: (в реестре не найдены)")

    def _on_item_double_clicked(self, item: QListWidgetItem):
        self._on_item_changed(item)
        if self.selected_lora_stem:
            self.accept()

    def _browse_custom_file(self):
        file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Выберите файл LoRA", "", "LoRA (*.safetensors *.pt *.ckpt)"
        )
        if not file_path:
            return
        p = Path(file_path)
        self.selected_lora_stem = p.stem
        self.selected_triggers = []
        self.accept()

    def get_result(self) -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
        """Возвращает строку инъекции тега LoRA и список триггеров."""
        stem = self.selected_lora_stem or ""
        weight = self.spin_weight.value()
        lora_tag = f"<lora:{stem}:{weight:.2f}>"
        return lora_tag, self.selected_triggers

"""

Displays responsive thumbnail grid of all images generated in the current conversation,

class ThumbnailButton(QPushButton):
    """Clickable thumbnail image button with hover animation and glowing border."""
    def __init__(self, image_path: Path, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.image_path = Path(image_path)
        self.setFixedSize(140, 140)
        self.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor))
        self.setToolTip(f"{self.image_path.name}\n(Клик для полноразмерного просмотра)")

        # Render thumbnail
        pix = QPixmap(str(self.image_path))
        if not pix.isNull():
            thumb = pix.scaled(
                130, 130,
                Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
                Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
            )
            self.setIcon(QIcon(thumb))
            self.setIconSize(QSize(130, 130))

        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #0E1422;
                border: 1px solid #1E2B42;
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 4px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                background-color: #162035;
            }
            QPushButton:pressed {
                border-color: #FF0055;
            }
        """)


class ChatMediaGalleryDialog(QDialog):
    """
    Dialog displaying all images generated or attached in the active chat session.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        session_images_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
        image_paths: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        session_title: Optional[str] = None,
        parent=None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.session_id = session_id
        self.session_title = session_title or "Диалог"
        if session_images_dir is not None:
            self.session_images_dir = Path(session_images_dir)
        elif session_id == "all_sessions":
            from config import OUTPUTS_DIR
            self.session_images_dir = OUTPUTS_DIR
        else:
            self.session_images_dir = SessionManager.get_session_images_dir(session_id)

        found_paths = []
        if self.session_images_dir.exists():
            for ext in ("*.png", "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.webp"):
                found_paths.extend(list(self.session_images_dir.glob(ext)))

        if image_paths:
            for p in image_paths:
                p_path = Path(p)
                if p_path.exists() and p_path not in found_paths:
                    found_paths.append(p_path)

        # Sort newest first
        found_paths.sort(key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime if x.exists() else 0, reverse=True)
        self.image_paths = found_paths

        if self.session_id == "all_sessions":
            self.setWindowTitle(f"Медиа галерея — все изображения ({len(self.image_paths)})")
        else:
            title_suffix = f" • {self.session_title}" if self.session_title else ""
            self.setWindowTitle(f"Медиа галерея диалога — {len(self.image_paths)} изображений{title_suffix}")
        self.resize(760, 560)
        self.setMinimumSize(540, 400)

        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QDialog {
                background-color: #090C12;
                color: #CBD5E1;
            }
            QScrollArea {
                background: transparent;
                border: 1px solid #1A2438;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #151E2E;
                color: #E2E8F0;
                border: 1px solid #25354F;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 6px 16px;
                font-weight: 500;
                font-size: 13px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #1F2D45;
                border-color: #00F0FF;
                color: #00F0FF;
            }
            QPushButton:pressed {
                background-color: #121A28;
            }
        """)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(16, 16, 16, 16)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        # Header bar
        hdr_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        header_text = f"🖼️ Медиа галерея ({len(self.image_paths)})" if self.session_id == "all_sessions" else f"🖼️ Медиафайлы текущего диалога ({len(self.image_paths)})"
        title_lbl = QLabel(header_text)
        title_lbl.setStyleSheet("font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; color: #00F0FF;")
        hdr_layout.addWidget(title_lbl)
        hdr_layout.addStretch()

        layout.addLayout(hdr_layout)

        # Grid of Thumbnails
        if not self.image_paths:
            empty_lbl = QLabel("В этом диалоге пока нет сгенерированных изображений.\nПопросите Ассистента создать арт или фото, и они появятся здесь!")
            empty_lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
            empty_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #64748B; font-size: 13px; margin: 40px;")
            layout.addWidget(empty_lbl, stretch=1)
        else:
            scroll = QScrollArea(self)
            scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
            scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)

            grid_container = QWidget()
            grid_container.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
            grid_layout = QGridLayout(grid_container)
            grid_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)
            grid_layout.setSpacing(12)

            columns = 4
            for idx, img_p in enumerate(self.image_paths):
                row = idx // columns
                col = idx % columns
                btn = ThumbnailButton(img_p, grid_container)
                btn.clicked.connect(lambda checked, p=img_p: self._preview_image(p))
                grid_layout.addWidget(btn, row, col)

            scroll.setWidget(grid_container)
            layout.addWidget(scroll, stretch=1)

        # Bottom Action Bar
        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()

        btn_open_folder = QPushButton("📂 Открыть папку в Проводнике")
        btn_open_folder.clicked.connect(self._open_folder)
        btn_layout.addWidget(btn_open_folder)

        btn_layout.addStretch()

        btn_close = QPushButton("Закрыть")
        btn_close.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        btn_layout.addWidget(btn_close)

        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)

    def _preview_image(self, image_path: Path):
        dialog = ImagePreviewDialog(image_path, self)
        dialog.exec()

    def _open_folder(self):
        target_dir = self.session_images_dir
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            if hasattr(os, "startfile"):
                os.startfile(str(target_dir))
            else:
                subprocess.Popen(["explorer", str(target_dir)])
        except Exception as e:
            pass

"""
Model Sampling Parameters Dialog for NeonRoute.
Modal dialog in Glassmorphism style for configuring LLM sampling parameters:
Temperature, Min-P, Repetition Penalty, Max Tokens, and DM Mode toggle.
Modernized with QFluentWidgets components under Agentrules.md.
"""

from typing import Dict, Any
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QEvent
from PyQt6.QtGui import QColor, QMouseEvent
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QFrame,
    QDoubleSpinBox, QSpinBox
)
from qfluentwidgets import (
    Slider,
    DoubleSpinBox,
    SpinBox,
    CheckBox,
    PushButton,
    PrimaryPushButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
)

from services.session_manager import get_default_sampling_params


class SamplingSlider(Slider):
    """
    Кастомный слайдер для параметров сэмплинга:
    - Плавное и естественное перетаскивание бегунка зажатой ЛКМ (нативная логика Slider)
    - Включен трекинг реального времени self.setTracking(True)
    - Защита от смещения значения при простом движении мыши (hover) без нажатия
    - ClickFocus и отключение wheelEvent
    """
    def __init__(self, orientation=Qt.Orientation.Horizontal, parent=None):
        super().__init__(orientation, parent=parent)
        self.setTracking(True)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
        self.handle.installEventFilter(self)

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event):
        if watched == self.handle:
            if event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonPress:
                if event.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    return True
                self._pressedPos = self.handle.mapToParent(event.pos())
            elif event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseMove:
                if event.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    slider_pos = self.handle.mapToParent(event.pos())
                    self.setValue(self._posToValue(slider_pos))
                    self._pressedPos = slider_pos
                    self.sliderMoved.emit(self.value())
                    return True
                return True
            elif event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease:
                if event.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    return True
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def mousePressEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent):
        if e.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            e.ignore()
            return
        super().mousePressEvent(e)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent):
        # Реагируем на перемещение СТРОГО при зажатой левой кнопке мыши
        if not (e.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton):
            e.ignore()
            return
        super().mouseMoveEvent(e)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent):
        if e.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            e.ignore()
            return
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(e)

    def wheelEvent(self, e):
        # Отключаем случайное изменение значений колесиком мыши
        e.ignore()


class SamplingDoubleSpinBox(DoubleSpinBox):
    """
    Поле числового ввода с плавающей точкой (Temperature, Min-P, Repetition Penalty):
    - Стрелки вверх/вниз гарантированно инкрементируют/декрементируют значение с точным шагом
    - Границы minimum / singleStep строго соблюдаются
    - Отключение wheelEvent во избежание случайного скролла значений
    - ClickFocus
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
        try:
            self.downButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.downButton.clicked.connect(self.stepDown)
        try:
            self.upButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.upButton.clicked.connect(self.stepUp)

    def stepDown(self):
        new_val = max(self.minimum(), self.value() - self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(round(new_val, self.decimals()))

    def stepUp(self):
        new_val = min(self.maximum(), self.value() + self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(round(new_val, self.decimals()))

    def wheelEvent(self, e):
        e.ignore()


class SamplingSpinBox(SpinBox):
    """
    Поле целочисленного ввода (Max Tokens):
    - Стрелки вверх/вниз гарантированно инкрементируют/декрементируют значение с точным шагом (64)
    - Нижняя граница minimum (256) и верхняя maximum (4096) строго соблюдаются
    - Отключение wheelEvent
    - ClickFocus
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
        try:
            self.downButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.downButton.clicked.connect(self.stepDown)
        try:
            self.upButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.upButton.clicked.connect(self.stepUp)

    def stepDown(self):
        new_val = max(self.minimum(), self.value() - self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(int(new_val))

    def stepUp(self):
        new_val = min(self.maximum(), self.value() + self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(int(new_val))

    def wheelEvent(self, e):
        e.ignore()

        # Connect signals for real-time dynamic synchronization on the fly
        self.slider_temp.valueChanged.connect(self._on_temp_slider_changed)
        self.slider_temp.sliderMoved.connect(self._on_temp_slider_changed)
        self.spin_temp.valueChanged.connect(self._on_temp_spin_changed)

        self.slider_min_p.valueChanged.connect(self._on_min_p_slider_changed)
        self.slider_min_p.sliderMoved.connect(self._on_min_p_slider_changed)
        self.spin_min_p.valueChanged.connect(self._on_min_p_spin_changed)

        self.slider_top_p.valueChanged.connect(self._on_top_p_slider_changed)
        self.slider_top_p.sliderMoved.connect(self._on_top_p_slider_changed)
        self.spin_top_p.valueChanged.connect(self._on_top_p_spin_changed)

        self.slider_rep_pen.valueChanged.connect(self._on_rep_pen_slider_changed)
        self.slider_rep_pen.sliderMoved.connect(self._on_rep_pen_slider_changed)
        self.spin_rep_pen.valueChanged.connect(self._on_rep_pen_spin_changed)

        self.slider_dry.valueChanged.connect(self._on_dry_slider_changed)
        self.slider_dry.sliderMoved.connect(self._on_dry_slider_changed)
        self.spin_dry.valueChanged.connect(self._on_dry_spin_changed)

        self.slider_xtc_prob.valueChanged.connect(self._on_xtc_prob_slider_changed)
        self.slider_xtc_prob.sliderMoved.connect(self._on_xtc_prob_slider_changed)
        self.spin_xtc_prob.valueChanged.connect(self._on_xtc_prob_spin_changed)

        self.slider_xtc_thresh.valueChanged.connect(self._on_xtc_thresh_slider_changed)
        self.slider_xtc_thresh.sliderMoved.connect(self._on_xtc_thresh_slider_changed)
        self.spin_xtc_thresh.valueChanged.connect(self._on_xtc_thresh_spin_changed)

        self.slider_max_tokens.valueChanged.connect(self._on_max_tokens_slider_changed)
        self.slider_max_tokens.sliderMoved.connect(self._on_max_tokens_slider_changed)
        self.spin_max_tokens.valueChanged.connect(self._on_max_tokens_spin_changed)
        self.chk_dm_mode.toggled.connect(lambda _: self._on_user_input_changed())

        active_mode = "engineer" if self.is_engineer_mode else self.mode
        ref_params = get_default_sampling_params(active_mode)
        ref_temp = ref_params["temperature"]
        ref_min_p = ref_params["min_p"]
        ref_top_p = ref_params.get("top_p", 1.00 if self.is_engineer_mode else 0.95)
        ref_rep_pen = ref_params["repeat_penalty"]
        ref_dry = ref_params.get("dry_multiplier", 0.00 if self.is_engineer_mode else 0.80)
        ref_xtc_prob = ref_params.get("xtc_probability", 0.00 if self.is_engineer_mode else 0.20)
        ref_xtc_thresh = ref_params.get("xtc_threshold", 0.10)
        ref_max_tok = ref_params["max_tokens"]

        init_temp = float(current_params.get("temperature", ref_temp))
        init_min_p = float(current_params.get("min_p", ref_min_p))
        init_top_p = float(current_params.get("top_p", ref_top_p))
        init_rep_pen = float(current_params.get("repeat_penalty", ref_rep_pen))
        init_dry = float(current_params.get("dry_multiplier", ref_params.get("dry_multiplier", 0.80 if not self.is_engineer_mode else 0.00)))
        init_xtc_prob = float(current_params.get("xtc_probability", ref_xtc_prob))
        init_xtc_thresh = float(current_params.get("xtc_threshold", ref_xtc_thresh))
        init_max_tokens = int(current_params.get("max_tokens", ref_max_tok))

        self.spin_temp.setValue(init_temp)
        self._on_temp_spin_changed(init_temp)

        if self.is_engineer_mode:
            # Температура разблокирована для свободного управления креативностью генерации кода
            self.spin_temp.setEnabled(True)
            self.slider_temp.setEnabled(True)

            self.spin_dry.setValue(0.00)
            self._on_dry_spin_changed(0.00)
            self.spin_dry.setEnabled(False)
            self.slider_dry.setEnabled(False)
            self.lbl_dry.setText("Штраф шаблонов DRY: 🔒 0.00 (Режим «⚡ Инженер»)")
            self.lbl_dry.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-weight: bold;")
            dry_eng_tip = "В режиме «⚡ Инженер» сэмплер DRY зафиксирован на 0.00 (выключен) во избежание поломки повторяющихся синтаксических конструкций кода."
            self.spin_dry.setToolTip(dry_eng_tip)
            self.slider_dry.setToolTip(dry_eng_tip)
            self.lbl_dry.setToolTip(dry_eng_tip)

            self.spin_xtc_prob.setValue(0.00)
            self._on_xtc_prob_spin_changed(0.00)
            self.spin_xtc_prob.setEnabled(False)
            self.slider_xtc_prob.setEnabled(False)
            self.lbl_xtc_prob.setText("Срез клише XTC: 🔒 0.00 (Режим «⚡ Инженер»)")
            self.lbl_xtc_prob.setStyleSheet("color: #00F0FF; font-weight: bold;")
            xtc_eng_tip = "В режиме «⚡ Инженер» сэмплер XTC зафиксирован на 0.00 (выключен) во избежание искажения синтаксиса и точных ключевых слов кода."
            self.spin_xtc_prob.setToolTip(xtc_eng_tip)
            self.slider_xtc_prob.setToolTip(xtc_eng_tip)
            self.lbl_xtc_prob.setToolTip(xtc_eng_tip)
        else:
            self.spin_dry.setValue(init_dry)
            self._on_dry_spin_changed(init_dry)
            self.spin_xtc_prob.setValue(init_xtc_prob)
            self._on_xtc_prob_spin_changed(init_xtc_prob)

        self.spin_xtc_thresh.setValue(init_xtc_thresh)
        self._on_xtc_thresh_spin_changed(init_xtc_thresh)

        self.spin_min_p.setValue(init_min_p)
        self._on_min_p_spin_changed(init_min_p)

        self.spin_top_p.setValue(init_top_p)
        self._on_top_p_spin_changed(init_top_p)

        self.spin_rep_pen.setValue(init_rep_pen)
        self._on_rep_pen_spin_changed(init_rep_pen)

        self.spin_max_tokens.setValue(init_max_tokens)
        self._on_max_tokens_spin_changed(init_max_tokens)

        # Control Buttons
        btn_box = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_box.setSpacing(10)

        self.btn_reset = PushButton(FIF.SYNC, "Сбросить по умолчанию", self)
        self.btn_reset.setObjectName("btn_reset")
        self.btn_reset.clicked.connect(self._reset_defaults)
        btn_box.addWidget(self.btn_reset)

        btn_box.addStretch()

        self.btn_cancel = PushButton("Отмена", self)
        self.btn_cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        btn_box.addWidget(self.btn_cancel)

        self.btn_save = PrimaryPushButton("Сохранить", self)
        self.btn_save.setObjectName("btn_save")
        self.btn_save.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        btn_box.addWidget(self.btn_save)

        layout.addSpacing(6)
        layout.addLayout(btn_box)

    def _on_user_input_changed(self):
        if not getattr(self, "_is_resetting", False):
            self.was_reset_to_defaults = False

    def _on_temp_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_temp.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_temp.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_temp.setValue(target)
            self.spin_temp.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_temp_spin_changed(self, val: float):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_temp.value() != target:
            self.slider_temp.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_temp.setValue(target)
            self.slider_temp.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_min_p_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_min_p.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_min_p.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_min_p.setValue(target)
            self.spin_min_p.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_min_p_spin_changed(self, val: float):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_min_p.value() != target:
            self.slider_min_p.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_min_p.setValue(target)
            self.slider_min_p.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_top_p_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_top_p.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_top_p.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_top_p.setValue(target)
            self.spin_top_p.blockSignals(False)
        self._on_user_input_changed()

    def _on_top_p_spin_changed(self, val: float):
        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_top_p.value() != target:
            self.slider_top_p.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_top_p.setValue(target)
            self.slider_top_p.blockSignals(False)
        self._on_user_input_changed()

    def _on_rep_pen_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_rep_pen.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_rep_pen.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_rep_pen.setValue(target)
            self.spin_rep_pen.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_rep_pen_spin_changed(self, val: float):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_rep_pen.value() != target:
            self.slider_rep_pen.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_rep_pen.setValue(target)
            self.slider_rep_pen.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_dry_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_dry.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_dry.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_dry.setValue(target)
            self.spin_dry.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_dry_spin_changed(self, val: float):

        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_dry.value() != target:
            self.slider_dry.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_dry.setValue(target)
            self.slider_dry.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_xtc_prob_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_xtc_prob.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_xtc_prob.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_xtc_prob.setValue(target)
            self.spin_xtc_prob.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_xtc_prob_spin_changed(self, val: float):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_xtc_prob.value() != target:
            self.slider_xtc_prob.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_xtc_prob.setValue(target)
            self.slider_xtc_prob.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_xtc_thresh_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = round(val / 100.0, 2)
        if abs(self.spin_xtc_thresh.value() - target) > 0.001:
            self.spin_xtc_thresh.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_xtc_thresh.setValue(target)
            self.spin_xtc_thresh.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_xtc_thresh_spin_changed(self, val: float):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        target = int(round(val * 100))
        if self.slider_xtc_thresh.value() != target:
            self.slider_xtc_thresh.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_xtc_thresh.setValue(target)
            self.slider_xtc_thresh.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_max_tokens_slider_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        snapped = round(val / 64) * 64
        snapped = max(256, min(4096, snapped))
        if self.spin_max_tokens.value() != snapped:
            self.spin_max_tokens.blockSignals(True)
            self.spin_max_tokens.setValue(snapped)
            self.spin_max_tokens.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_max_tokens_spin_changed(self, val: int):
        self._on_user_input_changed()
        if self.slider_max_tokens.value() != val:
            self.slider_max_tokens.blockSignals(True)
            self.slider_max_tokens.setValue(val)
            self.slider_max_tokens.blockSignals(False)

    def _reset_defaults(self):
        self._is_resetting = True
        try:
            active_mode = "engineer" if self.is_engineer_mode else self.mode
            from services.session_manager import get_default_sampling_params
            defaults = get_default_sampling_params(active_mode)

            if self.is_engineer_mode:
                self.spin_temp.setValue(defaults["temperature"])
                self.slider_temp.setValue(int(round(defaults["temperature"] * 100)))
                self.spin_dry.setValue(0.00)
                self.slider_dry.setValue(0)
                self.spin_xtc_prob.setValue(0.00)
                self.slider_xtc_prob.setValue(0)
            else:
                self.spin_temp.setValue(defaults["temperature"])
                self.slider_temp.setValue(int(round(defaults["temperature"] * 100)))
                dry_val = float(defaults.get("dry_multiplier", 0.80 if not self.is_engineer_mode else 0.00))
                self.spin_dry.setValue(dry_val)
                self.slider_dry.setValue(int(round(dry_val * 100)))
                xtc_p_val = float(defaults.get("xtc_probability", 0.20 if self.mode == "assistant" else 0.30))
                self.spin_xtc_prob.setValue(xtc_p_val)
                self.slider_xtc_prob.setValue(int(round(xtc_p_val * 100)))
            self.spin_min_p.setValue(defaults["min_p"])
            self.slider_min_p.setValue(int(round(defaults["min_p"] * 100)))
            top_p_def = float(defaults.get("top_p", 1.00 if self.is_engineer_mode else 0.95))
            self.spin_top_p.setValue(top_p_def)
            self.slider_top_p.setValue(int(round(top_p_def * 100)))

            xtc_t_val = float(defaults.get("xtc_threshold", 0.10))
            self.spin_xtc_thresh.setValue(xtc_t_val)
            self.slider_xtc_thresh.setValue(int(round(xtc_t_val * 100)))

            self.spin_rep_pen.setValue(defaults["repeat_penalty"])
            self.slider_rep_pen.setValue(int(round(defaults["repeat_penalty"] * 100)))
            self.spin_max_tokens.setValue(defaults["max_tokens"])
            self.slider_max_tokens.setValue(defaults["max_tokens"])

            self.current_params["top_p"] = top_p_def

            if hasattr(self, "chk_dm_mode") and self.mode == "roleplay":
                self.chk_dm_mode.setChecked(bool(defaults.get("is_dm_mode", False)))
        finally:
            self._is_resetting = False
            self.was_reset_to_defaults = True

    _on_reset_clicked = _reset_defaults

    def get_sampling_params(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        params = {
            "temperature": round(self.spin_temp.value(), 2),
            "min_p": round(self.spin_min_p.value(), 2),
            "top_p": round(self.spin_top_p.value(), 2),
            "repeat_penalty": round(self.spin_rep_pen.value(), 2),
            "dry_multiplier": round(self.spin_dry.value(), 2),
            "xtc_probability": 0.00 if self.is_engineer_mode else round(self.spin_xtc_prob.value(), 2),
            "xtc_threshold": round(self.spin_xtc_thresh.value(), 2),
            "max_tokens": int(self.spin_max_tokens.value())
        }
        if self.is_engineer_mode:
            # Для режима Инженер сохраняем реальное значение температуры, выставленное пользователем
            pass
            params["dry_multiplier"] = 0.00
            params["xtc_probability"] = 0.00
        if hasattr(self, "chk_dm_mode") and self.mode == "roleplay":
            params["is_dm_mode"] = self.chk_dm_mode.isChecked()
        return params

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, Union, List
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtGui import QGuiApplication
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout
from qfluentwidgets import (
    MessageBoxBase,
    SubtitleLabel,
    BodyLabel,
    CaptionLabel,
    PlainTextEdit,
    PushButton,
    FluentIcon as FIF,
    InfoBar,
    InfoBarPosition
)
from services.roleplay_prompt_builder import RoleplayPromptBuilder
from services.tavern_parser import TavernParser
from services.session_manager import SessionManager


class PromptViewerDialog(MessageBoxBase):
    """
    Диалог инспекции и редактирования системного промпта карточки для текущей РП сессии.
    Выполнен на компонентах QFluentWidgets в темной стилистике NeonRoute.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: QWidget,
        character_card,
        user_name: str,
        current_prompt: Optional[str] = None,
        world_facts: Union[str, List[str]] = "",
        active_persona: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.character_card = character_card
        self.user_name = user_name or "Игрок"

        if isinstance(character_card, dict):
            self.char_name = character_card.get("name", "Собеседник") or "Собеседник"
            self.archetype = character_card.get("archetype") or TavernParser.detect_card_archetype(character_card)
        else:
            self.char_name = getattr(character_card, "name", "Собеседник") if character_card else "Собеседник"
            self.archetype = getattr(character_card, "archetype", None) or TavernParser.detect_card_archetype(character_card)

        if isinstance(self.archetype, dict):
            active_flags = [k.replace("is_", "").capitalize() for k, v in self.archetype.items() if v is True]
            self.archetype = active_flags[0] if active_flags else "Solo"

        if active_persona is None and parent and hasattr(parent, "current_session") and parent.current_session:
            sess_persona_id = parent.current_session.get("user_persona_id")
            active_persona = SessionManager.get_active_user_persona(is_roleplay=True, session_persona_id=sess_persona_id)

        # Нормализация world_facts
        if isinstance(world_facts, list):
            wf_str = "\n".join(str(f) for f in world_facts if f)
        else:
            wf_str = str(world_facts or "")

        # Получаем исходный эталонный промпт для карточки
        self.default_prompt = RoleplayPromptBuilder.get_default_system_prompt(
            self.character_card, 
            user_name=self.user_name,
            world_facts=wf_str,
            active_persona=active_persona
        ).strip()
        
        self.initial_prompt = (current_prompt.strip() if current_prompt and current_prompt.strip() else self.default_prompt)

        self._init_widget()

    def _init_widget(self):
        # Настройка размеров окна под комфортное чтение промптов
        self.widget.setMinimumWidth(720)
        self.widget.setMaximumWidth(850)

        # Заголовок
        self.title_lbl = SubtitleLabel("📜 Системный промпт карточки", self)
        self.viewLayout.addWidget(self.title_lbl)

        # Метаданные сцены
        meta_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        meta_layout.setSpacing(16)

        c_info = CaptionLabel(f"Персонаж: <b style='color: #00F0FF;'>{self.char_name}</b>", self)
        u_info = CaptionLabel(f"Игрок: <b style='color: #38BDF8;'>{self.user_name}</b>", self)
        a_info = CaptionLabel(f"Архетип: <b style='color: #A855F7;'>{self.archetype}</b>", self)

        meta_layout.addWidget(c_info)
        meta_layout.addWidget(u_info)
        meta_layout.addWidget(a_info)
        meta_layout.addStretch()
        self.viewLayout.addLayout(meta_layout)

        # Поясняющее описание
        desc_lbl = BodyLabel(
            "Этот системный промпт задает поведение персонажа, личность, мир и инструкции отыгрыша для LLM. "
            "Изменения применяются строго к текущей сессии.",
            self
        )
        desc_lbl.setWordWrap(True)
        desc_lbl.setStyleSheet("color: #94A3B8; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 4px; margin-bottom: 6px;")
        self.viewLayout.addWidget(desc_lbl)

        # Редактор промпта
        self.prompt_edit = PlainTextEdit(self)
        self.prompt_edit.setPlainText(self.initial_prompt)
        self.prompt_edit.setMinimumHeight(320)
        self.prompt_edit.setStyleSheet("""
            PlainTextEdit {
                background-color: rgba(15, 19, 28, 0.85);
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
                border-radius: 8px;
                color: #F8FAFC;
                font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Code', monospace;
                font-size: 12px;
                padding: 10px;
                line-height: 1.4;
            }
            PlainTextEdit:focus {
                border: 1px solid #00F0FF;
                background-color: rgba(15, 19, 28, 0.95);
            }
        """)
        self.viewLayout.addWidget(self.prompt_edit)

        # Панель вспомогательных кнопок
        actions_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        actions_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 6, 0, 0)
        actions_layout.setSpacing(10)

        self.btn_reset_default = PushButton(FIF.SYNC, "По умолчанию", self)
        self.btn_reset_default.setToolTip("Сбросить к исходному системному промпту карточки")
        self.btn_reset_default.clicked.connect(self._on_reset_to_default)

        self.btn_copy = PushButton(FIF.COPY, "Копировать", self)
        self.btn_copy.setToolTip("Скопировать текст промпта в буфер обмена")
        self.btn_copy.clicked.connect(self._on_copy_clicked)

        actions_layout.addWidget(self.btn_reset_default)
        actions_layout.addWidget(self.btn_copy)
        actions_layout.addStretch()
        self.viewLayout.addLayout(actions_layout)

        # Кнопки MessageBoxBase
        self.yesButton.setText("Применить")
        self.cancelButton.setText("Отмена")

    def _on_reset_to_default(self):
        self.prompt_edit.setPlainText(self.default_prompt)
        InfoBar.info(
            title="Сброс",
            content="Восстановлен исходный системный промпт карточки",
            parent=self.widget,
            position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
            duration=2000
        )

    def _on_copy_clicked(self):
        text = self.prompt_edit.toPlainText().strip()
        if text:
            QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
            InfoBar.success(
                title="Скопировано",
                content="Системный промпт помещен в буфер обмена",
                parent=self.widget,
                position=InfoBarPosition.TOP,
                duration=2000
            )

    def get_configured_prompt(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """
        Возвращает:
        - None, если текст совпадает с дефолтным (чистый сброс ключа в сессии).
        - Отредактированную строку, если пользователь задал кастомный промпт.
        """
        current_text = self.prompt_edit.toPlainText().strip()
        if not current_text or current_text == self.default_prompt:
            return None
        return current_text

"""
UserSettingsDialog for NeonRoute.
Provides user identity configuration for Elaria Assistant mode and RPG Player Personas Manager.
Refactored strictly according to Section 9 of neonroute_ui_spec.md and Agentrules.md:

- Tab 2: Two-panel persona manager:

class InteractiveAvatarWidget(QWidget):
    """
    Интерактивный круглый аватар со сглаживанием, подсветкой при наведении
    и поддержкой прямого клика для смены изображения.
    """
    avatar_clicked = pyqtSignal()

    def __init__(self, size: int = 64, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.avatar_size = size
        self.setFixedSize(size, size)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._pixmap = QPixmap()
        self._is_hovered = False
        self.setToolTip("Нажмите, чтобы выбрать новое изображение")

    def setPixmap(self, pixmap: QPixmap):
        self._pixmap = pixmap
        self.update()

    def pixmap(self) -> QPixmap:
        return self._pixmap

    def enterEvent(self, event):
        self._is_hovered = True
        self.update()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):
        self._is_hovered = False
        self.update()
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.avatar_clicked.emit()
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, True)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)

        rect_f = self.rect().adjusted(1, 1, -1, -1)

        if not self._pixmap.isNull():
            scaled = self._pixmap.scaled(
                self.avatar_size, self.avatar_size,
                Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
                Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
            )
            # Center in widget
            dx = (self.width() - scaled.width()) // 2
            dy = (self.height() - scaled.height()) // 2
            painter.drawPixmap(dx, dy, scaled)
        else:
            painter.setBrush(QColor(15, 23, 42))
            painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(0, 240, 255, 60), 1.0))
            painter.drawEllipse(rect_f)

        # Soft ring / glow border
        if self._is_hovered:
            painter.setBrush(QColor(0, 240, 255, 25))
            painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(0, 240, 255, 220), 2.0))
            painter.drawEllipse(rect_f)
        else:
            painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
            painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 30), 1.2))
            painter.drawEllipse(rect_f)


class _TabCompatProxy:
    """Адаптер для обратной совместимости с self.tab_widget.setCurrentIndex()."""
    def __init__(self, dialog: 'UserSettingsDialog'):
        self._dlg = dialog

    def setCurrentIndex(self, idx: int):
        self._dlg.set_current_tab(idx)

    def currentIndex(self) -> int:
        return self._dlg.stacked_widget.currentIndex()


class _RadioCompat:
    """Адаптер для совместимости с радиокнопками rb_art_auto / rb_art_manual."""
    def __init__(self, segmented: SegmentedWidget, target_key: str):
        self._seg = segmented
        self._target_key = target_key

    def isChecked(self) -> bool:
        return self._seg.currentRouteKey() == self._target_key

    def setChecked(self, checked: bool):
        if checked:
            self._seg.setCurrentItem(self._target_key)


class _GenderComboCompat:
    """Адаптер для совместимости со старым self.combo_rp_gender."""
    def __init__(self, segmented: SegmentedWidget):
        self._seg = segmented

    def currentIndex(self) -> int:
        return 1 if self._seg.currentRouteKey() == "female" else 0

    def setCurrentIndex(self, idx: int):
        self._seg.setCurrentItem("female" if idx == 1 else "male")

    def blockSignals(self, b: bool):
        pass

    def _setup_ui(self):
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(18, 16, 18, 16)
        root.setSpacing(12)

        # 1. Top Navigation: SegmentedWidget
        self.nav_segmented = SegmentedWidget(self)
        self.nav_segmented.addItem(
            routeKey="tab_asst",
            text="⚡ Ассистент",
            onClick=lambda: self.set_current_tab(0)
        )
        self.nav_segmented.addItem(
            routeKey="tab_rp",
            text="🎭 Ролевой чат",
            onClick=lambda: self.set_current_tab(1)
        )
        root.addWidget(self.nav_segmented)

        # 2. Content: QStackedWidget
        self.stacked_widget = QStackedWidget(self)
        self.tab_asst_widget = self._create_assistant_tab()
        self.tab_rp_widget = self._create_rp_tab()

        self.stacked_widget.addWidget(self.tab_asst_widget)
        self.stacked_widget.addWidget(self.tab_rp_widget)
        root.addWidget(self.stacked_widget, 1)

        # 3. Bottom Action Bar
        btn_box = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_box.setSpacing(10)
        btn_box.addStretch()

        self.btn_cancel = TransparentPushButton("✕ Отмена", self)
        self.btn_cancel.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        btn_box.addWidget(self.btn_cancel)

        self.btn_save_all = PrimaryPushButton("💾 Сохранить изменения", self)
        self.btn_save_all.setObjectName("btn_save_all")
        self.btn_save_all.clicked.connect(self._save_all_and_close)
        btn_box.addWidget(self.btn_save_all)

        root.addLayout(btn_box)

    def set_current_tab(self, index: int):
        idx = max(0, min(1, index))
        self.stacked_widget.setCurrentIndex(idx)
        route_key = "tab_asst" if idx == 0 else "tab_rp"
        self.nav_segmented.setCurrentItem(route_key)

    # =========================================================================

    def _load_assistant_fields(self):
        asst = self.profiles.get("assistant_user", {})
        if not isinstance(asst, dict):
            asst = {}
        self.asst_name_input.setText(asst.get("name", "Пользователь"))
        self.asst_bio_input.setPlainText(asst.get("bio", ""))
        self._update_assistant_avatar_preview()

        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        auto_art = cfg.get("auto_generate_art", DEFAULT_AUTO_GENERATE_ART)
        if auto_art:
            self.art_mode_segmented.setCurrentItem("auto")
        else:
            self.art_mode_segmented.setCurrentItem("manual")

        self.combo_asst_model.blockSignals(True)
        self.combo_asst_model.clear()

        parent_window = self.parent()
        parent_combo = getattr(parent_window, "lm_combo", None) if parent_window else None
        active_model = cfg.get("active_model", "")

        if parent_combo and hasattr(parent_combo, "count") and parent_combo.count() > 0:
            for i in range(parent_combo.count()):
                m_text = parent_combo.itemText(i).strip()
                if m_text and not m_text.startswith("default") and self.combo_asst_model.findText(m_text) == -1:
                    self.combo_asst_model.addItem(m_text)
            curr_parent_model = parent_combo.currentText().strip()
            if curr_parent_model and not curr_parent_model.startswith("default"):
                active_model = curr_parent_model

        if active_model:
            idx = self.combo_asst_model.findText(active_model)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.combo_asst_model.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            else:
                self.combo_asst_model.addItem(active_model)
                self.combo_asst_model.setCurrentIndex(self.combo_asst_model.count() - 1)

        self.combo_asst_model.blockSignals(False)

    def _choose_assistant_avatar(self):
        f, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Выберите аватар для Ассистента", "", "Images (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.webp)"
        )
        if f:
            try:
                CHARACTERS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                dest = CHARACTERS_DIR / f"user_asst_{Path(f).name}"
                shutil.copy2(f, dest)
                self.assistant_avatar_temp = str(dest)
                self._update_assistant_avatar_preview()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Ошибка сохранения аватара ассистента: {e}")

    def _update_assistant_avatar_preview(self):
        p = Path(self.assistant_avatar_temp) if self.assistant_avatar_temp and Path(self.assistant_avatar_temp).exists() else None
        name = self.asst_name_input.text().strip() if hasattr(self, "asst_name_input") else "User"
        pix = render_circular_avatar(p, name or "User", size=64, is_user=True)
        self.asst_avatar_lbl.setPixmap(pix)

    def _on_asst_name_changed(self, text: str):
        if not self.assistant_avatar_temp:
            self._update_assistant_avatar_preview()
