        scroll_layout.addWidget(lbl_outfit)

        self.rp_outfit_input = LineEdit(scroll_content)
        self.rp_outfit_input.setStyleSheet("""
            LineEdit {
                font-family: 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace;
                font-size: 11px;
                color: #38BDF8;
                background-color: rgba(6, 10, 18, 0.95);
                border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.25);
            }
        """)
        self.rp_outfit_input.setPlaceholderText("linen explorer shirt, cargo pants, leather belt, combat boots")
        scroll_layout.addWidget(self.rp_outfit_input)

        scroll.setWidget(scroll_content)
        right_layout.addWidget(scroll)
        main_layout.addWidget(right_panel, 1)

        return widget

    def _on_gender_changed(self, gender_key: str):
        if self._is_populating or not self.active_persona_id:
            return
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        if self.active_persona_id in personas:
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["gender"] = gender_key

    def _get_personas_dict(self) -> dict:
        rp_settings = self.profiles.get("rp_settings")
        if not isinstance(rp_settings, dict):
            self.profiles["rp_settings"] = rp_settings = {}
        personas = rp_settings.get("personas")
        if not isinstance(personas, dict):
            rp_settings["personas"] = personas = {}
        return personas

    def _load_rp_personas_list(self):
        self._is_populating = True
        rp_settings = self.profiles.get("rp_settings")
        if not isinstance(rp_settings, dict):
            self.profiles["rp_settings"] = rp_settings = {}
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        if not personas:
            personas["persona_default"] = {"name": "Игрок", "avatar_path": None, "bio": "", "gender": "male"}
            rp_settings["active_persona_id"] = "persona_default"

        active_id = rp_settings.get("active_persona_id")
        if active_id not in personas:
            active_id = next(iter(personas.keys()))
            rp_settings["active_persona_id"] = active_id

        self.active_primary_persona_id = active_id
        if not self.active_persona_id or self.active_persona_id not in personas:
            self.active_persona_id = active_id

        self.list_personas.blockSignals(True)
        self.list_personas.clear()
        selected_row = 0

        for idx, (pid, pdata) in enumerate(personas.items()):
            p_name = pdata.get("name", "Персонаж").strip() or "Персонаж"
            is_pri = (pid == self.active_primary_persona_id)
            label = f"★ {p_name} (Основной)" if is_pri else f"👤 {p_name}"
            item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, pid)
            if is_pri:
                item.setForeground(QColor("#00F0FF"))
            else:
                item.setForeground(QColor("#CBD5E1"))
            self.list_personas.addItem(item)
            if pid == self.active_persona_id:
                selected_row = idx

        self.list_personas.setCurrentRow(selected_row)
        self.list_personas.blockSignals(False)

        self._populate_persona_fields(self.active_persona_id)
        self._is_populating = False

    def _populate_persona_fields(self, pid: str):
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        pdata = personas.get(pid, {}) if isinstance(personas, dict) else {}

        self.rp_name_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_name_input.setText(pdata.get("name", ""))
        self.rp_name_input.blockSignals(False)

        gender = str(pdata.get("gender", "male")).lower()
        self.sw_gender.setCurrentItem("female" if gender == "female" else "male")

        self.rp_personality_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_personality_input.setPlainText(pdata.get("personality", ""))
        self.rp_personality_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_backstory_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_backstory_input.setPlainText(pdata.get("backstory", "") or pdata.get("bio", ""))
        self.rp_backstory_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_inventory_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_inventory_input.setText(pdata.get("inventory", ""))
        self.rp_inventory_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_visual_dna_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_visual_dna_input.setPlainText(pdata.get("visual_dna", ""))
        self.rp_visual_dna_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_outfit_input.blockSignals(True)
        self.rp_outfit_input.setText(pdata.get("outfit", ""))
        self.rp_outfit_input.blockSignals(False)

        self.rp_avatar_temp = pdata.get("avatar_path")
        self._update_rp_avatar_preview()

    def _on_persona_row_changed(self, row: int):
        if self._is_populating or row < 0 or row >= self.list_personas.count():
            return
        item = self.list_personas.item(row)
        if not item:
            return
        new_pid = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if not new_pid or new_pid == self.active_persona_id:
            return

        self._sync_current_persona_fields()
        self.active_persona_id = new_pid
        self._populate_persona_fields(new_pid)

    def _on_rp_name_changed(self, text: str):
        if self._is_populating or not self.active_persona_id:
            return
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        if self.active_persona_id in personas:
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["name"] = text
            row = self.list_personas.currentRow()
            if row >= 0:
                item = self.list_personas.item(row)
                if item:
                    display = text.strip() or "Персонаж"
                    is_pri = (self.active_persona_id == getattr(self, "active_primary_persona_id", None))
                    item.setText(f"★ {display} (Основной)" if is_pri else f"👤 {display}")
            self._update_rp_avatar_preview()

    def _sync_current_persona_fields(self):
        if self._is_populating or not getattr(self, "active_persona_id", None):
            return
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        if self.active_persona_id in personas:
            name = self.rp_name_input.text().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_name_input") else ""
            gender = self.sw_gender.currentRouteKey() if hasattr(self, "sw_gender") else "male"
            pers = self.rp_personality_input.toPlainText().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_personality_input") else ""
            back = self.rp_backstory_input.toPlainText().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_backstory_input") else ""
            inv = self.rp_inventory_input.text().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_inventory_input") else ""
            dna = self.rp_visual_dna_input.toPlainText().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_visual_dna_input") else ""
            outfit = self.rp_outfit_input.text().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_outfit_input") else ""

            bio = f"{pers}\n{back}".strip() if (pers or back) else ""

            personas[self.active_persona_id]["name"] = name
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["gender"] = gender or "male"
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["personality"] = pers
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["backstory"] = back
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["bio"] = bio
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["inventory"] = inv
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["visual_dna"] = dna
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["outfit"] = outfit
            personas[self.active_persona_id]["avatar_path"] = self.rp_avatar_temp

    def _set_current_as_primary(self):
        if not getattr(self, "active_persona_id", None):
            return
        self.active_primary_persona_id = self.active_persona_id
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        rp_settings = self.profiles.get("rp_settings")
        if isinstance(rp_settings, dict):
            rp_settings["active_persona_id"] = self.active_primary_persona_id

        for i in range(self.list_personas.count()):
            it = self.list_personas.item(i)
            if it:
                pid = it.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                name = (personas.get(pid) or {}).get("name", "Персонаж")
                is_pri = (pid == self.active_primary_persona_id)
                it.setText(f"★ {name} (Основной)" if is_pri else f"👤 {name}")
                if is_pri:
                    it.setForeground(QColor("#00F0FF"))
                else:
                    it.setForeground(QColor("#CBD5E1"))

    def _create_new_persona(self):
        self._sync_current_persona_fields()
        new_id = f"persona_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        personas[new_id] = {
            "name": f"Персонаж {len(personas) + 1}",
            "gender": "male",
            "avatar_path": None,
            "bio": "",
            "personality": "",
            "backstory": "",
            "inventory": "",
            "visual_dna": "",
            "outfit": ""
        }
        self.active_persona_id = new_id
        self._load_rp_personas_list()
        self.rp_name_input.setFocus()
        self.rp_name_input.selectAll()

    def _delete_current_persona(self):
        if not getattr(self, "active_persona_id", None):
            return
        personas = self._get_personas_dict()
        if len(personas) <= 1:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Внимание", "Нельзя удалить единственного персонажа.")
            return

        del_id = self.active_persona_id
        self._is_populating = True

        if del_id in personas:
            del personas[del_id]

        if self.active_primary_persona_id == del_id:
            self.active_primary_persona_id = next(iter(personas.keys()))
            rp_settings = self.profiles.get("rp_settings")
            if isinstance(rp_settings, dict):
                rp_settings["active_persona_id"] = self.active_primary_persona_id

        next_pid = self.active_primary_persona_id
        if next_pid not in personas:
            next_pid = next(iter(personas.keys()))
        self.active_persona_id = next_pid

        self.rp_avatar_temp = None
        self._load_rp_personas_list()

    def _choose_rp_avatar(self):
        f, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "Выберите аватар для RP персонажа", "", "Images (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.webp)"
        )
        if f:
            try:
                CHARACTERS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                dest = CHARACTERS_DIR / f"user_rp_{Path(f).name}"
                shutil.copy2(f, dest)
                self.rp_avatar_temp = str(dest)
                self._update_rp_avatar_preview()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Ошибка сохранения аватара героя: {e}")

    def _update_rp_avatar_preview(self):
        p = Path(self.rp_avatar_temp) if self.rp_avatar_temp and Path(self.rp_avatar_temp).exists() else None
        name = self.rp_name_input.text().strip() if hasattr(self, "rp_name_input") else "Hero"
        pix = render_circular_avatar(p, name or "Hero", size=64, is_user=True)
        self.rp_avatar_lbl.setPixmap(pix)

    # =========================================================================
    # Валидация и Сохранение данных
    # =========================================================================
    def _validate_inputs(self) -> bool:
        """Валидирует обязательные поля перед сохранением профилей."""
        self._sync_current_persona_fields()

        # Валидация текущей персоны в редакторе
        if self.active_persona_id:
            personas = self._get_personas_dict()
            pdata = personas.get(self.active_persona_id, {})
            p_name = pdata.get("name", "").strip()
            if not p_name:
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self,
                    "Валидация персоны",
                    "Имя героя не может быть пустым!\nПожалуйста, заполните поле «Имя героя»."
                )
                self.set_current_tab(1)
                self.rp_name_input.setFocus()
                return False

        return True

    def _save_all_profiles(self):
        """Сохраняет настройки профиля ассистента, персоны ролевого чата и параметры в config.json."""
        self.profiles["assistant_user"] = {
            "name": self.asst_name_input.text().strip() or "Пользователь",
            "avatar_path": self.assistant_avatar_temp,
            "bio": self.asst_bio_input.toPlainText().strip()
        }

        self._sync_current_persona_fields()

        rp_s = self.profiles.setdefault("rp_settings", {})
        rp_s["active_persona_id"] = getattr(self, "active_primary_persona_id", None) or self.active_persona_id

        # 1. Сохранение основного файла профилей
        SessionManager.save_user_profiles(self.profiles)

        # 2. Сохранение персон в data/user_personas.json
        try:
            DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            personas_file = DATA_DIR / "user_personas.json"
            atomic_write_json(personas_file, rp_s.get("personas", {}))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Не удалось записать user_personas.json: {e}")

        # 3. Сохранение настроек Эларии в config.json
        cfg = ConfigManager.load_config()
        cfg["user_name"] = self.asst_name_input.text().strip() or "Пользователь"
        is_auto = (self.art_mode_segmented.currentRouteKey() == "auto") if hasattr(self, "art_mode_segmented") else self.rb_art_auto.isChecked()
        cfg["auto_generate_art"] = is_auto
        selected_model = self.combo_asst_model.currentText().strip()
        if selected_model and not selected_model.startswith("default"):
            cfg["active_model"] = selected_model
        ConfigManager.save_config(cfg)

        new_config = ConfigManager.load_config()
        self.settings_applied.emit(new_config)
        self.profiles_updated.emit()

    def _save_all_and_close(self):
        if not self._validate_inputs():
            return
        self._save_all_profiles()
        self.accept()

def render_seamless_avatar(
    avatar_path: Optional[Union[Path, str]] = None,
    name: str = "Assistant",
    size: int = 44
) -> QPixmap:
    """
    Рендерит круглый аватар без жестких рамок (border: none)
    с мягким растворением внешнего контура в фон (edge feathering via radial gradient alpha mask).
    """
    scale_factor = 3
    render_size = size * scale_factor
    center = float(render_size) / 2.0
    radius = float(render_size) / 2.0

    image = QImage(render_size, render_size, QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32_Premultiplied)
    image.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)

    p_path = Path(avatar_path) if avatar_path else None
    loaded = False

    painter = QPainter(image)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, True)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)

    if p_path and p_path.exists():
        try:
            orig = QPixmap(str(p_path))
            if not orig.isNull():
                orig_w = orig.width()
                orig_h = orig.height()
                min_edge = min(orig_w, orig_h)
                if min_edge > 0:
                    crop_rect = QRect((orig_w - min_edge) // 2, (orig_h - min_edge) // 2, min_edge, min_edge)
                    sq = orig.copy(crop_rect)
                    scaled = sq.scaled(
                        render_size,
                        render_size,
                        Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
                        Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation
                    )
                    path = QPainterPath()
                    path.addEllipse(0.0, 0.0, float(render_size), float(render_size))
                    painter.setClipPath(path)
                    painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, scaled)
                    painter.setClipping(False)
                    loaded = True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Failed to load seamless avatar image {avatar_path}: {e}")
            loaded = False

    if not loaded:
        grad = QLinearGradient(0, 0, render_size, render_size)
        grad.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(14, 165, 233))
        grad.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(79, 70, 229))

        path = QPainterPath()
        path.addEllipse(0.0, 0.0, float(render_size), float(render_size))
        painter.fillPath(path, QBrush(grad))

        clean_name = re.sub(r'^[^\w\d]+', '', name.strip()) if name else ""
        letter = clean_name[0].upper() if clean_name else "N"
        font_size = max(10 * scale_factor, int(render_size * 0.42))
        font = QFont("Inter", font_size, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        font.setFamilies(["Inter", "Segoe UI", "sans-serif"])
        painter.setFont(font)
        painter.setPen(QColor(255, 255, 255))
        painter.drawText(QRectF(0, 0, float(render_size), float(render_size)), Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, letter)

    # Мягкое сглаживание и растворение краев портрета в цвет подложки (бесшовный эффект глубины)
    painter.setCompositionMode(QPainter.CompositionMode.CompositionMode_DestinationIn)
    radial_mask = QRadialGradient(center, center, radius)
    radial_mask.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(0, 0, 0, 255))
    radial_mask.setColorAt(0.82, QColor(0, 0, 0, 255))
    radial_mask.setColorAt(0.93, QColor(0, 0, 0, 170))
    radial_mask.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(0, 0, 0, 0))
    painter.setBrush(QBrush(radial_mask))
    painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
    painter.drawRect(0, 0, render_size, render_size)

    painter.end()

    result_pixmap = QPixmap.fromImage(image)
    result_pixmap.setDevicePixelRatio(scale_factor)
    return result_pixmap


def get_cached_circular_avatar(avatar_path: Optional[Path], name: str, size: int = 44) -> QPixmap:
    """
    Возвращает бесшовный круглый аватар из дискового кэша.
    Если кэш устарел или отсутствует — рендерит через render_seamless_avatar и кэширует.
    """
    if not avatar_path or not Path(avatar_path).exists():
        return render_seamless_avatar(None, name=name, size=size)

    p = Path(avatar_path).resolve()
    try:
        mtime = int(p.stat().st_mtime)
        path_hash = hashlib.md5(str(p).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:10]
        cache_file = GALLERY_THUMBS_DIR / f"{p.stem}_{path_hash}_{mtime}_{size}_feathered.png"

        if cache_file.exists():
            pix = QPixmap(str(cache_file))
            if not pix.isNull():
                pix.setDevicePixelRatio(3.0)
                return pix

        # Удаляем устаревшие файлы превью с прежним mtime перед генерацией нового
        for old_cache in GALLERY_THUMBS_DIR.glob(f"{p.stem}_{path_hash}_*_{size}*.png"):
            if old_cache != cache_file:
                old_cache.unlink(missing_ok=True)

        # Рендерим и сохраняем компактный кэш
        pix = render_seamless_avatar(p, name=name, size=size)
        if not pix.isNull():
            pix.save(str(cache_file), "PNG")
        return pix
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug(f"Thumbnail cache fallback for {p.name}: {e}")
        return render_seamless_avatar(p, name=name, size=size)


class CharacterCardWidget(QFrame):
    """
    Soft Card виджет элемента списка персонажей:
    - Бесшовная аватарка 44x44 без рамок, растворяющаяся в фоне карточки
    - Имя персонажа и плашки (тип карточки, статус бюджета токенов)
    - Мягкая подсветка при наведении (hover)
    - Четкая визуальная фиксация выбранного героя
    """
    clicked = pyqtSignal()
    double_clicked = pyqtSignal()

    def __init__(
        self,
        card_name: str,
        avatar_pixmap: QPixmap,
        badge_text: str = "",
        type_badge: str = "",
        parent: Optional[QWidget] = None
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("CharacterCardWidget")
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._is_selected = False
        self._name = card_name
        self._badge_text = badge_text.strip()
        self._type_badge = type_badge.strip()
        self._pixmap = avatar_pixmap

        self._setup_ui()
        self._apply_style()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.setFixedHeight(62)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(8, 6, 10, 6)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        # Avatar — бесшовный без рамок
        self.avatar_lbl = QLabel(self)
        self.avatar_lbl.setObjectName("CharacterCardAvatar")
        self.avatar_lbl.setFixedSize(44, 44)
        self.avatar_lbl.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self.avatar_lbl.setStyleSheet("border: none; background: transparent;")
        if not self._pixmap.isNull():
            self.avatar_lbl.setPixmap(self._pixmap)
        layout.addWidget(self.avatar_lbl)

        # Info Box
        info_box = QVBoxLayout()
        info_box.setContentsMargins(0, 2, 0, 2)
        info_box.setSpacing(4)

        self.name_lbl = QLabel(self._name, self)
        self.name_lbl.setObjectName("CharacterCardName")
        info_box.addWidget(self.name_lbl)

        self.badges_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        self.badges_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.badges_layout.setSpacing(6)

        self.type_lbl = QLabel(self._type_badge, self)
        self.type_lbl.setObjectName("CharacterCardTypeBadge")
        self.type_lbl.setVisible(bool(self._type_badge))
        self.badges_layout.addWidget(self.type_lbl)

        self.traffic_lbl = QLabel(self._badge_text, self)
        self.traffic_lbl.setObjectName("CharacterCardTrafficBadge")
        self.traffic_lbl.setVisible(bool(self._badge_text))
        self.badges_layout.addWidget(self.traffic_lbl)

        self.badges_layout.addStretch()
        info_box.addLayout(self.badges_layout)

        layout.addLayout(info_box, stretch=1)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit()
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.double_clicked.emit()
        super().mouseDoubleClickEvent(event)

    def contextMenuEvent(self, event):
        p = self.parentWidget()
        while p and not isinstance(p, QListWidget):
            p = p.parentWidget()
        if p:
            p.customContextMenuRequested.emit(p.mapFromGlobal(event.globalPos()))
        else:
            super().contextMenuEvent(event)

    def set_selected(self, selected: bool):
        if self._is_selected != selected:
            self._is_selected = selected
            self._apply_style()

    def update_info(
        self,

        if type_badge is not None:
            self._type_badge = type_badge.strip()
            self.type_lbl.setText(self._type_badge)
            self.type_lbl.setVisible(bool(self._type_badge))

"""
Mixin for Character Gallery: Scenery DNA, Visual DNA, and Party Extraction.
"""

import re
import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List

from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPixmap
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QDialog, QMessageBox, QPushButton, QFrame, QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel, QApplication, QTextEdit
)

from services.tavern_parser import CharacterCard, TavernParser
from services.art_director.contracts import VisualIntent
from services.token_budget_manager import TokenBudgetManager
from services.task_queue import InferenceTask
from ui.dialogs.local_lora_dialog import LocalLoraDialog
from ui.dialogs.card_visual_setup_dialog import CardVisualSetupDialog

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.CharactersGallery.DnaPartyMixin")


class GalleryDnaPartyMixin:
    def _extract_and_apply_scenery_dna(self, card: CharacterCard, json_path: Path):
        """Фоновое извлечение геометрии окружения карточки через локальную LLM."""
        if getattr(card, "is_lorebook", False):
            return

        # 1. Если есть regex-теги, сохраняем сразу
        scenery = getattr(card, "scenery_dna", "").strip()
        if not scenery and (card.scenario or card.description):
            scenery = TavernParser.extract_scenery_dna_regex(card.scenario or card.description)

        if scenery:
            card.scenery_dna = scenery
            TavernParser.save_card_scenery_dna(card, json_path)
            return

        # 2. Фоновый инференс через TaskQueue
        parent_win = self.parent()
        if not (parent_win and hasattr(parent_win, "task_queue") and hasattr(parent_win, "lm_client")):
            return

        desc_for_scenery = card.scenario or card.description or card.first_mes
        if not desc_for_scenery:
            return

        sys_prompt = (
            "You are an environment concept artist for Stable Diffusion. "
            "Extract 4-8 physical environment and architecture tags in English from the text.\n"
            "Examples of valid output:\n"
            "- 'ancient stone ruins, broken pillars, moss, overgrown, cloudy sky'\n"
            "- 'cyberpunk street, neon signs, wet asphalt, dark alley, holographic billboards'\n"
            "STRICT RULES:\n"
            "1. Do NOT include abstract category words (e.g. 'room type', 'furniture', 'materials', 'lighting', 'weather', 'outdoor scenery').\n"
            "2. Do NOT include character names, humans, living creatures, or actions.\n"
            "3. Output ONLY comma-separated tags."
        )
        user_prompt = f"Extract location environment tags from this scenario/setting:\n{desc_for_scenery}"

        def _worker_scenery(payload: str) -> dict:
            resp = parent_win.lm_client.chat_completion(
                messages=[{"role": "system", "content": sys_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}],
                temperature=0.2,
                emit_signal=False,
                is_roleplay=False
            )
            return {"raw_reply": resp}

        target_file = Path(json_path).resolve()
        card_ref = card
        target_key = str(target_file)

        task = InferenceTask(
            name=f"🏞️ Извлечение локации: {card.name}",
            task_type="memory",
            func=_worker_scenery,
            kwargs={"payload": desc_for_scenery},
            abort_fn=parent_win.lm_client.abort,
            metadata={"silent": True}
        )

        def _on_scenery_done(task_id, result):
            active_set = self._running_analysis_tasks.get(target_key, set())
            active_set.discard(task_id)
            if not active_set:
                self._running_analysis_tasks.pop(target_key, None)

            reply = result.get("raw_reply", "") if isinstance(result, dict) else str(result)
            if reply and reply.strip():
                raw_result = reply.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
                if raw_result.lower().startswith("tags:"):
                    raw_result = raw_result[5:].strip()

                # Санитизация тегов от персонажей и сюжетных глаголов
                WHITELIST_COMPOUND_LOCATIONS = {
                    "slave market", "slave cage", "slave cell", "slave quarters", 
                    "slave auction", "slave camp", "slave caravan", "prison cell", "iron cage"
                }
                forbidden_words = {"protects", "protect", "aggressive", "problem", "lot", "sisters", "sister", "girls", "girl", "slave", "slaves", "defiant", "terrified"}
                if card_ref.name:
                    forbidden_words.update(w.lower() for w in re.findall(r'\b[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ0-9_-]+\b', card_ref.name))
                for comp in getattr(card_ref, "companions", []):
                    if isinstance(comp, dict) and comp.get("name"):
                        forbidden_words.update(w.lower() for w in re.findall(r'\b[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ0-9_-]+\b', comp["name"]))

                INSTRUCTION_META_NOISE = {
                    "only architecture", "architecture", "room type", "furniture", 
                    "materials", "lighting", "weather", "outdoor scenery", 
                    "room", "environment", "tags", "indoor"
                }
                raw_tags = [t.strip() for t in raw_result.split(",") if t.strip()]
                clean_tags = []
                for t in raw_tags:
                    t_low = t.lower().strip()
                    if t_low in INSTRUCTION_META_NOISE:
                        continue
                    if t_low in WHITELIST_COMPOUND_LOCATIONS:
                        clean_tags.append(t)
                        continue
                    words = t_low.split()
                    if any(fw in words for fw in forbidden_words):
                        continue
                    clean_tags.append(t)
                final_scenery_dna = ", ".join(clean_tags)

                card_ref.scenery_dna = final_scenery_dna
                TavernParser.save_card_scenery_dna(card_ref, target_file)
                if self.active_entry and Path(self.active_entry["path"]).resolve() == target_file:
                    if hasattr(self.active_entry.get("card"), "scenery_dna"):
                        self.active_entry["card"].scenery_dna = final_scenery_dna

            self._update_card_analysis_ui()

        def _on_scenery_fail(task_id, err):
            active_set = self._running_analysis_tasks.get(target_key, set())
            active_set.discard(task_id)
            if not active_set:
                self._running_analysis_tasks.pop(target_key, None)
            logger.warning(f"Ошибка фонового извлечения scenery_dna: {err}")
            self._update_card_analysis_ui()

        self._ensure_task_queue_connected()
        self._running_analysis_tasks.setdefault(target_key, set()).add(task.id)
        parent_win._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self._active_dialog_tasks[task.id] = {
            "on_done": _on_scenery_done,
            "on_fail": _on_scenery_fail,
            "abort_fn": parent_win.lm_client.abort
        }
        self._update_card_analysis_ui()
        parent_win.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _extract_and_apply_visual_dna(self, card, json_path: Path):
        dna = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
        if not dna and hasattr(card, "description") and card.description:
            try:
                dna = TavernParser.extract_physical_dna_regex(card.description)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Не удалось извлечь Visual DNA для '{getattr(card, 'name', 'Unknown')}': {e}")
                dna = ""

        if dna:
            card.visual_dna = dna
            try:
                TavernParser.save_card_visual_dna(card, json_path)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Не удалось сохранить visual_dna в {json_path}: {e}")

            if hasattr(self, "active_entry") and self.active_entry and Path(self.active_entry.get("path", "")).resolve() == Path(json_path).resolve():
                if hasattr(self, "input_visual_dna"):
                    self.input_visual_dna.setPlainText(dna)
                if hasattr(self, "_update_context_budget"):
                    self._update_context_budget()

        if getattr(self, "_awaiting_visual_modal_path", None) == str(Path(json_path).resolve()):
            self._awaiting_visual_modal_path = None
            QTimer.singleShot(200, lambda: self._show_visual_setup_modal(card, Path(json_path)))


    def _check_and_extract_party(self, card: CharacterCard, json_path: Path):
        """
        Логика фонового извлечения сопартийцев:
        Строго проверяет, является ли карточка групповой.
        Если да и отряд еще не сохранен — запускает фоновое распознавание состава отряда via LLM.
        Если карточка НЕ групповая — вызов _extract_party_via_llm категорически запрещен.
        Обычные карточки идут штатным путем _extract_and_apply_visual_dna.
        """
        tags_lower = [str(t).lower() for t in getattr(card, "tags", [])]
        is_group = getattr(card, "is_group", False) or "multiple characters" in tags_lower
        has_saved_party = bool(getattr(card, "companions", []))

        if is_group and not has_saved_party:
            self._extract_party_via_llm(card, Path(json_path))
        else:
            self._update_party_selector_ui()
            if not is_group:
                self._extract_and_apply_visual_dna(card, Path(json_path))

    def _extract_party_via_llm(self, card: CharacterCard, json_path: Path):
        """
        Фоновое распознавание состава отряда через локальную LLM в TaskQueue.
        Запускается ТОЛЬКО для карточек, идентифицированных как групповые.
        """
        parent_win = self.parent()
        if not (parent_win and hasattr(parent_win, "task_queue") and hasattr(parent_win, "lm_client")):
            return

        # Исключаем заметки автора (авторские комментарии), system_prompt и посторонние метаданные:
        desc_parts = []
        if card.description:
            desc_parts.append(f"Описание:\n{card.description.strip()}")
        if card.personality:
            desc_parts.append(f"Личность:\n{card.personality.strip()}")
        if card.scenario:
            desc_parts.append(f"Сценарий:\n{card.scenario.strip()}")
        if card.first_mes:
            desc_parts.append(f"Первая сцена:\n{card.first_mes.strip()[:600]}")

        party_source_text = "\n\n".join(desc_parts)
        if not party_source_text:
            return

        sys_prompt = (
            "You are an expert AI data extractor. Analyze this group character card and extract all distinct companions/members.\n"
            "Return STRICT JSON list of objects:\n"
            "[\n"
            "  {\n"
            "    \"name\": \"Character Name\",\n"
            "    \"role\": \"Brief role/relationship\",\n"
            "    \"visual_dna\": \"8-12 English comma-separated tags for SD: age, gender, race, hair, eyes, body, distinct features. NO clothing.\"\n"
            "  }\n"
            "]"
        )
        user_prompt = f"Analyze this group character card and extract all companions:\n{party_source_text}"

        def _worker_party(payload: str) -> dict:
            resp = parent_win.lm_client.chat_completion(
                messages=[{"role": "system", "content": sys_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}],
                temperature=0.2,
                emit_signal=False,
                is_roleplay=False
            )
            return {"raw_reply": resp}

        target_file = Path(json_path).resolve()
        card_ref = card
        target_key = str(target_file)

        def _on_party_done(task_id, result):
            active_set = self._running_analysis_tasks.get(target_key, set())
            active_set.discard(task_id)
            if not active_set:
                self._running_analysis_tasks.pop(target_key, None)

            reply = result.get("raw_reply", "") if isinstance(result, dict) else str(result)
            if reply and reply.strip():
                clean_reply = reply.strip()
                if "```json" in clean_reply:
                    clean_reply = clean_reply.split("```json", 1)[1].split("```", 1)[0].strip()
                elif "```" in clean_reply:
                    clean_reply = clean_reply.split("```", 1)[1].split("```", 1)[0].strip()

                parsed = None
                try:
                    parsed = json.loads(clean_reply)
                except Exception:
                    m = re.search(r'\[\s*\{.*\}\s*\]', clean_reply, re.DOTALL)
                    if m:
                        try:
                            parsed = json.loads(m.group(0))
                        except Exception:
                            parsed = None

                if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                    if "companions" in parsed and isinstance(parsed["companions"], list):
                        parsed = parsed["companions"]
                    elif "members" in parsed and isinstance(parsed["members"], list):
                        parsed = parsed["members"]

                if isinstance(parsed, list) and len(parsed) >= 2:
                    valid_comps = []
                    for item in parsed:
                        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("name"):
                            valid_comps.append({
                                "name": str(item.get("name", "")).strip(),
                                "role": str(item.get("role", "")).strip(),
                                "visual_dna": str(item.get("visual_dna", "")).strip(),
                                "aliases": [str(item.get("name", "")).strip()]
                            })

                    if len(valid_comps) >= 2:
                        card_ref.companions = valid_comps
                        card_ref.is_group = True
                        TavernParser.save_card_companions(card_ref, target_file)
                        if self.active_entry and Path(self.active_entry["path"]).resolve() == target_file:
                            if hasattr(self.active_entry.get("card"), "companions"):
                                self.active_entry["card"].companions = valid_comps
                                self.active_entry["card"].is_group = True
                            self._update_party_selector_ui()

            self._update_card_analysis_ui()
            if self._awaiting_visual_modal_path == target_key:
                self._awaiting_visual_modal_path = None
                QTimer.singleShot(200, lambda: self._show_visual_setup_modal(card_ref, target_file))

        def _on_party_fail(task_id, err):
            active_set = self._running_analysis_tasks.get(target_key, set())
            active_set.discard(task_id)
            if not active_set:
                self._running_analysis_tasks.pop(target_key, None)
            logger.warning(f"Ошибка фонового извлечения сопартийцев: {err}")
            self._update_card_analysis_ui()
            if self._awaiting_visual_modal_path == target_key:
                self._awaiting_visual_modal_path = None
                QTimer.singleShot(200, lambda: self._show_visual_setup_modal(card_ref, target_file))

        task = InferenceTask(
            name=f"👥 Распознавание отряда: {card.name}",
            task_type="memory",
            func=_worker_party,
            kwargs={"payload": party_source_text},
            abort_fn=parent_win.lm_client.abort,
            metadata={"silent": True}
        )
        self._ensure_task_queue_connected()
        self._running_analysis_tasks.setdefault(target_key, set()).add(task.id)
        parent_win._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self._active_dialog_tasks[task.id] = {
            "on_done": _on_party_done,
            "on_fail": _on_party_fail,
            "abort_fn": parent_win.lm_client.abort
        }
        self._update_card_analysis_ui()
        parent_win.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _update_party_selector_ui(self):
        """
        Динамический инспектор сопартийцев:
        Панель отображается СТРОГО при обнаружении более 1 персонажа (N > 1).
        Для одиночных карточек (N <= 1) панель полностью скрыта (setVisible(False)).
        """
        while self.party_selector_layout.count():
            item = self.party_selector_layout.takeAt(0)
            w = item.widget()
            if w:
                w.deleteLater()
        self.party_buttons.clear()

        if not self.active_entry:
            self.party_selector_container.setVisible(False)
            self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setText("🎨 Сгенерировать арт")
            self.active_companion_idx = -1
            return

        card = self.active_entry.get("card")
        companions = getattr(card, "companions", []) if card else []

        # СТРОГОЕ ПРАВИЛО: если len <= 1 -> скрыть панель
        if len(companions) <= 1:
            self.party_selector_container.setVisible(False)
            self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setText("🎨 Сгенерировать арт")
            self.active_companion_idx = -1
            return

        # len > 1 -> отобразить панель сопартийцев
        self.party_selector_container.setVisible(True)

        for i, comp in enumerate(companions):
            c_name = comp.get("name", "").strip() or f"Спутник {i+1}"
            btn = QPushButton(f"👤 {c_name}")
            btn.setObjectName("btn_tr_field")
            btn.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
            btn.clicked.connect(lambda checked=False, idx=i: self._on_companion_chip_clicked(idx))
            self.party_buttons.append(btn)
            self.party_selector_layout.addWidget(btn)

        btn_all = QPushButton("👥 Общий кадр")
        btn_all.setObjectName("btn_tr_field")
        btn_all.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        btn_all.clicked.connect(lambda checked=False: self._on_companion_chip_clicked(-1))
        self.party_buttons.append(btn_all)
        self.party_selector_layout.addWidget(btn_all)
        self.party_selector_layout.addStretch()

        if self.active_companion_idx == -1 or self.active_companion_idx >= len(companions):
            self.active_companion_idx = 0

        self._refresh_party_button_styles()

        if 0 <= self.active_companion_idx < len(companions):
            comp = companions[self.active_companion_idx]
            self.input_visual_dna.setPlainText(comp.get("visual_dna", ""))
            self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setText(f"🎨 Сгенерировать арт: {comp.get('name', 'Спутник')}")
        else:
            combined = ", ".join(c.get("visual_dna", "") for c in companions if c.get("visual_dna")).replace(", ", " BREAK ")
            self.input_visual_dna.setPlainText(combined)
            self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setText("🎨 Сгенерировать арт: Отряд")

    def _refresh_party_button_styles(self):
        """Подсвечивает активную кнопку сопартийца неоновым акцентом #00F0FF."""
        card = self.active_entry.get("card") if self.active_entry else None
        companions = getattr(card, "companions", []) if card else []
        n_comps = len(companions)

        for i, btn in enumerate(self.party_buttons):
            is_active = False
            if i < n_comps:
                is_active = (i == self.active_companion_idx)
            else:
                is_active = (self.active_companion_idx == -1)

            if is_active:
                btn.setStyleSheet(
                    "border: 1px solid #00F0FF; background-color: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.18); "
                    "color: #00F0FF; font-weight: bold; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px;"
                )
            else:
                btn.setStyleSheet(
                    "border: 1px solid #1E293B; background-color: #0F172A; "
                    "color: #94A3B8; font-weight: normal; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px;"
                )

    def _on_companion_chip_clicked(self, idx: int):
        """
        Смена сопартийца:
        1. Сохраняет текущий набранный текст из input_visual_dna в card.companions[active_companion_idx].
        2. Переключает active_companion_idx = idx.
        3. Если выбран конкретный персонаж: подставляет visual_dna, меняет текст кнопки.
           Если выбран «Общий кадр»: объединяет теги через BREAK, меняет текст кнопки на «🎨 Сгенерировать арт: Отряд».
        4. Перерисовывает стили кнопок.
        """
        if not self.active_entry:
            return
        card = self.active_entry.get("card")
        companions = getattr(card, "companions", []) if card else []
        if not companions:
            return

        # 1. Сохраняем текущий набранный текст
        if 0 <= self.active_companion_idx < len(companions):
            companions[self.active_companion_idx]["visual_dna"] = self.input_visual_dna.toPlainText().strip()

        # 2. Переключаем индекс
        self.active_companion_idx = idx

        # 3. Обновляем поле ввода и кнопку генерации
        if 0 <= idx < len(companions):
            comp = companions[idx]
            self.input_visual_dna.setPlainText(comp.get("visual_dna", ""))
            self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setText(f"🎨 Сгенерировать арт: {comp.get('name', 'Спутник')}")
        else:
            # «Общий кадр» (-1)
            combined = ", ".join(c.get("visual_dna", "") for c in companions if c.get("visual_dna")).replace(", ", " BREAK ")
            self.input_visual_dna.setPlainText(combined)
            self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setText("🎨 Сгенерировать арт: Отряд")

        # 4. Перерисовываем стили кнопок
        self._refresh_party_button_styles()
        self._update_context_budget()

    def _on_gallery_generate_art_clicked(self):
        """
        Обработчик кнопки прямой генерации арта из галереи:
        Считывает текущий prompt_text из input_visual_dna,
        собирает VisualIntent и отправляет в TaskQueue / ArtDirector без открытия чата.
        """
        prompt_text = self.input_visual_dna.toPlainText().strip()
        if not prompt_text:
            self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setToolTip("⚠️ Промпт внешности (Visual DNA) пуст!")
            parent_win = self.parent()
            if parent_win and hasattr(parent_win, "statusBar"):
                parent_win.statusBar().showMessage("⚠️ Visual DNA пуст. Заполните теги внешности для генерации.", 4000)
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Visual DNA пуст", "Поле внешности (Visual DNA) пусто.\nЗаполните теги внешности для генерации арта.")
            return

        if not self.active_entry:
            return

        card = self.active_entry["card"]
        parent_win = self.parent()
        if not parent_win:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Ошибка", "Родительское окно недоступно.")
            return

        has_art = hasattr(parent_win, "art_director") or hasattr(parent_win, "_on_scene_art_requested")
        if not has_art:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Сервис недоступен", "Сервис генерации артов недоступен.")
            return

        from services.art_director import VisualIntent, TargetSubject

        comp_name = card.name
        if 0 <= self.active_companion_idx < len(getattr(card, "companions", [])):
            comp_name = card.companions[self.active_companion_idx]["name"]
        elif self.active_companion_idx == -1 and getattr(card, "companions", []):
            comp_name = "Отряд"

        v_intent = VisualIntent(
            prompt=prompt_text,
            target_subject=TargetSubject.COMPANION,
            user_neg="",
            suggested_model=getattr(parent_win, "selected_forge_checkpoint", None),
            seed=-1,
            raw_user_query=f"Прямая генерация из галереи: {comp_name}",
            mode="roleplay"
        )

        orig_btn_text = self.btn_gallery_generate_art.text()
        self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setText("⏳ Отправлено в Forge...")
        self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setEnabled(False)

        def _restore_btn():
            self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setText(orig_btn_text)
            self.btn_gallery_generate_art.setEnabled(True)

        QTimer.singleShot(2000, _restore_btn)

        if hasattr(parent_win, "_on_scene_art_requested"):
            parent_win._on_scene_art_requested(
                visual_intent=v_intent,
                character_name=comp_name
            )
        elif hasattr(parent_win, "task_queue") and hasattr(parent_win, "art_director") and hasattr(parent_win, "forge_client"):
            def _gallery_art_worker(v_payload: VisualIntent, ckpt: Optional[str] = None):
                getattr(parent_win, "_cancel_lms_reload", lambda: None)()
                avail = parent_win.forge_client.get_models()
                plan = parent_win.art_director.plan_from_visual_intent(
                    visual_intent=v_payload,
                    preferred_style=ckpt,
                    available_models=avail,
                    character_name=comp_name,
                    character=card,
                    mode="roleplay"
                )
                from services.vram_arbiter import VRAMArbiter
                VRAMArbiter.get_instance().release_llm_for_diffusion()

                kwargs = plan.to_forge_kwargs()
                img = parent_win.forge_client.text_to_image(**kwargs)
                try:
                    parent_win.forge_client.unload_checkpoint()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                if hasattr(parent_win, "_reload_active_lms_model_async"):
                    parent_win._reload_active_lms_model_async(delay=1.2)
                return {"image_path": img, "plan": plan}

            task = InferenceTask(
                name=f"🎨 Арт: {comp_name}",
                task_type="image",
                func=_gallery_art_worker,
                kwargs={"v_payload": v_intent, "ckpt": getattr(parent_win, "selected_forge_checkpoint", None)},
                abort_fn=parent_win.forge_client.interrupt,
                metadata={"prompt": prompt_text, "silent": True, "needs_llm_prompt_gen": False}
            )
            if hasattr(parent_win, "_active_tasks") and isinstance(parent_win._active_tasks, dict):
                parent_win._active_tasks[task.id] = task
            parent_win.task_queue.enqueue(task)

        if hasattr(parent_win, "statusBar"):
            parent_win.statusBar().showMessage(f"🎨 Генерация арта для '{comp_name}' отправлена в Forge.", 4000)

    def _on_find_lora_clicked(self):
        if not self.active_entry:
            return
        card = self.active_entry["card"]
        
        # Определяем целевое имя: если выбран конкретный сопартиец — ищем его
        target_name = card.name
        if 0 <= self.active_companion_idx < len(getattr(card, "companions", [])):
            target_name = card.companions[self.active_companion_idx]["name"]
        
        # Очищаем имя от лишних приписок ("Кай и Эйла - Рабыни" -> "Кай", отсекаем скобки)
        clean_query = re.sub(r'[\(\[].*?[\)\]]', '', target_name)
        clean_query = clean_query.split('-')[0].split('—')[0].strip()

        from ui.dialogs.civitai_lora_dialog import CivitaiLoraDialog
        dlg = CivitaiLoraDialog(
            character_name=target_name,
            initial_query=clean_query,
            active_architecture="SD 1.5",
            parent=self
        )
        dlg.lora_installed.connect(self._on_lora_installed_for_card)
        dlg.exec()

    def _on_lora_installed_for_card(self, file_stem: str, character_name: str, trained_words: list):
        """Предлагает добавить тег LoRA и триггерные слова в поле Visual DNA карточки."""
        act_tags = ", ".join(trained_words[:5]) if trained_words else ""
        lora_token = f"<lora:{file_stem}:0.8>"
        suggested_injection = f"{lora_token}, {act_tags}".strip(" ,")

        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "LoRA установлена",
            f"LoRA '{file_stem}' успешно сохранена в Forge и зарегистрирована!\n\n"
            f"Добавить тег активации в Visual DNA персонажа?\n\n{suggested_injection}",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes
        )

        if reply == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            cur_dna = re.sub(r'<lora:[^>]+>\s*,?\s*', '', self.input_visual_dna.toPlainText(), flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip(' ,')
            new_dna = f"{suggested_injection}, {cur_dna}".strip(" ,") if cur_dna else suggested_injection
            self.input_visual_dna.setPlainText(new_dna)
            self._save_changes(silent=True)

    def _show_visual_setup_modal(self, card: CharacterCard, target_path: Path):
        if not self.isVisible():
            return
        dlg = CardVisualSetupDialog(card, parent=self)
        if dlg.exec() == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
            new_dna = dlg.get_visual_dna()
            card.visual_dna = new_dna
            self._save_card_visual_dna(card, target_path)
            if self.active_entry and Path(self.active_entry["path"]).resolve() == target_path.resolve():
                self.input_visual_dna.setPlainText(new_dna)
                self._update_context_budget()
                self._save_changes(silent=True)

    def _on_choose_local_lora_clicked(self):
        if not self.active_entry:
            return
        card = self.active_entry["card"]
        target_name = card.name
        if 0 <= self.active_companion_idx < len(getattr(card, "companions", [])):
            target_name = card.companions[self.active_companion_idx]["name"]

        dlg = LocalLoraDialog(character_name=target_name, parent=self)
        if dlg.exec() == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
            lora_tag, triggers = dlg.get_result()
            if lora_tag:
                cur_dna = re.sub(r'<lora:[^>]+>\s*,?\s*', '', self.input_visual_dna.toPlainText(), flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip(' ,')
                add_s = lora_tag
                if triggers:
                    add_s += f", {', '.join(triggers[:4])}"
                new_dna = f"{add_s}, {cur_dna}".strip(" ,") if cur_dna else add_s
                self.input_visual_dna.setPlainText(new_dna)
                self._save_changes(silent=True)

    def _save_card_visual_dna(self, card: CharacterCard, json_path: Path):
        """Saves card.visual_dna into the character JSON file on disk."""
        try:
            p = Path(json_path)
            if not p.exists():
                return
            with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            target = data.get("data", data) if ("spec" in data or "data" in data) else data
            target["visual_dna"] = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
            if "visual_dna" in data and data is not target:
                data["visual_dna"] = getattr(card, "visual_dna", "")
            from utils.file_utils import atomic_write_json
            atomic_write_json(p, data)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Could not persist visual_dna to {json_path}: {e}")

"""
Mixin for Character Gallery: Card and Field Translation Pipeline.
"""

import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Callable, Any

from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QTextEdit, QPushButton, QMessageBox, QApplication
)

from services.tavern_parser import CharacterCard, TavernParser
from services.task_queue import InferenceTask
from services.card_translator import (
    CardTranslator,
    mask_card_tags,
    unmask_card_tags,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("NeonRoute.CharactersGallery.TranslationMixin")


class GalleryTranslationMixin:
    def _toggle_card_language(self):
        """Swaps displayed text between original and _ru translation for all fields."""
        if not self.active_entry:
            return
        card: CharacterCard = self.active_entry["card"]
        self._showing_ru = not getattr(self, "_showing_ru", True)

        if not self._showing_ru:
            self.btn_toggle_lang.setText("🌐 RU / EN [EN]")
            self.btn_toggle_lang.setToolTip("Отображается: Оригинал (EN). Нажмите для переключения на русский перевод (RU).")
            self.input_desc.setPlainText(card.description or "")
            self.input_personality.setPlainText(card.personality or "")
            self.input_scenario.setPlainText(card.scenario or "")
            self.input_mes_example.setPlainText(card.mes_example or "")
        else:
            self.btn_toggle_lang.setText("🌐 RU / EN [RU]")
            self.btn_toggle_lang.setToolTip("Отображается: Русский перевод (RU). Нажмите для переключения на оригинал (EN).")
            self.input_desc.setPlainText(card.description_ru or card.description or "")
            self.input_personality.setPlainText(card.personality_ru or card.personality or "")
            self.input_scenario.setPlainText(card.scenario_ru or card.scenario or "")
            self.input_mes_example.setPlainText(card.mes_example_ru or card.mes_example or "")

        self._update_greeting_display()

    def _toggle_field_lang(self, text_edit: QTextEdit, field_key: str):
        """Toggles a single field between original and RU translation."""
        if not self.active_entry:
            return
        card: CharacterCard = self.active_entry["card"]
        current_val = text_edit.toPlainText().strip()
        ru_val = getattr(card, f"{field_key}_ru", "") or ""
        orig_val = getattr(card, field_key, "") or ""
        if current_val == ru_val and orig_val:
            text_edit.setPlainText(orig_val)
        elif orig_val and ru_val:
            text_edit.setPlainText(ru_val)
        elif ru_val:
            text_edit.setPlainText(ru_val)
        elif orig_val:
            text_edit.setPlainText(orig_val)

    def _execute_translation_pipeline(
        self,
        source_text: str,
        system_prompt: str,
        btn: QPushButton,
        on_success,
        max_chunk_tokens: int = 600
    ):
        parent_win = self.parent()
        if not parent_win or not hasattr(parent_win, "task_queue") or not hasattr(parent_win, "lm_client"):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Ошибка", "Модуль инференса недоступен.")
            return

        btn.setEnabled(False)
        orig_btn_text = btn.text()
        btn.setText("⏳ ...")

        def _on_done(task_id, result):
            btn.setEnabled(True)
            res_dict = result if isinstance(result, dict) else {"final_text": str(result), "had_cjk_issue": False}
            final_text = res_dict.get("final_text", "")
            had_cjk = res_dict.get("had_cjk_issue", False)

            if had_cjk:
                btn.setText("⚠️ Проверьте текст")
            else:
                btn.setText(orig_btn_text)

            if final_text.strip():
                on_success(final_text)

        def _on_fail(task_id, err):
            btn.setEnabled(True)
            btn.setText(orig_btn_text)
            logger.error(f"[CardTranslator] Ошибка перевода: {err}")
            # Мягкое уведомление без блокирующего QMessageBox
            btn.setText("❌ Сбой")

        task = CardTranslator.create_translation_task(
            source_text=source_text,
            system_prompt=system_prompt,
            lm_client=parent_win.lm_client,
            on_done=_on_done,
            on_fail=_on_fail,
            max_chunk_tokens=max_chunk_tokens,
            task_name=f"🌐 Перевод: {orig_btn_text}"
        )
        self._ensure_task_queue_connected()
        if hasattr(parent_win, "_active_tasks") and isinstance(parent_win._active_tasks, dict):
            parent_win._active_tasks[task.id] = task
        self._active_dialog_tasks[task.id] = {
            "on_done": _on_done,
            "on_fail": _on_fail,
            "abort_fn": getattr(task, "abort_fn", getattr(parent_win.lm_client, "abort", None))
        }
        parent_win.task_queue.enqueue(task)

    def _translate_field(self, text_edit: QTextEdit, field_key: str, btn: QPushButton):
        """Translates a single field to Russian via robust literary pipeline."""
        if not self.active_entry:
            return
        card: CharacterCard = self.active_entry["card"]
        text = getattr(card, field_key, "") or text_edit.toPlainText().strip()
        if not text:
            return

        sys_prompt = CardTranslator.build_field_prompt(field_key)

        def _apply_field(translated_text: str):
            if self.active_entry and self.active_entry["card"] == card:
                self._showing_ru = True
                if hasattr(self, "btn_toggle_lang"):
                    self.btn_toggle_lang.setText("🌐 RU / EN")
                text_edit.setPlainText(translated_text)
                ru_attr = f"{field_key}_ru"
                if hasattr(card, ru_attr):
                    setattr(card, ru_attr, translated_text)
                TavernParser.save_card_translations(card)
                self._save_changes(silent=True)

        self._execute_translation_pipeline(text, sys_prompt, btn, _apply_field)

    def _translate_mes_example(self):
        """Translates card.mes_example to Russian via pipeline."""
        if not self.active_entry:
            return
        card: CharacterCard = self.active_entry["card"]
        source_text = card.mes_example or self.input_mes_example.toPlainText().strip()
        if not source_text:
            return

        sys_prompt = CardTranslator.build_field_prompt("mes_example")

        def _apply_ex(translated_text: str):
            card.mes_example_ru = translated_text
            if self.active_entry and self.active_entry["card"] == card:
                self._showing_ru = True
                if hasattr(self, "btn_toggle_lang"):
                    self.btn_toggle_lang.setText("🌐 RU / EN")
                self.input_mes_example.setPlainText(translated_text)
            TavernParser.save_card_translations(card)
            self._save_changes(silent=True)

        self._execute_translation_pipeline(source_text, sys_prompt, self.btn_tr_ex, _apply_ex)

    def _translate_first_mes(self):
        """Translates currently open greeting variant to Russian via pipeline."""
        if not self.active_entry:
            return
        card: CharacterCard = self.active_entry["card"]

        pool = card.get_greetings_pool()
        if pool and self.current_greeting_idx < len(pool) and pool[self.current_greeting_idx]["orig"]:
            source_text = pool[self.current_greeting_idx]["orig"]
        else:
            source_text = self.input_first_mes.toPlainText().strip()

        if not source_text:
            return

        sys_prompt = CardTranslator.build_field_prompt("first_mes")

        def _apply_first_mes(translated_text: str):
            card.set_greeting_variant(self.current_greeting_idx, translated_text, is_ru=True)
            if self.active_entry and self.active_entry["card"] == card:
                self._showing_ru = True
                if hasattr(self, "btn_toggle_lang"):
                    self.btn_toggle_lang.setText("🌐 RU / EN")
                self.input_first_mes.setPlainText(translated_text)
            TavernParser.save_card_translations(card)
            self._save_changes(silent=True)

        self._execute_translation_pipeline(source_text, sys_prompt, self.btn_tr_first_mes, _apply_first_mes)

    def _on_translate_all_clicked(self):
        """Translates all character card fields via parent window task."""
        if not self.active_entry:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Внимание", "Пожалуйста, выберите персонажа.")
            return

        parent_win = self.parent()
        if not parent_win or not hasattr(parent_win, "_translate_character_card_task"):
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Ошибка", "Метод перевода недоступен.")
            return

        card: CharacterCard = self.active_entry["card"]

        # Sync inputs to card only if not showing RU and fields are not empty
        self._save_current_greeting_text()
        if self.input_name.text().strip():
            card.name = self.input_name.text().strip()
        if hasattr(self, "input_visual_dna") and self.input_visual_dna.toPlainText().strip():
            card.visual_dna = self.input_visual_dna.toPlainText().strip()

        if not getattr(self, "_showing_ru", False):
            if self.input_desc.toPlainText().strip():
                card.description = self.input_desc.toPlainText().strip()
            if self.input_personality.toPlainText().strip():
                card.personality = self.input_personality.toPlainText().strip()
            if self.input_scenario.toPlainText().strip():
                card.scenario = self.input_scenario.toPlainText().strip()
            if hasattr(self, "input_system_prompt") and self.input_system_prompt.toPlainText().strip():
                card.system_prompt = self.input_system_prompt.toPlainText().strip()
            if self.input_mes_example.toPlainText().strip():
                card.mes_example = self.input_mes_example.toPlainText().strip()

        self.btn_translate_all.setEnabled(False)
        if hasattr(self.btn_translate_all, "update_step_progress"):
            self.btn_translate_all.update_step_progress(1, 1, "Подготовка...")
        else:
            self.btn_translate_all.setText("⏳ Перевод карточки...")

        def _on_all_done(success: bool, res_dict=None):
            if hasattr(self.btn_translate_all, "reset_state"):
                self.btn_translate_all.reset_state(success=success)
            else:
                self.btn_translate_all.setEnabled(True)
                self.btn_translate_all.setText("🌐 Перевести всю карточку (RU)")
            if success:
                self._showing_ru = True
                if hasattr(self, "btn_toggle_lang"):
                    self.btn_toggle_lang.setText("🌐 RU / EN [RU]")
                    self.btn_toggle_lang.setToolTip("Отображается: Русский перевод (RU). Нажмите для переключения на оригинал (EN).")

                if isinstance(res_dict, dict) and res_dict:
                    if res_dict.get("DESCRIPTION"):
                        card.description_ru = res_dict["DESCRIPTION"]
                    if res_dict.get("PERSONALITY"):
                        card.personality_ru = res_dict["PERSONALITY"]
                    if res_dict.get("SCENARIO"):
                        card.scenario_ru = res_dict["SCENARIO"]
                    if res_dict.get("MES_EXAMPLE"):
                        card.mes_example_ru = res_dict["MES_EXAMPLE"]
                    if res_dict.get("FIRST_MES"):
                        card.first_mes_ru = res_dict["FIRST_MES"]

                    if hasattr(card, "alternate_greetings") and card.alternate_greetings:
                        alt_ru = list(getattr(card, "alternate_greetings_ru", []) or [])
                        while len(alt_ru) < len(card.alternate_greetings):
                            alt_ru.append("")
                        for idx in range(len(card.alternate_greetings)):
                            key = f"ALT_GREETING_{idx+1}"
                            if res_dict.get(key):
                                alt_ru[idx] = res_dict[key]
                        card.alternate_greetings_ru = alt_ru

                if self.active_entry and self.active_entry["card"] == card:
                    self.input_desc.setPlainText(card.description_ru or card.description or "")
                    self.input_personality.setPlainText(card.personality_ru or card.personality or "")
                    self.input_scenario.setPlainText(card.scenario_ru or card.scenario or "")
                    self.input_mes_example.setPlainText(card.mes_example_ru or card.mes_example or "")
                    if hasattr(self, "_update_greeting_display"):
                        self._update_greeting_display()
                    if hasattr(self, "_update_sections_visibility"):
                        self._update_sections_visibility()
                    TavernParser.save_card_translations(card)
                    self._save_changes(silent=True)
                else:
                    TavernParser.save_card_translations(card)

                QMessageBox.information(self, "Успех", f"Карточка '{card.name}' успешно переведена на русский язык!")
            else:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "Ошибка", "Не удалось перевести карточку.")

        translate_fn = getattr(parent_win, "_translate_character_card_task", None)
        if translate_fn:
            progress_cb = getattr(self.btn_translate_all, "update_step_progress", None)
            try:
                translate_fn(card, on_complete=_on_all_done, on_progress=progress_cb)
            except TypeError:
                translate_fn(card, on_complete=_on_all_done)

class SamplingSlider(Slider):
    """
    Кастомный слайдер для параметров рендера:
    - Плавное и естественное перетаскивание бегунка зажатой ЛКМ
    - Живой трекинг в реальном времени self.setTracking(True)
    - ClickFocus и отключение случайного wheelEvent
    """
    def __init__(self, orientation=Qt.Orientation.Horizontal, parent=None):
        super().__init__(orientation, parent=parent)
        self.setTracking(True)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
        self.handle.installEventFilter(self)

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event):
        if watched == self.handle:
            if event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonPress:
                if event.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    return True
                self._pressedPos = self.handle.mapToParent(event.pos())
            elif event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseMove:
                if event.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    slider_pos = self.handle.mapToParent(event.pos())
                    self.setValue(self._posToValue(slider_pos))
                    self._pressedPos = slider_pos
                    self.sliderMoved.emit(self.value())
                    return True
                return True
            elif event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease:
                if event.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    return True
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def mousePressEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent):
        if e.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            e.ignore()
            return
        super().mousePressEvent(e)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent):
        if not (e.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton):
            e.ignore()
            return
        super().mouseMoveEvent(e)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, e: QMouseEvent):
        if e.button() != Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            e.ignore()
            return
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(e)

    def wheelEvent(self, e):
        e.ignore()


class SamplingDoubleSpinBox(DoubleSpinBox):
    """
    Числовой счетчик с плавающей точкой (CFG Scale, Денойз Hires):
    - Стрелки с точным шагом
    - Отключение wheelEvent во избежание случайного скролла
    """
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.ClickFocus)
        try:
            self.downButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.downButton.clicked.connect(self.stepDown)
        try:
            self.upButton.clicked.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.upButton.clicked.connect(self.stepUp)

    def stepDown(self):
        new_val = max(self.minimum(), self.value() - self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(round(new_val, self.decimals()))

    def stepUp(self):
        new_val = min(self.maximum(), self.value() + self.singleStep())
        self.setValue(round(new_val, self.decimals()))

    def wheelEvent(self, e):
        e.ignore()

class FluentTextEdit(TextEdit):

    TextEdit с методами text() и setText() для строковой совместимости.
    """
    def text(self) -> str:

class RoutingTestWorker(QThread):
    result_ready = pyqtSignal(str, float, str, list)  # (best_id, score, reason, snapshot_profiles)
    error_occurred = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, text: str, profiles: List[Dict[str, Any]], router: ModelRouter, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.text = text
        self.profiles = profiles
        self.router = router
        self._is_aborted = False

    def abort(self):
        self._is_aborted = True
        self.requestInterruption()

    def run(self):
        if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
            return
        try:
            winner_id, score, reason = self.router.match_prompt_detailed(self.text, profiles=self.profiles)
            if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
                return
            if not winner_id:
                if not (self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested()):
                    self.error_occurred.emit("Не удалось определить подходящую модель среди активных.")
                return
            if not (self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested()):
                self.result_ready.emit(winner_id, score, reason, self.profiles)
        except Exception as e:
            if not (self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested()):
                logger.error(f"[RoutingTestWorker] Ошибка тестирования маршрутизации: {e}", exc_info=True)
                self.error_occurred.emit(str(e))


class ForgeScanWorker(QThread):
    scan_completed = pyqtSignal(list, list, list)  # (raw_models, installed_checkpoints, upscalers)
    scan_failed = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, forge_client: ForgeClient, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.forge_client = forge_client
        self._is_aborted = False

    def abort(self):
        self._is_aborted = True
        self.requestInterruption()

    def run(self):
        if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
            return
        try:
            raw_models = self.forge_client.get_models() or []
        except Exception:
            raw_models = []

        if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
            return

        try:
            installed = self.forge_client.get_installed_checkpoints() or []
        except Exception:
            installed = []

        if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
            return

        try:
            upscalers = self.forge_client.get_upscalers() or []
        except Exception:
            upscalers = []

        if not (self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested()):
            self.scan_completed.emit(raw_models, installed, upscalers)


class CivitaiParamsWorker(QThread):
    params_ready = pyqtSignal(dict)
    error_occurred = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, checkpoint: str, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.checkpoint = checkpoint
        self._is_aborted = False

    def abort(self):
        self._is_aborted = True
        self.requestInterruption()

    def run(self):
        if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
            return
        try:
            from services.civitai_service import fetch_civitai_parameters
            params = fetch_civitai_parameters(self.checkpoint)
            if not (self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested()):
                self.params_ready.emit(params)
        except Exception as e:
            if not (self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested()):
                logger.error(f"[CivitaiParamsWorker] Ошибка запроса Civitai: {e}", exc_info=True)
                self.error_occurred.emit(str(e))


class FP8ConvertWorker(QThread):
    progress_updated = pyqtSignal(str)
    conversion_finished = pyqtSignal(str)
    conversion_failed = pyqtSignal(str)

    def __init__(self, python_exe: str, script_path: Path, input_checkpoint_path: Path, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.python_exe = str(python_exe)
        self.script_path = Path(script_path)
        self.input_checkpoint_path = Path(input_checkpoint_path)
        self.dst_path = self.input_checkpoint_path.with_name(
            f"{self.input_checkpoint_path.stem}_fp8e4{self.input_checkpoint_path.suffix}"
        )
        self.output_path = self.dst_path
        self._is_aborted = False
        self.process: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None

    def abort(self):
        self._is_aborted = True
        self.requestInterruption()
        if self.process is not None and self.process.poll() is None:
            try:
                self.process.terminate()
            except Exception:
                try:
                    self.process.kill()
                except Exception:
                    pass

    def run(self):
        if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
            return

        startupinfo = None
        creationflags = 0
        import sys
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
            startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
            startupinfo.wShowWindow = 0  # SW_HIDE
            creationflags = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW

        cmd = [
            self.python_exe,
            str(self.script_path),
            str(self.input_checkpoint_path),
            str(self.dst_path)
        ]

        try:
            self.process = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                text=True,
                bufsize=1,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
                startupinfo=startupinfo,
                creationflags=creationflags
            )

            if self.process.stdout:
                for line in self.process.stdout:
                    if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
                        break
                    stripped = line.strip()
                    if stripped:
                        self.progress_updated.emit(stripped)

            if self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested():
                if self.process.poll() is None:
                    try:
                        self.process.terminate()
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                return

            ret = self.process.wait()
            if ret == 0 and self.dst_path.exists() and self.dst_path.stat().st_size > 0:
                self.conversion_finished.emit(str(self.dst_path))
            else:
                self.conversion_failed.emit(f"Код завершения: {ret}")
        except Exception as e:
            if not (self._is_aborted or self.isInterruptionRequested()):
                logger.error(f"[FP8ConvertWorker] Ошибка выполнения: {e}", exc_info=True)
                self.conversion_failed.emit(str(e))
        finally:
            self.process = None

"""
Engineer Task Card Widget for NeonRoute.
Monolithic Agent Activity Stream (Cursor Composer / Devin style canvas) for autonomous Engineering Mode.
Features:
- Pure PyQt-Fluent-Widgets & PyQt6 component foundation
- Monolithic translucent task canvas occupying 100% feed width (rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65), 10px radius, 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08))
- Fully removed avatar column and speech bubble asymmetry (no left indent, no speech tail)
- Activity Header: real-time phase indicator (⚡ RUNNING · 2.4s / ✓ COMPLETED / ✕ FAILED), active skill badge [🎮 Игры и GUI], stop/action buttons
- Smooth collapsible architecture spoiler (SmoothSpoiler) with QPropertyAnimation & QEasingCurve
- Execution Stepper: compact vertical action log (glyphs ✓, ⟳, ●, target paths, [📄 В инспектор] buttons)
- Clean summary box without raw unformatted code dumps
- Strict Qt Use-After-Free guard (sip.isdeleted checks) and cross-session race condition safety
"""

import re
import html
import time
import uuid
import logging
from pathlib import Path
